descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

3242 -  AV Business Director (12 month FTC - Betfred)

Role Summary and Impact

Reporting into the Deputy Head Of AV, you will be the Senior AV representative for EMN, from our Team to all clients, Media Owners to senior internal stakeholders across our UK business. This involves delivering the best in market AV output through our team for our clients, senior commercial support of the business, overall team development and a proactive relationship with our senior media owner partners to solidify EM’s reputation across the UK as a market leader.

As an AV Director you will be expected to see the Bigger Picture and overarching AV and Video strategies for all of our clients.

You will work closely with your senior counterparts in the planning, strategy, digital, PRO and Creative Future departments to understand our client’s business needs, with a view to our team delivering knowledgeable, accurate and innovative AV approaches across the board that can really drive our client’s business forward.

In collaboration with our senior digital, social and creative future colleagues, review then improve our wider agency video investment capabilities today – benchmarking them and identifying where we can get better.

You will lead on all AV senior media partner relationships, driving efficiencies in our approach across the market. Ensure all senior contact strategies are relevant throughout EMN and that we are always front of mind for all market opportunities.

Play a leading role in our AV thinking in new business pitching and organic business development, leveraging media partner relationships to bolster our thinking and ideas.

From a Bigger Picture perspective, you will support the marketing of the agency. This will include but not limited to, creating and leading internal/external media insight events (Thinkbox Tevevisionaries, AV week etc) the writing of market leading case studies and contribute to award entries where required.

Responsibilities of the role:

People:

  • Ensure the AV team deliver our new essencemediacom breakthrough thinking and culture principles in everything we do from learning everyday to building better together, always inclusive and celebrate every success.
  • Lead our overall team management and development. Proactively shape, clearly communicate, and proactively implement new ways of working across all levels of our team (1 – 5.5), manage all learning and growth opportunities as well develop our culture with input from the wider AV team, making EMN the place to work.
  • Demonstrate effective management of all of our AV team. Ensure the team is motivated, challenged, and given the opportunity to develop.
  • Work closely and support the Head of AV to constantly review full Team ways of working and involve yourself in developing and improving process as well as team efficiency. Manage feedback from across the team as senior management and address as required.
  • Embrace any new ways of working with tenacity and take the AV team on that learning journey.
  • Continue and grow the already existing trust and confidence you have of senior internal UK stakeholders, senior clients, industry leads (such as Thinkbox) and senior Media Owners across the video media marketplace.
  • Ensure your profile is always raised across the senior management team in EM UK.
  • The senior EMN AV representative. For all clients, media partners and internal stake holders across our UK business.

Product / Output: AV Operations

  • In support of the Deputy Head Of AV, help lead our overall AV offering to clients and market.
  • Be responsible for the overall strategic planning output across the AV team.
  • Ensure, in collaboration with our senior Planning colleagues that the AV briefing, planning, implementation and reporting outputs are as efficient, relevant and at all points fit for purpose.
  • High level of presentation skills required, with the ability to present at short notice to a range of audiences both internally and externally.
  • Ensure our AV team maintains zero errors across everything we do, with recommendations being supported with rationale and clear understanding.
  • Think Digital First: Be digitally literate in the field of AV and ensure our team are putting data at the heart of plans.
  • Push the boundaries. Ensure our team are confident in challenging briefs and deliver innovation/new thinking wherever possible across everything we do as AV.
  • Show a genuine, proactive interest in industry research with a view to producing award-winning work across our team.
  • Be adaptable, pro-active, demonstrate an ability to change approach or tweak work based on feedback and changing circumstances to meet the needs of our team, clients and colleagues.
  • You will be ultimately responsible for the buying output of our team, ensure best practice approach to buying is followed by all of you reports.
  • Ensure all trading requirements are monitored, managed, communicated, and met across all AV channels.
  • Be the senior person for escalation issues across the Team, both internally and externally.

Commercial:

  • Commercial awareness - understand what is needed to make essencemediacom UK a successful business and work closely with the senior commercial and UK trading team to help deliver this across our AV Team.
  • Ultimately responsible for our team’s output for audits and delivering PRF’s.
  • Ensure all financial procedures are adhered to and your accounts are SOx compliant.
  • Senior RMN and UK Commercial Remit. Demonstrate a clear understanding of central trading strategy, support however required UK key partners and help to deliver and report against trading objectives set by the UK, EMN Leadership and Commercial teams.
  • Understand the commercial mechanics that effect our team,
  • Lead our AV thinking in new business pitching and organic business development, leveraging media partner relationships to bolster our thinking and ideas.

Skills and Experience

You will have an extensive knowledge of the AV market, market mechanics (including audits) and all AV tools used, ensuring specialism excellence in the overall Teams output.   

The role requires long term proof of strong leadership, proactive strategic thinking, great communication skills with an ability to flex your style dependent on personality type, numeracy acumen, strong presentation skills, history of being a team player, individual and team development, resilience, and the ability to remain calm under pressure.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.  

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. title: B2B Marketing Manager, DACH
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes directly to our mission of responsible and widespread AI adoption.

The EMEA B2B Marketing team translates global priorities into regionally relevant programs that drive awareness, consideration, pipeline, adoption, and long-term customer trust. We partner closely with Sales and GTM, Product Marketing, Field and Executive Marketing, Content, Customer Marketing, Partner Marketing, Comms, Events, Marketing Operations, and regional leadership.

DACH is one of OpenAI’s most important markets in EMEA. Our opportunity spans major enterprises and digital natives, ambitious startups, developers, partners, and a highly influential business community navigating the adoption of AI.

About the Role

As the B2B Marketing Manager for DACH, you will own the integrated B2B marketing strategy and execution for Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

You will be a close commercial partner to local Sales and GTM leadership, translating market insight, revenue priorities, target-account needs, and global launches into locally relevant programs that create pipeline, accelerate complex opportunities, deepen customer relationships, and grow adoption.

You will carry clear pipeline goals and be accountable for Marketing’s measurable contribution to commercial outcomes in DACH. These goals will be established through the regional planning process and will evolve with the priorities and maturity of the market. You will be expected to understand the pipeline, make informed investment decisions, and demonstrate how marketing activity creates, influences, or accelerates revenue opportunities.

This is a generalist role spanning field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based programs, content, customer marketing, partnerships, events, and product launches. You will bring these channels together into a focused DACH B2B plan, drawing on specialist capabilities within the EMEA B2B Marketing team in London and global Marketing teams. A particularly important partnership will be with the DACH Consumer Marketing Lead: together, you will align market strategy, narratives, launches, audience priorities, channels, and major moments so B2B and B2C activity is coordinated, complementary, and mutually reinforcing.

Close partnership with Marketing Operations will be crucial. Together, you will establish campaign infrastructure, audience and account segmentation, attribution, reporting, and operating rhythms that give Sales and Marketing a reliable view of performance and inform where the team should invest next.

The role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: shaping the market plan, participating in pipeline reviews, developing a priority-account program, adapting a global campaign, briefing an agency, supporting an executive event, and personally unblocking delivery when needed.

This role is preferably based in Munich. Berlin may be considered for an exceptional candidate. Regular travel within DACH and to London will be required.

In this role, you will:

  • Own and execute the integrated DACH B2B marketing plan, aligned with regional priorities, local revenue goals, market opportunities, and customer needs. Partner closely with the DACH Consumer Marketing Lead to ensure B2B and B2C strategies and activities are coordinated and complementary, while retaining clear accountability for B2B pipeline and revenue outcomes.

  • Carry pipeline goals for DACH B2B marketing and be accountable for demonstrating measurable contribution to pipeline creation, influence, opportunity progression, and revenue outcomes.

  • Partner closely with DACH Sales and GTM leadership on territory planning, target-account prioritisation, pipeline goals, strategic opportunities, and quarterly business reviews.

  • Build full-funnel programs across field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based marketing, content, customer advocacy, partnerships, events, and digital channels.

  • Design programs around priority accounts and buying groups, tailoring narratives and engagement for senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—and connecting customer proof, partner participation, content, and seller follow-up to create or advance opportunities.

  • Work in close partnership with Marketing Operations to define target audiences, establish campaigns, maintain data and process quality, track performance, improve attribution, and turn results into clear recommendations.

  • Build a regular Sales, Marketing, and Marketing Operations pacing rhythm covering pipeline performance, account engagement, campaign conversion, opportunity follow-up, risks, and investment decisions.

  • Translate global campaigns, product launches, narratives, and assets into locally relevant programs that reflect DACH market dynamics, language, industry priorities, and customer expectations.

  • Work with EMEA specialist teams in London to bring the strongest regional capabilities into the market, while serving as the voice of DACH in regional planning and prioritisation.

  • Develop locally relevant customer stories and advocacy opportunities in partnership with Sales, Customer Success, Customer Marketing, Comms, and senior customer stakeholders.

  • Build joint programs with strategic technology, consulting, and implementation partners where they can extend reach, strengthen customer value, or contribute to pipeline.

  • Own the operating rhythm for DACH B2B marketing, including planning, budget management, agency coordination, campaign pacing, performance reporting, and prioritisation.

  • Build repeatable playbooks and share market learning across EMEA, helping the wider organisation understand what resonates with DACH customers and decision-makers.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 12+ years of experience in integrated B2B, regional, field, demand generation, or account-based marketing, ideally in enterprise technology, cloud, AI, or SaaS.

  • Have a proven track record of driving measurable pipeline and revenue impact through integrated B2B marketing programs, ideally within large, complex enterprise sales cycles.

  • Have supported high-value products with long sales cycles, multiple decision-makers, and significant commercial scrutiny, and are familiar with engaging senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—throughout complex buying journeys.

  • Have held pipeline goals or comparable commercial targets and can clearly demonstrate how your marketing decisions created, influenced, or accelerated revenue opportunities.

  • Have partnered closely with enterprise sellers and Sales leadership on account prioritisation, pipeline reviews, opportunity acceleration, executive engagement, and follow-up.

  • Have worked closely with Marketing Operations on campaign architecture, segmentation, lead and account processes, measurement, attribution, and performance reporting.

  • Are comfortable using pipeline and campaign data to diagnose performance, make trade-offs, and redirect investment—not simply report activity.

  • Are a marketing generalist with experience connecting multiple channels into one coherent market plan, rather than operating within a single specialist discipline, and have a strong track record of partnering with consumer marketing leaders to integrate B2B and B2C strategy and activity without blurring ownership.

  • Understand DACH enterprise buying dynamics and can translate local customer, industry, cultural, and regulatory context into stronger marketing decisions.

  • Can balance local market needs with regional and global priorities, influencing effectively within a matrixed international organisation.

  • Are both strategic and hands-on: able to establish direction and operating structure while personally driving high-priority work to completion.

  • Bring strong commercial judgement, operational discipline, and the ability to make clear prioritisation decisions when opportunities exceed available capacity.

  • Communicate credibly with senior customer decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—as well as Sales, Marketing, and partner stakeholders.

  • Are energised by AI and motivated to help organisations across DACH adopt transformative technology responsibly.

  • Are fluent in German and English.

title: Billing Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs is scaling fast – new enterprise customers, new products, new markets. The Billing Operations Specialist is the person who makes sure every deal that closes is reflected correctly in our systems.

This is an operational ownership role, sitting at the intersection of Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Engineering – responsible for the full billing lifecycle of our enterprise accounts, from provisioning a new customer on day one to cleanly closing out a churned account. You'll resolve discrepancies before customers notice them, catch configuration drift before it becomes a revenue problem, and build the processes that make billing feel invisible to everyone else. You'll also work on projects and programs that evolve the sophistication of our billing processes and our tooling, and help with things like pricing migrations and other critical efforts.

The ideal person is someone who is obsessive about accuracy and automation, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and energized (not frustrated) by the complexity of managing billing at scale across thousands of accounts.

Provisioning

  • Translate closed-won deals from Salesforce into correctly configured subscriptions in our billing platforms, such as Stripe – pricing plan, billing interval, contract start date, trial periods, discounts

  • Own the reconciliation between executed order forms and what's been requested for provisioning; work with Sales and Legal to resolve any gaps

  • Partner with Engineering to identify automation opportunities and build guardrails that make provisioning faster and more accurate over time

Subscription & account management

  • Process mid-cycle changes and manage renewal mechanics – upgrades, downgrades, seat changes, plan switches, and so on.

  • Handle offboarding cleanly: close subscriptions, issue final invoices or credits, ensure no residual billing

  • Resolve invoice discrepancies raised by customers or flagged by the Customer Success team – incorrect amounts, missing credits, misapplied discounts

Revenue integrity

  • Run periodic audits of active subscriptions to verify billing matches contracted terms

  • Identify and remediate ghost subscriptions, duplicate customers, and orphaned invoices

  • Support month-end and quarter-end close by reconciling billing platforms with Finance's records

  • Surface pricing or configuration anomalies to relevant teams.

Requirements

Must-have

  • 2-5 years in billing operations, revenue operations, finance operations or a similar role supporting B2B or enterprise customers (adjust the range for level)

  • Hands-on experience with a subscription billing platform, ideally Stripe Billing or similar (Chargebee, Zuora, Recurly), including subscriptions, invoices, credits, coupons and billing intervals

  • Experience turning closed-won deals and order forms into correct billing configurations (pricing plan, start date, trial, discounts)

  • Strong attention to detail and a record of catching discrepancies before customers do

  • Can read a contract or order form and spot gaps against what was requested for provisioning

  • Experience reconciling billing data to finance records, including supporting month-end or quarter-end close

  • Comfort working with Salesforce (or another CRM) as the source of truth for deals

  • Clear written communication and ability to work across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal and Engineering

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and with managing a high volume of accounts without losing track

Strong plus

  • Experience with usage-based or hybrid pricing

  • Familiarity with SQL, spreadsheets at scale (pivots, lookups), or BI tools, for audits and reconciliation

  • Experience building automation or scripts, or partnering with Engineering on guardrails (APIs, webhooks, no-code tools)

  • Experience running subscription audits, such as finding ghost subscriptions, duplicate customers and orphaned invoices

  • Experience with pricing migrations or billing-system migrations

  • Exposure to ASC 606 or revenue recognition basics

  • Experience with a quote-to-cash stack (CPQ, contract management, ERP such as NetSuite)

  • Experience at a high-growth SaaS or AI company

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States or Europe.

title: BLP Academy Facilitator
descriptionHtml:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based at our HQ in central Zurich. The BLP Academy happens in person, and so does this role: you are in the room with our clients for every cohort.

Your Mission

You run the room. Two to three days in Zurich that set the tone for every implementation that follows.

Before a project kicks off, our clients send the people who will carry it, their BLP Champions, to the BLP Academy. They learn hands-on on our platform, work through real project scenarios, and meet peers from other enterprises facing the same challenges. Across 1,300+ projects, the customer team has made the difference between a smooth and a slow implementation, so these days matter.

You make them count. You welcome every participant, run and own the sessions, and set the energy in the room from the first coffee to the last evening. You bring in our BLP experts for deep dives and make sure their expertise lands. Our clients go home certified, connected and ready for their implementation, after an unforgettable few days in Zurich. And as BLP expands across Europe and North America, the Academy will grow with it, with you shaping what that looks like.

That takes an unusual mix: part entertainer, part teacher, part professor, with a real curiosity for processes and AI. We care less about where you come from than about what happens when you walk into a room. You will join a fast-growing, global AI company and a team that brings real energy to everything it does. If you light up a room and make complex things simple at the same time, read on.

Key Responsibilities

In the room

  • Host every Academy cohort in Zurich: welcome our clients, set the tone, and be their main point of contact from arrival to departure.

  • Lead the sessions: present, explain, and guide participants through hands-on exercises on the BLP platform.

  • Pace every hands-on block to the room, giving fast learners space to go deeper while making sure nobody gets left behind.

  • Moderate the deep-dive sessions with BLP experts and connect their content to each participant's situation.

  • Keep the energy high across two to three intense days, and host the evenings and everything around the program.

Around each cohort

  • Get every participant ready before they arrive, so the Academy starts with momentum on day one.

  • Make sure every participant completes the BLP Champion Certification and goes home ready for their implementation.

  • Collect feedback and participant NPS, and make every cohort better than the last.

Beyond the classroom

  • Bring the Academy experience to new formats as they launch, from online learning programs for our clients and certification for our implementation partners to onboarding for new BLP colleagues.

What We're Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Energy – You bring the room to life on day one and still have it on day three, evenings included.

  • Owning a Room – You lead groups with confidence, from senior client audiences to hands-on sessions, and know when to push, when to pause and when to make people laugh.

  • Patience and Empathy – You notice who is struggling before they say so, and you adapt the pace of a hands-on session to each participant.

  • Communication – You make complex topics simple and convincing, and you can tell whether a participant has really understood or is just nodding.

  • Credibility – You hold your own with senior experts and executives, because you think in structures and understand what you are talking about.

  • Curiosity for Processes and AI – You want to understand how enterprise processes run and what AI changes about them, and you learn fast.

  • Host Mindset – You care that every participant has a great experience, keep a multi-day program running smoothly, and notice the details that make it work.

What You Bring

  • You know how to lead a room, whether that’s a workshop, a training, an event or a client meeting, ideally with senior audiences. We care more about how you got that experience than where: consulting, teaching, events, tech or team leadership all count.

  • You’ve gained several years of professional and relevant experience, in any industry or along any path.

  • You’re excited about AI and how it changes the way businesses work, and you can’t wait to get to know the BLP platform inside out.

  • You’re fluent in German and English, both spoken and written. This is a must, because you’ll run Academy sessions in both languages, often for senior client audiences.

  • Proven experience designing and delivering trainings, workshops, or customer onboarding sessions yourself, ideally to business or technical audiences.

  • Experience with ERP systems or finance processes, workshop or event formats, or AI-driven SaaS is a plus.

How You Grow

As BLP grows, the Academy grows with it, and so does this role. You will be close to our clients, our experts and our leadership, which opens doors across the company as we expand.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you own the Academy experience and shape how our clients start their BLP journey.

  • Impact at scale – every cohort you run shapes implementations at enterprises across Europe.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with project managers, consultants, engineers, product teams and our clients daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Energized team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators who bring energy to everything they do.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Offsites – including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about BLP and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers.

Tu intégreras l'équipe Communication et travailleras au quotidien avec les équipes Sales, RH, Product, la Direction ainsi qu'avec nos prestataires externes.

Tu auras pour mission de :

  • Faire évoluer notre identité visuelle sur l'ensemble de nos supports, produits et marchés, et en garantir la cohérence au quotidien.

  • Concevoir les créations de nos campagnes marketing : publicités, réseaux sociaux, emails, lancements produits et communications clients.

  • Rendre accessibles des sujets complexes (gestion des dépenses, finance, conformité, IA) grâce à des illustrations, infographies, schémas et vidéos.

  • Créer nos supports commerciaux et institutionnels : présentations, brochures, fiches produits, témoignages clients, documents corporate.

title: Business Development Intern
descriptionHtml:
Big changes start with people who want to achieve more.

How do employees get to work? Why do company cars sit idle while parking spaces are scarce? And how can we make sustainable mobility the most attractive choice?

At Urban Connect, we turn these challenges into practical solutions. We bring shared e-bikes and company cars, public transport, mobility budgets and digital parking management together on one platform. We help companies reduce costs, make better use of resources and give their employees greater freedom.

Companies such as Roche, Google, SWISS and Lonza already rely on us. Our ambition goes further: we want to transform how companies manage mobility.

To make that happen, we are looking for curious minds who take ownership and want to make a difference together.

Your internship: accelerated learning, real responsibility

Want to understand how a technology company grows—and help make it happen?

During this six-month internship, you will work closely with our Sales and Account Management team, as well as Product and Operations. You will learn to understand customer needs, develop compelling solutions and turn data into tangible business opportunities.

Your initiative matters. You will contribute your own ideas, take on increasing responsibility and see the impact of your work.

How you will make a difference

  • Turn data into opportunities: analyse usage and market data, including vehicle and parking utilisation, and translate your findings into recommendations for better corporate mobility solutions.

  • Drive your own projects: Work with the team lead to take ownership of clearly defined projects, such as analysing products, assessing sales opportunities and developing corporate mobility concepts.

  • Understand the product: learn how customers are set up on our platform, how bookings and billing work, and how vehicles and parking barriers are connected.

  • Work smarter with AI: use AI tools thoughtfully, test new applications and help us improve research, analysis and everyday processes.

  • Help drive growth: identify prospective customers, research their challenges and support the team in winning new business and expanding existing partnerships.

  • Make a compelling case: create clear presentations, well-founded proposals and insightful quarterly reviews that demonstrate the value of our solutions.

  • Keep things moving: maintain accurate customer data and activities in HubSpot, ensuring good conversations lead to clear next steps.

  • Connect teams: resolve technical questions with the Product, Operations and Technology teams and communicate the answers clearly to customers and the Commercial team.

What you bring

  • An excellent degree, for example in business, economics, data science, engineering or industrial engineering. We are looking for excellence, curiosity, creativity and courage - not to have studied a perfect subject.

  • Some practical experience through an internship, part-time job, personal project or entrepreneurial initiative.

  • An analytical mindset, confidence with Excel and the ability to understand and communicate complex ideas and interdependencies clearly and simply.

  • Ability to think outside of the box and to question conventional ways of doing things.

  • Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot - and the excellent judgement to critically assess their output. In fact, good judgment is a key criterion for success with us.

  • An interest in technological progress, the curiosity to truly understand how things work, and the confidence to contribute your questions and ideas to a highly motivated team.

  • Excellent German and good English skills. French is a big plus.

Above all, we value your mindset: you learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions and think ahead. You take initiative, develop suggestions and seek support when you need it. You care about the details, strive to make good work even better and are willing to take a risk sometimes to try something new - even when that means making a mistake and learning from it.

What you can expect

High standards - and an environment of smart, kind people to challenge you to grow.
We are ambitious, give direct, constructive feedback and support one another. Excellence shows up in our everyday work: in thoughtful solutions, careful execution and the drive to keep improving.

A view of the whole business.
You will work at the intersection of sales, customer success, technology and operations, learning how an idea becomes a solution that customers value.

Direct access and room to take initiative.
Good ideas get heard quickly here. Your responsibility grows with your capabilities and commitment.

The opportunity to build a future with us.
If we are a good fit for each other, there is an opportunity to join Urban Connect beyond the internship and grow with the company.

You will also benefit from:

  • Flexible working hours and a beautiful office in Zurich.

  • A monthly mobility budget and access to our e-bikes and shared electric cars.

  • A motivated team that enjoys working together (mostly in person), sharing knowledge, growing together, and celebrating success together!

Ready to make a difference?

Send us your CV and a few personal lines: Why Urban Connect? And what are you proud of having initiated, solved or improved yourself?

We look forward to meeting you.

descriptionHtml:
Your Mission

As Business Development & Tender Manager NL (all genders) you will identify and drive new business opportunities to help the company grow and become a market leader in the Netherlands.

This high-visibility role combines business development, commercial strategy, value proposition development, tender leadership, strategic account management (municipalities, grid operator, ecosystem partners), as well as stakeholder management. You will not only grow ubitricity presence in the market, building strong relationships with public authorities, key stakeholders and relevant institutions but also develop and adapt our value proposition to the local needs. You will be instrumental in developing and improving our product and service offering. You will be accountable in particular for network size and securing new contracts.

We are looking for highly-motivated individuals with a commercial background, clear business acumen and strong communication skills, who can successfully drive major tenders and develop the Dutch market in line with ubitricity goals and ambition.

Based in our Amsterdam office on Keizersgracht 452, you'll be part of an international, collaborative team that values trust, ownership and open communication. We work in a hybrid setup with three days per week in the office, balancing flexibility with meaningful in-person collaboration. Regular travel within the Netherlands will allow you to build strong relationships with partners and municipalities and make a tangible impact on the country's transition to sustainable mobility.

Responsibilities

  • Owning and leading major public tenders from end to end, bringing together cross-functional teams, coordinating key stakeholders and driving competitive, high-quality bids through to contract award and signature.
  • Identifying and securing new business opportunities with public authorities and strategic partners across the Netherlands.
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with decision-makers at national, regional and local government level.
  • Shaping and executing ubitricity's commercial strategy and value proposition in the Dutch market.
  • Representing ubitricity at industry events, conferences, trade fairs and market consultations, strengthening our visibility and influence across the sector.
  • Acting as a trusted ambassador for ubitricity within key industry organisations such as NAL, NKL and Elaad.
  • Leading commercial negotiations with public authorities, grid operators and other strategic stakeholders.
  • Building and expanding a strong network across the Dutch energy and e-mobility ecosystem.
  • Monitoring market developments, regulatory trends and competitive dynamics to identify new growth opportunities.
  • Contributing to industry working groups and helping shape the future of smart and grid-aware charging solutions.

Your profile

We're looking for a commercially driven professional who combines strategic thinking with the ability to build relationships and turn opportunities into results.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in business development, tender management, public affairs, sales or a comparable commercial role.

  • Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to influence decision-makers and build long-term partnerships.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Experience in the e-mobility, energy or infrastructure sector is advantageous.
  • Experience with public procurement, B2G sales or tender processes is advantageous.
  • Full professional proficiency in Dutch and English, with the ability to engage confidently with public authorities and senior stakeholders.

Our Offer

Why Join ubitricity?

  • Help accelerate the transition to cleaner and more sustainable transportation.
  • Work in an international and purpose-driven company with ambitious growth plans.

  • Collaborate with passionate colleagues across Europe.

Diversity & Inclusion

At ubitricity, we believe that diverse teams build better solutions. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and identities. title: Business Informatie Analist Backend Platform
descriptionHtml:
Bouw jij mee aan betrouwbaar functioneel beheer voor applicaties die onze collega’s dagelijks nodig hebben?

Wie ben jij

Als je aan de slag gaat bij het bedrijfsonderdeel IT, dan ga je de uitdaging aan om Univé fit en wendbaar te houden - in alle IT-opzichten. Je zal terechtkomen op de afdeling IT Kern binnen het team Backend Platform en je richten op de verzekerings- en/of HR-processen.

In algemene zin vinden we het belangrijk dat je:

  • HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau hebt met een relevante vakgerichte opleiding;

  • minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in de IT;

  • kennis hebt van methoden en technieken op het gebied van requirements engineering, data- en procesmodellering;

  • nieuwsgierig bent naar nieuwe IT ontwikkelingen en innovatie oplossingen kunt bedenken;

  • bedrijfsprocessen en behoeftes kunt vertalen naar effectieve oplossingen;

  • ervaring hebt met Agile werken;

  • initiatief neemt en proactief handelt;

  • ervaring hebt met de applicaties Level (van leverancier CCS) en/of AFAS (pré).

Wat ga je doen

Voorkomen, beperken en verzekeren heeft een centrale plek in de strategie van Univé. Wij helpen onze klanten risico’s te voorkomen en schade te beperken. En wat we niet kunnen voorkomen of beperken, verzekeren we gewoon goed.

De afdeling IT Kern, waaronder Backend Platform valt, levert een state-of-the-art IT-fundament voor de Univé-organisatie om de business doelen te realiseren. Dat doen we door waarde te creëren op continuïteit, betrouwbaarheid, schaalbaarheid, veiligheid en enabler te zijn van innovatie & productiviteit.

Voor Backend Platform zoeken wij een Business Informatie Analist. Als Business Informatie Analist werk je in op DevOps gebaseerde Agile teams en ben je continue bezig om de beloftes aan onze klanten waar te maken.

Je werk bestaat onder andere uit:

  • Analyseren van wensen en wijzigingen: Je onderzoekt wijzigingsverzoeken, brengt requirements in kaart en vertaalt deze naar passende functionele oplossingen.

  • Verbeteren van processen en systemen: Je signaleert knelpunten, onderzoekt verbetermogelijkheden en draagt bij aan het optimaliseren van bestaande processen en applicaties.

  • Ondersteunen van de applicatieketen: Je ondersteunt en verbetert de werking van applicaties en bijbehorende processen, waaronder verzekerings- en HR-processen en de systemen en koppelingen binnen de ATS-keten.

  • Samenwerken en afstemmen: Je werkt nauw samen met collega's, stakeholders en externe leveranciers om wensen, verwachtingen en oplossingen op elkaar af te stemmen.

  • Begeleiden van wijzigingen: Je bent betrokken bij het voorbereiden, uitwerken, testen en implementeren van functionele wijzigingen en bewaakt hierbij de voortgang en kwaliteit.

  • Bewaken van de ketensamenhang: Je overziet de impact van wijzigingen op applicaties, systemen en onderlinge koppelingen en draagt bij aan een stabiele en betrouwbare dienstverlening.

  • Continu verbeteren: Je denkt actief mee over het verbeteren van onze dienstverlening, werkwijzen en samenwerking binnen de Agile teams.

Wat bieden wij

Bij Univé IT bieden we je een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische organisatie, waarin je veel ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan professioneel en toekomstgericht Backend Platform.

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, eigenaarschap en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling.

  • Nauwe samenwerking met ervaren collega’s binnen IT, architectuur en security.

  • De mogelijkheid om actief bij te dragen aan de verdere professionalisering van IT Kern.

  • Ruimte om mee te denken over marktontwikkelingen, automatisering en de inzet van AI binnen Unive en IT.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • Jaarsalaris tussen €58.352,80 en €82.377,96 bruto per jaar op basis van 38 uur ( inclusief vakantiegeld en dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning);

  • Dienstverband van 32 tot 38 uur per week;

  • Standplaats Zwolle of Assen, met hybride werken in overleg met het team;

  • Een contract voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op een vast contract;

  • 13e maand en 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Variabele collectieve prestatiebeloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris;

  • Goede pensioen- en studiekostenregeling;

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die dicht bij haar leden staat. Als IT-organisatie werken we aan een wendbaar, betrouwbaar, veilig en toekomstgericht IT-landschap. Schaalbare technologie, goede processen, standaardisatie en continu verbeteren zijn daarbij belangrijk. Binnen IT Kern werken verschillende teams aan het beheren, ondersteunen en doorontwikkelen van applicaties, platformen, infrastructuur, netwerkdiensten en securityoplossingen. Deze IT-diensten zijn essentieel voor onze dagelijkse dienstverlening aan leden en voor de ondersteuning van onze collega’s. Samen bouwen we aan een moderne IT-organisatie waarin we betrouwbaar functioneren, waardestromen goed worden ondersteund en vernieuwing gecontroleerd en toekomstbestendig kan plaatsvinden. Je komt terecht in een team waarin samenwerking, eigenaarschap en plezier in het werk belangrijk zijn. We werken met collega’s die graag verbeteren, verantwoordelijkheid nemen en elkaar helpen om het applicatie- en IT-landschap iedere dag een stukje beter te maken.

title: CEO - Doit Lithuania
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As CEO of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital.

  • Experience building or scaling a business, ideally in financial services or fintech.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn regulation quickly and work credibly with regulators.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with boards, regulators, partners and teams.

  • Comfortable working across product, operations, finance and compliance.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a senior manager.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania.

  • Experience with MiFID II, brokerage, wealth management or fund distribution.

  • Experience building or running a regulated financial business in the EU.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

  • People who see regulation as someone else’s problem.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

title: Chef de Projet développement commercial et partenariats
descriptionHtml:
Vous savez décrocher votre téléphone et ouvrir une porte fermée, sans introduction, sans lead, sans filet ?

Vous préférez construire un marché à partir de zéro plutôt qu'hériter d'un portefeuille tout fait ?

Vous voulez que votre rémunération reflète exactement ce que vous décrochez, sans plafond ?

Si vous avez répondu oui aux trois questions, ce poste est fait pour vous. Lisez ce qui suit.

QUI SOMMES NOUS
KT Groupe a construit son succès sur un marché : le fitness. Salles de sport premium, clubs, franchises. Ce marché fonctionne, et il continue de croître.

Aujourd'hui, la direction ouvre un second moteur de croissance : l'hôtellerie, les résidences de tourisme, les spas, les centres wellness et le sport en entreprise. Un marché sur lequel KT Groupe possède déjà le savoir-faire technique, mais pas encore la présence commerciale.

C'est précisément là que vous entrez en jeu.

LE POSTE EN UNE PHRASE

Vous ne reprenez pas un portefeuille : vous le construisez. Ce n'est pas un poste de gestion, c'est un poste de conquête.

Vous allez chercher les projets, vous construisez le réseau de prescription (architectes, maîtres d'œuvre, bureaux d'études, équipementiers, groupes et franchises), et vous conduisez le cycle de vente de la qualification jusqu'à la signature. Vous êtes rattaché à la direction du développement commercial, et vous travaillez au quotidien avec la direction générale, la direction technique et le pôle fitness — votre homologue, sans lien hiérarchique.

Vos missions

Créer et développer le marché du pôle

  • Construire la cartographie du marché : groupes hôteliers, chaînes, hôtels indépendants haut de gamme, résidences de tourisme, spas, centres wellness, entreprises souhaitant équiper leurs locaux.
  • Identifier les décideurs réels : direction générale, direction technique, direction des opérations, asset managers, responsables de l'expérience client.
  • Aller chercher les projets par prospection directe, LinkedIn, réseau personnel, salons et recommandations.
  • Contribuer à la construction de l'offre du pôle : arguments, références, cas d'usage.

Développer les partenariats et la prescription — le levier le plus puissant du poste

  • Identifier, approcher et signer des partenariats avec les prescripteurs du marché : architectes, maîtres d'œuvre, bureaux d'études, équipementiers wellness et spa, groupes et franchises.
  • Construire des accords donnant-donnant, où KT Groupe apporte des marchés à ses partenaires et réciproquement.
  • Faire référencer KT Groupe comme constructeur et aménageur auprès des partenaires.
  • Entretenir la relation dans la durée : un partenariat signé et non animé ne produit rien.

Conduire le cycle de vente de bout en bout

  • Qualifier les demandes entrantes et les opportunités sortantes, mener la découverte, préparer les briefs de chiffrage pour la direction technique.
  • Présenter la proposition, négocier et signer.
  • Rester l'interlocuteur unique du premier contact jusqu'à la signature — un principe de maison chez KT Groupe.

Préparer et exploiter les salons

  • Constituer en amont le pipeline de rendez-vous du salon Meeting Hôtellerie de mars 2027.
  • Assurer un suivi post-salon aussi rigoureux que la préparation.

Tenir la rigueur commerciale

  • Tenir le CRM à jour, réagir vite aux demandes entrantes, participer à la réunion commerciale hebdomadaire.
  • Documenter vos process au fur et à mesure, pour permettre la délégation future.

Vos compétences

Nous n'attendons pas un CV type. Trois chemins peuvent mener à ce poste, et nous arbitrerons en fonction des candidatures reçues :

  • Confirmé du secteur — hôtellerie, spa, wellness, équipement hôtelier, agencement d'hôtels. Vous apportez un carnet d'adresses immédiatement activable.
  • Confirmé B2B, autre secteur — vente de projets à panier élevé (BTP, agencement, mobilier professionnel, équipement, retail, énergie). Vous apportez une méthode de vente éprouvée sur cycle long et une culture du chiffre.
  • Junior à fort potentiel — deux à trois ans d'expérience commerciale, forte envie, pas encore le réseau. Vous apportez de l'énergie et une capacité à vous former sans habitudes à défaire.

Le socle commun, non négociable

  • Vente B2B de projets à cycle long et à panier élevé, à partir de 150 000 €.
  • Capacité à ouvrir un compte à froid, sans lead entrant et sans introduction.
  • Aptitude à lire un besoin d'aménagement, comprendre un plan et dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs techniques.
  • Rigueur dans la tenue d'un CRM et dans le suivi des engagements pris.
  • Qualité de l'écrit professionnel : une proposition mal écrite décrédibilise un projet à 200 000 €.
  • Anglais professionnel apprécié ; permis B et disponibilité pour des déplacements réguliers.

Votre savoir-être

  • Le goût de la chasse : vous ne dépendez pas des leads qu'on vous donne.
  • Une posture de conseil : vous aidez un investisseur à réussir un projet, vous ne vendez pas des travaux.
  • De l'exigence et de la fiabilité : ce que vous annoncez, vous le tenez.
  • De la tenue dans la durée : un cycle de vente de 3 à 4 mois demande de la constance.
  • Une ambition assumée : la part variable est déplafonnée, elle est faite pour ceux qui veulent aller la chercher.

Avantages

Une rémunération pensée pour la performance

Le principe est simple et assumé : un fixe qui sécurise, un variable sans plafond qui récompense la performance réelle.

  • Un fixe mensuel selon expérience et valeur apportée.
  • Une prime versée à la signature de chaque projet de construction ou de rénovation, proportionnelle et non plafonnée.
  • Une prime à la signature d'un partenariat structurant, franchise ou groupe.
  • Une commission sur les marchés que vous apportez, selon les règles en vigueur dans l'entreprise.

Le fixe couvre vos besoins. Le variable, lui, n'a pas de plafond : une personne performante gagne significativement plus que son fixe.

Des moyens et un vrai accompagnement

  • Ordinateur, téléphone, accès CRM, outils de prospection, budget de déplacement, participation aux salons professionnels.
  • Une formation interne : méthode commerciale propriétaire, formation à l'équipement sportif et à l'agencement par le pôle fitness, immersion chantier.
  • Un plan d'intégration structuré sur 90 jours (immersion, structuration, transformation, pilotage), avec des points de situation réguliers avec la direction.
  • Une évolution possible vers responsable du développement du pôle, dès lors qu'une équipe se constitue sous votre responsabilité.

Notre état d'esprit

Chez KT Groupe, la transparence n'est pas affichée, elle est pratiquée : on dit les choses, y compris quand elles sont difficiles, les chiffres sont partagés. On ne compte pas ses efforts quand un projet est en jeu — et on ne compte pas non plus la reconnaissance. Le niveau d'exigence est élevé sur la qualité livrée, chacun assume ses sujets jusqu'au bout, les décisions se prennent vite. On va sur les chantiers, on voit les sites, on rencontre les clients : rien ne se décide uniquement depuis un bureau.

Ce poste n'est pas un poste confortable. Le marché est entièrement à créer, et le premier semestre demande une vraie tolérance à l'incertitude : pas de portefeuille, pas de leads fournis, un rythme de montée en puissance qui dépend largement de vous. Pendant la phase de démarrage du pôle, vous apporterez aussi un renfort ponctuel et cadré dans le temps sur la qualification téléphonique des demandes entrantes du pôle fitness — sans que cela remette en cause votre responsabilité pleine sur votre propre pôle.

Si vous cherchez la sécurité d'un portefeuille existant, ce poste n'est pas pour vous. Si vous voulez construire quelque chose et être payé à la hauteur de ce que vous construisez, la suite est pour vous.

title: Chief Engineer Operations H/F
descriptionHtml:
📍 Paris / Île-de-France | Environnement Data Center | CDI | Périmètre multisite

Rejoignez mon client au cœur des infrastructures critiques.

Dans un contexte de forte croissance et de développement de ses infrastructures, mon client renforce son organisation Operations en France et crée un poste de Chief Engineer.

Au sein d'un nouvel pôle d'expertise technique transverse, vous devenez le référent technique des opérations sur plusieurs sites stratégiques en France, avec un périmètre prioritaire couvrant notamment deux sites.

Votre mission : apporter votre expertise, sécuriser les opérations et contribuer à faire progresser l'ensemble de l'organisation vers davantage de standardisation, de rigueur opérationnelle et d'excellence technique.

Ce poste s'adresse à un profil expérimenté qui souhaite aller au-delà de l'expertise technique pure et jouer un rôle central dans la structuration des opérations d'un acteur Data Center en pleine croissance.

Vos missions

Votre rôle

Le Chief Engineer intervient comme référent technique et opérationnel multisite.

Vous êtes à la fois :

  • un expert technique capable de challenger les équipes et les prestataires ;

  • un référent opérationnel garant de la sécurisation des opérations ;

  • un acteur transverse capable de fédérer des équipes aux profils et niveaux d'expérience différents.

Vous disposez d'une véritable autorité technique : lorsque les conditions de sécurité ou de maîtrise des risques ne sont pas réunies, vous êtes capable de challenger une opération et, si nécessaire, de prononcer un NO GO sur un mode opératoire ou une intervention.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de site, qui conservent la responsabilité opérationnelle de leur périmètre.

Vos principales missions

1 - Être le référent technique des infrastructures critiques

Vous apportez votre expertise sur l'ensemble des infrastructures techniques du Data Center et êtes capable d'en comprendre les interactions et les impacts opérationnels.

Votre périmètre couvre notamment :

  • les infrastructures électriques HT/BT ;

  • les systèmes de secours électrique ;

  • les UPS / onduleurs ;

  • les groupes électrogènes ;

  • les infrastructures CVC / HVAC ;

  • les systèmes de refroidissement ;

  • la protection et la sécurité incendie ;

  • les systèmes de contrôle-commande et infrastructures associées.

Vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des responsables de site et des équipes Operations, et êtes capable de challenger les différents interlocuteurs internes ou externes sur leurs choix et leurs pratiques.

2 - Sécuriser les opérations

L'une de vos responsabilités majeures sera de garantir que les opérations réalisées sur les infrastructures critiques sont préparées et exécutées dans les meilleures conditions de sécurité et de maîtrise des risques.

À ce titre, vous :

  • challengez les modes opératoires (MOP) ;

  • vérifiez la cohérence et l'exhaustivité des procédures ;

  • identifiez les risques et leurs impacts potentiels ;

  • sécurisez les opérations avant leur réalisation ;

  • challengez les premières analyses et propositions d'intervention ;

  • pouvez émettre un NO GO lorsqu'une opération ne présente pas les garanties nécessaires ;

  • accompagnez les responsables de site dans la prise de décision technique ;

  • contribuez à la mise en place de mécanismes de double vérification.

Vous êtes en quelque sorte le garde-fou technique de l'organisation, avec pour objectif de sécuriser les opérations sans perdre de vue les impératifs de continuité de service.

3- Structurer et harmoniser les pratiques

L'un des enjeux majeurs du poste est de contribuer à l'harmonisation des pratiques entre les différents sites.

Aujourd'hui, les niveaux de maturité et les pratiques peuvent varier d'un site à l'autre. Votre rôle sera de contribuer à construire un socle commun de méthodes et de standards opérationnels.

Vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

  • structurer les processus d'exploitation ;

  • définir et harmoniser les standards techniques ;

  • rédiger et améliorer les procédures et modes opératoires ;

  • mettre en place des workflows opérationnels ;

  • contrôler leur bonne application ;

  • identifier les écarts entre les sites ;

  • proposer et suivre les plans d'amélioration ;

  • partager les bonnes pratiques ;

  • réaliser des REX multisites ;

  • accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouveaux standards.

La capacité à construire et faire vivre des process sera donc aussi importante que votre expertise technique.

4- Apporter votre expertise lors des incidents critiques

En cas d'incident technique complexe, vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des équipes Facility et Operations.

Vous êtes notamment amené(e) à :

  • analyser techniquement l'incident ;

  • identifier les causes et les impacts potentiels ;

  • apporter votre expertise aux responsables de site ;

  • challenger les analyses proposées ;

  • accompagner les équipes internes et les prestataires ;

  • contribuer à la définition des actions correctives ;

  • participer à la résolution de l'incident ;

  • organiser et partager les retours d'expérience à l'échelle des différents sites.

Votre capacité à prendre du recul, analyser rapidement une situation complexe et apporter une réponse techniquement robuste sera essentielle.

5 - Développer une culture d'excellence opérationnelle

Vous ne vous contentez pas de définir les standards : vous accompagnez les équipes dans leur appropriation.

Vous serez ainsi amené(e) à :

  • former et accompagner les équipes ;

  • expliquer les exigences techniques et opérationnelles ;

  • faire progresser les pratiques ;

  • fédérer autour d'objectifs communs ;

  • accompagner la conduite du changement ;

  • favoriser le partage de connaissances entre les sites.

Vous disposez d'une forte capacité d'influence et savez faire avancer les sujets sans nécessairement disposer d'un lien hiérarchique direct.

6 - Être l'interlocuteur technique des clients majeurs

Vous serez capable de :

  • représenter la société sur les sujets techniques ;

  • expliquer une situation ou un incident complexe ;

  • présenter les actions mises en œuvre ;

  • répondre aux interrogations techniques des clients ;

  • apporter un discours structuré et crédible sur les enjeux d'exploitation et de sécurité des infrastructures.

Une organisation en construction

Vous rejoindrez un pôle d'expertise technique transverse nouvellement structuré, regroupant différentes compétences destinées à accompagner les opérations et les projets.

L'objectif est de créer une véritable communauté d'experts capable d'apporter son expertise à l'ensemble des sites et de faire progresser collectivement les standards d'exploitation.

Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec :

  • les responsables de site ;

  • les équipes Facility et Operations ;

  • les équipes projets ;

  • les experts techniques ;

  • les prestataires et partenaires externes ;

  • les fonctions transverses ;

  • les clients majeurs.

Le poste est donc particulièrement transverse et nécessite une forte capacité à créer du lien entre les différentes parties prenantes.

Vos compétences

Votre profil

Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans un environnement Data Center ou infrastructure critique fortement structurée.

Vous avez idéalement évolué dans un environnement où les exigences en matière de procédures, de sécurité opérationnelle, de maintenance et de continuité de service sont particulièrement élevées.

Une expérience dans un environnement critique comparable serait particulièrement appréciée.

Votre expertise technique

Vous disposez d'une excellente connaissance des infrastructures critiques et notamment :

  • électricité HT/BT ;

  • systèmes de secours électrique ;

  • UPS / groupes électrogènes ;

  • CVC / HVAC ;

  • refroidissement ;

  • protection incendie ;

  • contrôle-commande ;

  • maintenance des infrastructures critiques.

Vous êtes capable de comprendre l'intégralité de l'infrastructure et les interactions entre les différents systèmes, et pas uniquement votre domaine d'expertise initial.

Vous savez également analyser une problématique technique complexe, identifier les risques et challenger les solutions proposées.

Votre expérience opérationnelle

Vous avez déjà évolué dans un environnement où les procédures et les standards opérationnels occupent une place importante.

Vous êtes à l'aise avec :

  • les modes opératoires (MOP) ;

  • la gestion des changements ;

  • l'analyse de risques ;

  • la maintenance préventive et corrective ;

  • la gestion d'incidents critiques ;

  • les audits et contrôles opérationnels ;

  • les REX ;

  • la standardisation des pratiques ;

  • la gestion de prestataires techniques.

Vous avez surtout envie de faire progresser une organisation, de structurer les pratiques et d'améliorer durablement les opérations.

Vos qualités

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, nous recherchons une personne :

  • dotée d'une forte expertise technique ;

  • structurée et rigoureuse ;

  • capable d'analyse et de prise de recul ;

  • pédagogue et capable de transmettre son expertise ;

  • à l'aise pour challenger ses interlocuteurs ;

  • capable de prendre des décisions et de défendre une position technique ;

  • dotée d'une forte intelligence relationnelle ;

  • capable de s'adapter à différents profils et différents niveaux de maturité ;

  • fédératrice et à l'aise dans un rôle transverse ;

  • capable d'accompagner la conduite du changement.

Votre capacité à adapter votre communication à votre interlocuteur tout en maintenant un haut niveau d'exigence technique sera déterminante.

Avantages

  • Bonus : 2 mois de salaire

title: Chief Financial Officer
descriptionHtml:
Location: East Croydon, London (next to East Croydon station) · Hybrid: 3 days in the office, 2 days from home
Reports to: CEO (David Fowle), with regular exposure to the Board
Direct reports: Finance Director, team of 4
Start: ASAP

About Hozah

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte's Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we're one of the fastest-scaling companies in the country.

The role

Hozah is scaling rapidly and we're looking for a commercial, hands-on CFO to be the right hand to the CEO and a partner to the wider leadership team. This is not a back-office, keep-the-books role; it's a seat at the top table. We want someone who changes how the business thinks about its numbers, its unit economics, and where growth is coming from.

You'll use your knowledge of financial and data technology (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, Omni, Looker, Metabase) to build the FP&A and forecasting capability the business needs to scale with confidence, and give the CEO, the Board and our investors a clear, forward-looking view of the business.

This role goes beyond reporting and analysis. You'll be directly involved in the company's most important commercial decisions, partnering with the CEO and commercial team on negotiations, investment decisions and strategic initiatives. You'll help win deals, not just measure them.

We want someone pragmatic and front-footed: comfortable rolling up their sleeves, able to explain the big picture and the detail at the same time, opinionated about where value is created, and excited to use AI to make finance faster, sharper and more strategic.

What you'll own

  • Being the CEO's right hand on all things financial, commercial and strategic

  • Bringing rigour and a fresh lens to growth decisions

  • Commercial deal-making support: pricing, contract economics, and the numbers behind new site and client decisions

  • Building and owning budgeting, forecasting and FP&A

  • The forward-looking board pack and investor reporting that leadership and shareholders use to make decisions

  • The KPIs and financial dashboards that connect day-to-day operations to financial outcomes

  • Cash flow, capex, working capital and scenario planning as the business scales

  • Building, leading and developing the finance team, including growing existing talent toward more senior roles

  • The processes, controls and systems a scaling business needs, without bureaucracy that slows it down

  • Partnering with the CEO and investors on fundraising, refinancing and M&A / corporate development

  • Banking, treasury and key financial partner relationships

  • A front-footed approach to AI and automation across reporting, forecasting, reconciliation and analysis

Who we're looking for

  • You've led finance before, or you're ready for your first shot and can prove it. A strong FD/Head of Finance ready to step up, or an early second-time CFO who wants to build rather than inherit. Either way, you can walk us through a function you built, not just one you worked inside.

  • You're commercial, not just technical. You read the business, not just the ledger, and have a view on where value is created and where it leaks.

  • You can build FP&A from scratch. Modelling, forecasting, scenario planning: the forward view is your craft, not something you outsource.

  • You're hands-on. You'll build it yourself before you delegate it, and you're not above the detail.

title: Cloud Solution Architect
descriptionHtml:
Cloud Solution Architect - Data & AI

Location: UK (Hybrid)
Practice: Data & AI

About HSO

HSO is a Business Transformation Partner with deep industry expertise and global reach. As one of Microsoft's leading partners, we help organisations unlock the full potential of Microsoft Dynamics 365, Azure, Data and AI technologies to deliver meaningful business outcomes.

With operations across Europe, North America and Asia, HSO combines industry knowledge, technical excellence and a people-first culture to help customers modernise their businesses, transform operations and embrace innovation with confidence.

As demand for Data & AI solutions continues to accelerate, we're expanding our Data & AI practice and looking for experienced Cloud Solution Architects to help shape the next generation of customer transformation programmes.

The Role

As a Cloud Solution Architect - Data & AI, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping and qualifying customer opportunities across the Microsoft cloud ecosystem.

This is a highly visible role that sits at the intersection of sales, enterprise architecture and delivery, combining technical leadership with commercial thinking. You'll work closely with customers, Microsoft and internal stakeholders to understand business challenges, identify opportunities, design compelling solutions and create clear pathways from initial discovery through to successful delivery.

You'll help organisations transform the way they use data, analytics and artificial intelligence, translating business ambition into practical, costed and deliverable solutions.

Success in this role requires more than technical expertise. You'll need strong consulting and stakeholder management skills, the confidence to challenge assumptions, and the commercial awareness to ensure opportunities are both valuable for clients and aligned with HSO's delivery capability.

What You'll Be Doing

Opportunity Qualification & Solution Shaping

  • Lead Data & AI opportunity qualification alongside Account Managers, Business Development teams and Enterprise Architects.
  • Facilitate customer discovery workshops, architecture assessments and strategic discussions.
  • Understand customer business drivers, challenges and desired outcomes.
  • Help customers define realistic transformation roadmaps aligned to business priorities.
  • Qualify opportunities using structured sales and consulting methodologies, including MEDDIC/MEDDICC approaches.

Solution Architecture & Advisory

  • Design end-to-end Data & AI solutions using Microsoft technologies and best practices.
  • Shape modern analytics, AI and data platform architectures that are commercially viable and technically deliverable.
  • Provide architectural leadership across data platform modernisation, analytics, AI and automation initiatives.
  • Ensure alignment with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Well-Architected principles.
  • Communicate architectural trade-offs and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Commercial Leadership

  • Translate customer requirements into proposals, statements of work, delivery plans and business cases.
  • Produce solution estimates, cost models and phased implementation approaches.
  • Support customers in understanding ROI, value realisation and investment considerations.
  • Challenge unclear scope and identify delivery, cost and commercial risks early in the sales cycle.
  • Work closely with delivery teams to validate assumptions before commitments are made.

Growth & Go-to-Market

  • Contribute to the evolution of HSO's Data & AI propositions and repeatable offerings.
  • Develop demonstrations, accelerators, sales collateral and industry-specific solution narratives.
  • Support RFPs, bid responses, executive presentations and proof-of-concept engagements.
  • Collaborate with Microsoft stakeholders to drive pipeline growth and co-sell opportunities.
  • Keep up to date with emerging Microsoft technologies and industry trends across Data & AI.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate combines strong technical capability with exceptional commercial awareness.

You'll be equally comfortable discussing board-level business outcomes with executive stakeholders as you are diving into architecture decisions with technical teams.

Commercial & Consulting Experience

You'll have:

  • Proven experience in a Solution Architecture, Pre-Sales, Consulting or Technical Advisory role.
  • Experience working within a Microsoft partner, consultancy or enterprise technology environment.
  • Strong commercial acumen and experience creating proposals, business cases and Statements of Work.
  • The ability to qualify opportunities and challenge assumptions constructively.
  • Excellent workshop facilitation, discovery and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience presenting to senior business and technical audiences.
  • The ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value.
  • Understanding of opportunity qualification methodologies such as MEDDIC or MEDDICC.

Experience across industries such as manufacturing, retail, financial services, healthcare, public sector, not-for-profit, utilities or professional services would be advantageous.

Technical Experience

We recognise that few candidates will have expertise across every area listed below. We're primarily looking for strong Data & AI architecture experience across the Microsoft ecosystem.

Essential

Data & Analytics

  • Microsoft Fabric
  • Lakehouse architecture patterns
  • Power BI and self-service analytics
  • Semantic modelling and reporting solutions
  • Data platform modernisation and analytics strategy

Azure Data Platform

  • Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS)

AI & Automation

  • Copilot Studio
  • Agentic AI patterns and intelligent automation solutions

Data Engineering & Platform Delivery

  • SQL

  • Data pipelines and transformation frameworks
  • CI/CD concepts and deployment automation
  • Azure DevOps and/or GitHub
  • Infrastructure as Code awareness
  • Environment promotion and release management approaches

Advantageous

  • Data governance frameworks

Integration & Application Connectivity

Certifications

As a leading Microsoft partner, HSO actively invests in certification, specialisation and continuous learning, helping our consultants stay at the forefront of Microsoft's rapidly evolving technology landscape.

Why Join HSO?

This is an exciting opportunity to join one of Microsoft's most respected global partners during a period of significant growth in Data & AI.
