title: Commercial Director
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The Opportunity

This is one of the highest-leverage commercial roles in the business. As Commercial Director, you'll own the entire sales system at Relay — strategy, structure, process, and performance across all four of our segments: Pitstop/Field Sales, Enterprise, Large Parcel, and SME Parcel. You'll set the standards that let each segment lead build well, and you'll be personally accountable for the sum of the results.

Beyond the day-to-day, this role has a genuine builder's brief: creating the infrastructure and team capabilities that take Relay international over the next few years. If you want to shape how a fast-growing carrier goes to market at scale — and leave a lasting mark on how that machine works — this is the role.

What You'll Own

Sales strategy and structure

  • Design the shape of Relay's sales organisation across all four segments — how they relate, where they overlap, how resource is prioritised

  • Define the sales motion for each segment: who it sells to, how, and through which channel

  • Keep strategy current as the business and market evolve

Data and performance management

  • Set the metrics that matter across pipeline, conversion, quota attainment, and productivity

  • Build or oversee the dashboards that surface them

  • Use data to make decisions on resourcing, territory design, and where to invest or pull back — instinct complements data here, it doesn't replace it

Process, structure, and scalability

  • Own the sales playbook, forecasting cadence, deal review process, CRM hygiene standards, and comp and quota-setting principles

  • Upskill and coach the existing team on pitch, process, and performance

  • Build infrastructure that scales for the next three years, not just today's headcount

Team leadership and org design

  • Lead the four segment sales leads (Pitstop/Field, Enterprise, Large Parcel, SME Parcel) and any central sales ops or enablement partners

  • Decide what's centralised across functions versus what each segment lead owns locally

  • Hire, develop, and coach those leads so each can build out their patch well

Global and remote team leadership

  • Lead teams remotely across time zones and geographies as Relay expands into the Americas and Europe

  • Proven capability to do this is a requirement — it can't be learned on the job here

Exec partnership and GTM planning

  • Partner with the CCO and other function leads on revenue planning, headcount decisions, and commercial trade-offs

  • Translate company strategy into a sequenced sales roadmap and GTM direction

  • Push back clearly when targets or timelines aren't realistic

Who Will Thrive in This Role

  • Multi-motion sales leader. You've led more than one kind of sales motion — for example, high-volume SMB or transactional sales alongside enterprise or mid-market relationship-led sales. You're comfortable setting standards and managing performance across both. You've carried a number yourself and led others doing the same. This isn't a role for a single-lane specialist.

  • Data-driven and structured operator. You define the metrics that matter, build or oversee the dashboards, and use data to make resourcing and process calls — not gut feel alone. You have a track record of introducing or significantly upgrading forecasting discipline, CRM hygiene, territory design, and comp structures in ways that improved consistency and scalability. You think in systems across a multi-year horizon, not just the next quarter.

  • Global and remote team builder. You've led sales teams across multiple geographies or time zones, ideally including the US and Europe. You're comfortable setting standards, culture, and expectations remotely. Having helped take a company into a new country is a bonus; the core requirement is proven capability.

  • People leader and org designer. You've led sales managers or leaders — not just individual contributors — and operated at least one layer removed from the front line. You have a track record of hiring and developing leaders beneath you, and making clear calls about what to centralise versus what to delegate.

  • Exec partner. You've partnered directly with a CEO, founder, or C-suite on revenue planning and commercial trade-offs. You can push back on unrealistic targets while maintaining trust, and you can translate company strategy into an actionable, sequenced sales roadmap.

  • Builder, not just operator. You've introduced new process, data infrastructure, or org structure in a previous role — not only operated within a system someone else built. This role is not about being a super-IC closer or a sector-pedigree hire; logistics experience is welcome but not a requirement or a filter.

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

  • Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay’s success.

  • Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you’d need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it.

  • 25 days of holidays

  • Enhanced parental leave.

  • Hardware of your choice.

  • Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more).

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Company Operations Lead
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs moves fast - by design. We run lean, we bias toward action, and we trust our people to figure things out. That's how we've built world-leading AI products in three years with a fraction of the headcount of our peers. But speed at 200 people and speed at 1,000+ people are different challenges, and the systems, habits, and connective tissue that let a company move fast without breaking things don't build themselves.

As our Company Operations Lead, you'll own the infrastructure that lets ElevenLabs keep its velocity as it scales. Not by adding process for process's sake - but by building the right systems, in the right places, at the right time, so that the rest of the company can focus on what they do best. You'll establish the operating layer that keeps a 50-country, hybrid organization coherent; drive the strategic planning cadence that keeps leadership aligned; and deploy a lean team of strategic generalists against the company's most urgent cross-functional challenges.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Operating Cadence: Running the planning and alignment cycles that keep the company pointed in the right direction. This includes OKR planning, workforce, and headcount planning.

  • Operating System: Building and maintaining the infrastructure layer that lets the company move faster. Systems of record, org taxonomy and governance, and the knowledge management systems that ensure information flow effectively across our remote-first team.

  • AI Enablement & Agentification: Ensuring every team at ElevenLabs has the tools, access, and knowledge to work effectively with AI. You'll own the internal AI enablement framework - managing tool access and rollout, identifying where agents and automation can accelerate how functions operate, and building the learning opportunities and champions programmes that drive deep adoption. You'll work closely with Security, IT, and the Automations team to ensure what gets built is built right.

  • Operations Centre of Excellence: Defining what great operations looks like at ElevenLabs and embedding it across the company. You'll set the blueprint that makes operational excellence repeatable and deploy the team as embedded operators inside other functions, standing up best practices, up-skilling teams, and handing off cleanly once the work is done.

Requirements

We do not require formal experience, certifications, or degrees. We do require:

  • Proven experience building and leading a Strategy & Operations or BizOps function at a high-growth technology company - ideally through a meaningful scaling inflection (Series B–D trajectory or equivalent).

  • Track record of standing up functions and systems from scratch and handing them off, rather than owning a permanent queue.

  • Structured problem-solving background - strategy consulting, a BizOps or Chief of Staff seat with genuine strategic scope, or an operator role that required both systems-building and executive influence.

  • Strong AI and tooling fluency - you should be pushing the organisation on what's possible with AI enablement, not chasing it.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management: you can partner with founders and Leads and earn trust quickly in a flat, high-velocity environment.

Bonus:

  • Experience inside a company that scaled through a 200 → 2,000+ person inflection.

  • Background that spans both consulting and operator roles - you've done the thinking and the building.

  • Familiarity with knowledge management, AI agentification, or internal tooling as an operational discipline.

Location

This role is remote. London or New York preferred.

descriptionHtml:
Are you seeking a role that combines Venture Capital, Startups, and Consulting? Do you want to help founders secure funding for transformative technologies addressing our planet's most critical challenges, such as artificial intelligence, carbon removal, and waste reduction?

FUNDED could be the perfect fit for you.

FUNDED is a dynamic and rapidly growing consulting boutique dedicated to helping startups and scale-ups tackle one of their most urgent needs: fundraising. Our mission is to become the leading advisory for non-dilutive fundraising, combining premium consulting services with our proprietary SaaS solution.

Join a team of ambitious people who previously worked for Bain, BCG, Roland Berger and many more; and studied at Cambridge, LMU, St. Gallen (HSG), WHU and more.

What We Do

  • Grant Funding: We assist our clients in securing up to EUR 15 million in tax-free, non-dilutive cash through government grants
  • Debt Fundraising: We support our clients in raising venture debt with our network, process, and document support
  • FundedOS: Our proprietary SaaS solution enables clients to conduct the necessary documentation for grant programs

Tasks

What you can expect at FUNDED

Venture Ecosystem: We operate at the center of the venture ecosystem. Our clientele includes 100+ of the most forward-thinking and well-funded tech start- and scale-ups in Germany, such as Celonis, Twaice and Wandelbots.

Start-Up: As a young and fast-growing startup, every team member is involved in the firm's decisions, thus being a part of our growth story. All of our employees receive a share of the company's success via our participation compensation.

Consulting: Project-based, we work shoulder-to-shoulder with the founders of some of the most innovative start-ups and scale-ups in Germany. We create added value for our customers through our expertise, network, and superior operational support for quantitative and qualitative tasks.

As a Consultant, you will

  • Own client projects end-to-end , interacting directly with c-level / founders of the most promising German founders
  • Create grant applications holistically, taking care of supporting slide decks and the application text, as well as corresponding financials
  • Own the PMO of the application, coordinating deadlines, deliverables, and workshops with clients by yourself
  • Further build our debt advisory practice, supporting on cases and getting exposure to the venture debt ecosystem
  • Support internal projects, e.g., business development or operations

Requirements

Candidates interested in this role, should

  • Possess fluent German language skills
  • Possess a a Master's degree from any academic background
  • Have done a minimum of two internship/working student positions in relevant sectors, i.e., consulting, investment firms, start-up

Benefits

Why FUNDED?

  • Insights into the most exciting tech companies in the DACH region: From robotics and sensor technology to AI – you gain deep insights into technologies and business models while working shoulder to shoulder with the founders
  • Colleagues you learn from: Our team brings experience from top-tier consultancies, finance, and the startup scene. From day one, a dedicated buddy is there to help you find your footing - we work together, not side by side
  • A steep learning curve: A structured development process with regular feedback shows you where you stand and what your next step is. On top of that, our training program sharpens your analytics, storytelling, and project management skills
  • Attractive compensation: Competitive base salary, a structured promotion process with fast salary progression, a variable component tied to the firm's success, and 30 vacation days
  • Employee participation program: Share directly in the long-term value FUNDED creates through our VSOP program
  • Office in the heart of Munich: A modern office in Schwabing, with snacks and drinks on us
  • Home office: One day a week you can work from home
  • Wellpass: A subsidized membership giving you access to more than 7,200 gyms and sports facilities across Germany
  • Team events: From ski trips to our own FUNDED Oktoberfest tables and relaxed after-work drinks – we celebrate our milestones together

Are you ready to take on this unique opportunity? Let’s connect and discuss how you can be part of our journey.

Not sure if you meet the requirements? Just send us a message.

title: Consultant Informationssicherheit / IT-Risikomanagement – ISO 27001 (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software- und IT-Dienstleister mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden.

Kurze Wege, ehrliches Feedback, keine politischen Spielchen. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen zwischen dir und den Leuten, die Entscheidungen treffen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest in Kundenprojekten bei großen Unternehmen und unterstützt dort das Informationssicherheits- und IT-Risikomanagement im laufenden Betrieb.

  • IT-Risikoanalysen und Risk Assessments für Anwendungen und Infrastruktur durchführen
  • Bedrohungsanalysen erstellen und daraus Maßnahmen ableiten
  • Risiken bewerten, dokumentieren und mit den Verantwortlichen nachverfolgen
  • Den ISMS-Prozess nach ISO 27001 und ISO 27005 unterstützen
  • Abstimmung mit Fachbereichen, IT-Betrieb und Security-Verantwortlichen

Die Einsätze laufen überwiegend remote. Kundentermine sind meist in Frankfurt, an einzelnen Präsenztagen.

Wo du landest

Je nach Projekt bei Großkonzernen, im öffentlichen Sektor oder bei Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden. Unsere Kunden besetzen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung.

Was du mitbringst

Das erwarten wir:

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung in der Informationssicherheit
  • Mindestens drei Jahre praktische Erfahrung im IT-Risikomanagement
  • Sicherer Umgang mit den Anforderungen der ISO 27001 und ISO 27005
  • Erfahrung mit Bedrohungsanalysen

Von Vorteil (kein Muss):

  • Audit- oder Assessment-Erfahrung
  • Werkzeuge für Risikomanagement, zum Beispiel risk2value
  • Zertifizierung wie ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, BSI-Grundschutz-Praktiker oder -Auditor, CISSP oder T.I.S.P.
  • Erfahrung im Umfeld von Eisenbahn- oder Verkehrsunternehmen

Projektsprache ist Deutsch

Du arbeitest im Team des Kunden, auf Deutsch, in Meetings und in der Dokumentation. Wir erwarten Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder besser.

Was wir bieten

  • Überwiegend remote, dazu Büro, wenn du magst
  • MacBook (außer der Kunde stellt eigene Hardware)
  • Verschiedene Kunden, verschiedene Projekte
  • Die Gründer sind deine direkten Ansprechpartner

Bewerbung

Lebenslauf reicht. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage.

title: Consultant Senior AI Advisory - CDI Paris - Theodo Data & AI
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Créée en 2016, Theodo Data & AI est l'entité Data et IA de Theodo. Notre ambition est d'accompagner nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de leur stratégie data ainsi que la recherche et le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle à l’état de l’art. L'entreprise est en pleine croissance : chaque année, Theodo Data & AI enregistre une croissance de plus de 30 % de son chiffre d'affaires, ouvrant ainsi de nouvelles opportunités passionnantes pour les Theodoers !
Ton équipe : Tu rejoins l’activité AI Advisory que Theodo est en train de lancer. Le rôle de ton équipe : aider les directions générales à passer de l’expérimentation IA à un impact business massif, en réconciliant vision stratégique et réalité technologique. Ton objectif en tant que Consultant Senior / Manager AI Advisory est de contribuer, piloter et (selon ton niveau) vendre des missions de conseil AI & Data, avec un niveau d’exigence “cabinet d’excellence” et une obsession pour la mise en production. Tes missions : Piloter le delivery de missions de conseil IA : cadrage de cas d’usage, analyse de valeur, audits (SI / data / plateformes), production de livrables structurants (schéma directeur, business case, roadmap IA). Être l’interlocuteur de confiance côté client : gérer la relation au quotidien, embarquer les parties prenantes (DG, C-level, DSI, Directeur Data/IA…), challenger les idées et sécuriser l’adoption (culture, gouvernance, éthique). Structurer l’exécution vers l’impact : transformer un besoin flou en plan d’action clair (Audit → MVP → Scale), prioriser et piloter les chantiers avec une logique ROI (EBITDA, churn, productivité, etc.). Contribuer au build de l’activité (selon le niveau) : concevoir des offres et méthodologies AI Advisory, formaliser des frameworks, capitaliser sur les retours mission. Développer le business (selon le niveau) : identifier des opportunités de rebond, porter l’avant-vente, rédiger les propositions commerciales et assurer le foisonnement. Leadership & coaching (niveau Manager) : encadrer et faire grandir des consultants sur les missions, challenger leurs travaux, garantir la qualité globale et la satisfaction des décideurs. Tes perspectives d’évolutions : Chez Theodo, tu participes à la construction d’une nouvelle activité : tu n’arrives pas dans une structure figée. Selon tes appétences, tu pourras évoluer vers des rôles de Lead / Principal AI Advisor, Practice Lead, ou piloter des programmes de transformation IA à grande échelle, avec une forte exposition sur des enjeux stratégiques et commerciaux. Profil recherché : Tu as 2 à 5 ans d’expérience (Consultant Senior) ou 5 à 8 ans (Manager), idéalement en cabinet de conseil ou boutique reconnue Data/IA (Big 4, Capgemini Invent, Accenture… ou Artefact, Eleven, AI Builders…). Tu as une expérience impérative sur des comptes SBF120 / CAC40 ou des scale-ups avec une forte complexité organisationnelle (missions de transformation > 6 mois). Tu es tech-fluent : pas besoin d’être codeur, mais tu comprends l’architecture SI/data, tu sais distinguer mode vs innovation de rupture, et tu testes les outils (LLMs, agents…) pour en connaître les limites réelles. Tu as une vraie posture de trusted advisor : écoute active, intelligence situationnelle, fiabilité, capacité à créer de la confiance avec des décideurs. Tu maîtrises la synthèse top-down : tu sais captiver un COMEX en 3 slides, tout en pouvant descendre dans le détail technique quand nécessaire. Tu as une forte rigueur analytique et une culture ROI : tu sais chiffrer l’impact financier et piloter l’exécution avec obsession du résultat. Process de recrutement : Sourcing / pré-sélection si pertinent Premier entretien avec le responsable AI Advisory (Yannick) Étude de cas Éventuellement deuxième entretien expert ou managérial Entretien VP (Clément)Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo Data & IA ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Consultant.e Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Conviction 🌟 Chez Thiga, nous sommes convaincus que le Design est un accélérateur de croissance responsable pour les entreprises.
Mais pour avoir un réel impact, le rôle du designer doit évoluer.
Nous défendons une approche de Product Designers “Product Builders”, capables de maîtriser l’ensemble du cycle produit : de la discovery à la delivery, en collaboration étroite avec le Produit, la Tech et le Business.

Des designers augmentés par la data et l’IA, qui leur permettent d’explorer plus vite, décider avec justesse et délivrer avec impact.
En plaçant les besoins réels des utilisateurs au cœur des produits, tout en intégrant les enjeux économiques, sociaux et environnementaux, le design devient un levier puissant pour une innovation à la fois performante et durable.

Le Product Design doit donc être porté à un niveau stratégique pour transformer réellement les organisations.

Nous recherchons des expert.e.s qui incarnent cette vision.
Être Consultant.e Product Designer chez Thiga 🖇
  • Soit tu es en immersion chez le client : tu renforces ses équipes pour créer des produits numériques responsables et performants.
  • Soit tu accompagnes le client dans la conception de la stratégie Design afin de garantir la cohérence, la qualité et l’impact des expériences utilisateurs sur l’ensemble des produits et services de l’entreprise

    • Ton quoditien chez le client 🎯
  • Tu collabores étroitement avec les équipes Produit, Tech et Marketing pour établir une vision claire du Design, en alignement avec les objectifs utilisateurs et business.
  • Tu formes les équipes internes aux meilleures pratiques de Design
  • Tu contribues à la définition de la roadmap produit en apportant une perspective centrée utilisateur.
  • Tu définis les user flows et tu crées les interfaces
  • Tu supervises la cohérence des parcours utilisateurs et des interfaces sur l’ensemble des plateformes
  • Tu promeus la valeur stratégique du Design auprès des parties prenantes
  • Tu mets en place et fais évoluer les processus, outils et rituels de Design. Tu participes notamment à l’amélioration du Design System, contribues à la Research, l’usage de la data et au déploiement de l’Intelligence Artificielle dans ton équipe
  • Tu mets en place des indicateurs de performance (KPIs) pour mesurer l’impact du Design sur les objectifs Business.

    • Expériences et qualités requises 📇
  • Tu as au moins 8 ans d’expérience avec un impact mesurable dans les environnements e-commerce et, idéalement avec un parcours varié (Scale-ups, grands groupes, Conseil)
  • Communication : tu as d'excellentes compétences en communication (aussi bien écrite que verbale) et en relations interpersonnelles. Tu as la capacité à développer une relation de confiance avec les clients.
  • Diplomatie : tu sais présenter tes idées et tes convictions et gérer les relations entre différentes parties prenantes. Tu sais faire preuve d’assertivité.
  • Curiosité : tu t’informes des nouveautés et des meilleures pratiques en Product Design, Product Management et IA. Figma Make, Claude, Lovable n'ont plus aucun secret pour toi :) Ce sont des alliés te permettant d'accélérer, d'améliorer la qualité et d'explorer de nouvelles façons de concevoir et de livrer.
  • Humilité : tu sais te remettre en question et apprendre de tes erreurs pour mieux évoluer
  • Anglais courant : tu peux travailler en autonomie dans un contexte international

    • Ce que nous offrons 🎊
  • Un on-boarding pour rencontrer tes collègues
  • De l’apprentissage avec minimum 5 jours de formations à l’année, des sessions de partage hebdomadaires et du contenu pour te faire monter en compétences
  • Du mentoring sur ta mission par un pair plus confirmé
  • Du confort avec deux jours de télétravail par semaine (selon ton client) complétés par un accès à un catalogue de matériels, ainsi qu’un Macbook Air ou un PC selon ta préférence.
  • Du fun avec des Thigapéros, des Team building et un séminaire (en prêtant attention à notre empreinte carbone).
  • Et pleins d’autres avantages comme une carte Swile, le remboursement de ton abonnement de transport à 50%/forfait mobilité durable, etc.

    • Les étapes du process 🎢
  • Un pré-entretien téléphonique avec une membre de l’équipe Recrutement
  • L'évaluation de ton portfolio par nos Product Designers
  • Une rencontre avec Fanny, Directrice de la tribe, un Principal, ou un.e Manager
  • Une étude de cas avec deux Product Designers de l’équipe pour tester ton savoir-faire
  • Un dernier échange pour apprécier l’entente mutuelle 🤝

title: Content Creator in Residence (Intern)
descriptionHtml:
Baue eine Marke von Anfang an. Mit guten Ideen – und einem Plan dahinter.

Fortisana ist ein wissenschaftlich fundierter All-in-One-Drink für Menschen ab 40, die aktiv bleiben wollen. Das Produkt steht. Wie wir daraus eine unverwechselbare Marke machen, gestalten wir jetzt. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Hinter Fortisana stehen Piran, Leon und Max:

  • Piran hat KoRo mitgegründet und über neun Jahre zu einer der erfolgreichsten Lebensmittelmarken Deutschlands aufgebaut.

  • Leon ist Ernährungsberater und in der Welt der Nahrungsergänzung aufgewachsen. Seine Familie produziert seit über 25 Jahren Nahrungsergänzungsmittel in Deutschland.

  • Max hat bereits mehr als sechs Startups begleitet und zuletzt bei 1KOMMA5° gelernt, wie aus einer Vision ein operativ exzellentes Unternehmen wird.

Du gibst Fortisana auf Social Media Haltung, Sprache und einen eigenen Stil. Und du findest heraus, welche Botschaften bei welchen Menschen wirklich ankommen.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du übersetzt Strategie in Inhalte. Aus unserer Positionierung entwickelst du Botschaften, Tonalität und Formate für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen und Kaufmotive.

  • Du stellst gute Fragen und testest deine Antworten. Du formulierst Hypothesen, entwickelst passende Inhalte und legst fest, woran wir ihren Erfolg erkennen.

  • Du setzt selbst um. Du schreibst Texte und produzierst Kurzvideos, Stories und Bildserien – von der ersten Idee bis zur Veröffentlichung.

  • Du lernst aus Zahlen. Du wertest Ergebnisse aus, ziehst Schlüsse und priorisierst die nächsten Tests.

  • Du hörst zu. Fragen und Rückmeldungen aus der Community bringst du ins Team zurück, damit wir Marke und Angebot weiterentwickeln.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du denkst in Zielgruppen und Wirkung. Du kannst erklären, wen ein Inhalt erreichen soll und warum du ihn genau so umsetzt.

  • Du hast schon etwas ausprobiert. Zeig uns einen Kanal, eine Kampagne, ein Hochschulprojekt oder ein eigenes Projekt. Entscheidend ist, was du gemacht und gelernt hast.

  • Du verbindest Kreativität mit Analyse. Du liest Zahlen und leitest daraus Entscheidungen ab.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher. Ausgezeichnete Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind Voraussetzung. Du formulierst in beiden Sprachen sicher, präzise und zielgruppengerecht.

  • Du gehst sorgfältig mit Gesundheitsthemen um. Du machst komplexe Inhalte verständlich, ohne sie zu übertreiben.

  • Du bist vor Ort. Du kannst sechs Monate in Vollzeit in Berlin mit uns arbeiten.

  • Du arbeitest AI-native und mit Qualitätsanspruch. Du testest eigenständig neue KI-Tools und kreative Ansätze und integrierst sie sinnvoll in deine Workflows. Dabei prüfst du die Ergebnisse kritisch und hältst unseren Qualitätsstandard bei Inhalt, Gestaltung und Genauigkeit hoch.

  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung in Marketing, Markenaufbau oder Kommunikation sowie mit Video und Schnitt.

Was wir dir bieten

Du prägst mit, wie Fortisana aussieht, klingt und sich anfühlt. Dafür bekommst du kreativen Freiraum, Verantwortung und direktes Feedback vom Gründerteam. Der Markt ist voll. Wir wollen auffallen – mit guten Ideen und dem Mut, sie auszuprobieren.

In sechs Monaten entwickelst du deine Fähigkeiten in Markenstrategie, Storytelling und Produktion weiter und baust ein Portfolio auf, das deine Handschrift trägt. Nach einem erfolgreichen Praktikum besteht die Möglichkeit einer unbefristeten Vollzeitstelle mit Unternehmensbeteiligung.

Zeig uns deine Arbeit 🤎

Schick uns drei Arbeiten, auf die du stolz bist. Sag bei jeder Arbeit konkret, was von dir stammt: Idee, Skript, Dreh, Schnitt oder Veröffentlichung – und ob sie im Job, für einen Kunden oder als eigenes Projekt entstanden ist. Wenn vorhanden, ergänze Ergebnisse und was du daraus gelernt hast. Dazu brauchen wir deinen Standort, deinen möglichen Starttermin und ein kurzes Profil oder einen Lebenslauf.

title: Content Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
As a Content Marketing Manager you will own organic social as an always-on channel for the Scandinavian market, translating the global content and brand strategy into relevant local content. You will manage the local community in their own language and act as the fast, native-speaking point of contact for market-specific content needs, working within existing SEO and brand frameworks rather than building a parallel strategy.

PERGOLUX designs and sells Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, such as pergolas and garden furniture, directly to customers. We are a premium e-commerce company with around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue, and operations across 8 markets, combining Nordic design with a clear focus on quality and customer experience.

What You'll Do

  • Turn the global content calendar and brand pillars into a market-specific plan aligned to local seasonality, holidays, and campaigns, and spot content gaps and opportunities.

  • Own the daily organic social channels (Instagram, TikTok, and others): content creation, planning, and community management, adapting global assets to local tone and interacting with the community in the local language.

  • Localise and adapt blog and on-site content from the global calendar, including cultural adaptation and light on-page SEO, and support blog refreshes.

  • Act as the local-language quality check across all content types and the first point of contact for ad-hoc content needs, escalating to global Creative Ops when full production is required.

  • Shape the influencer content plan, create briefings and timelines, track performance, and grow influencer outreach in the market, including repurposing creator/UGC content with credit and cleared rights.

What You'll Bring

  • 2–4 years in content marketing, organic social, or a hybrid content/social role, ideally in e-commerce or DTC.

  • Native or near-native skills in a Scandinavian language, plus confident English for cross-team collaboration.

  • Experience working within others' brand and SEO frameworks rather than setting strategy independently.

  • Strong sense for short-form, social-first content plus solid long-form writing and editing, proven localisation experience (real adaptation, not just translation), and photo/video editing for fast social content.

  • Nice to have: experience working with a central/global marketing function and familiarity with GA and native platform insights (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn) for simple performance reporting.

💼 Compensation — Competitive salary · Company pension · Fully paid, capped overtime without endless unpaid crunch

🚀 Growth and Career Development — You will take real ownership of organic social and local content from day one and can grow into a senior role as influencer outreach expands and PERGOLUX scales further.

⏰ Time Off and Flexibility — Up to 30 vacation days, starting at 27 · One week of remote workation per year in the EU/UK

🌟 Benefits and Lifestyle

  • Jobrad / bike leasing program for sustainable, healthy commuting

  • Team culture with regular events (summer party, Christmas party, after-work meetups) and retreats

  • Modern setup and laptops (Apple or Windows)

  • Employee discounts on PERGOLUX products

📍 Office Location – Schlesische Str. 27 C, Building C, 6th floor, 10997 Berlin

How to Apply

Sounds like you? We'd love to receive your application. Find out more about us and open roles on our Career Page and on LinkedIn.

PERGOLUX is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, we think it's less about ticking every box and more about what you bring to the table!

title: Corporate Counsel
descriptionHtml:
About IMU Biosciences

IMU Biosciences has developed proprietary platform technologies that generate and translate vast system-level immune data into actionable insights and tools to drive the development of precision medicines across a variety of diseases. IMU leverages advanced immune profiling with proprietary AI and machine learning analytics to uncover novel clinical immune signatures. IMU continues to establish partnerships with leading pharma and biotech companies to advance disease diagnosis, optimise product selection, and improve patient stratification and monitoring - while also building its own pipeline of innovative products.

About The Role

 

We are seeking Corporate Counsel to support IMU Biosciences across key commercial, operational, and clinical matters. In this role, you will draft and negotiate complex contracts, safeguard our IP portfolio, and provide actionable legal counsel to internal teams as we expand our platform capabilities and pipeline. You will be working with a dynamic team of stakeholders working on the cutting edge of biotech and machine learning, with support from the CLO, Contracts Manager and outside counsel.

Core Responsibilities

 

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of commercial contracts, including vendor agreements, service contracts, and strategic partnerships.

  • Provide clear, practical legal advice and guidance across all commercial matters to internal teams and organizational stakeholders.

  • Help build internal legal policies, contract playbooks, and training programs while managing outside counsel when needed.

 

Team and Ways of Working

You will join a collaborative Legal team comprising the Chief Legal Officer and a Contracts

Manager, with support from external counsel. Each team member takes ownership of their

areas of responsibility, working independently and proactively while collaborating to achieve the team’s and wider business’s objectives.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience

Qualification Requirements

  • Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.), Juris Doctor (J.D.), or equivalent law degree from an accredited institution.

  • Qualified solicitor or active bar admission in good standing in at least one relevant jurisdiction.

  • 3–7 years of post-qualification experience inhouse and/or private practice in biotech, pharmaceutical, or life sciences.

  • Strong foundational knowledge of commercial contracts, intellectual property considerations, and relevant regulatory frameworks in healthcare or biotechnology.

Technical Must-Haves (Essential Skills)

  • Strong proficiency in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating basic commercial contracts and service agreements in a timely fashion based on project needs.

  • Conversant with complex commercial contracts within the biotech or life sciences sector including IP licence provisions, with support as needed.

  • Strong familiarity with regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and healthcare standards relevant to biotechnology and life sciences.

  • Good technical understanding of life sciences relevant to clinical development.

Nice-to-Haves (Desirable Skills).

 

  • Working knowledge of data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR) as applied to clinical, biological, and health data.

  • Experience working with AI/ML and/or platform technologies.

Key Competencies

 

  • Collaborative nature: Works confidently with scientists, commercial colleagues, senior leaders and external partners.

  • Proactive: Takes the initiative to identify and address stakeholder needs as they arise.

  • Advocacy: Can advocate the legal position in cross functional teams

  • Flexible thinking: Able to see more than one approach as project needs and priorities change in a dynamic environment.

 

Why Join Us?

● Competitive salary and company bonus scheme

● Pension, health insurance, life assurance, and income protection

● Fast-paced, collaborative startup culture

● Strong opportunities for career development and progression

title: Corporate Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’ collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

Superhuman is on a mission to build the fastest, most delightful productivity experiences powered by AI. As we scale rapidly, our internal technology operations must evolve to match our ambition.

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to join our Corporate Technology team. Our commitment to user trust is unwavering, and this new team member will play a crucial role in protecting Superhuman’s corporate environment and the infrastructure that millions of users depend on. Working closely with the Corporate Infrastructure team, you will harden and secure the systems our employees rely on every day, Identity and Access Management, Endpoint Management, SaaS platforms, and Networking, while ensuring that security enables speed rather than slowing it down.

This is an opportunity to build and maintain critical security programs, including Insider Risk, Threat and Vulnerability Management, and Third-Party Risk. You’ll leverage AI to build smarter security controls and processes, and help define how AI itself is secured across our corporate infrastructure. Your work will empower employees to move fast while maintaining a high bar for corporate security.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and maintain corporate security controls that enable employees to move fast with confidence, making the secure path the easiest path.

  • Develop security standards, guidelines, and policies in collaboration with the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team.

  • Leverage AI to build and scale security controls, automate security processes, and accelerate threat detection and response across our corporate infrastructure.

  • Define and implement AI security standards for the corporate environment, ensuring employees can safely adopt AI-powered tools and workflows.

  • Perform risk assessments and security assurance on systems that support Superhuman’s business operations: IdP, operating systems, desktop applications, SaaS solutions, and network infrastructure (ZTNA, CASB, VPN).

  • Lead the design and execution of a corporate Zero Trust architecture, working across identity, endpoint, and network security.

  • Drive the remediation of security vulnerabilities identified through assessments.

  • Evaluate and implement cutting-edge enterprise security technology to continuously strengthen our security posture.

Qualifications

  • Has 6+ years of experience working on a Security team in corporate security, enterprise security, or a related domain for a SaaS company.

  • Expert-level understanding and experience in at least two corporate security domains: Identity and Access Management, Endpoint Management, SaaS platforms, and Networking.

  • Strong experience with data protection technologies (DSPM, discovery, masking, access controls, DLP, backup).

  • Strong experience with assessing the configuration of common SaaS applications (SSPM), such as Salesforce, Workday, and Coupa.

  • Strong experience with both macOS and Windows endpoint security.

  • Familiarity with AI security principles and practical knowledge of how to secure AI adoption in a corporate environment.

  • Demonstrated experience using AI to build security controls, automate security processes, or scale security operations.

  • Ability to assess risk in ambiguous situations and make balanced security decisions that consider both offensive and defensive perspectives.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and manage up effectively.

  • A mindset that security should enable speed, experience designing controls that protect without creating unnecessary friction.

  • Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Professional Growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first, hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture rooted in our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our team member resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations—to apply. Superhuman is an equal opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, sexual identity, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, criminal prosecution, judgment in a criminal case, or any other characteristic protected by law.

For more details about the personal data Superhuman collects during the recruitment process, for what purposes, and how you can address your rights, please see the Superhuman Data Privacy Notice for Candidates here.

title: Creative Director (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Teaching Socials

Teaching Socials ist die führende Unternehmensberatung für Personal Brands im Finanz- & Immobilienbereich im DACH-Raum. Unser Team aus 25 High-Performern hat innerhalb von 2 Jahren ein konstantes Monatswachstum von über 750.000 € aufgebaut. Wir verbinden Sichtbarkeit, Kundenakquise und Unternehmenswachstum in einem System – und du sorgst mit deinen Videos dafür, dass aus Ideen Reichweite, aus Zuschauern qualifizierte Leads und aus Personal Brands messbare Ergebnisse werden.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Content-Strategie: Du entwickelst für jeden Kunden einen Content-Plan für die nächsten Wochen und leitest daraus einen klaren Produktionsplan für die Cutter ab.

  • Ideen und Skripte: Du findest die Themen, Hooks und Titel für alle Hauptvideos auf YouTube und schreibst die Skripte selbst.

  • Dreh: Du begleitest Drehs, verstehst Kamera, Licht und Ton und greifst selbst zur Kamera, wenn es nötig ist.

  • Schnitt und Qualität: Du gibst jedes Video frei, bevor es zum Kunden geht. Was nicht gut genug ist, geht zurück.

  • Cutter-Führung: Du führst das Cutter-Team, gibst regelmäßig konkretes Feedback und machst jeden Editor messbar besser.

  • Shortform und Ads: Du sorgst dafür, dass aus jedem Longform-Video verwertbare Clips und Ad-Creatives entstehen.

  • Kundenkommunikation: Du führst die Weeklys mit unseren Kunden, erklärst, was produziert wird und warum, und vertrittst deine Entscheidungen auch dann, wenn der Kunde anders denkt.

Was für dich drin ist:

  • Starkes Team: Familiäres Umfeld, gemeinsame Erfolge und Geburtstage

  • Schnelle Wege: Deine Ideen werden intern umgesetzt, statt in endlosen Entscheidungsschleifen zu versanden

  • Direkter Impact: Deine Videos beeinflussen unmittelbar Reichweite, Leads und Umsätze unserer Kunden

  • Führung: Du führst ein eigenes Cutter-Team und prägst, wie bei uns Content entsteht

  • Wachstum: Du arbeitest mit unterschiedlichen Personal Brands, Formaten und Zielgruppen und entwickelst dich als Creator und Führungskraft kontinuierlich weiter

Das bringst du mit:

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung als Content Creator, Video Producer oder Head of Content, idealerweise mit Fokus auf YouTube-Longform, Shortform und Video-Ads

  • Ein Portfolio mit Videos, die du verantwortet hast, idealerweise mit messbaren Ergebnissen wie Views, Klickrate und Zuschauerbindung

  • Fundiertes Verständnis dafür, was ein Video viral macht: Hook, Titel, Thumbnail, Storytelling und Retention

  • Starkes Gespür für Ideen und Skripte: Du schreibst YouTube-Skripte selbst, die Zuschauer bis zum Ende halten

  • Editing auf hohem Niveau: Longform, Shortform und cinematic – idealerweise bist du selbst Creator

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Kamera, Licht und Ton: Du kannst selbst drehen

  • Verständnis für Video-Ads und ihre Rolle im Funnel und in der Customer Journey

  • Sicherer Umgang mit relevanten Kennzahlen wie CTR, Zuschauerbindung, Views und CPL

  • Führungserfahrung: Du steuerst mehrere Cutter gleichzeitig, planst Produktion und gibst Feedback, das dein Team besser macht

  • Souveräne Kundenkommunikation: Du führst Weeklys und vertrittst deine Content-Entscheidungen auch gegenüber anspruchsvollen Unternehmern

  • Hohe Standards: Kein Video verlässt dein Team, hinter dem du nicht selbst stehst

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du wartest nicht auf Ansagen, sondern bringst eigene Ideen und Trends ein

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau

  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Podcast- und Event-Drehs sowie tiefes Technik-Verständnis (Kamera-Setups, Equipment, Workflows)

Du passt eher nicht zu uns, wenn …

  • du lieber schöne Bilder produzierst, statt Videos, die Reichweite und Nachfrage erzeugen

  • du nur schneiden willst und Ideen, Skripte und Strategie anderen überlässt

  • du dich auf Bauchgefühl verlässt und Klickrate, Retention und Views ignorierst

  • du Videos rausgibst, hinter denen du selbst nicht stehst

  • du Trends anderer kopierst, statt eigene Ideen und Formate zu entwickeln

  • du Feedback persönlich nimmst oder deinem Team kein klares Feedback geben willst

  • du lange an einem einzelnen Video feilst, aber Schwierigkeiten hast, im Volumen zu liefern

  • du Deadlines eher als Empfehlung siehst

  • du Kunden nicht klar sagen magst, wenn etwas nicht funktioniert

  • dich klare Ziele, Zahlen und ein performanceorientiertes Umfeld eher abschrecken

  • du einfach nur einen Job suchst und nicht bereit bist, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln


Klingt nach dir? Dann lass uns herausfinden, ob wir zusammenpassen – bewirb dich jetzt!

Benefits

  • Betriebliche Weiterbildung

Häufige Fragen zum Loom-Video im Bewerbungsprozess

Wenn du dich bei uns bewirbst möchten wir ein Loom Video von dir erhalten. 🙏🏻

Warum wollt ihr ein Video statt eines Anschreibens? Weil wir in der Content-Branche arbeiten und uns ein kurzes Video in zwei Minuten mehr über dich sagt als jedes Anschreiben.

Was ist Loom und brauche ich einen Account? Loom ist ein kostenloses Tool, mit dem du dich selbst und/oder deinen Bildschirm aufnimmst und per Link teilst. Die kostenlose Version reicht völlig. Du kannst auch jedes andere Tool nutzen (z. B. Handyvideo über Google Drive) Hauptsache, wir können den Link öffnen.

Wie lang sollte das Video sein? 2–4 Minuten. Kürzer ist besser als länger – wenn du es knapp auf den Punkt bringst, ist das schon ein Pluspunkt.

Was soll ich im Video sagen? Stell dich kurz vor, erzähl, warum du zu RealStudio willst, und zeig uns ein Projekt, einen Kunden oder ein Ergebnis, auf das du stolz bist. Gerne mit geteiltem Bildschirm, z. B. Kampagnen, Reportings oder Content, an dem du beteiligt warst.

Muss das Video professionell aussehen? Nein. Kein Schnitt, keine Musik, kein Skript nötig. Wir bewerten nicht die Videoqualität, sondern dich. Ein ruhiger Ort und guter Ton reichen.

Auf Deutsch oder Englisch? Bitte auf Deutsch, da unsere Kunden überwiegend aus dem DACH-Raum kommen.

Wer sieht mein Video? Nur die Personen, die bei uns am Bewerbungsprozess beteiligt sind. Wir teilen es nicht weiter und löschen es nach Abschluss des Verfahrens.

Wie geht es nach dem Video weiter? Wir melden uns innerhalb von max 2 Werktagen bei dir. Wenn es passt, folgt ein Kennenlern-Call und danach ein Probetag, an dem du an einer realistischen Aufgabe mit uns arbeitest.

title: Customer Operations Manager B2B SaaS (w/m/d) – Technical Customer Success
descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

Die ParkEfficient GmbH ist ein wachsendes B2B-Softwareunternehmen, das sich auf die Digitalisierung des Parkraum- und Arbeitsplatzmanagements spezialisiert hat.

Mit unseren SaaS-Lösungen ParkEfficient und OfficeEfficient unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre Büro- und Parkflächen effizienter zu nutzen, Prozesse zu automatisieren und moderne Arbeitsumgebungen zu gestalten.

Zu unseren Kunden gehören führende Banken, Versicherungen und eine Vielzahl von Unternehmen, vom deutschen Mittelstand bis hin zu DAX-Unternehmen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit im Projektmanagement, die unsere Kunden bei der Einführung unserer Softwarelösungen begleitet und Implementierungsprojekte eigenverantwortlich zum Erfolg führt.

Deine Mission

Als Senior Customer Operations Manager bist du eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden, dem Customer Success, Projektmanagement und unserer Softwareentwicklung.

Du übernimmst anspruchsvolle technische Kundenanfragen, analysierst komplexe Problemstellungen und sorgst für nachhaltige Lösungen. Gleichzeitig optimierst du unsere operativen Abläufe und gestaltest den weiteren Aufbau unseres Customer-Operations-Bereichs.

Die Position verbindet technischen 2nd-Level-Support und operatives SaaS-Kundenmanagement.

Deine Aufgaben

2nd-Level-Support & Technical Troubleshooting

  • Du übernimmst komplexe technische und funktionale Kundenanfragen, die über unseren First-Level-Support hinausgehen.

  • Du analysierst Softwarefehler, unerwartetes Systemverhalten und technische Probleme und gehst deren Ursachen systematisch auf den Grund.

  • Du stellst Fehler nach, grenzt Problemursachen ein und entwickelst eigenständig Lösungen oder geeignete Workarounds.

  • Du unterscheidest zwischen Anwendungsfehlern, Konfigurationsproblemen und tatsächlichen Softwarebugs.

  • Du koordinierst technische Eskalationen mit unserem Entwicklungsteam, bereitest Fehlerbeschreibungen strukturiert auf und begleitest die Umsetzung bis zur erfolgreichen Lösung.

  • Du unterstützt unser Support-Team bei besonders anspruchsvollen Fällen und gibst dein technisches Wissen aktiv weiter.

Customer Operations & Technische Bestandskundenbetreuung

  • Du unterstützt unsere Bestandskunden bei komplexeren Konfigurationen, individuellen Anforderungen und der optimalen Nutzung unserer SaaS-Plattformen.

  • Du übernimmst anspruchsvolle Anfragen von Administratoren und Kundenverantwortlichen.

  • Du sorgst gemeinsam mit unserem Projektmanagement für eine strukturierte Übergabe neuer Kunden in die laufende Betreuung.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Customer-Success-Team zusammen und schaffst die operativen Voraussetzungen für eine proaktive Kundenbetreuung.

Prozessoptimierung & Wissensmanagement

  • Du entwickelst unseren 2nd-Level-Support und unsere Customer-Operations-Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Du etablierst klare Zuständigkeiten, effiziente Ticket- und Eskalationsprozesse sowie ein systematisches Problemmanagement.

  • Du analysierst wiederkehrende Supportfälle, identifizierst deren Ursachen und leitest gemeinsam mit unserem Produkt- und Entwicklungsteam nachhaltige Verbesserungen ab.

  • Du baust unsere Wissensdatenbank, technischen Dokumentationen und Self-Service-Angebote weiter aus.

  • Du optimierst unsere Workflows und internen Tools, insbesondere HubSpot, Jira und Confluence.

Team- und Bereichsentwicklung

  • Du bringst deine Erfahrung beim Aufbau einer professionellen und skalierbaren Customer-Operations-Struktur ein.

  • Du unterstützt die fachliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Support- und Customer-Success-Mitarbeitenden.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung Standards für Servicequalität, Kundenzufriedenheit und effiziente Abläufe.

  • Perspektivisch besteht die Möglichkeit, zusätzliche Verantwortung für die fachliche Koordination oder Leitung des Bereichs zu übernehmen.

Qualifikation

Wen wir suchen

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einem technisch anspruchsvollen B2B-SaaS-Umfeld, idealerweise im 2nd-Level-Support, Technical Customer Success, Application Support oder Customer Operations.

  • Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis und praktische Erfahrung in der Analyse und Lösung komplexer Softwareprobleme.

  • Erfahrung mit Ticketmanagement, Supportprozessen und der Zusammenarbeit mit Softwareentwicklungsteams.

  • Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt und die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Sachverhalte verständlich zu erklären.

  • Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und den Anspruch, Probleme nachhaltig zu lösen und Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle in unserer technischen Kundenbetreuung und kannst den Aufbau unserer Customer-Operations-Strukturen aktiv mitgestalten.

title: Customer Service and Sales administaror
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Cloverleaf Plumbing, Heating & Renewables is a well-established and growing business, proudly serving customers since 1994.

We specialise in plumbing, heating, air conditioning and renewable energy solutions, helping homeowners and businesses improve their comfort and energy efficiency.

As our business continues to grow, we're looking for an enthusiastic, organised and confident individual to join our friendly office team.

About the Role

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working with people, thrives in a busy office environment, and wants to develop their career in customer relationship and sales.

Initially, the role will focus primarily on general office administration, customer service and supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the business.

However, we're looking for more than someone who simply processes paperwork.

You'll also play an important role in how we welcome new customers, manage incoming enquiries and guide prospective clients through the early stages of their journey with Cloverleaf.

As you become familiar with our services, systems and customers, there will be opportunities to take on greater sales responsibilities, develop your commercial skills and earn additional income through a commission structure.

You don't need to be a heating or renewable energy expert. We're much more interested in finding someone with the right personality, communication skills and willingness to learn.

Key Responsibilities

Office Administration & Operations

  • Manage and coordinate boiler and air source heat pump servicing, including customer reminders, bookings and follow-up communications.

  • Complete manufacturer product and warranty registrations, ensuring accurate records are maintained.

  • Assist with the administration of our company vehicle fleet, including servicing, MOTs, insurance and general vehicle records.

  • Maintain accurate customer information, job records and documentation within our Simpro management system.

  • Support the scheduling and coordination of engineers and customer appointments.

  • Liaise with customers, engineers, suppliers and other members of the team to ensure jobs progress smoothly.

  • Assist with general office administration and other operational tasks as required.

Customer Enquiries & Relationship Management

  • Act as a friendly, professional and confident first point of contact for customers contacting Cloverleaf by telephone, email or through our website.

  • Handle new sales enquiries, asking relevant questions to understand customers' requirements and identify the most appropriate next step.

  • Qualify and organise incoming enquiries, ensuring customers are directed towards the correct service, appointment or member of the team.

  • Build rapport with prospective customers and maintain communication throughout the early stages of their enquiry.

  • Arrange initial consultations, surveys and follow-up appointments with the appropriate team members.

  • Proactively follow up with prospective customers, keeping conversations moving forward and ensuring opportunities are not overlooked.

  • Maintain accurate customer notes and enquiry records to support a structured and professional sales process.

Sales Development & Career Progression

As you gain experience and confidence, we would like you to become increasingly involved in the commercial side of the business.

This could include:

  • Following up on quotations and helping customers make informed purchasing decisions.

  • Developing the confidence to discuss our services, explain their benefits and address common customer objections.

  • Managing your own customer enquiries and progressing opportunities through the sales process.

  • Helping convert enquiries into confirmed appointments and accepted quotations.

  • Working towards agreed sales targets with the opportunity to earn commission.

Full training and ongoing support will be provided as your responsibilities develop.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who combines excellent organisational skills with a natural ability to communicate and build relationships.

Essential Skills & Qualities

  • Previous experience in office administration, customer service or a similar role.

  • Confident, friendly and professional telephone manner.

  • Comfortable starting conversations with new customers and asking questions to understand their needs.

  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage several tasks and priorities.

  • Excellent attention to detail and a reliable approach to completing administrative work.

  • Good written communication and computer skills.

  • A proactive attitude, with the confidence to take ownership of tasks and follow them through.

  • Willingness to learn new systems, processes and technical information.

  • A positive, enthusiastic personality and the ability to work well within a small team.

  • An interest in developing customer relationship and sales skills.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience working in plumbing, heating, air conditioning, renewables, construction or a related industry.

  • Previous experience in a customer-facing sales or sales support role.

  • Experience using CRM or job management software such as Simpro.

  • Experience managing service schedules, customer appointments or maintenance contracts.

  • Previous involvement in following up on quotations or converting customer enquiries into sales.

Industry experience is an advantage but is not essential. We believe that the right attitude, personality and communication skills are just as important as previous technical knowledge.

What We Offer

  • Competitive basic salary of £26,000–£29,000 per annum, depending on experience.

  • Opportunity to earn additional sales commission as your role develops.

  • 20 days' annual leave plus 8 bank holidays.

  • An additional 3 days' paid holiday gifted by the company during our Christmas shutdown.

  • Workplace pension scheme.

  • Friendly, supportive and established team environment.

  • Training on our products, services and business systems.

  • Genuine opportunities for professional development as the company continues to grow.

  • The opportunity to play an important role in a growing business within the renewable energy sector.

How to Apply

If you're organised, enjoy speaking with people and would like a role that offers both variety and the opportunity to develop your career, we'd love to hear from you.

We're particularly interested in hearing from candidates who are confident on the telephone, enjoy building customer relationships and are motivated to take on more responsibility over time.

Please apply with your up-to-date CV and a brief introduction explaining why you feel you'd be a good fit for our team.

title: Customer Service Team Lead - Motor
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

Role Purpose

Location: Chatham, Kent.

As a Team Lead across the frontline servicing division, you will lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 10 front-line agents responsible for delivering exceptional service and support to customers, including those in complex or vulnerable circumstances. You will ensure the consistent achievement of key performance indicators (KPIs), use data and insight to foster continuous improvement, and champion initiatives that streamline processes and improve customer experiences. You will dedicate a substantial portion of your time (up to 30%) to identifying and supporting process improvements, leveraging frontline insights to inform automation, digital enhancements, and re-engineering of complex workflows. You will play a pivotal role developing your team, managing risk, ensuring compliance, and collaborating cross-functionally to deliver the best possible customer and business outcomes.

 

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach, and inspire a team of 10 agents, ensuring they deliver high-quality, empathetic support and achieve team and individual KPIs (e.g., customer satisfaction, quality, compliance, productivity, SLAs).

  • Foster a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and best practice, tailoring support and development to the needs of each team member and identifying emerging talent.

  • Conduct regular individual and team performance reviews, providing actionable feedback and targeted coaching.

Performance Management & Data-Driven Improvement

  • Monitor and analyse a variety of data sources (KPIs, dashboards, call listening, QA, customer feedback) to assess individual and team performance.

  • Identify trends, performance gaps, opportunities for improvement, and design appropriate action plans to uplift service quality and efficiency.

  • Escalate and resolve issues proactively, using data and customer insights to drive change.

Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Dedicate up to 30% of your time to reviewing customer and team interactions (calls, chats, digital correspondence, workflows) to identify process pain points and improvement opportunities.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Technology, and Operational teams to support automation, system enhancements, and re-engineering of complex processes.

  • Champion and embed process changes, ensuring they improve customer journeys, efficiency, compliance, and accessibility, especially for vulnerable or high-risk customers.

Compliance, Risk & Quality

  • Ensure your team's customer interactions meet regulatory and compliance standards relevant to all customer segments, with particular attention to those in vulnerable or complex situations.

  • Promote risk awareness, adherence to policies, and corrective action where necessary.

  • Support in embedding governance, quality frameworks, and change management initiatives within the team.

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Communicate performance, risks, best practices, and improvement recommendations to the relevant Head of Department and across teams as required.

  • Act as an advocate for frontline feedback and customer insight, driving positive change through cross-functional collaboration.

Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience managing or supervising customer-facing, operations, or support teams in a regulated, fast-paced, and/or tech-enabled environment.

  • Experience in driving the performance and development of individuals and teams against ambitious targets.

  • Analytical skills, with the ability to interpret a range of data sources (dashboards, QA, customer feedback) to inform coaching and process improvements.

  • Demonstrated ability to motivate, coach, and develop a diverse team; skilled at recognising and nurturing emerging talent.

  • Comfortable working with CRM/case management systems, digital platforms, and supporting technology-driven change (automation, AI, etc.).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage, motivate, and influence at all levels.

title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Diese Rolle passt perfekt zu Dir, wenn Du:

  • du Energie von Gesprächen bekommst und gerne im Austausch bist

  • Lust hast, Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens zu sein
  • 1-2 Jahre Erfahrung im Account Management oder Kundenkontakt mitbringst
  • erste Erfahrung mit CRM Systemen und digitalen Abläufen hast

Diese Rolle passt gar nicht, wenn Du:

  • auf detaillierte Anweisungen wartest, bevor du einen Schritt machst
  • Kundengespräche als lästige Pflicht siehst
  • du dich an wiederkehrenden Aufgaben und optimierten Prozessen störst

Was wir machen

Fired Up bietet Weiterbildungen und Coaching für Menschen in der Karriereorientierung – gefördert über Bildungsgutschein und AVGS, kostenlos für unsere Teilnehmenden. Wir sind AZAV-zertifiziert und begleiten jährlich über 1.300 Menschen durch unsere Programme. Unser kleines, engagiertes Team in Berlin wächst und du kannst ein Teil davon sein. Die Arbeitswelt verändert sich gerade stark durch KI und wir haben einen Impact, Menschen Zugänge zur neuen Arbeitswelt zu schaffen.

Dein Job (konkret, nicht in Buzzwords)

Intro Calls mit unseren Clients führen

Dein Kernstück: Du führst täglich zehn bis zwölf kurze Erstgespräche (je 15 Minuten) mit Menschen, die gerade in einer beruflichen Umbruchphase sind. Du informierst sie über unsere Angebote, nimmst dir kurz Zeit für sie – und schickst danach eine knappe Follow-up-Mail. Klingt simpel, hat aber echten Einfluss auf Menschen in einer verletzlichen Phase.

Was du brauchst: Kommunikationsstärke, Empathie, aktives Zuhören, gutes Zeitgefühl, fließendes Deutsch und Englisch

Matching mit unseren Programmen

Du informierst welche Programme wir anbieten und schaust welche am besten passt.

Was du brauchst: Sorgfalt, Systemverständnis (Hubspot), Kollaborationsbereitschaft

Follow Up Aufgaben

Du bleibst an den Menschen dran, rufst an um zu sehen ob das Programm beantragt wurde.

Was du brauchst: Grid, Drive, Energie

Was du mitbringst

Must-haves:

  • Freundliche, empathische Kommunikation – du machst Menschen das Ankommen leicht
  • 1-2 Jahre Erfahrung im Kundenservice
  • Fließend Deutsch und Englisch, mündlich und schriftlich
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise – du weißt, was als nächstes zu tun ist

Nice-to-haves:

  • Kontakt mit Weiterbildung, EdTech und/oder Coaching
  • Vertrautheit mit CRM-Systemen, idealerweise Hubspot

Dealbreaker:

  • Für dich steht Strategie im Vordergrund
  • Empathie ist nicht deine Stärke
  • Schnelligkeit in Arbeitsprozessen schreckt dich ab

Was wir bieten

Kultur:

  • Kein BS: Wir reden miteinander, nicht übereinander
  • Impact: Deine Arbeit verändert das Leben von Menschen, die einen Neustart brauchen
  • Team Support: Großer Support mit deinen Team Mitgliedern

Strukturell:

  • 28 Urlaubstage
  • Strukturiertes Onboarding in den ersten drei Monaten – du wirst nicht ins kalte Wasser geschmissen

Es ist eine Rolle für jemanden, der wirklich zuhören kann, der Struktur liebt und der Lust hat, in einem wachsenden Berliner Startup echten Impact zu haben.

Wenn das nach dir klingt: Wir freuen uns auf dich.
