title: Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
Help bring new technology to live construction sites

 

About XYZ Reality

XYZ Reality created the world’s first engineering-grade augmented reality for construction. Our site-safe hardhat, The Atom, overlays the design model onto the live build, so our engineers can verify work as it goes in on some of the most complex mission-critical projects in the world.

Backed by Series B investment and growing fast across the US, UK and Europe, we’re a driven, passionate team changing how the industry builds.

If you want your work to shape how the world gets built, we’d like to hear from you.

Our project delivery team runs XYZ's service on site across multiple active projects, from mobilisation to handover.

 

THE ROLE

Customer Success Managers are the face of XYZ Reality for our clients. You'll help people feel the product.
This role is for someone who has spent years in construction delivery, in Electrical Engineering, CSA, Project Controls or Commissioning, and knows the industry inside out. You'll use that experience to connect with site teams on their level, understand their pressures, and show them how XYZ Reality helps them deliver better. You're not a software salesperson. You're a construction professional who has found a better way.
You'll spend a lot of time on sites, working directly with project teams and building trust. You'll also hold your own in a room with VPs and senior client stakeholders, translating field reality into business value.

Location: We're open to candidates based in the UK or across Europe, with regular travel to client sites.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the day-to-day client relationship across your assigned projects, acting as the primary point of contact for site teams, project managers, and senior stakeholders to ensure they are getting full value from the XYZ platform.

  • Drive on-site adoption of the XYZ platform, working directly with field teams to embed the service into daily workflows, remove adoption barriers, and ensure the product is genuinely improving how work gets done.

  • Be the bridge between site and senior leadership, translating on-the-ground performance, issues, and wins into clear reporting and insight for client Project Directors, Construction Directors, and VPs.

  • Identify risks to client satisfaction or adoption early, flagging issues proactively, coordinating with internal teams to resolve them, and maintaining a high standard of delivery across every project touchpoint.

  • Support commercial growth, contributing to account retention and expansion by building strong relationships, demonstrating measurable delivery impact, and working with colleagues on client conversations.

  • Feed real-world insight back into XYZ, sharing client feedback, site observations, and adoption patterns with colleagues to help shape how the platform and service evolves.

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Proven background in construction delivery with specialism in one or more of: Electrical Engineering, Civil / Structural / Architectural (CSA), Project Controls, or Commissioning, on major programmes.

  • Hands-on site experience that gives you genuine credibility with field teams

  • Communication skills to engage effectively with senior client stakeholders up to VP level.

  • Comfortable with extensive travel to project sites as a core part of the role; this is a field-facing position, not a desk job.

  • Curiosity about technology and genuine openness to learn; you do not need to be a tech expert, but you need to believe that better tools can change how construction gets delivered.

 

KEY EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

  • Deep construction specialism: Electrical, CSA, Project Controls, or Commissioning

  • Naturally builds trust with site teams & senior stakeholders alike

  • Clear, confident communicator from Sub-Contractor to VP

  • Client-focused with a drive to deliver measurable value

  • Curious about technology & motivated to learn

  • Resilient, adaptable & thrives in a fast-moving environment

 

BENEFITS (UK)

  • 🚇 Office a 5 minute walk from Angel station

About FullEnrich:

Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. We solve that problem: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them and verifying data in real-time until we find the best available contact information. The result is industry-leading coverage and data quality, helping sales and GTM teams connect with the right people faster.

What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted GTM data infrastructure layer powering modern revenue teams and AI agents. Today, more than 6,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, Intercom, Unify,and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.

Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.

The Role:

You’ll be joining as a Customer Success Manager in our Customer Success team, reporting to Jemima, our Founding CSM.

FullEnrich has grown to 5,000+ customers, and our CS function has been a team of one until now. We're bringing in our next CSM to own all of our French-speaking customers, across every segment, plus our Scale/SMB book ($10k to $25k ARR). Day to day, you'll onboard new customers, drive adoption, run renewals end to end, and spot the accounts that are ready to grow. Ownership here means your book is yours: you know every account, you close every renewal, and you catch risk before it turns into churn. You'll work closely with Sales, Product and Support, and because the team is still small, you'll help shape the playbooks the rest of CS is built on.

What You'll Do:

Own your book

  • Own the post-sale relationship for all of our French-speaking customers who range from Enterprise to SMB, plus our Scale/SMB book

  • Run onboarding and kick-off calls so new customers reach first value quickly

  • Be the voice of your customers internally, feeding product feedback into the roadmap

Renewals & retention

  • Own renewals end to end: forecasting, commercial conversations and closing

  • Monitor usage, credit consumption and health signals, and act early on risk

title: Customer Success Onboarding Specialist (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

Deine Mission

Du bist die Stimme unserer deutschen Kunden und trägst direkt dazu bei, dass sie mit Pennylane erfolgreich sind. Du hilfst kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen (KMU), ihre Finanzprozesse zu vereinfachen und das volle Potenzial unserer Finanzmanagement-Plattform auszuschöpfen. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du mit uns den Aufbau von Pennylane in Deutschland.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Onboarding mit Wirkung: Du begleitest neue KMU-Kunden und ihre Steuerkanzleien durch den gesamten Onboarding-Prozess. Du sorgst dafür, dass der Einstieg reibungslos gelingt und Unternehmen schnell von den Möglichkeiten unserer Plattform profitieren.
  • Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und weiterentwickeln: Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere bestehenden KMU-Kunden. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, erkennst Potenziale für zusätzliche Funktionen und eine erweiterte Nutzung und hilfst deinen Kunden, ihre unternehmerischen und finanziellen Ziele mit Pennylane zu erreichen.
  • Proaktiv beraten: In regelmäßigen Gesprächen prüfst du, wie erfolgreich deine Kunden mit Pennylane arbeiten und wo sie Unterstützung brauchen. Du steigerst ihre Zufriedenheit, optimierst die Nutzung der Plattform und erkennst frühzeitig, wenn eine Abwanderung droht.
  • Gemeinsam den deutschen Markt gestalten: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem deutschen Sales-Team und dem lokalen Leadership-Team zusammen. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr Abläufe weiter, bündelt Produktfeedback und treibt das Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland voran.
  • Expertise aufbauen und teilen: Du entwickelst dich zur gefragten Ansprechperson für unsere Plattform und die deutsche Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft. Dein Wissen und bewährte Vorgehensweisen gibst du direkt an unsere KMU-Kunden weiter.

Das bringst du mit

  • Relevante Erfahrung: Du hast 2–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, im Finanzmanagement, in Corporate Finance oder in einer vergleichbaren unternehmensinternen Rolle. Idealerweise hast du selbst mit Finanzprozessen, Rechnungsstellung oder Buchhaltungsabläufen gearbeitet. Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld, bei einem Fintech oder in einer Steuerkanzlei ist ein Plus.
  • Fachliche Grundlage: Du hast ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen. Alternativ bringst du eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, eine Weiterbildung als Steuerfachwirt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Rechnungswesen mit.
  • Verständnis für den deutschen Markt: Du kennst die Anforderungen von KMU an ihr Finanzmanagement und verstehst die zentralen Abläufe rund um Rechnungswesen, Rechnungsstellung und das finanzielle Tagesgeschäft in Deutschland.
  • Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie: Du hörst aufmerksam zu, versetzt dich in deine Kunden hinein und erklärst komplexe finanzielle oder technische Themen einfach und verständlich.
  • Lust, selbst anzupacken: Du möchtest Teil eines Teams sein, das in Deutschland noch am Anfang steht und wächst. Du ergreifst die Initiative, denkst in Lösungen und hast Freude daran, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.
  • Reisebereitschaft: Du freust dich darauf, unser Team beim Onboarding im Pariser Headquarter kennenzulernen, und bist bereit, gelegentlich Kunden in Deutschland zu besuchen – etwa einmal im Monat.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder verhandlungssicherem Niveau (C2) und fließend Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren internationalen Teams.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

  • Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.
  • Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage.
  • Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.
  • Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.
  • Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.
  • Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.
  • Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

  • Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).
  • Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.
  • Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).
  • Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Benefits

  • Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung mit echtem Wachstumspotenzial – Leistung lohnt sich bei uns spürbar.

title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Lead
descriptionHtml:
About CyberCube:

CyberCube delivers the world's leading analytics to quantify digital risk, helping the largest global carriers, reinsurers and brokers understand, price and manage cyber risk in financial terms.

  • AI at our foundation, cyber risk at our core. We don't just use AI, we shape it.

  • Built on AI from day one. Artificial intelligence has been part of our strategy since the beginning, blended with deep cybersecurity and insurance expertise and backed by rigorous testing.

  • Trusted by more than 100 clients, including 75% of the top 40 European and US cyber insurance carriers and 70% of the top ten reinsurance brokers.

  • Backed for global growth. In 2025 Spectrum Equity joined some of CyberCube’s financial partners as a new cornerstone investor, accelerating our global growth and fueling innovation across our end-to-end cyber risk analytics for the insurance industry.

  • A truly global team across San Francisco, New York, London, and Tallinn.

  • A culture of collaboration, openness, intellectual rigor, and ownership for excellence.

  • People at the forefront. We encourage CyberCubers to challenge themselves, push boundaries, and do the best work of their careers.

The Impact You Will Make

  • Work in a team of cyber threat analysts, economists, data scientists, actuaries and risk modelers to develop insights, scores, and features for a suite of products delivering cyber risk analytics to the (re)insurance industry

  • Own CyberCube's point of view on technology risk including factors such as:

    • Offensive capabilities and trends among threat actor classes, and validating CyberCube models against observed real-world events,

    • Security hygiene standards (e.g. NIST CSF, CIS) and mitigations for companies to lower their potential likelihood and/or impact of events, and

    • Technology adoption and trends including the adoption, reliance on and governance of artificial intelligence

… translating these factors into the assumptions and scenarios that drive risk models – especially where historical data is limited

  • Own the scenario and "event family" library for cyber catastrophe modeling, including emerging AI-driven scenarios

  • Own the assumptions register and expert-judgment governance: the documented, client-defensible rationale for modeling choices that are not purely data-driven

  • Present CyberCube methodology, threat landscape and emerging risk trends to clients and prospects and engage in strategic dialogue with key stakeholders as one of CyberCube's key voices and thought leaders on technology risk. Be able to differentiate when speaking with varying technical backgrounds and seniority (e.g. analyst to C-Suite)

  • Engage in cross functional collaboration with stakeholders from engineering, product management, analytics personnel, and client facing teams to deliver on projects and product goals

  • Deliver various cyber threat intelligence reports – e.g. threat landscape, scenario libraries, changes to mitigation and exploitation assumptions, etc. – on a quarterly cadence

The Skills and Experience You Will Bring

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in cyber security, computer science, statistics, economics, mathematics, or related field

  • 3-5 years experience in offensive and/or defensive cyber security (CISSP, CEH, CISM, CompTIA Security+, or other certification preferred)

  • Working fluency in Python / R, SQL, flat files and complex data types (JSON, XML), APIs, and Excel – enough to specify and interpret analysis with Data/Analytics teams

  • Ability to translate real-world cyber threat behavior into modeling assumptions and scenarios – e.g. scenario likelihoods, severity, and mitigation impacts

  • Intellectual curiosity, willingness to learn new skills, and push ideas forward

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

  • Strong communication and consulting presence with key stakeholders

  • Experience working in and leading project teams

  • Ability to work in an agile, fast-paced startup environment

  • Ability to maintain relationships, collaborate effectively, and meet deadlines with a distributed, remote-first workforce

  • Ability to think creatively and respond to emerging threats (cyber, AI, other) and their modeling implications in a timely manner

The Extra Credit, or The Focus Areas You Will Develop

  • Experience with analytics and risk modeling

  • Experience in a SaaS product development environment

  • Familiarity with ML techniques and statistical data analysis

  • Familiarity with AI / LLM risk and its implications for cyber risk, social engineering, product safety, errors/omissions, and critical infrastructure

  • Familiarity with a wide variety of Internet technologies such as BGP, TCP/IP, DNS, etc.

Why You'll Love it Here

  • Play an instrumental role in reshaping one of the key industries in the world

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work remotely

  • Opportunity to participate in a secondment program

  • Company-supported mentorship program

  • Grow in a collaborative, respectful, and empathetic culture

US specific

  • Competitive salary and unlimited PTO

  • Generous healthcare benefits with medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Monthly catered lunches and happy hours

  • Company-paid learning and development assistance

  • Dependant care assistance plan

UK specific

  • Competitive salary, pension and benefits

  • Generous private medical healthcare insurance with dental and vision coverage

  • Extra vacation days during winter holidays

AI Fluency at CyberCube

AI is reshaping how work gets done across every function. We value people who are curious about AI, eager to learn, and thoughtful about applying AI tools to work more effectively. AI fluency is part of how we assess every role in our hiring process.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway.

Research shows the best candidates rarely match a job description point for point. If you're excited about this role and believe you could make an impact, we'd love to hear from you, even if your experience doesn't line up perfectly with everything listed above.

CyberCube Analytics, Inc. and CyberCube Analytics Europe Limited is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t tolerate discrimination against age, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, race, color, nationality, ethnicity, religion, disability, veteran status, protected genetic information or political affiliation.

  • London • Estimated Base Salary £80K – £95K

title: Data Associate - Internship (6 months, flexible start)
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Data associate ⭐

The position is a six-month end-of-studies internship in Paris, with a flexible start date.

Data Associates join a product or business crew and work alongside a senior member of the Data team, taking on a real share of their projects. It is the same work as the rest of the team, building insights and data-powered products that help our members stay healthy, at a pace and scope designed for someone starting out.

Our team is full stack: each member sits in a crew next to engineers, product builders and designers and leads projects from A to Z, covering analytics, engineering and science. We mainly use SQL, Python, dbt, Airflow and Metabase, and Claude Code and AI agents are part of our daily workflow. Want to know more? Read our vision for the Data team (old one, but still relevant) and how our Data team is re-inventing its craft with AI.

This is our first generation of Data Associates, and we built the program with one goal: you join us full-time at the end of it. That decision is made at your 5-month review.

⭐ Detailed missions ⭐

What you work on depends on the crew you join, something that is decided once you start your internship, but your six months will mix:

  • Answering real business or product questions: framing the problem, digging into the data and turning what you find into a recommendation your crew acts on.

  • Building tools people use: a dbt model, a dashboard a team uses every week, a tool powered by AI. You would ship them end to end, with your senior counterpart supporting you on key steps

  • Growing with the Data community: joining our main rituals (retros, insights sharing sessions, on-call shifts), and later helping us recruit the next generation of Data Associates

You won’t be alone: from day one, you will benefit from a senior Alaner from the Data team to work with at the office and a coach from the Data team as well.

⭐ Is it you we're looking for? ⭐

Please note that for this internship, you need to:

  • Be based in Paris, France

You would be a great fit if most of this sounds like you:

  • You want a career in Data, across the whole spectrum. If what you want above everything else is to build ML models, a research internship is probably a better fit for you

  • You have used SQL and Python, at school, in an internship or on a side project. We teach you the rest

  • Analytical sense and rigor: you ask the right question before you reach for the data, and you can tell a real signal from noise

  • Business & product sense: you care about what the numbers change for members and for the company

  • Effective communication: you explain a result simply, in writing and out loud

title: Data Center Long-Term Capacity Partnerships
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral Cloud builds and operates the infrastructure that powers Mistral's AI. The Data Centers team signs long-term leases for data center capacity developed by third-party operators, sources the GPUs that fill those halls, and runs the workloads that train and serve Mistral's models. Today the team is around 40 people, mainly based in Paris with some remote members, and operates roughly 200 MW of existing capacity across France. Key partners include Éclairion in France and EcoDC in Sweden, which is currently delivering Mistral's first Swedish data center.

The team sits at the center of an ambitious roadmap: Mistral has publicly committed to securing one gigawatt of data center capacity globally by 2030. With 200 MW already online, roughly 800 MW remain to be secured over the next five years.

The Role

Mistral's cheapest and best-tailored capacity is the capacity planned furthest ahead. This hire builds the partnerships that make that possible: long-term relationships with infrastructure funds, data center developers, and landowners who acquire sites, secure grid connections, and construct bespoke facilities on Mistral's behalf, three to four years before the first GPU is installed.

You will define the collaboration principles that govern this ecosystem. You will structure partnerships where third parties carry development risk and Mistral locks in capacity designed to its technical specifications. The role is part strategist, part negotiator, part ecosystem builder.

What You Will Do

  • Negotiate long-term capacity partnerships with infrastructure funds, data center companies, and landowners across Europe

  • Define collaboration principles and contractual frameworks that allow third parties to develop data centers on Mistral's behalf

  • Structure bespoke data center designs so that power, cooling, and layout are tailored to Mistral's technical needs

  • Build a pipeline of development sites: land acquisition, grid connection, and construction timelines planned three to four years out

  • Align partnership strategy with Mistral's science and infrastructure roadmaps

What We're Looking For

  • You have built infrastructure partnerships. You have negotiated long-term capacity or development agreements with data center operators, infrastructure funds, or similar counterparties.

  • You think in multi-year horizons. You have planned capacity three to five years ahead and understand how early commitment reduces cost and improves design control.

title: Data Center Operations Implementation Manager
descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Data Center Operations Implementation Manager to own the end-to-end Day 0 to Day 2 transition of Nscale's data centres — spanning construction, fit-out, and live, steady-state local operations — across an assigned region and set of sites. Rather than owning construction execution itself, you'll be the connective tissue between Construction, Network Engineering, Compute/Infrastructure Deployment, and local Operations teams — driving a structured, well-documented transition so every site goes live on schedule and ready to support production workloads. This is an individual-contributor role built on strong stakeholder management, cross-functional influence, and travel to sites during critical transition windows.

What You'll Do

Day 0 to Day 2 Transition Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end Day 0 to Day 2 transition process for each data centre site within your assigned region — spanning construction, fit-out, and steady-state operations.
  • Define and maintain a standardized transition framework and readiness checklist applied consistently across your assigned sites.
  • Track and drive closure of cross-team action items, dependencies, and blockers standing between construction handover and operational go-live.
  • Identify and escalate risks to go-live timelines, and drive resolution across the relevant stakeholder groups.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Track progress and status across Construction, Network Engineering, Compute/Infrastructure Deployment, Facility Engineering, SDM, and local site Operations teams throughout the transition window.
  • Partner with Construction teams to track handover status, outstanding items, and site readiness milestones.
  • Track Network Engineering's buildout, testing, and cutover activities required for a site to go live.
  • Track hardware intake, rack-and-stack, and deployment scheduling with Compute/Infrastructure Deployment teams to stay aligned with the transition timeline.
  • Coordinate with Facility Engineering on site systems and infrastructure readiness ahead of transition.
  • Engage with the Service Delivery Management (SDM) team to ensure alignment with customer needs, SLAs, security, and facility performance.
  • Take part in regular cross-functional syncs and stakeholder reviews to stay current on transition status.
  • Contribute to a shared sense of ownership and accountability across stakeholder teams, even without formal authority over them.

Local Day Two Operations Readiness

  • Partner with local Operations leads to confirm staffing, training, tooling, and support processes are in place before a site transitions to Day 2 ownership.
  • Create and validate standard operating procedures (SOPs) and operational processes required for local Operations teams to run the site post-handover.
  • Create the operational site tool bill of materials (BOM) required for local Operations teams to maintain the site post-handover.
  • Verify the spare parts bill of materials (BOM) is complete and in place ahead of Day 2 handover.
  • Facilitate structured knowledge transfer and handover documentation from Construction, Network, and Compute teams to local Operations teams.
  • Confirm monitoring, ticketing, and ITSM processes are validated and operating before a site is handed to local Operations.
  • Act as an escalation point for local Operations teams during the early post-handover period to smooth the transition.

Reliability, Safety & Compliance

  • Define and enforce Day 2 readiness criteria that a site must meet before transitioning to local Operations ownership.
  • Facilitate root-cause analysis for transition delays or gaps surfaced during handover, and drive remediation across teams.
  • Ensure health, safety, and environmental requirements are validated and documented as part of readiness sign-off.
  • Support certification and audit readiness (ISO 27001, ISO 22237, SOC 2, Cyber Essentials Plus, ISO 22301) ahead of go-live.

Vendor & Supplier Coordination

  • Coordinate with construction contractors and colocation providers as needed to close out remaining items affecting the transition timeline.
  • Track vendor commitments and SLAs relevant to the transition window, and escalate delays that put go-live at risk.
  • Coordinate with the Supply Chain team to align hardware intake and staging with the transition schedule.

Monitoring, Reporting & Analytics

  • Track KPIs and KRIs for the Day 0 to Day 2 transition process (time to transition, readiness checklist completion rate, post-handover incident rate, etc.).
  • Build and maintain dashboards that track transition status across your assigned site pipeline for all stakeholder teams.
  • Produce regular reports for senior leadership on transition status, risks, and blockers.
  • Use data-driven insights to identify systemic bottlenecks in the Day 0 to Day 2 process and drive continuous improvement.

About You

Experience & Background

  • 3-8 years of experience in data centre operations, program/project management, or infrastructure deployment at scale.
  • Proven track record coordinating the transition of new sites into live operations across construction, network, compute, and operations functions.
  • Experience operating in a matrixed environment, influencing outcomes without direct authority over every stakeholder team.
  • Demonstrated success managing multiple concurrent site transitions in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Background in hyperscale, cloud, or HPC data centre environments (preferred).

Technical Knowledge & Expertise

  • Working knowledge of data centre power, cooling, networking, and compute infrastructure, sufficient to coordinate effectively across specialist teams.
  • Familiarity with network deployment and cutover processes, and compute/hardware deployment lifecycles.
  • Knowledge of Layer 1 network infrastructure, including fiber, copper, optics, and transceivers.
  • Familiarity with ITSM tooling, ticketing systems, and monitoring platforms used by local Operations teams.

Influence & Communication

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align Construction, Network, Compute, and Operations teams without direct authority.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills, able to translate technical detail between teams with different priorities and vocabularies.
  • Program management discipline, with the ability to track and drive multiple concurrent workstreams to closure.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, matrixed, fast-moving environments.
  • Bias toward ownership, pragmatism, and delivering results with urgency.

Operational Excellence

  • Rigorous tracking of readiness checklists, risk logs, and action items across many concurrent site transitions within your assigned region.
  • Proven ability to build and refine standardized transition frameworks that scale with business growth.
  • Strong attention to detail in transition documentation and handover packages.
  • Willingness to travel to sites during critical transition windows.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with program management tooling (e.g., Smartsheet, Asana, Jira, monday.com) for tracking multi-workstream transitions.
  • Familiarity with network cutover or compute/hardware deployment processes specifically.
  • Experience with ITSM platforms and ticketing workflows.
  • Experience with Palantir Foundry or similar data platforms for operational analytics.

About the Role

You would lead our Data & Analytics team of 3-4 engineers end to end: ingestion, the warehouse and its models, the metric layer, and the analysis and reporting built on top of it. It is a small team with a big surface, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach.

We are deliberately not splitting data engineering from analytics. At our size the hard problems sit in the handover between the two, and we want one person who enjoys that whole puzzle.

The team serves four groups with genuinely different needs. Growth wants hourly to daily signals and can live with approximately right. Carrier reporting and corporate finance are calendar-locked and need numbers that reconcile and survive an audit months later. Actuarial needs depth and lineage over speed. Prioritising here is arbitration between things that fail in different ways, and the arbitration is yours.

It's a hands-on role. You can open the warehouse and read the models, you review a new data model before it ships, and your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. The job is still the team: its own game, its communication, and each person in it. When something slips, hands-on work is the first thing that yields.


What you'll be doing
  • Leading a team of 3-4 data engineers and analysts end to end: what it builds, how it runs in production, and who you hire and grow to get there
  • Running discovery with the teams we serve: understanding what they need from data, and bringing the platform and datasets that enable them
  • Owning the trade-offs between Growth, carrier reporting, finance and actuarial: deciding what the team works on, driving alignment with key partners across other teams, and saying no when the answer is no
  • Making the platform scale: a new country, carrier or product should mean configuration and reused models, and recurring manual work, like carrier reporting and cash reconciliation, should turn into automation
  • Bringing engineering excellence to how the team works: data contracts with product teams, testing in CI, alerts that get resolved, a way to try changes before they hit production
  • Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

    • What you'll need
  • You've managed or led a data team before, including hiring, feedback and growing people. It doesn't have to be for long, but it has to be real and you have to want more of it
  • Depth on one side of the data stack and working fluency on the other. You still love shipping, you review your team's work, and they trust your judgement on it
  • A track record of shaping what gets built, not only how: you've turned business problems into data priorities, cut scope, and can show the decisions that followed
  • Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your team's boundaries to get to results
  • You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt. Your team gets that from you: you try new tools and ways of working first, and bring the ones that stick

    • Nice to have
  • Experience with reporting that has to reconcile: bordereaux, revenue, cash, ledger
  • Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech
  • Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets
  • Experience with Databricks, dbt and event tracking (Snowplow or similar)

    • Our stack

    Databricks with Unity Catalog, dbt with SQL-based transformation, running on AWS.

    None of this is a hard requirement, and you don't need to know all of our stack. We care more about how you reason about data, systems and teams than which tools you have used. Strong on most of it? Apply.


    How we hire
    Five conversations, each with a clear purpose, and you hear where you stand after every one:
    1. Leadership. We look at your experience with performance management, personal development and building teams.
    2. Data Model Review. You review a change to our warehouse models with two of our engineers.
    3. Data Platform Design. A modelling and platform problem close to what we deal with.
    4. Values Interview. We look at your approach to work, and how it adds to our Values.
    5. Meet the Founder.
    You get the outcome within three days of your last round, with specific feedback either way.
    We offer
  • Competitive compensation. We offer a salary in the range of 85k-110k EUR plus performance-based equity grants
  • Hybrid. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year from abroad, 25 holiday days
  • Pension. 6% employer contribution
  • Wellbeing budget. €50 net a month via Epassi, from the gym to takeaway, rolls over
  • Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs and coaching
  • Central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, Friday drinks, high-spec MacBook Pro

    • About Insify

    Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

    We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

    Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.

title: Data Migration Project Manager
descriptionHtml:
À propos de Dastra

Dastra est une plateforme SaaS dédiée à la protection des données, à la compliance et à la gouvernance de l’IA.

Notre mission est claire : Faire de la protection des données une réalité opérationnelle, en plaçant la confiance au cœur des stratégies des entreprises.

Nous aidons les organisations à maîtriser leurs risques pour innover, en transformant des obligations réglementaires complexes (RGPD, IA) en processus simples, concrets et actionnables.

Le rôle

En tant que Data Migration Project Manager, tu pilotes les projets de migration des données clients vers Dastra, du cadrage jusqu'à la livraison.

À la croisée de la gestion de projet, de la data et du conseil client, ton rôle est majoritairement orienté pilotage et accompagnement client (environ 70 %), tout en étant suffisamment à l'aise avec la data et la technique pour comprendre, structurer et mapper les données.

Tes missions

Piloter tes projets de migration de A à Z

  • Piloter plusieurs projets clients simultanément, du cadrage à la livraison, en priorisant efficacement pour garantir un suivi fluide et de qualité.

  • Piloter le suivi et l’avancement des projets à travers des meetings clients

  • Comprendre les enjeux métier et Privacy du client afin d’adapter la stratégie de migration à son contexte et à ses besoins.

  • Accompagner le client dans les choix techniques et data nécessaires à sa migration

Notre outil interne automatise désormais une grande partie des transformations auparavant réalisées via des scripts spécifiques : nous ne cherchons donc pas un développeur, mais quelqu'un qui comprend suffisamment la technique pour prendre les bonnes décisions.

title: Deep Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:

Train the intelligence behind our radars – turning complex signal data into instant, real-world detection.

As our Deep Learning Engineer, you develop, optimize, and deploy neural networks that enhance real-time radar performance. You work side-by-side with AI, Software Engineering, Hardware, and Product Management colleagues – translating abstract radar signal modalities into models that spot small airborne objects in noisy environments. You report to the Team Lead AI, and your models directly safeguard critical sites around the globe.

What you'll do

  • Model design and architecture: Design, train, and optimize deep learning models for detection, segmentation, and classification. Tailor neural networks to process abstract, non-natural 3D, 4D, and 5D radar imagery.

  • Target classification and tracking: Build advanced neural network architectures to detect and track small objects like birds and drones. Ensure models perform reliably despite real-world background noise and weather.

  • Data engineering and automation: Prepare, preprocess, and augment large-scale radar datasets for training pipelines. Implement automated labeling strategies to streamline data preparation at scale.

  • Edge optimization and deployment: Optimize trained neural networks for high-performance inference on edge computing hardware. Collaborate with Software Developers and Radar Specialists to integrate models seamlessly into production systems.

  • Research and field validation: Evaluate emerging deep learning techniques to continuously lift our radar capabilities. Test model robustness under diverse field conditions and document design choices clearly.

What you bring

  • MSc in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field

  • 2-4 years of experience in Deep Learning, specifically within Computer Vision

  • Strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience using PyTorch

  • Practical experience with edge deployment and model optimization tools like TensorRT or ONNX

  • Familiarity with non-natural signal modalities such as radar, sonar, LiDAR, or medical imaging

Our radars and software protect military sites, borders and critical infrastructure from drone threats, and also help prevent bird strikes in aviation and reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife. Our work shows up at defence and security sites, airports and wind farms around the world.

title: Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operating system for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgement matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by over $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

The role

Deployment Engineers own the technical side of getting Wordsmith live inside a customer.

Once a deal is signed, you’ll connect Wordsmith to the systems our customers already run on. That means identity and SSO, Microsoft 365 and SharePoint, Google Workspace, Salesforce, document management, chat tools, and MCP connections to the wider AI and data stack. You’ll design how data and permissions flow between them, build and test the integrations, and work through each customer’s IT and security requirements until everything works in production.

It’s part integration engineering, part solutions architecture, and part customer-facing problem solving. You’ll be the technical lead on every deployment you own, the person customer IT teams talk to, and the person who works out how to make it work when an integration doesn’t behave as documented.

This is a technical, hands-on role. You don’t need to be a lawyer, and we’re not necessarily looking for one. We’re looking for engineers and technical consultants who understand identity, APIs and enterprise SaaS, and who enjoy making systems talk to each other. Your focus is the technical foundation the rest of the deployment runs on.

You’ll work side by side with our Legal Engineers on every deployment. While you connect Wordsmith to the customer’s systems, they configure the platform itself: workflows, agents, playbooks and automations built around how the legal team works. You’ll plan the deployment together, agree what each integration needs to support, and make sure the connections you build give their configuration the data, documents and permissions it depends on.

What you’ll do

1. Integrations

  • Own the integrations for each deployment, including SSO and SCIM, Microsoft 365, SharePoint and OneDrive, Google Workspace, Salesforce, document management and chat tools

  • Configure and connect Wordsmith to customers’ wider AI and data stack through MCP

  • Build, test and harden integrations so they hold up in production, not just in a demo

2. Identity, Security & Access

  • Set up identity and access, including SSO with Okta, Entra ID and Google, user provisioning, roles and permissions

  • Work through customers’ security reviews, IT questionnaires and data-handling requirements

  • Make sure permissions in Wordsmith respect the permissions in the systems it connects to

3. Technical Solution Design

  • Take the technical handover from Sales and confirm the customer’s systems landscape, constraints and integration scope

  • Design how data, documents and requests flow between Wordsmith and the customer’s tools

  • Advise customer IT on the right architecture for their environment and where the trade-offs sit

  • Work with Legal Engineers to agree what each integration needs to support the workflows, agents and playbooks they’re configuring

4. Technical Delivery & Escalation

  • Lead the technical workstream of each deployment, from environment setup and integration build through testing to go-live

  • Diagnose and fix integration issues, and act as the escalation point for technical problems during rollout

  • Know when a problem needs Engineering, and bring them a clear, reproducible case

5. Improve How We Integrate

  • Turn what you learn into reusable integration patterns, setup guides and technical runbooks

  • Feed connector gaps, API limitations and recurring requests back to Product and Engineering

What we’re looking for

  • Hands-on experience deploying and integrating enterprise SaaS in customer environments

  • Strong working knowledge of identity and access, including SSO (SAML, OIDC), SCIM provisioning, Okta, Entra ID or Google Workspace

  • Experience integrating with the Microsoft 365 and SharePoint, Google Workspace or Salesforce ecosystems

  • Comfortable with APIs, webhooks, authentication flows and reading technical documentation. You can script or write code where it helps

  • Familiarity with MCP or other ways of connecting AI systems to tools and data, or a strong appetite to learn

  • Credible with customer IT and security teams. You can answer their questions and stand behind your architecture

  • Methodical troubleshooter who isolates problems, reproduces them and fixes them

  • Clear communicator who can explain a technical decision to a non-technical stakeholder

Typical backgrounds include

  • Deployment, integration or implementation engineers in SaaS

  • Solutions engineers or solutions architects

  • Technical consultants with Microsoft 365, Google Workspace or Salesforce experience

  • IT or identity engineers who have moved into customer-facing roles

How we work

We’re an in-person team based in Edinburgh or London. You should expect to work from the office or visit customers as your default.

We set a high bar, move quickly and give people meaningful ownership. There will not always be an established playbook, so you’ll need to bring curiosity, structure and persistence to unfamiliar situations.

You’ll sit in the Transformation team, reporting to the VP of Transformation, and work closely with our Legal Engineers, alongside Legal Intelligence, Enablement, Customer Success, Support Engineering and Product.

Our customer teams have clear but closely connected responsibilities: Transformation leads implementation, Support Engineering resolves technical issues, Account Management owns renewals and commercial growth, Customer Success owns adoption, customer health and value realisation, and Enablement owns onboarding, training and customer capability.

Why Wordsmith

Wordsmith is growing quickly, winning new customers and expanding within larger organisations. Wordsmith is only as useful as the systems it connects to. Every new customer brings a different stack, and Deployment Engineers are the people who make Wordsmith work inside it.

You’ll work directly with ambitious in-house legal teams, see how dozens of legal functions really operate, and take that back into a product you help shape. You will work across enterprise identity, productivity and CRM platforms, and on MCP as it develops into a standard. title: Deployment Strategist - German Speaking
descriptionHtml:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Deployment Strategist to join our team. In this role, you'll partner with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) across the full deployment lifecycle, from first discovery conversation to live production. You'll lead use case discovery and scoping with senior customer stakeholders, ship prototypes hands-on to prove value early, then stay close to the build through delivery to bring the strategic, business-value lens to every decision. You're the partner who keeps the work pointed at the highest-impact outcomes, ready to pick up the keyboard alongside the FDE when the moment calls for it.

We're looking for engineers with strategic instincts: people who can write code, but whose deepest strength is the strategic, opinionated lens they bring across every phase of a deployment - spotting where value lives, scoping it realistically, and partnering with engineers to capture it from prototype to production.

At HappyRobot, there's no role seniority or hierarchy. We operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success.

What You'll do

  • Strategic Leadership and Use Case Discovery: Partner with Global and Regional C-Level executives and VPs to assess AI opportunities and prioritize the highest-impact use cases. Lead curiosity-driven discovery that surfaces the workflows where AI creates the most business value, well beyond what the customer thought to ask for. Build the trusted relationships that let you present findings and challenge assumptions at the most senior levels, keeping technical delivery aligned with their business priorities.

  • Scoping: Frame impact versus effort with rigor on both axes. On business value, pressure-test the realistic upside, question whether the use case as posed will actually deliver the most impact, and explore whether reframing it or pivoting to an adjacent process would unlock more. The art is deeply understanding how to maximize value of this use case for the customer, not just delivering what was asked for. On technical effort, map integrations, data, and platform constraints, and surface the edge cases and dependencies that shape timelines. Land on a plan that's realistic on both.

  • Prototyping: Build prototypes and demos hands-on. Use our platform and AI-powered coding tools to test ideas end-to-end at light scope. Prove value early, before the customer commits.

  • Program Management: Coordinate work across the active deployments in an account. Be the escalation point for the customer and the watchout partner for the FDE. Stay close enough to the build that you both understand the use case deeply, spot opportunities to capture more value, and catch when work is drifting from the highest-impact path.

  • Prioritization: Sequence use cases within an account so each deployment compounds the next. Make the call on what gets built when, what gets parked, and where to invest discovery and building time.

  • Customer Partnership: Be the main business-side point of contact for the account. Build trust with operational and executive stakeholders day-to-day. Translate AI capabilities into language they can act on.

  • Onsite Embedding: Travel onsite for kickoffs, mapping sessions, and key moments where being on the ground changes the outcome.

  • Product Feedback Loop: Bring field signal back to Product and Engineering. Identify reusable patterns, common edge cases, and where the platform needs to evolve.

Must Have

  • Background that mixes technical depth with strategic instinct, and a real history of building things. Common paths include engineering (Computer Science, electrical, industrial, systems), data science, founding a tech startup, product management, or technical / strategic consulting.

  • Comfortable coding -mostly Python- using LLMs and AI-powered tools like Claude Code to ship prototypes fast.

  • Working understanding of APIs, integrations, and how AI agents sit inside enterprise workflows.

  • Strategic instinct: ability to spot the business value behind a workflow and translate it into impact, effort, and prioritization terms a C-level can act on.

  • Excellent communication skills with both executives and operators. Comfortable translating between business and technical without losing either side.

  • Proven ability to prioritize ruthlessly across multiple workstreams and drive outcomes, not just activity.

  • Founder mindset: highly independent, takes ownership, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

Why join us?

  • Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

  • Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

  • Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

  • Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

  • Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job:

We are seeking a highly skilled DevOps Specialist to architect, implement, and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, with a strong focus on test-driven deployment, automated release management, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.

The ideal candidate will containerize services using Docker, manage build, compilation, and publishing workflows for JavaScript, TypeScript, and C++ packages, and design robust multi-language build pipelines leveraging CMake or similar build tools.

The role also includes automating build, tagging, and publication processes across web, desktop, and mobile platforms to ensure consistent and traceable releases. Deep expertise in Linux system administration, networking, and IaC tools is essential to deliver

scalable, secure, and highly available deployments.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, architecture, and management of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions (and similar tools), ensuring fast, reliable, and reproducible software delivery.

  • Implement and enforce test-driven deployment systems, integrating automated testing, validation, and monitoring to maintain code quality and accelerate feedback cycles.

  • Containerize applications and microservices with Docker, optimize image builds, and manage deployment pipelines for distributed environments.

  • Oversee the build, packaging, and publishing lifecycle for JavaScript, TypeScript, and C++ packages, including versioning, semantic tagging, and NPM or internal registry publication.

  • Develop and maintain cross-platform build pipelines using CMake or equivalent tools, ensuring consistent compilation and release workflows across web, desktop, and mobile.

  • Automate end-to-end release processes, including tagging, building, signing, and distributing mobile, web, and desktop applications.

  • Define and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure environments.

  • Collaborate closely with development, QA, and operations teams to troubleshoot deployment issues, optimize performance, and improve release reliability.

  • Continuously improve observability and feedback loops, leveraging monitoring and alerting systems to maintain operational excellence.


Mandatory:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience architecting and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools at scale in a production environment.

  • Strong proficiency in test-driven deployment methodologies, including writing and maintaining automated test suites for integration and end-to-end validation.

  • Expertise in containerization technologies such as Docker, including image creation, registry management, and basic orchestration patterns.

  • Experience managing package lifecycles for JavaScript and TypeScript, including versioning, compilation, semantic tagging, and publishing workflows to NPM.

  • In-depth knowledge of C++ build systems, specifically CMake, with proven experience optimizing native build and deployment pipelines.

  • Advanced Linux system administration and networking skills, including shell scripting, package management, performance troubleshooting, firewalls, and VPN configuration.

  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in globally distributed teams.

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, AWS CDK or AWS CloudFormation.

  • Experience with mobile CI/CD automation, including build, tagging, and publication for iOS and Android applications

  • Advanced knowledge of release management practices, including automated versioning, signing, and artifact distribution.

Preferred:

  • Exposure to observability and monitoring systems, leveraging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK for deployment health tracking.

  • Experience working in high-availability, security-sensitive environments, especially in fintech, blockchain, or distributed systems contexts.

  • Experience deploying and managing blockchain-based applications.

  • Exposure to AI/ML pipelines, including automated model training, evaluation, and deployment using frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

L’objectif : faire de l’infrastructure un levier de croissance plutôt qu’un frein. Pionniers de la conteneurisation, nous plaçons aujourd'hui l'innovation au cœur de notre approche Cloud. Nous concevons des offres qui adressent les enjeux les plus actuels du secteur :
  • Accélérer les migrations et modernisations Cloud grâce à l'IA pour créer de la valeur au plus vite.
  • Construire et infogérer des environnements d'industries régulées (ex : HDS pour la santé, SecNumCloud) sans sacrifier le time to market.
  • ⁠Exploiter tout le potentiel des LLMs tout en optimisant la performance cloud, les coûts et la sûreté industrielle.

Ton équipe : L’équipe technique de Theodo Cloud est constituée de deux pôles : - le pôle Build, dédié à nos projets de création, migration et optimisation d’infrastructures - le pôle Run, dédié à l’infogérance des infrastructures de nos clients Au build, tu travailles main dans la main avec un ou une Lead DevOps et un ou une Agile Project Manager pour garantir l’impact de tes actions chez nos clients. Au run, tu rejoins une équipe d’une quinzaine de personnes avec laquelle tu gères un portefeuille de clients. L’équipe run dispose également d’un volet build, dédié à l’amélioration continue des plateformes de nos clients. Nous déterminerons ensemble à l’issue de l’entretien RH le pôle sur lequel nous pouvons te positionner. Tes futures missions : En tant que DevOps Engineer, tu travailles sur des infrastructures cloud en suivant les bonnes pratiques techniques et les standards définis par l’équipe. Au run les missions consistent à : - Réagir aux incidents en production et mener des investigations techniques approfondies - Réaliser les post-mortem et assurer une communication claire et structurée avec les clients - Répondre aux interrogations des clients et formuler des recommandations actionnables pour améliorer la qualité, la fiabilité, la sécurité et la performance de leur infrastructure - Concevoir et découper techniquement des fonctionnalités adaptées aux contraintes projet (qualité, coût, délais) Au build tu apprendras à comprendre et répondre aux besoins d’un client sur sa stratégie d’infrastructure : - montage d’infrastructure from scratch - migrations Cloud et Kubernetes - mise en place de pipelines de CI/CD - mise en place d’outils de monitoring et d’alerting - apport des bonnes pratiques DevOps chez nos clients - participation active aux rituels agiles (Scrum) de l’équipe projet La réalisation d’astreintes est également possible, elle se fait sur la base du volontariat. Ce poste de DevOps Engineer est fait pour les personnes curieuses qui veulent monter en compétences rapidement, au contact d’un large panel d’infrastructures et d’outils (AWS, GCP, Azure, Scaleway, Outscale, OVH, …) et de bugs complexes en production. Theodo Cloud est encore une jeune entreprise où il y a de la place pour construire des choses. En parallèle de ton projet, tu auras du temps dédié pour t’investir sur des sujets qui te tiennent à cœur : la formation des équipes business, la diversité, ou le recrutement technique… Tes perspectives d’évolution : La première étape d’évolution chez Theodo Cloud est de devenir Lead, et de devenir ainsi garant de la stratégie technique et de la montée en compétences de ton équipe. Nous proposons ensuite deux tracks d’évolution possibles : - une track Management, qui t’emmènera vers un rôle d’Engineering Manager - une track Expertise, qui te permettra d’accéder à un rôle de Staff Engineer Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : - Tu disposes d’une solide formation en école d’ingénieur, avec une première expérience en infrastructures Cloud (Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, GCP...) - Tu fais preuve de rigueur, d’une bonne gestion du stress, et sais intervenir efficacement sur des environnements de production - Tu as l’envie de progresser rapidement et de travailler en équipe Tu ne coches pas 100% des critères mais tu penses tout de même correspondre à notre recherche ? Ne t’auto-censure pas et envoie-nous ta candidature, on se fera un plaisir de l’étudier ! Pour information : - Le poste est proposé en CDI, basé depuis nos locaux à Paris. - Le salaire proposé dépend du niveau d’expérience de chacun : nous en parlons toujours dès le premier appel téléphonique. Déroulement des entretiens : Nous répondons à toutes les candidatures dans un délai de 2 jours. Si ton parcours retient notre attention, voici le process qu’on te propose : - un appel téléphonique de 30 minutes avec un membre de l’équipe recrutement, pour comprendre tes critères de recherche - un entretien d’une heure avec le recruteur ou la recruteuse avec qui tu as échangé à la première étape, pour parler plus en détail de la culture Theodo - un entretien de technique théorique de 45 minutes - un entretien technique de debug de 45 minutes - un échange de 30 minutes avec un membre de l’équipe dirigeante Notre process dure 1 semaine en moyenne. Tu seras accompagné(e) par un membre de l’équipe recrutement, qui sera là pour te coacher tout au long du process.Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo Cloud ? L'environnement : 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: DevOps Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Clariness is looking for a DevOps Engineer (f/m/d) based in Berlin, Hamburg, Cape Town, UK, or Serbia.
- Full-time; unlimited -

About the role:

This role is about ensuring that Clariness' global cloud infrastructure remains reliable, secure and ready to scale. You will join a collaborative technical environment where infrastructure enables our product, data engineering and AI teams to deliver meaningful solutions.

As a DevOps Engineer, you would be responsible for:

  • Building, operating and improving Clariness' global AWS infrastructure, with a particular focus on ECS, RDS and supporting services.
  • Managing infrastructure through Terraform, contributing to reusable, maintainable and version-controlled infrastructure as code.
  • Improving CI/CD pipelines and container deployment processes to support reliable, secure and efficient software delivery.
  • Supporting our production systems by monitoring infrastructure, troubleshooting incidents and contributing to improvements in reliability, security and cloud cost efficiency.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional product teams, as well as our data engineering and AI teams, to understand their requirements and provide effective infrastructure solutions.
  • Contributing to infrastructure improvement initiatives, maintaining operational documentation and supporting technical excellence across Clariness.

We would like you to have:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Hands-on experience working with production infrastructure on AWS, ideally including ECS, RDS and supporting services.
  • Practical experience with Terraform, including modules, state management and infrastructure changes through version control and code review.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerized applications and production deployments.
  • Familiarity with backup and disaster recovery, high-availability configurations and safe database migrations.
  • The ability to independently deliver well-defined infrastructure tasks, explain technical trade-offs and contribute to architectural discussions.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills (English at C1 level), along with an interest in using AI-assisted tools responsibly to support infrastructure development, testing and troubleshooting.

You may ask now, why should I work for you? Let us give you a few reasons – and you'll learn more during the process.

  • A varied and exciting job with a lot of personal responsibility in an international company, where you can develop and expand your skills.
  • Professional and personal development opportunities - incl. personal development budget.
  • Flexible working hours and mobile working.
  • Regular team events and open feedback culture.
  • A versatile field of activity and challenging projects.
  • A supportive and open company culture, providing the opportunity to collaborate with a diverse and professional team.
  • Impact healthcare by accelerating medical innovation through improved access to clinical trials, potentially bringing needed treatments to patients faster.

How to apply & what to expect:

  • Apply via link (CV only; no cover letter required).
  • Introductory call (30 min) → Technical interview → Take Home Test → Demo Day → Decision.
  • We aim to move promptly and keep you updated at every step.

At Clariness, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

For more information, feel free to reach out to

Would you like to become part of our dynamic, curious, and international culture with plenty of room for your ideas and creativity in an inspiring atmosphere? If so, we look forward to receiving your application with details of your desired salary and possible starting date, preferably via our application portal.
