title: Digital Marketing & Performance Manager 100%
descriptionHtml:
Du bist ein Profi in Google Ads und hast über mehrere Jahre Kampagnen mit substanziellen Budgets geplant, aufgebaut und optimiert – idealerweise in einer Agentur für verschiedene Kunden und Branchen. Du weisst, wie man aus jedem Werbefranken das Maximum herausholt, Zielgruppen präzise erreicht und Kampagnen messbar auf Leads und Umsatz ausrichtet.

In dieser Position übernimmst du die Verantwortung für unser gesamtes Paid Advertising: Google Ads als Kernkanal, ergänzt durch Microsoft Ads (Bing) und Social Ads auf Meta, LinkedIn und weiteren Plattformen. Du entwickelst alle Kanäle strategisch und operativ weiter. Ergänzend bringst du dich in SEO und GEO ein, damit unser Unternehmen sowohl in klassischen Suchmaschinen als auch in KI-basierten Antwortsystemen sichtbar bleibt.

Aufgaben

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

Schwerpunkt Paid Ads – Google, Microsoft & Social (rund 70 %)

  • Strategische und operative Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Google-Ads-Konten
  • Kampagnenstruktur, Keyword-Strategie, Anzeigentexte, Gebotsstrategien und Budgetsteuerung
  • Sauberes Conversion-Tracking mit Google Tag Manager, GA4 und Enhanced Conversions als Basis aller Optimierungen
  • Laufende Optimierung von CPA, ROAS und Conversion-Rate
  • Aufbau und Optimierung von Landingpages im Zusammenspiel mit den Kampagnen
  • A/B-Tests von Anzeigen, Zielgruppen und Landingpages
  • Aufbau, Skalierung und Optimierung unserer Microsoft-Ads-Kampagnen (Bing) als Ergänzung zu Google Search
  • Planung, Umsetzung und Optimierung von Social Ads auf Meta (Facebook, Instagram), LinkedIn und je nach Zielgruppe TikTok
  • Entwicklung von Kreativkonzepten, Anzeigenformaten und Zielgruppenstrategien für Social Ads in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team
  • Kanalübergreifende Budgetverteilung und Attribution über Google, Microsoft und Social hinweg
  • Aussagekräftige Reportings mit konkreten Handlungsempfehlungen an die Geschäftsleitung

Qualifikation

Must-have

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Performance-Marketing mit klarem Schwerpunkt Google Ads
  • Agenturerfahrung mit Betreuung mehrerer Kunden und Branchen ist ein klarer Vorteil
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Google Ads, Google Tag Manager und GA4
  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit Gebotsstrategien, Zielgruppen, Conversion-Tracking und Budgetsteuerung
  • Praxiserfahrung mit Microsoft Ads (Bing) inkl. Import und Anpassung von Google-Kampagnen
  • Praxiserfahrung mit Social Ads, insbesondere Meta Ads und LinkedIn Ads
  • Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denken und sicherer Umgang mit Kennzahlen und Budgets
  • Hohe Eigeninitiative und selbstständige, hands-on Arbeitsweise
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (stilsicher in Anzeigentexten) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

Was dich auszeichnet

Google Ads ist dein Handwerk. Du kennst die Plattform in der Tiefe, hinterfragst Googles Automatisierungsempfehlungen kritisch und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten statt Bauchgefühl. Microsoft Ads und Social Ads beherrschst du ebenso sicher und weisst, welcher Kanal für welches Ziel den besten Return liefert. Gleichzeitig denkst du über den einzelnen Kanal hinaus und verstehst, wie Paid Ads, SEO und GEO zusammenspielen. Du arbeitest strukturiert und lösungsorientiert, vor allem aber bist du ein Macher, der Kampagnen selbst aufsetzt, testet und optimiert.

Benefits

Wir bieten

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle 100-%-Position am Standort Wil SG
  • Volle Verantwortung für unser Paid-Advertising-Budget und viel Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld an der Schnittstelle von Marketing, Technologie und künstlicher Intelligenz

  • Abwechslungsreiche Projekte mit direktem Einfluss auf Wachstum und Umsatz

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt?

Du willst deine Google-Ads-Expertise in einem Unternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen einbringen und direkten Einfluss auf Wachstum und Umsatz haben? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung, gerne mit Beispielen von Kampagnen, die du verantwortet hast.

About CoreView   

CoreView is the global leader in Microsoft 365 (M365) tenant resilience, serving over 23 million users worldwide. We empower the world’s leading organizations to master the complexity of Microsoft M365.  Through robust security and precise governance, we help ensure that our client’s environments stay cyber-resilient and productive, no matter how complex they are.  
 
Our unified, cloud-native platform delivers powerful automation, rapid value, and end-to-end visibility across the entire M365 ecosystem. Backed by world-class support and a collaborative, innovative culture, CoreView is a place where your ideas matter, and your work truly impacts global enterprises.  

Job Summary 

CoreView is seeking a Director, Channel Sales – EMEA to lead and scale its regional channel strategy across Europe, working closely with the VP Sales, EMEA to drive partner-led growth. The Director will own the execution and evolution of CoreView’s partner strategy across Northern, Southern, and Central Europe. This role will be responsible for managing and developing CoreView’s EMEA channel motion through a team of direct reports based in the UK, France, and Germany, while also building strong relationships with key partners across the region. 

The Director, Channel Sales - EMEA will play a critical role in expanding CoreView’s partner ecosystem, increasing partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue, and strengthening go-to-market execution with GSI, System Integrators, resellers, distributors, and strategic partners. This is a highly visible leadership role requiring a strong mix of strategic thinking, commercial focus, team leadership, and hands-on channel execution. 

This individual should bring deep experience in channel sales within B2B SaaS or enterprise software, ideally in industries related to cybersecurity. 

Job Requirements

  • Experience in cybersecurity is strongly preferred.
  • Significant experience in channel sales, partner management, or indirect sales leadership within B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or cybersecurity.
  • Proven success leading channel or partner teams across multiple EMEA markets.
  • Experience working with resellers, distributors, service providers, and strategic alliance partners.
  • Strong track record of driving partner-sourced pipeline and revenue growth.
  • Experience building and executing partner business plans, joint go-to-market strategies, and regional growth plans.
  • Ability to lead a distributed team across multiple countries and create strong operating cadence and accountability.
  • Strong commercial and operational discipline, including forecasting, pipeline management, and performance tracking.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with direct sales, marketing, pre-sales, customer success, and operations.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to build credibility internally and externally
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills.
  • Comfortable operating in a high-growth, fast-paced, and evolving software business.
Key Soft Skills 
  • Strategic but hands-on mindset.
  • Strong leadership and coaching capability.
  • High level of ownership and accountability.
  • Collaborative and cross-functional working style.
  • Commercially driven with strong business acumen.
  • Strong organisational and prioritisation skills.
  • Comfortable navigating complexity across regions, teams, and partner types.
  • Confident communicator with strong executive-level presence.
  • Resilient, adaptable, and able to operate effectively in a scaling environment.

Extra Credit 

  • Experience selling through or alongside Microsoft-focused partners or CSPs.
  • Background in Microsoft 365 ecosystem and governance solutions.
  • Experience in a business scaling its indirect route to market across enterprise customers.
  • Additional European language skills, particularly French or German.
Job Responsibilities
  • Define and execute the EMEA channel sales strategy aligned to CoreView’s regional revenue goals.
  • Lead, coach, and develop channel sales team members located in UK, France, and Germany.
  • Build and expand CoreView’s ecosystem of resellers, distributors, and strategic partners across EMEA.
  • Identify, recruit, onboard, and activate new partners in priority markets.
  • Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue growth.
  • Create and manage strategic partner business plans to improve market coverage and commercial performance.
  • Develop strong executive relationships with key partners and act as a senior point of contact where needed.
  • Improve consistency and execution across partner planning, pipeline reviews, QBRs, enablement, and joint go-to-market activity.
  • Work closely with sales teams to strengthen co-sell execution and improve partner engagement in active opportunities.
  • Partner with marketing on regional partner campaigns, events, demand generation, and enablement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with pre-sales, customer success, and operations teams to ensure effective partner support and execution.
  • Monitor partner performance and make data-driven decisions around investment,prioritisation, and growth opportunities.
  • Own channel forecasting and provide regular reporting on partner pipeline, contribution, performance, and risk areas.
  • Help build scalable processes and frameworks for partner management, territory planning, and regional channel performance.
  • Provide market feedback on partner trends, competitive insights, and regional opportunities to internal leadership.

#LI-CW1

Coreview Values

Ownership Mindset:Take ownership. Drive outcomes. 

One Team: One team, one goal, embracing diversity - to achieve more together. 

Velocity: Decide fast. Deliver fast. Repeat.

Continuous Improvement: Curiosity drives us. We challenge the status quo.

Customer First: Listen deeply. Solve boldly.  

Resilience: Steady under pressure.

title: Director, Fan Services
descriptionHtml:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Director, Fan Services leads the Fan Services customer service organization across first and second line teams, owning the departmental budget, headcount planning, and vendor/BPO relationships in partnership with global teams. This role works across internal Fanatics International stakeholders to prioritize activity for the benefit of partners and fans, delivering feedback to the SLT on progress and future opportunities while bringing extensive experience of best-in-class processes, tools, and performance management. The Director, Fan Services delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.

HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT

Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

Cross-Functional Leadership:

  • Liaise with fulfillment operations, logistics, merchandising, marketing, business analytics, Partnerships, and technology teams to gather information, provide key insights, and resolve issues across the organization.
  • Coordinate resources, remove barriers, and work cross-functionally with external partners including marketplace operations, drop ship vendors, and MTO/3PL partners to ensure seamless operations.
  • Lead and present Fan Services operational data on daily, weekly, and monthly business review calls to senior and executive leadership, proactively communicating core KPIs and delivering strategies to overcome operational challenges.

People Leadership:

  • Manage staffing, workflows, and performance seamlessly for on-premises, hybrid, and remote employees, maximizing team performance through training, motivation, project management, and incentive programs.
  • Develop succession plans and talent pipelines for managers, supervisors, and team leaders to build organizational depth and resilience.
  • Deploy policies, procedures, and service level standards across the customer service organization in partnership with global teams to ensure consistent, high-quality execution.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

  • Own the voice of the fan by serving as the subject matter expert for customer sentiment and feedback, strategizing messaging that adapts to fan needs and enhances the Fanatics brand globally.
  • Consistently analyze and leverage data to drive targets and process improvements across key metrics including Net Promoter Score, Customer Satisfaction/Customer Delight, First Contact Resolution, Appeasement per Contact, and Contacts per Order.
  • Identify and reduce contact drivers through innovative solutions while ensuring adherence to all appropriate regulatory and compliance frameworks, including PCI/PII and GDPR.
  • Develop and manage BPO and vendor partner relationships — including performance, cost, and contract oversight — to ensure fans receive best-in-class service across every channel.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

  • Apply strong technical proficiency across customer experience technologies including contact experience platforms, e-commerce front-end/back-end tools, order management systems, content management systems, and AI/Machine Learning-powered conversation analytics systems to drive continuous improvement.
  • Leverage omni-channel operational expertise to identify gaps, design scalable solutions, and enhance the end-to-end fan service experience across all touchpoints.
  • Bring innovative approaches to first and second line contact management, improving resolution rates and reducing friction across own and 3PL operations.
  • Identify opportunities to integrate emerging technologies and data-driven tools to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and elevate fan outcomes.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

  • Own the strategic roadmap, budget, and resource planning for the Fan Services customer service organization, aligning headcount, technology, and vendor/BPO investment to business goals.
  • Drive performance management across the team with a disciplined focus on financial targets and third-party SLAs, ensuring accountability at every level of the organization.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, demonstrating the ability to manage competing priorities with urgency and composure while delivering results at scale.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently in writing, speaking, and digital formats to senior-level and C-level audiences, translating operational complexity into strategic insight.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:

  • Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
  • Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
  • Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
  • Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of customer operations experience, including deep expertise in first and second line contact management and managing own and 3PL operations.
  • 7+ years of people leadership experience, including demonstrated success leading leaders and managers across on-premises, hybrid, and remote environments.
  • Experience and understanding of omni-channel operations and the e-commerce space.
  • Advanced communication skills in writing, speaking, and digital formats, with the ability to deliver comfortably to senior-level and C-level audiences.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, including foundational experience with Excel and pivot tables; knowledgeable user of CRM technologies, Conversation-Analytics Software, Contact Center Technologies, Customer Review Tools, and order management tools such as EDI, DAX, and Cloud Reporting.
  • Proven track record of owning departmental budgets, headcount planning, and BPO/vendor relationships including performance, cost, and contract oversight.
  • Multi-lingual candidates are encouraged to apply; Spanish, French, and German are preferred.

Education:

Bachelor's degree in business, communications, management, or a related field.

WORK LOCATION

On-site: Your work location will be onsite in Stakehill.

At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.

ABOUT US
Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

ABOUT THE TEAM
Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally – as well as its flagship site, www.fanatics.com.

Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world—including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).

At Fanatics Commerce, we infuse our BOLD Leadership Principles in everything we do:
· Build Championship Teams
· Obsessed with Fans
· Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit
· Determined and Relentless Mindset

title: Director, Field Sales Enablement EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

As the Director of EMEA Field Enablement, you hold a high-impact role at the intersection of strategy and field execution. Rubrik is growing quickly, and the field needs a leader who can connect global corporate strategy with the realities of selling across EMEA’s different markets, buying cultures and levels of maturity.

You will own the readiness and productivity of the EMEA sales organization. You’ll architect and scale enablement programs, from onboarding for new hires through to advanced value selling for tenured sellers. The goal is that every Account Executive can clearly communicate Rubrik’s Zero Trust Data Security and AI-driven resilience story to the organizations, from hospitals to governments to financial institutions, that rely on us to keep operating.

You’ll work directly with the GVP of EMEA and regional sales leaders, with the backing of Global Enablement and the autonomy to decide what your theater needs. What you build will show up in ramp time, win rates and quota attainment.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Executive Partnership

  • Executive Partnership: Act as the primary strategic partner to the GVP of EMEA, AVPs/RVPs and Regional Directors, tying enablement priorities and KPIs directly to regional revenue targets.
  • Regional Strategy & Roadmap: Build and own the EMEA enablement roadmap, aligned to Global Enablement programs and shaped by leadership input and needs analysis, so investment goes where the biggest gaps are.
  • Localized Execution: Translate global initiatives into regional results by adapting content, examples and delivery to local market conditions and business cultures across EMEA.
  • Gap Analysis: Run regular assessments of the sales team’s skills and performance to identify readiness gaps early, and close them before they show up in the forecast.

Program Development & Delivery

  • Program Development & Delivery: Design and deliver enablement in region for both ramping and ramped sellers, from foundational onboarding to advanced value selling.
  • Onboarding: Reinforce and extend the global onboarding journey in EMEA, track ramp progress and validate capstones, so new hires reach productivity faster.
  • Methodology Mastery: Drive adoption of Rubrik’s sales methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message) so pipeline qualification and deal execution are consistent across every region and segment.
  • Coaching Enablement: Equip front-line sales leaders to reinforce learning through coaching, using AI-assisted coaching tools where they add value.

Metrics & Operational Excellence

  • Data-Driven Insights: Track, analyze and report on the impact of enablement programs using CRM (Salesforce) and sales engagement tools (Clari).
  • KPI Ownership: Measure success through quota attainment, win rates and the adoption of new product plays, and report on them candidly to senior leadership.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years in Sales Enablement, a Sales role and/or Sales Leadership within a high-growth SaaS or cybersecurity environment.
  • Leadership: 5 years leading sales teams, with a proven ability to lead through influence rather than authority.
  • Program Design: A track record of building and scaling enablement programs, from onboarding through advanced selling, that measurably improved sales performance.
  • Methodology: Hands-on experience driving adoption of a structured sales methodology such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message.
  • Market Knowledge: A deep understanding of the EMEA sales landscape, regional business practices and the competitive cybersecurity market.
  • Technical Stack: Proficiency with Salesforce and AI-forward CMS/LMS platforms. Experience with AI-assisted coaching tools is a significant advantage.

Who You Are (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Strategic Architect: You don’t just deliver training; you build the systems and frameworks that drive predictable revenue and long-term growth.
  • Exceptional Communicator: You have strong executive presence and can act as the trusted “voice of truth” when presenting to senior leadership.
  • Adaptable & Resilient: You thrive where the product landscape evolves monthly, and you treat continuous learning as part of the job.

#LI-[Remote / Hybrid / Onsite]

Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation

Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

Linkedin | X (formerly Twitter) | Instagram | Rubrik.com

Inclusion @ Rubrik

At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.

Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.

Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:

  • Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.

  • Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.

  • Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.

title: Director, Litigation & Regulatory Affairs
descriptionHtml:
About Us:

At Sitecore, our mission is to simplify how brands reach, engage, and serve people by delivering intelligent, personalised digital experiences that connect the world. We empower the world’s most iconic brands to build lifelong relationships with their customers—seamlessly, smartly, and at scale.


As the leading provider of agentic digital experience software, Sitecore brings together content, commerce, and data into one composable platform that enables brands to deliver millions of meaningful, adaptive experiences every day. Trusted by global leaders such as American Express, Porsche, Starbucks, and L’Oréal, Sitecore helps brands transform engagement through experiences that are not only personalised but predictive and dynamic.


Our foundation is our people—a diverse, passionate, and collaborative global team spanning over 25 countries. We believe that every experience matters, and that belief starts with how we work together. Our values guide how we lead, innovate, and connect. They are the behaviours that bring our mission and vision to life, every day, in every interaction.


As we continue to evolve, we are actively cultivating AI skills across our teams to unlock new levels of creativity, efficiency, and insight. From engineering to customer experience, AI capabilities are becoming integral to how we design, build, and deliver the next generation of digital experiences.
Learn more at Sitecore.com.

About the Role:

Reporting to the General Counsel, the Director, Litigation & Regulatory Affairs will lead Sitecore’s global approach to disputes, investigations, software license compliance, and regulatory readiness. This senior role has broad international scope and strong visibility across the business.

You will combine sharp litigation judgment with a practical in-house mindset. You will protect commercial value, guide senior leaders through complex matters, and build scalable processes that help Sitecore manage risk with confidence.

 

What You Will Do:

  • Own Sitecore’s global disputes portfolio, including employment, commercial, vendor, license compliance, regulatory, and pre-litigation matters

  • Lead early case assessment and litigation strategy, covering merits, business impact, preservation, settlement posture, and recommended next steps

  • Manage matters from investigation through resolution, including legal holds, discovery, witness preparation, mediation, arbitration, settlement, and court proceedings

  • Lead software license compliance and entitlement enforcement matters, partnering with Finance, Revenue Operations, Sales, Product, and Deal Desk

  • Direct responses to regulatory inquiries and investigations, including strategy, correspondence, document collection, remediation, and executive updates

  • Track relevant legal developments and translate new requirements into practical policies, controls, training, templates, and operating processes

  • Support sensitive internal investigations involving workplace, ethics, commercial, privacy, security, and third-party risk issues

  • Provide concise, decision-ready reporting to senior leaders on material disputes, regulatory risks, and remediation progress

  • Manage outside counsel, strategy, budgets, staffing, and performance, and strengthen playbooks and escalation processes across the business

What Success Looks Like

  • Material matters receive early, practical risk assessments and clear ownership

  • Senior leaders receive concise recommendations and understand the available decisions and trade-offs

  • Outside counsel is used strategically, with disciplined budgets and accountability

  • Disputes, investigations, license compliance matters, and new regulatory obligations are handled consistently across jurisdictions

What You Need to Succeed

  • Significant post-qualification experience in litigation, regulatory disputes, investigations, commercial disputes, or software license compliance, gained in-house or at a leading law firm

  • Experience managing complex matters from early assessment through resolution and developing litigation strategy, settlement posture, and executive recommendations

  • Strong judgment across legal, commercial, financial, operational, and reputational risk

  • Sound knowledge of legal holds, document preservation, privilege, confidentiality, discovery, and sensitive communications

  • A record of translating legal requirements into practical business processes and partnering effectively with cross-functional teams

  • Excellent communication and project management skills, with high ownership and attention to detail

  • A practical, collaborative approach and the credibility to build trust with senior leaders

Additional Skills That Could Set You Apart:

  • Experience in a global SaaS, software, technology, or digital platform business

  • Experience with software license compliance, audit rights, entitlement disputes, or contractual enforcement

  • Experience with AI, digital services, cybersecurity, privacy-adjacent, consumer protection, public sector, or employment regulation

  • Experience managing cross-border matters and reporting to executives, Boards, or Audit Committees.

Equal Opportunities at Sitecore

Sitecore isproud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity without unlawful regard to race, colour, ancestry, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other local legally protected characteristic.

title: Director of Communications
descriptionHtml:
Born in 1971, the roots of Mulberry are in Somerset, England. For more than fifty years, Mulberry has been a British lifestyle brand, internationally acclaimed for quality and design capturing the Mulberry Spirit.
Sustainability has been part of the Mulberry ethos since the brand's inception, in recognition of our purpose-driven approach, in 2024 we proudly achieved B Corp Certification.
Today, we are a global brand, but our values remain the same; we are committed to improving our impact on people and the planet. To do this our people are honest, dynamic, and community spirited.
If these are values you share, we would love you to join our team.

The Role:

As the Director of Communications you will represent and champion Mulberry’s new strategy – Back to the Mulberry Spirit – which will see the brand returning to its original values & proposition. Based in Mulberry’s Kensington HQ, the roles primary focus is the UK, EU & US whilst also providing strategic guidance and support to local marketing teams in China, South Korea and Japan and respective agency partners. You will be responsible for implementing the 360 global communication strategy encompassing PR, Events and Talent, to ensure a consistent global strategy and brand voice across the markets. You will also drive the Mulberry by Christopher Kane strategy – working with the RTW team and agencies.

Duties and responsibilities:

PR:

  • Develop strategic 360° global communication plans, that ensures a consistent brand voice across the markets
  • Achieve strong editorial coverage in line with the annual objectives
  • Work with key agencies to deliver this objective – across Mulberry core and Mulberry by Christopher Kane
  • Devise and work with the team to execute targeted communications plans for the launch of key projects, product launches, brand events and collaborations
  • Oversee an effective and creative product placement strategy
  • Support the team to identify and map key target media for Mulberry across the relevant markets
  • Responsible for overall story and feature placements
  • Manage and evaluate interviews requests and speaking opportunities for CEO, CFO and Creative Director, RTW
  • Analyse and improve on editorial output achieved each season in qualitative and quantitative terms
  • Oversee the creation of press kits, press releases and other seasonal documents
  • Work closely with the key markets (including marketing & communications managers and communications agencies), to adapt the global communications strategy to local market needs.s
  • Oversee the execution of agreed strategy, supporting the local teams to generate positive editorial coverage across features, news and product stories.
  • Build and maintain a relevant community around Mulberry and help to foster meaningful relationships with key figures in media and creative worlds
  • Stay ahead of key industry news and updates as well as competitor activity and share developments across departments
  • Advise the Brand Director and wider Executive Committee on interesting developments, movements, new trends, and new directions within the Global media landscape
  • Advise on partnerships, collaborations and sponsorships to drive brand awareness and support commercial objectives.
  • Foster strong internal relationships with all areas of the business including creative studio, marketing, product management, buying & merchandising, finance and retail to support business objectives
  • Forecast and manage departments budget with an in-season agile approach to allocate in accordance with the businesses needs
  • ·Oversee reports for timely distribution across the business

Events:

  • In partnership with the brand marketing team, deliver the Mulberry by Christopher Kane show at LFW
  • Responsible for the successful end-to-end project management & delivery of the Global Events Calendar including brand moments and activations related to seasonal collection launch
  • Work closely with key internal business stakeholders to define the Global Events strategy
  • Oversee guestlists for events and ensure appropriate editor & KOL attendance at targeted events; including overseas events, brand moments and press days
  • Attend key press and KOL trips where relevant, overseeing all aspects of the trip and ensuring the brand’s objectives are delivered
  • Find interesting Partner events and opportunities linked to Mulberry’s strategy & objectives e.g. speaking opportunities for ExCo members
  • Develop and maintain strong 3rd party relationships
  • Plan activity with target ROI in mind and measure and report on success post event

Talent:

  • Drive a successful VIP, talent and influencer strategy ensuring the brand vision and identity is reinforced and global brand awareness is increased
  • Work with key internal stakeholders to constantly refine the global influencer and talent strategy, in line with the broader business' brand & commercial goals
  • Oversee all aspects of brand talent relationships from initial contract negotiation, product placement talent appearances, editorial talent placements and social media activity, as well as all operational & logistical support
  • Work with Global Event and Talent Manager on product placement of hero product on brand appropriate talent and influencers.
  • Managing relevant budgets and ensuring that all event, talent and press activities are delivered in line with this
  • Supporting and mentoring direct reports to aid their learning and growth

Culture:

  • Drive internal comms strategy with key stakeholders including HR
  • Embrace and demonstrate the Mulberry values and behaviours: honesty, dynamism, and a community-oriented spirit.
  • Support Mulberry to deliver an inclusive culture, through behaving in a way that is open-minded and respectful towards others, and understanding that your views, opinions, and experiences may not always be shared by your colleagues.
  • Act as an ambassador for Mulberry and communicate positively about the brand.

Sustainability:

  • Work closely with the sustainability team to shape and amplify key moments eg Impact Report
  • Be one of the proponents of ensuring sustainability forms a part of everyones role at Mulberry
  • As a certified B Corp business, it is important to incorporate environmentally responsible practices into your work wherever possible. Support the businesses ‘Five C’s’ strategy in addressing and improving Climate, Cultivation, Craft, Culture and Circularity. Promote a greener, more sustainable future.
  • Support to foster an environment where diversity is embraced and all individuals feel valued, respected and included. Promote equity, empathy and understanding and demonstrate this commitment within your internal and external communities.

Skills and Knowledge:

  • Experience of working in a similar level role on luxury /premium fashion or lifestyle brands, ideally gained both in-house and at an agency, and able to demonstrate senior level UK fashion press and industry contacts
  • Strong sustainability comms is beneficial
  • Excellent written and verbal English
  • Excellent team management skills
  • Ability to effectively challenge and influence both internal and external teams
  • A truly collaborative team player, able to work across multiple departments with differing objectives, whilst championing and delivering best practice and innovation across the business
  • Confident with multi-tasking, working to tight deadlines and troubleshooting under pressure
  • Well-organised and efficient with strong planning and prioritising capabilities and the ability to work to multiple, competing deadlines
  • Proficient in Microsoft office – Excel, Word, PowerPoint
  • Good knowledge of Launchmetrics, Lefty, Diary Directory, Dash Hudson
  • Interest and current knowledge of wider culture

title: Director of Engineering Operations (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

As Director of Engineering Operations, you will build structured, repeatable operating capability across Mechanical, Electrical and Controls. You will own engineering planning and capacity reporting, configuration and release administration, supplier engineering readiness, and end-to-end engineering and supplier quality. This is a functional leadership role: you will set the processes that engineering must follow, while authorised engineers keep design approval, Systems Engineering keeps requirements governance, and Commercial Procurement keeps contracts.

What You'll Do

descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

11625 - Director, Partnerships, Global

Role Summary and Impact

This Partnerships Director role is the link between our Global Investment specialists and WPP Media and agency Client Account teams, working to define and deliver joint business plan (JBP) partnership opportunities for key global clients, primarily The Coca Cola Company but with the opportunity to expand to other brands such as Ford, Colgate and Estee Lauder.  This role will also work in tandem with Strategy leads and Account teams to identify relevant media partners, to then develop integrated investment strategies with, delivering best in class, progressive, strategic client partnerships.

Aided by support from the broader team, the Partnerships Director will define client’s JBPs with media partners, such as Google, Amazon, Pinterest, Meta and TikTok, to maximise client benefits, and then work to deliver these commercial and strategic benefits, throughout the year.  Cooperation with, and co-ordination of, local and regional market teams will be central to this, to ensure a consistent approach and successful execution of the negotiated benefits.

This role will require high levels of relationship management, strategy, coordination and organization as it will involve management of a complex client and agency structure.

The Partnerships Director will need to gain a deep understanding of our client’s businesses and will need to apply their digital (and to a lesser extent, offline) landscape and strategic knowledge to ensure that the client partnership team delivers the most effective plans to deliver on the client’s objectives and the changing entertainment marketing landscape.

They will be responsible for managing partner relationships with the key digital vendors (Meta, Amazon, Google, etc.) to ensure that our clients gain maximum benefits from trading deals brokered and JBPs. Measurement is a key part of the role, so this role is also responsible for ensuring that digital investment associated with the JBPs is tracked and reported back to the client, to ensure full transparency of pacing versus any investment endeavours in place. 

Reporting of the role

This role reports to the Global Head of Partnerships.

Responsibilities of the role:

Strategic Skills

  • Work collaboratively within the WPP Media network, and specialist practice departments e.g. DPAM teams, Brand Safety and Governance, , to deliver innovative and media-first, cross media Global JBP opportunities
  • Develop a strong understanding of media landscape working closely with on and offline Global partners, to ensure first mover opportunities are leveraged for client
  • Support in development and monitoring of opportunities with key vendors in the Diversity, Sustainability and Inclusion space, helping to grow client spend
  • Identify key areas of partnership growth and work collaboratively with client teams, as an extension to their strategy & planning teams, to deliver and activate Global JBPs
  • Support in the deployment and monitoring of Global JBPs, across local markets and regions, to ensure targets are met and value is unlocked

External Relationship Management

  • Demonstrate an ability to build and maintain strong working relationships with clients, global media vendors, proprietarymedia opcos and internal teams, to drive collaboration and best in class delivery
  • Develop and sell partnerships persuasively and with confidence, passion and enthusiasm to both clients and internal stakeholders

Delivery Excellence 

  • Present confidently, with gravitas & impact
  • Proactively share global marketplace updates and work with markets to do the same

New business 

  • Support where needed in new business pitches and proposals, supporting client and strategy teams in content partnership proposals in group pitches

General tasks:

  • Develop a full understanding of in all areas of the WPP Media and agency suite of products and services, in order to speak confidently with clients about them, ultimately increasing client adoption
  • Deliver best in class JBPs, ensuring client value, innovation and excellence are delivered
  • Develop global integrated investment strategy and then actively work with regional and local leads to deploy in markets, adapting as needed
  • Work closely with Regional and Market leads to support in roll out of investment frameworks & JBP benefits
  • Develop best in class campaign measurement frameworks and build out case studies of the best case studies, to be socialized within local and regional teams, as well and with the client directly
  • Develop, deploy, and monitor client’s global inclusive marketing investment roadmap, partnering with global strategy and integrations leads
  • Partner with global lead on media quality processes and governance and ensure same rigor applied to all media
  • Actively scout for new opportunities bespoke to the GroupM client set
  • Manage monthly partner investment pacing against agreed JBP endeavours, ensuring correct framework is in place to hit spend thresholds across regions and markets
  • Brief and manage set up of client QBR and JBP reviews coordinating with regions and markets where required

People Responsibilities: 

  • Develop relationships with both clients as well as internally at WPP Media
  • Build trusted relationships with media vendors, proprietarymedia opcos and internal stakeholder teams
  • Manage, motivate and encourage growth and skillset of junior members of the team

Skills and Experience

  • Leading by example, with integrity and good citizenship
  • Positive and passionate approach that motivates the team
  • Independently owning and managing relationships confidently
  • Ambition and drive to execute new ideas and be at the forefront of new industry developments

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.  

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

title: Director Solutions (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Director Solutions (m/f/d) · Stuttgart, with frequent travel to customer sites in Europe and the US · Reports to the CEO · Full-time

Who we are

Sereact builds the robot brain for physical work. Cortex, our vision-language-action foundation model, is hardware-agnostic: the same model runs single-arm and dual-arm systems and mobile manipulators that pick, sort and handle returns in live production across Europe and the US. Customers include Zalando, IKEA, BMW, Rohlik and DHL.

Founded in 2021 in Stuttgart, with an R&D hub in Zurich and a US office in Boston. We have raised more than $145 million, most recently a Series B led by Headline, with Zalando as a strategic investor. We work in small, senior teams with a flat structure; execution counts more than titles.

Why this role, why now

A robot deal is won twice: once when the contract is signed, and once when the cell runs the customer’s orders at the throughput we promised. The distance between the two is decided before anyone unpacks a crate: by the site survey, the item spectrum, the cell concept, the integration with the customer’s warehouse systems, and by the number we write into the contract.

We are moving from single stations to fleets, with customers who order dozens of systems at once. The deals are getting larger, the sites more varied, and a concept that does not fit the site is paid for in months of commissioning. We are looking for the technical counterpart to our sales team: a leader who sits next to every account executive from the first conversation and makes deals technically feasible. Someone who has deployed robots personally, knows what a real site does to a design, finds the solution that makes the customer’s use case work, and makes sure what we promise is what we can build.

The Real-World Learning Loop starts with your design

Cortex learns from live deployments. The cell you design is the body the model works in, and a concept that goes live in weeks instead of months is weeks of real-world data no one else has.

  • In-Situ Policy Execution. Every station runs the current policy on the customer’s items. Your surface on it: reach, camera placement and item presentation that let the policy do its job on day one.

  • Continuous Data Acquisition. Robots annotate their own work while they run. Your surface on it: standard cells with a known stack wherever possible, so every pick teaches the same model.

  • Data Curation and Learning. Edge cases decide what Cortex learns next. Your surface on it: the item spectrum and the sample tests you run before signature, so curation starts before go-live.

  • Evaluation and Policy Redeployment. Updated policies return to the fleet after validation. Your surface on it: concepts that transfer, so a policy proven on one cell works on the next.

A site designed right goes live faster, teaches Cortex more, and grows.

Responsibilities

  • Be Sales’ technical counterpart on every deal. One solutions lead next to every account executive, from the first customer conversation to signature. Your job is to make the deal technically feasible: understand the customer’s process, find the solution that works for their site and items, and give Sales a technical story the customer’s engineers believe.

  • Own the technical solution for every deal, from the first site visit to the signed scope: site survey, process and material-flow analysis, item spectrum, cell concept and layout, reach and camera study, integration concept for WMS, WCS and conveyors, safety concept. One package per deal, and you are accountable for it.

  • Set the number. Throughput, pick success and intervention rates we commit to per site, derived from the item spectrum and the site and checked against what comparable live sites actually do. No KPI goes into a contract without your sign-off.

  • Standard first. Configure our standard single-arm, dual-arm and mobile products to the site. Every deviation is a documented decision taken with Engineering, not a discovery during installation.

  • Run the gate. No contract is signed without your solution design sign-off and a delivery slot agreed with Operations. You hold the pen on the technical statement of work, the acceptance criteria and the site-readiness list the customer has to meet.

  • Make it feasible, fast. Sample tests, pick studies and scanning or dimensioning checks with our applied AI team, within days, not months. When a requirement does not fit, find the version that does: a different cell or item presentation, a phased scope, a pilot that proves the hard part first. A no is the last answer, not the first.

  • Hand over to Deployment a package that builds: layout, configuration, integration spec, acceptance criteria, risks and dates, so commissioning executes without reopening the concept. You stay accountable until the first live orders prove the design.

  • Own the interfaces to integrators and WMS vendors at the solution level, from AutoStore and goods-to-person systems to conveyor and WMS partners: interface specs, a clear split of responsibilities and readiness tests before we ship.

  • Build the solution library: reference designs per use case (goods-to-person ports, put walls, returns, decanting, store replenishment), throughput models, layout templates and integration patterns, so the tenth deal of a kind takes a day, not a month.

  • Close the loop from the field. What commissioning and live sites learn about a design flows back into the reference concepts and into requirements for Product and Engineering.

  • Lead the big pursuits in person: the technical counterpart to the customer’s engineering and operations teams in fleet deals, tenders and RFPs; demos and reference visits with the customer’s real items.

  • Build and lead the Solutions team in Europe and the US: solutions engineers who have stood at a cell, with the playbooks and tools (CAD, simulation, throughput models) to do this at ten times today’s deal flow.

  • Partner with Sales, Operations and Deployment, Service Accounts, Systems Engineering, Applied AI and Supply Chain. Report to the CEO and be part of the leadership team.

Not in scope, by design

  • Pricing, contract terms and closing stay with Sales. You are their technical counterpart: you own what we promise technically, how we make it work and when it can be delivered.

  • Build, installation and commissioning up to the Site Acceptance Test stay with Operations. You hand over a package that builds, and you stay accountable for the concept.

  • Live sites after acceptance stay with Service Accounts. You design for the site they will have to run.

  • Product and system design stay with Engineering and New Product Introduction. You configure the standard; what the standard lacks, you bring them as requirements.

What makes this role hard

  • Your job is to find the yes we can deliver. Most of the time that means a smarter solution, sometimes a different scope or a later date, and occasionally a no to a deal the company wants. When it is a no, you have to be right about it, with numbers.

  • The product moves fast: what the model could not do in spring it may do in autumn. You commit to today’s capability and plan for tomorrow’s, and you do not confuse the two.

  • The site is never finished. WMS, conveyors, bins and item master data belong to the customer or an integrator, and your design has to survive their reality.

  • Every shortcut in the concept comes back as months of commissioning. You carry both sides of that trade, in front of Sales and in front of Deployment.

Your first 12 months

  • First 90 days: every open deal has a solution package and a realistic commitment; the gate is in place (checklist, sign-off, delivery slot); every live site’s concept reviewed for what we would design differently today.

  • By month 6: reference designs for our three main use cases; a throughput model validated against live sites; interface specifications agreed with our three most important integration partners; the first solutions engineer in the US onboarded.

  • By month 12: deals signed in 2027 go live at the throughput in the concept, without redesign; a Solutions team in Europe and the US; a library that makes the standard deal routine.

What you bring

  • 8+ years in warehouse or factory automation, several of them in solutions, application engineering or deployment of robotic systems. You have personally deployed robots in live operations, from site survey to commissioning: piece-picking arms, dual-arm cells, mobile manipulators or AMR fleets. You know what a go-live night feels like.

  • You did it while your company grew from its first sites to dozens or hundreds, and you built the solution process rather than inheriting it.

  • You can do the work yourself: a site survey, a layout in CAD, a material-flow and throughput model, an interface specification for a WMS or WCS (APIs, PLC handshakes), a risk assessment for a cell. And you can explain it to a customer’s operations director and to our machine learning engineers in the same afternoon.

  • You have worked side by side with sales teams as their technical counterpart and helped win deals by finding a solution that works. You have led solutions or application engineers, and when a sales team pushed for a bigger number, you held the line with evidence.

  • You know the intralogistics ecosystem: AutoStore and goods-to-person systems, conveyors, the integrators; ideally e-commerce, returns or grocery fulfilment.

  • Fluent English; German is a strong plus, since many of our customers are in the DACH region. You are happy to spend a large part of your time at customer sites in Europe and the US.

Nice to have: piece-picking or dual-arm robotics · systems whose capability is driven by machine learning and moves every quarter · robotics-as-a-service models · deployments in the US.

Not the right fit: pre-sales architects who have never commissioned a system, solutions as slide-making, or anyone who needs a finished product specification before they can start.

Three questions we will ask you

  1. Walk us through a site you designed that went live at the throughput you promised, and one that did not. What was the difference?

  2. Sales wants to sign a deal this quarter with a KPI 50% above what your model says the site can do. What do you do in the next 48 hours to still make the deal work?

  3. A customer’s goods-to-person ports are fixed, and the layout leaves 30 cm less reach than our standard cell needs. What are the options, and which one do you choose?

What we offer

  • A product in live production with some of Europe’s largest operators, and the mandate to decide what we promise and what we build.

  • A seat in the leadership team of a company scaling from Europe into the US, with equity.

  • Travel, accommodation and meals covered when you are on site.

  • Our HQ in Stuttgart, with teams in Zurich and Boston.

How we hire

Conversations with the founders and our VP Operations, a working session on a real site (we give you a layout, an item spectrum and a target; you tell us what to build and what to promise), and time with the team in Stuttgart. We move fast.

title: Embedded Automotive Platforms, Staff Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

The Embedded Automotive Platforms (EAP) group builds the software that connects Wayve’s AI Driver to the vehicle and its onboard systems. We develop the platform adaptation and integration layers that let our AI capabilities run reliably across different vehicles, hardware platforms and programmes.

You’ll join a team working across Wayve’s internal fleets and customer programmes. Our work spans embedded software that resides between vehicle platforms, HMI and AI Driver, and the software interfaces that connect these capabilities to the AI Driver. We work closely with teams across autonomy, hardware, product and vehicle engineering to turn system requirements into robust, testable software.

As a Staff Software engineer, you’ll own significant technical work from design through integration and validation. You’ll help shape how EAP software is structured, make sound engineering decisions in an evolving environment, and work with partner teams to deliver capabilities that operate reliably on real vehicles.

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Design, build and maintain embedded software that integrates Wayve’s AI Driver with vehicle platforms and onboard systems.

  • Develop and evolve interfaces between AI capabilities, vehicle software and platform-specific components.

  • Work across areas such as inference integration, vehicle data, navigation, localisation, odometry, driver interaction and motion control interfaces.

  • Collaborate with engineers across autonomy, hardware, vehicle programmes and product to clarify requirements and resolve integration issues.

  • Take features from technical design through implementation, testing, vehicle integration and release.

  • Diagnose and resolve issues using simulation, hardware-in-the-loop, vehicle testing, logs and performance data.

  • Contribute to architecture and engineering practices that support reuse across vehicle platforms and programmes.

  • Use AI development tools where they can improve engineering productivity and software quality.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Building and integrating software for current and future vehicle platforms, including internal development fleets and customer programmes.

  • Developing reliable interfaces and adaptation software between Wayve’s AI Driver and vehicle-specific systems.

  • Improving software quality, observability, performance and resilience in resource-constrained onboard environments.

  • Supporting the migration and evolution of capabilities across vehicle generations and hardware configurations.

  • Working with simulation and test teams to improve how embedded and vehicle-integrated software is validated.

  • Contributing to technical direction, reviewing designs and code, and helping raise engineering standards across the team.

🙌 You should apply if

  • Essential: a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical, Automotive Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Essential: strong software engineering experience in modern C++, with a track record of delivering production-quality software.

  • Essential: experience developing embedded or systems software, ideally on Nvidia and Qualcomm platforms with Linux/QNX.

  • Essential: experience with Linux-based platforms.

  • Essential: experience with system architecture and designing software components, APIs or interfaces for complex systems.

  • Essential: strong understanding of software quality practices, including testing, debugging, code review and maintainability.

  • Essential: experience diagnosing problems across component or system boundaries.

  • Essential: ability to work with technical partners to clarify requirements and make progress in ambiguous situations.

  • Essential: clear communication and collaboration skills, including working across teams and locations.

  • Essential: a practical, ownership-minded approach, so you can take a complex problem from investigation through implementation and validation.

  • Desirable: experience in autonomous driving, automotive, robotics or another real-time, safety-related domain.

  • Desirable: familiarity with vehicle software, middleware, sensors, actuators or vehicle communication protocols.

  • Desirable: experience integrating machine-learning inference or other compute-intensive workloads on embedded hardware.

  • Desirable: familiarity with AV stack components like navigation, state estimation or driver-interaction systems.

  • Desirable: experience with simulation, hardware-in-the-loop testing or vehicle testing.

  • Desirable: familiarity with automotive software development processes, including ASPICE or similar practices.

  • Desirable: experience supporting software across multiple hardware platforms or vehicle programmes.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews (Programming and hiring manager interview; 1.5 hours total)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Systems & domain-specific interviews; 4 hours total)

  • Final interview: Mission & values alignment (30 mins).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

About us

AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase: a small, growing team turning lab setups into a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet.

The role

As Embedded Engineer you own everything between the instrument hardware and our acquisition software. You integrate cameras, frame grabbers, motion controllers, piezo stages, lasers and FPGA timing hardware, and you make them run as one synchronized, reliable scan. The work is hands-on: vendor SDKs, trigger wiring, PCIe cards and lab networks one day, clean driver code and a live data stream to the user interface the next. You work closely with the System, Mechatronics, Application and Algorithm engineers.

What you will do

  • Design the trigger and acquisition architecture that synchronizes camera exposure, stage motion and laser pulses.

  • Integrate industrial cameras and frame grabbers through industry-standard interfaces and vendor SDKs, from driver set-up to stable high-rate acquisition.

  • Integrate motion controllers and positioning stages through vendor APIs and controller scripting, including commissioning and tuning with the Mechatronics Engineer.

  • Develop and extend FPGA-based timing and I/O for triggering and position-synchronized acquisition.

  • Write driver and control layers in C/C++ and Python that the scan and reconstruction software builds on, and expose live status and data streams to the user interface.

  • Own the instrument PC and lab network set-up: PCIe hardware, high-speed Ethernet links between devices, IP planning and device discovery.

  • Bring up and debug hardware in the lab with oscilloscope, logic analyzer and network captures, and document interfaces and timing budgets with the System Engineer.

Your profile

  • MSc in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Applied Physics or a related field.

  • ~5 years of hands-on experience integrating and controlling hardware, preferably in high-tech equipment, scientific instruments or industrial automation.

  • Strong C/C++ and Python, including working with vendor SDKs and drivers on Windows and Linux.

  • Proven experience with hardware triggering and synchronization of multiple devices (cameras, motion, lasers, DAQ).

  • Experience with FPGA development or working closely with FPGA-based timing hardware.

  • Solid grasp of hardware interfaces and networking: Ethernet, USB, serial, PCIe, and multi-device lab networks.

  • Experience with Git and collaborative code review.

  • Full professional proficiency in English.

We value judgment and ownership over a perfect match. If you recognize yourself in most of this, we would like to hear from you.

Bonus

  • Experience with machine-vision cameras, frame grabbers or high-throughput image acquisition.

  • Experience with precision motion controllers and encoder-based position triggering.

  • High-speed data paths to a host PC, SoC FPGAs or Linux driver development.

  • Experience building lightweight web or API layers for instrument control and live data.

  • Background in optics, lasers, coherent imaging, semiconductor metrology or lithography equipment.

  • Experience with CI, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or working in a Scrum team.

What we offer

  • Ownership of the embedded and timing backbone of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet.

  • A small team with short feedback loops and real impact on the product.

  • Hands-on work at the meeting point of hardware, optics and software, on the High Tech Campus Eindhoven.

title: Embedded Software Engineer - SoM
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Embedded Software Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to own the embedded software stack on the compute modules used across our platforms. You will take a new module from bare board to a maintained, securely booting Linux platform, covering the boot chain, kernel, drivers, and the verification around them. This is a high impact role that combines deep Linux and kernel work with hands on bring up on new hardware, taking a board from first power up through to flight.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • BSP and Reference Images: Build and maintain the BSP layer, device trees, and the reference images for each board, including custom layers and SDK generation, and carry them forward across kernel upgrades and silicon revisions.

  • Boot Chain and Secure Boot: Own the boot chain, including bootloader porting, signed boot, verified rootfs, and A/B system update.

  • Drivers and Low Level Interfaces: Develop and validate Linux device drivers across I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, PCIe, and MIPI, including camera and sensor interfaces.

  • Board Support on MCU Targets: Provide startup, clock, and peripheral support on the microcontrollers of boards the team designs.

  • Board Bring Up and Hardware Validation: Lead software bring up on new hardware, take part in design reviews, and debug system level issues across the hardware and software boundary.

  • Verification and Documentation: Define verification test plans and acceptance criteria, automate boot and peripheral test on real targets, and document each milestone.

  • Cross Functional Collaboration: Work with the hardware team on new boards, and with Systems and Embedded Software Platform on interfaces and integration.

  • Mentorship: Depending on seniority, mentor junior embedded engineers.

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

  • Educational Background: MSc in engineering (electrical, computer, or a related field). PhD a plus. A hands on bring up record matters more than the specific degree.

title: Engineering Internship - Deep Learning for Infrared Thermography Antenna Measurements
descriptionHtml:
THE POSITION

ANYFIELDS measures antennas by infrared thermography: a thermosensitive film heated by the radiated field is imaged by an infrared camera, giving a 2D map of the electric field, nonintrusive and very close to the antenna. Two limits remain: the maps are noisy (dynamic range of 25 to 30 dB at best, 35 to 40 dB needed to retrieve side lobes and cross-polarization), and they are blurred by the response of the detector (film and optics), whose resolution is not explained by the theory.

This internship develops physics-driven neural networks, trained without any clean reference, to restore the maps, and compares them rigorously with the conventional methods already implemented.

Missions :

  • Benchmark synthetic and measured datasets, reproduction of the conventional methods (wavelet denoising, drift removal, deconvolution, slanted edge).

  • Estimate PSF of the detector: neural network constrained by the film heat diffusion and the optics, estimated from a few measurements; explain the gap between the theoretical (about 1 mm) and measured (4 to 8 mm) resolution. Compare with conventional methods.

  • Implement Denoising by self-supervised deep denoising of the maps, quantified gain in dB towards 35 to 40 dB, ranking of the limiting factors of the setup.

  • Validate by test whether the imaging resolves the individual elements of array antennas in the Ku and Ka bands, before and after improvement. Report on the retained methods.

You will work at the crossroads of electromagnetics, imaging and deep learning, with the engineers of the Innovation team.

Location: Toulouse (city centre)

Start: As soon as possible

Duration: 6 months

Profile

  • Bac+5 - Engineering school / Master in applied mathematics, signal and image processing, machine learning and/or electromagnetics

  • Programming skills (preferably Python), experience with a deep learning framework

  • Knowledge of inverse problems or infrared cameras is a plus

  • Team spirit, proactive attitude and good communication skills in an interdisciplinary team

At Databricks, we help public institutions use data and AI to improve services, increase productivity, and get more value from public data and technology investment. You will translate national and departmental priorities into measurable customer outcomes and sustainable growth.

Working closely with government stakeholders, internal teams, cloud providers, and strategic partners, you will deepen consumption in existing accounts and extend Databricks' footprint.

Government's hardest missions increasingly require insight across institutional boundaries, without requiring those institutions, their accountability, or their data to be centralised. The opportunity isn't one giant government data system; it's enabling institutions to connect, govern and use data and insight across boundaries while retaining control of their own data, responsibilities and decisions.
