title: Graduate Mechanical Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Hiring now

We are hiring as soon as possible. This role is for someone who has already graduated, or who will complete their degree in time to start with us very soon. We are not able to consider final-year students who graduate in summer 2027 or later, and this is not a graduate scheme with a fixed annual intake.

Role Overview

This is a first full-time engineering role on the NEO-1 satellite. You will design satellite hardware and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised as the design matures, learning from our lead designer and working in a small, multidisciplinary team. You will take ownership of real parts early, translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, such as brackets, panels, component mounts, thermal-control hardware and cable and harness routing, with guidance from the lead designer.

  • Work in the satellite's large 3D CAD assembly alongside the wider design team, learning how to keep interfaces, configurations and revisions in step as several designers work in the same model.

  • Support assembly configuration, PLM data (3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX') or similar), bills of materials and engineering change control (ECO/ECR/ECN), so that models, drawings and interfaces stay consistent as changes are released.

  • Run interference and clash checks and help maintain the digital mock-up, working with each subsystem owner to allocate space and resolve conflicts.

  • Produce dimensioned, manufacturing-ready drawings using GD&T, with review from senior engineers.

  • Support design reviews (PDR and CDR) and qualification, working with structural and thermal engineers.

  • Work with manufacturers and suppliers to make designs easier to build, and to balance cost, mass and reliability.

  • Support prototype builds, integration and environmental test campaigns, iterating designs based on results.

  • Collaborate with electrical, software, systems and thermal engineers to integrate mechanical components into the satellite platform.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical, aerospace or a related engineering discipline, completed or completing very soon.

  • Hands-on 3D CAD skills from university projects, a placement or an internship (SolidWorks preferred; CATIA, NX or Creo also considered).

  • Working knowledge of GD&T and experience producing engineering drawings, including from coursework or a team project.

  • Solid grounding in mechanical design principles, materials and thermal management, with a working understanding of structural mechanics.

title: Growth Lead - Performance Marketing
descriptionHtml:
About Plasma

Plasma is building the primary account for global money.

Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.

Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy.

Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move.

The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built.


The Team & Our Story

We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.

We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means.

The role

  • Own the cost of acquisition of valuable users and managing our paid advertising motion end to end.

  • Deploy many variations of ads, platforms and angles to test high performing creative and formats driving users into both custom funnels and direct to app while measuring downstream events.

  • Take us beyond our crypto-native audience. Find the audiences, messages and formats on Meta, Google, TikTok and YouTube that bring in people who fund and keep spending, then scale the ones that work.

  • Run the campaigns yourself. You build them, launch them, read the results and decide where tomorrow's budget goes. New creative, new audiences and new angles every week, with a clear read on what worked and why.

  • Look past the click. Work with product and design on landing pages, onboarding, lifecycle and referrals so a new sign-up becomes a funded account and a regular user.

  • Build the paid function. The tracking, reporting and playbooks you set up become what the team runs on, and as channels prove out you help hire the specialists who scale them.

The Bar

  • Regional market expertise. You know how to work on an acquisition strategy that differs between countries and markets

  • Deep, hands-on experience running paid acquisition at a consumer app or fintech, especially paid social and search, with real budgets and real accountability for the outcome.

  • Understand how to navigate Meta AEM, Google optimization, Apple search ads, Snapchat and other platforms, configure Appsflyer, our data warehouse and creative to achieve exceptional results.

  • A track record of structured creative testing and confident budget allocation across channels.

  • Strong measurement skills. You know attribution, incrementality and cohort analysis, and where each one can mislead you.

  • Range across the funnel. You have improved landing pages, onboarding, lifecycle or referrals, working closely with product and design.

  • Resourceful. You find a way to get the answer or the result, with or without a big team behind you. Based in London or ready to relocate.

Nice to have

  • You know your way around mobile measurement partners such as AppsFlyer or Adjust, and the ad policies that come with financial products.

What's in it for you

  • Premium health insurance for you and your family, fully covered by Plasma.

  • Real ownership and responsibility from day one, with your work shipping to hundreds of thousands of people, moving millions of dollars every day.

We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Any personal information you provide during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable local data protection laws.

title: Growth Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
Growth Marketing Manager

Retire the ERP

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers - automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Fuse Energy.

We're an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you're excited to modernise how companies run money, you're in the right place.

Backed by world-class investors including Balderton and Atomico and advised by industry titans, we're building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes. Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

Finance deserves better

Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, market or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled.

Light gives them a way out.

We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one:

  • Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one.

  • Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting.

  • Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter.

We take on the ERP and the legacy point solution world with something fast to implement, AI-native from the ground up, and better the more you use it.

Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée, and teams across Copenhagen, London and Stockholm, with remotes world over.

The Role

We're looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to join our growth team and open up the channels we haven't really touched yet.

We've built a lean, efficient demand generation engine on the core paid channels you'd expect at a Series A B2B company, with Google Ads and LinkedIn doing the heavy lifting. It works, and it fills our pipeline every month. Now we want to find the next sources of pipeline, and we need someone who knows how to build them from scratch.

You'll work alongside our Senior Growth Marketing Manager, VP Marketing and the wider marketing team, with the freedom to test, learn and scale the channels that move the number. You'll sit close to sales, product and design, and you'll own the results of everything you launch.

We may hire more than one person through this process, so if you go deep on some of these channels rather than all of them, we still want to hear from you.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Building a referral programme that turns happy customers, partners and finance leaders into a steady source of pipeline.

  • Running G2 and Capterra campaigns that put Light in front of buyers at the moment they compare options, and turning our reviews into proof across every channel.

  • Launching and scaling Meta Ads for B2B, testing creative and audiences until you find what drives qualified pipeline.

  • Finding the creators and influencers finance teams follow, writing briefs that land and scaling their content into campaigns that drive pipeline.

  • Growing our presence across search and AI answer engines, so that when a finance leader asks Google or ChatGPT about ERP alternatives, Light shows up.

  • Setting up measurement for each new channel with RevOps, so we know what every dollar returns.

  • Sharing what you learn with the team, doubling down on what works and cutting what doesn't.

What We Think* You'll Need

  • Enough years in growth to know how to take a channel from zero to pipeline at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company.

  • Hands-on experience across referrals, review sites, Meta Ads, influencer marketing or SEO and GEO. We don't expect you to master all five, so show us where you go deep.

  • A test-and-learn mindset, with the discipline to measure every experiment against pipeline and revenue.

  • Comfort with numbers and tools, from ad platforms to HubSpot to spreadsheets.

  • An eye for creative and a feel for what makes finance people stop scrolling.

  • Deep curiosity about how AI is reshaping marketing, finance and the companies we serve.

  • A can-do, empathetic and collaborative spirit. No brilliant assholes here, please.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don't tick every box, we'd still love for you to reach out and convince us you're the right person.

The Good Stuff

  • A five-day, in-office culture with a high-density team in Copenhagen.

  • A competitive salary and potential stock options.

  • 25 days of annual leave plus public holidays in the country where you're based.

  • Regular socials and two company offsites a year.

  • The chance to build new growth channels from the ground up at a company defining a new category.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

The Famous Last Words

We've proven the core of our growth engine works. Now we want to see how far it can go, and we want you to build the parts we haven't tried yet. If you love starting channels from scratch and watching them turn into pipeline, let's talk.

title: Hardware Design Senior Manager
descriptionHtml:
Hardware Design Senior Manager 

Bristol, UK

About the job

Lead the engineers behind the power, timing and control circuits that make Graphcore’s AI compute hardware work.

Your team’s schematics, component choices and electrical constraints will give PCB layout engineers complete inputs for implementing each design. You’ll help test and manufacturing teams understand expected behaviour, resolve circuit issues and take hardware through to production.

You’ll line-manage engineers, coach their development and agree achievable commitments, matching the work to available capacity. You’ll coordinate reviews and investigations, ensure corrective actions reach closure and plan ahead for tools, licences and compute resources.

Grow your leadership across the hardware lifecycle, drawing on specialist expertise rather than becoming the technical authority for every circuit. Build a more autonomous team whose methods and shared knowledge improve how Graphcore develops its next generation of hardware.

The team and culture

You’ll connect Hardware Design with SI/PI, PCB layout, mechanical, thermal, systems and firmware engineers across locations. Programme management owns the integrated plan; you’ll flag competing priorities early and bring practical options for resolving them.

Technical owners help agree operating conditions, margins and acceptance criteria. You’ll encourage engineers to challenge assumptions, using evidence and specialist advice to resolve difficult trade-offs.

What we’re looking for

  • People leadership that develops engineers, delegates effectively and addresses difficult performance issues, with readiness for formal line management.
  • Experience coordinating engineering delivery with programme management, including estimates, work allocation, dependencies and capacity, with sound judgement under schedule pressure.
  • Communication that builds relationships across disciplines and locations, resolves competing expectations and secures decisions by explaining risks and trade-offs.
  • A strong hardware engineering background spanning circuit and schematic development, board implementation, verification and production transition. An engineering degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Understanding of power supplies, sequencing, reset, clocks, digital interfaces and SI/PI constraints, with judgement about when specialist input is needed.
  • Experience organising technical reviews, maintaining traceable design records and ensuring investigations and corrective actions reach a clear conclusion.

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.

Benefits

· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
· Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover
· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

Sponsorship

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.

Join the Team at Graphcore

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.

Ready to lead the engineers shaping Graphcore’s AI compute hardware? Apply for the Hardware Design Team Lead role in Bristol.

title: Head of Brand/Content H/F
descriptionHtml:
Make Sense, aujourd'hui c'est +23 000 abonnés sur LinkedIn, 8 000 sur YouTube et un positionnement différenciant sur le marché des agences marketing.

L'objectif est de faire de Make Sense et de ses dirigeants une référence visible, désirable et incontournable sur le marché, en transformant l'agence en véritable « "media company" autour d'un point de vue fort et de preuves clients massives.

Le Head of Brand est l'architecte et l'orchestrateur de la brand (corporate + personal brands des founders), pas juste un "content manager". Il s'assure que chaque contenu, chaque touchpoint, chaque cas client renforce le positionnement Make Sense.

Vos missions

Mission principale

À 12 mois, construire et piloter un système de brand et de contenu qui :

- positionne Make Sense comme la référence des agences d'acquisition payante pour e-commerçants ambitieux,

- installe les dirigeants comme figures d'autorité sur le sujet,

- génère une demande inbound qualifiée et récurrente,

- crée de la préférence de marque et de la confiance avant même le premier call.

Cette mission s'inscrit dans un objectif à plus long terme (24-36 mois) : faire de Make Sense l'agence de performance marketing de référence en France.

Reporting & périmètre

Reporte à Maxence CEO / Founder.

Collabore étroitement avec : Senior Strategist, Sales, équipe externe (montage, graphisme).

Make Sense est une agence pilotée par son fondateur : Maxence reste le décisionnaire final sur les grands choix de marque et de positionnement. Le rôle du Head of Brand est de nourrir sa réflexion, de la challenger avec des arguments solides, et de transformer ses convictions en système de marque et de contenu qui tourne. Autonomie totale attendu sur l'exécution et la mise en place.

Objectifs & livrables

À 15 jours :

- Connaître sur le bout des doigts les offres de l'agence.

- Être capable de positionner Make Sense au sein de son environnement concurrentiel et de son marché.

À 1 mois :

- Une routine de contenus mise en place et qui commence à se roder.

- Une première capacité d'analyse des impacts (vues, engagement, retours) pour ajuster la stratégie.

À 3 mois :

- Une proposition structurée, construite pour atteindre les objectifs à 12 mois, avec une feuille de route priorisée et des premiers arbitrages.

- Un calendrier éditorial structuré à 90 jours, mis à jour en rolling.

À 12 mois :

- Une machine de contenu corporate + founder-led qui tourne et une cadence tenue sur l'année avec la capacité à scaler la production sans brûler les founders.

- Des process de production et de distribution documentés, et une équipe média externe qui exécute sans friction avec un Minimum Viable Squad brand/media structuré (pool de freelances ou éventuels internes) dont les rôles sont clairs.

- Une croissance claire des indicateurs brand : vues, reach qualifié, abonnés sur les bons canaux, trafic direct / branded search.

- Une croissance du volume de leads inbound qualifiés issus des contenus.

- Des feedbacks marché tangibles sur les calls de vente (« je vous suis depuis X mois », « j'ai vu telle étude de cas »).

Activités clés au quotidien

- Traduire les objectifs business en roadmap brand & contenu.

- Réaliser et faire valider les créas et contenus (idées, scripts, tournages, montages, posts).

- Travailler main dans la main avec les founders pour extraire les idées, les frameworks, les prises de position.

- Prioriser les sujets et campagnes qui créent le plus de levier business et brand.

- Suivre les chiffres brand & inbound, ajuster les stratégies et formats.

- Garantir la cohérence : chaque output doit ressembler à « Make Sense », pas à n'importe quelle agence.

Vos compétences

Profil recherché

Expérience

- 5 à 8 ans d'expérience en brand / content / media, idéalement en agence (RP, social, growth, création) plutôt qu'en grand groupe pour être à l'aise dans une structure où tout va vite et où les rôles ne sont pas cloisonnés.

- Expérience significative en BtoB, ou en environnement mixte BtoB/BtoC avec une vraie culture business.

- Idéalement, une expérience de personal branding ou d'accompagnement de dirigeants sur leur prise de parole (LinkedIn, contenu, storytelling).

- A déjà construit ou contribué à un programme de contenu structuré (pas seulement géré des réseaux sociaux au fil de l'eau).

- A déjà structuré et managé une petite équipe interne ou de freelances

Mindset

- Stratégique et tactique : voit la brand comme un levier business.

- À l'aise avec des dirigeants très visibles, capable de les challenger sans jamais lisser ou aseptiser leur discours.

- Orienté résultats.

Compétences « hard »

- Excellente compréhension du branding B2B / agence / service premium.

- Solide culture contenu (YouTube, LinkedIn, podcasts, storytelling, formats qui convertissent en confiance).

- Capacité à bâtir et piloter un système de production de contenus.

- Bon niveau en copywriting.

- Capacité à briefer et diriger des créatifs (vidéo, design, etc.).

- À l'aise avec les chiffres : sait définir et suivre les bons KPIs.

Culture fit

- Parle le langage business : comprend MRR, marge, LTV, CPA, etc.

- Communique clairement, sait dire non aux idées qui diluent la brand.

- Relie systématiquement ses choix créatifs et éditoriaux à des objectifs business (pas de contenu pour le contenu, pas de branding pour l'esthétique).

- Capable de travailler dans un environnement exigeant, avec des décisions qui se prennent vite et un fondateur impliqué.

- Connaît et suit Alex Hormozi : l'agence est structurée autour de la méthode VAM (Value Acceleration Method), qui nous accompagne depuis 2024 et qui structure notre feuille de route business.

- Style : direct, concret, orienté action, mais capable de profondeur sur le thinking.

Avantages

Les conditions :

- CDI - Cadre 37,5h

- Basé en métropole lilloise (Bondues) avec télétravail

- Salaire fixe + variable déplafonné

- Tickets restaurant, mutuelle et prévoyance pris en charge à 100 %

title: Head of Compliance and Risk (UK)
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

BJAK is Southeast Asia’s largest digital insurance platform, expanding financial access through automation, data, and digital scale. As we grow across markets, we are committed to building a platform that is safe, compliant, and trusted.

We are hiring a Head of Compliance and Risk (UK) to lead regulatory strategy, risk governance, and compliance operations for our UK market entry and expansion alongside the CEO. This role is expected to hold the SMF16 (Compliance Oversight) Senior Management Function once approved, and will act as our primary point of contact with the FCA.

This is a build role: you'll be creating frameworks, policies, and controls from scratch rather than inheriting an existing function.

 

Why This Role Matters

The Head of Compliance and Risk (UK) will:

  • Design and enforce compliance frameworks that enable safe scaling of digital financial services.

  • Ensure BJAK operates in accordance with UK regulatory standards, especially FCA requirements.

  • Protect consumers through transparent, fair, and ethical practices.

  • Establish BJAK as a trusted partner with regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.

  • Build compliance capability and culture across the company.

 

What You Will Do

Regulatory Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements.

  • Lead regulatory readiness for market entry, licensing, and ongoing supervision.

  • Serve as the primary contact with the FCA and relevant UK bodies.

  • Interpret regulatory changes and guide business strategy accordingly.

 

Risk Governance & Compliance Operations

  • Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance.

  • Conduct risk assessments and implement remediation plans for identified gaps.

  • Establish monitoring, testing, and reporting processes for ongoing compliance.

  • Ensure internal audits, compliance reviews, and control testing are operationalised.

 

Consumer Protection & Business Integrity

  • Embed fairness, transparency, and responsible selling throughout the organisation.

  • Oversee product compliance, marketing reviews, pricing governance, and distribution oversight.

  • Implement complaint handling frameworks aligned with regulatory standards.

 

Cross-Functional Support & Training

  • Partner with product, operations, legal, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure compliant execution.

  • Provide guidance on regulatory implications of new products, partnerships, or distribution models.

  • Deliver training to ensure teams understand and execute compliance responsibilities.

 

You Will Thrive in This Role If You

  • See compliance as a strategic enabler, not a blocker.

  • Operate with high integrity, sound judgment, and strong attention to detail.

  • Communicate clearly and influence leaders using data and logic.

  • Enjoy building frameworks and scaling systems from early-stage to mature environments.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, evolving settings where regulation meets innovation.

 

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of compliance, risk, or regulatory experience within financial services, insurance, insurtech, or fintech.

  • Deep understanding of UK regulatory frameworks, including FCA rules and consumer duty requirements.

  • Experience in compliance for digital platforms, distribution, or insurance products (preferred).

  • Proven ability to design policies, conduct risk assessments, and manage complex compliance programs.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including dealing with regulators.

 

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in start-up or high-growth environments.

  • Previous SMF experience.

  • Background in insurtech, digital distribution, or online marketplaces.

  • Knowledge of GDPR, AML, sanctions, or cross-border compliance.

 

Location Requirement

  • This role is based in the UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week.

 

Why Join Us

  • Shape compliance for a fast-growing international fintech-insurtech platform.

  • Build frameworks that enable safe, inclusive financial access at scale.

  • Work closely with leadership and regulators to drive responsible innovation.

  • Competitive compensation with long-term growth and international career opportunities.


Compensations Range

  • We offer a highly competitive package, ranging from £100,000 to £150,000, reflecting both experience and suitability for this pivotal role.

title: Head of Operations (GPU Fleet)
descriptionHtml:
Your mission

Demand for sovereign European compute is not our constraint. Capacity is. As Head of Operations you own Lyceum's GPU fleet end to end: every GPU we own, lease or operate for partners, from the first conversation with a data center to the day a node goes live and every day it runs after that.

The job has two halves. Grow the fleet: turn new financing into live GPUs, fast. Run the fleet: keep everything we operate available, efficient and under contract. Your north star is GPUs under management. You report directly to the CEO and work closely with the CFO, CTO and engineering. Depending on experience, we hire this role at Head or VP level.

What You'll Do

  • Secure data center capacity across Europe: power, liquid cooling, space, connectivity and colocation leases

  • Own relationships with OEMs and suppliers for servers, networking and storage, and manage lead times so hardware arrives when we need it

  • Run every deployment as a programme, from logistics and installation to burn-in, acceptance and handover to engineering

  • Keep the financing side of deployments clean: schedules, drawdown milestones, asset records, insurance and lender reporting

  • Run the live fleet together with engineering: availability, incidents, RMAs, warranty, spares and remote hands

  • Own supply-side contracts, renewals and SLAs, and drive down cost per GPU-hour

  • Build the operations team and the operating rhythm that lets us scale deployments without scaling chaos

 

Your profile

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of bringing physical infrastructure online at scale, ideally data centers, GPU or HPC clusters, or comparable hardware-heavy environments

  • You have owned the whole picture, from capacity and suppliers to deployment and live operations, not one slice of it

  • Exceptional analytical and strategic thinking. You see the whole board, from site selection to unit economics

title: Head of Technical Support
descriptionHtml:
📍 London (Hybrid — 2 days onsite)

🕒 Permanent | Start ASAP

 

We’re Making Travel Effortless. Join Us.

Travel is essential, whether it’s visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career defining trip. Yet today, over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades.

At Duffel, we’re rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we’re simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel

About the role

As Head of Technical Support, you’ll lead our team of Technical Support Engineers and take responsibility for the quality, effectiveness and development of the function.

You’ll build a team that combines strong technical investigation with clear, thoughtful customer communication. You’ll coach engineers, establish effective ways of working and ensure customers receive dependable support as their integrations grow in complexity and scale.

You’ll stay close to the work: reviewing investigations, helping with significant escalations and understanding where our products or processes create friction. Your impact will come from strengthening the whole team’s ability to resolve problems and turning what we learn from support into lasting improvements.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, Partner Engineering, Partner Management and Travel Operations. Technical Support owns day-to-day API questions, troubleshooting and the customer support response to technical incidents. Partner Engineers own strategic technical relationships and solution architecture; Implementation Managers own implementation programmes.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop the team. Set clear expectations, provide regular coaching and feedback, support career development and address performance issues constructively. Hire and onboard engineers as the team grows.

  • Own support quality. Establish standards for technical investigation, written communication, case ownership and follow-through. Ensure customers understand what is happening, what comes next and who is responsible.

  • Build a dependable support operation. Improve triage, prioritisation, queue management, handovers and escalation paths. Plan staffing and coverage around customer needs and agreed service commitments, with a sustainable workload for the team.

  • Strengthen technical capability. Help engineers investigate API behaviour, interpret logs and request traces, reproduce integration issues and distinguish customer configuration problems from platform or supplier issues.

  • Lead significant customer escalations. Coordinate the support response, establish customer impact and keep communication clear through to resolution. Work with Engineering on diagnosis and recovery, involving Partner Engineering where an issue creates a wider strategic risk.

  • Make collaboration effective. Give Engineering actionable escalation reports with evidence, reproduction steps and impact. Work with Travel Operations on booking and supplier issues, and with implementation teams to ensure new integrations enter support with the context the team needs.

  • Improve the product through support. Identify recurring problems and turn them into clear recommendations for Product and Engineering. Track whether fixes, documentation and product changes actually reduce customer friction.

  • Make support easier to deliver. Develop troubleshooting guides, internal knowledge, customer documentation and useful tooling. Apply automation and AI where they improve accuracy, speed and access to help.

  • Use evidence to guide decisions. Monitor response and resolution performance, ageing work, reopened cases, customer feedback and team capacity. Use that information to prioritise improvements and make clear recommendations about investment.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience managing and developing a technical support or support engineering team serving business customers.

  • A track record of improving both customer outcomes and how a support function operates.

  • Strong technical understanding of APIs, HTTP, authentication, webhooks and integrations, with enough practical depth to guide investigations and earn the trust of engineers.

  • Comfort working with logs, SQL and scripts to investigate problems or improve support workflows.

  • Experience handling consequential customer escalations, including situations where the cause or resolution is initially uncertain.

  • Ability to explain technical issues to developers, business stakeholders and senior leaders.

  • Sound judgement about urgency, customer impact and competing priorities.

  • Evidence of effective hiring, coaching, performance management and delegation.

  • The ability to influence Product, Engineering and commercial teams through clear reasoning and useful evidence.

  • Comfort building and improving a function in a growing company, while remaining involved in its day-to-day work.

Experience that would be useful

  • Supporting an API platform, developer product or infrastructure business.

  • Working with enterprise customers running important production integrations.

  • Leading support across different time zones.

  • Improving support tooling, knowledge management, self-service or automation.

  • Experience in travel technology, payments or another industry with complex external dependencies.

You don’t need to have worked in travel or held this exact title. We’re interested in the teams you’ve developed, the problems you’ve solved and the judgement you bring.

What success looks like

During your first six months:

  • Engineers have clear expectations, regular coaching and practical development plans.

  • Customer issues have clear ownership, appropriate prioritisation and dependable communication.

  • You have established a trustworthy baseline for support performance and delivered measurable improvements in the most important areas.

  • Escalations reach the right teams with better evidence and fewer unnecessary handovers.

  • Recurring problems are being addressed through product changes, documentation or tooling.

  • Duffel has a clear plan for the support capacity and capabilities needed as the business grows.

Why You’ll Love Working at Duffel

We believe in true ownership. That’s why every permanent employee gets equity in the business.

title: HR Stagiaire
descriptionHtml:
Draag bij aan onze missie Creating A Climate For Growth en word de nieuwe Stagiair(e) HR bij Priva! Ben jij enthousiast, leergierig en zelfstandig en op dit moment bezig met een opleiding in de richting van Human Resource Management? Dan zijn wij een match!

Wat ga je doen?

Als HR stagiair(e) bij Priva kom je terecht in een enthousiast HR team, bestaande uit HR Business Partners, Recruiters, HR Officers en een HR Assistant. We zijn een ambitieus team waarin we houden van hard werken, maar waar ook ruimte is voor een geintje of een goed gesprek. Tijdens jouw stage draai je volledig mee in het voorbijkomend HR werk en helpen wij je graag in het ontwikkelen van je competenties en de mogelijke schoolopdrachten. Je kunt hierbij denken aan:

  • Assisteren bij gegevensinvoer en HR assistenten taken in AFAS

  • Organiseren en bijhouden van personeelsdossier

  • Vragen van collega’s verwerken

  • Ondersteunen bij het organiseren van de onboardingdag

  • Meelopen met HR-professionals

  • Ondersteunen bij diverse HR projecten

Wie zijn wij?

Wij zijn Priva! Priva is een familiebedrijf, gevestigd in het Westland. Het is de missie van Priva om een ​​optimale omgeving te creëren waarin zowel planten als mensen kunnen werken, groeien en zich ontwikkelen. Wij bieden wereldwijde oplossingen voor de tuinbouw, gebouwautomatisering en alles daartussenin. Wij zijn toonaangevend in de ontwikkeling en productie van technologie voor het optimaliseren van omgevingsomstandigheden en processen.

Onze ambitie is om bekend te staan ​​als de toonaangevende technologie- en dienstverlener voor duurzame stedelijke delta's. We zijn er trots op dat onze oplossingen resulteren in een lager verbruik van natuurlijke hulpbronnen, zoals energie en water. Om onze missie en ambitie waar te maken, zijn we op zoek naar toegewijde collega's. We zijn er trots op dat we met ruim 500 collega's, in 16 internationale vestigingen verdeeld over 12 landen samen met meer dan 400 internationale installatiepartners werken aan het leveren van onze duurzame oplossingen en diensten in meer dan 100 landen.


Wie ben jij?

Wij zijn opzoek naar een enthousiaste derde- of vierdejaars stagiair die graag ervaring op wilt doen in HR. Bij voorkeur volg je de HBO-opleiding Human Resource Management, maar ook studenten van andere opleidingen waarbij HR een onderdeel is zijn welkom. Je bent proactief, nauwkeurig, communicatief vaardig en betrokken bij het team en je collega’s binnen Priva. Ook vind je het geen probleem om met internationale collega’s in het Engels te communiceren zowel schriftelijk als mondeling. Voor deze stage verwachten we dat je 24 tot 40 uur per week beschikbaar bent.

Wat je krijgt

  • Een uitdagende stage waarin je jezelf kunt ontwikkelen en waardevolle praktijkervaring opdoet.

  • Een passende stagevergoeding!

  • Bedrijfsrestaurant tegen betaalbare prijzen, gratis fruit en lekkere koffie in The Hub.

  • Een actieve personeelsvereniging & vitaliteitsteam met PrivaFit! workshops waaraan je deel kan nemen.

  • Toegang tot onze gratis fitnessfaciliteiten op locatie, waar je kunt meedoen aan Crossfit-, Pilates-, Yoga- en Full Body Workout of speel een potje tafelvoetbal en tafeltennis mee.

Solliciteren

Lijkt het je interessant om bij Priva stage te lopen? Solliciteer dan direct of neem contact met ons op voor meer informatie. We vertellen je graag meer over ons, onze visie en toekomst.

title: IAM Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
As an IAM Software Engineer, you’ll focus on Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions. Your work combines technical analysis, platform configuration, low-code implementation, integration, testing, and troubleshooting, with custom coding where needed. You’ll work closely with engineers, architects, consultants, and customer teams to deliver secure, reliable solutions. 

You’ll join an engineering delivery team of around 8–12 people, working across customer assignments in two-week sprints, often with a specific sprint focus. Our ‘you build it, you run it’ approach combines implementation, ongoing improvement, and troubleshooting after delivery, supported by senior engineers in your own and neighbouring teams doing similar work. 

What you’ll do as an IAM Software Engineer 

  • Design and deliver IGA solutions that help customers govern access, using standard platform capabilities, low-code tools, and integration standards, with C#, SQL, and APIs where needed. 
  • Translate customer needs into technical designs and engineering tasks, working with architects, security engineers, and customer stakeholders to meet security, compliance, scalability, and maintainability requirements. 
  • Troubleshoot complex IAM issues, identify root causes, and implement lasting improvements that reduce recurrence and security risk. 
  • Improve automation and delivery practices, using PowerShell and CI/CD where appropriate to make implementation and ongoing changes more reliable. 
  • Share knowledge and support junior engineers through mentoring, design sessions, and reviews of configurations, integrations, and code. 

The impact you’ll have 

Your engineering work will help leading organizations manage access confidently, protect sensitive data, and comply with evolving regulations. By building reliable IAM solutions and improving delivery practices, you’ll contribute to technical strategy and help the team deliver more effectively—strengthening client security and trust in the digital landscape. 

What we can offer you 

Autonomy in your work and support for your career development. 

  • Permanent, full-time contract (40 hours per week) 
  • Flexible, hybrid working: typically two days per week on location—one at a client site and one at our Waardenburg office. 
  • Work outside normal hours is rare (currently fewer than five occasions per year) and always discussed in advance. 
  • Typically, 5–15 learning days per year for your development, including certifications and events. Training and associated costs are agreed individually rather than through a fixed training budget. 
  • 30 days of annual leave: 25 flexible days and 5 fixed company days. 
  • Variable team bonus and annual profit distribution 
  • Mobility budget or company lease car 
  • Private pension scheme 
  • Home office setup budget and monthly remote work allowance 
  • Regular team and company social events 

What you’ll bring to the team 

Core experience and skills 

  • 3–6 years in software or platform engineering, including at least one year designing and implementing IGA solutions such as Omada Identity or Microsoft Entra ID Governance. 
  • Experience in solution design, configuration, API integration, testing, and deployment, using Git and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps). 
  • Practical C# and SQL experience to troubleshoot and extend IAM solutions where needed. 
  • Strong analytical, design, and problem-solving skills, with a deep understanding of software security and the ability to turn security and compliance requirements into practical solutions. 
  • A relevant bachelor’s degree (e.g., computer science or information security), or equivalent experience. 

How you work 

  • Strong collaboration, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with a structured, proactive approach and the ability to drive work independently. 

Practical requirements 

  • English at C1 and Dutch at B2 or higher, written and spoken. 
  • Client-site travel is within the Netherlands, with current major clients in the Randstad. You’re able and willing to travel to those sites and our Waardenburg office; no driver’s license is required. 
  • Currently residing in the Netherlands and eligible to work here. 

Nice to have 

  • Azure experience. 
  • AI-assisted tools for analysis, configuration, testing, documentation, or coding. 
  • Relevant certifications, e.g., Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Omada Certified Engineer, or CISSP. 

About SITS | Traxion 

SITS | Traxion specializes in Identity & Access Management, with 24 years of consulting experience and a team of 120 specialists. We work with organizations across sectors, including Schiphol Group, dsm-firmenich, Gemeente Rotterdam, Belastingdienst, E.ON, and Ayvens. 

As part of the European IT security group SITS, we combine international collaboration with a flat organizational structure and a respectful, collaborative culture. 

Ready to make an impact and secure Europe’s digital identities? Apply today!
Interested but have questions before applying? Contact to learn more about the role and whether it matches your experience. 

At SITS | Traxion, we believe diversity strengthens our teams and fosters innovation. We are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender, background, or experience, can thrive.

descriptionHtml:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Alta Ares recrute un technicien réglementation drones pour appuyer le responsable sécurité des vols. Il prendra en charge les dossiers réglementaires (SORA, PPDRA) et la conformité des opérations et des sites de vol.

Missions

Dossiers réglementaires : rédiger et suivre les demandes d’autorisation en catégorie spécifique (SORA, PPDRA, déclarations STS), préparer les dossiers d’accès à l’espace aérien et les protocoles avec les gestionnaires d’aérodromes, tenir à jour le MANEX et les procédures.

Veille réglementaire : suivre les évolutions EASA (règlements (UE) 2019/947 et 2019/945) et françaises, évaluer leur impact sur nos opérations et proposer les adaptations.

Relation avec les autorités : être l’interlocuteur opérationnel de la DGAC/DSAC sur le suivi des dossiers, préparer les audits et les contrôles pour le management AA ainsi que les visites sur lieu de vol.

Conformité des vols : réaliser des contrôles de conformité lors des vols avec le responsable sécurité, vérifier la documentation (qualifications des télépilotes, enregistrement des aéronefs, autorisations, assurances) et contribuer à l’analyse des incidents ainsi qu'à l'amélioration des procédures.

Sites de vol : visiter les aérodromes et les centres d’essais en vol, vérifier leur conformité et leur adéquation à nos besoins, et rédiger un rapport de visite.



Candidate Profile

  • Bac+2 à Bac+5 en aéronautique, en réglementation aérienne ou équivalent

  • Maîtrise de la SORA et de la rédaction de PPDRA, avec des dossiers déjà déposés

  • Connaissance de tout le cadre EASA drones (catégories ouverte, spécifique et certifiée, STS, LUC)

  • Connaissance de l’écosystème DGAC/DSAC

  • Bonnes notions d’espace aérien et de coordination avec les gestionnaires d’aérodromes

  • Anglais professionnel

  • Rigueur, qualité rédactionnelle, autonomie, aisance relationnelle, goût du terrain

Nice to have

  • Connaissance de la réglementation des aéronefs d’État (DSAÉ)

  • Brevet de télépilote ou expérience opérationnelle de vol

  • Expérience dans le secteur de la Défense

Mandatory

  • Déplacements fréquents sur les sites d’essais et les aérodromes, permis B indispensable

  • Présence sur les sites de vols, parfois en horaires décalés ou sur plusieurs jours

title: Internship: Explainable AI for the qualification of aerospace algorithms
descriptionHtml:
Background

Machine learning is increasingly used in aerospace for tasks that have traditionally relied on human experts or on fixed rule-based procedures. For such tasks, data-driven algorithms promise gains in speed, consistency and sensitivity. Before they can be used in practice however, they must be qualified, which means it has to be demonstrated with sufficient substantiation that the algorithm performs its intended function reliably within a defined set of conditions. The qualification approaches used in the sector today were developed for human operators and for conventional systems whose behaviour can be traced back to explicit requirements. They do not translate directly to algorithms whose behaviour is learned from data, and emerging guidance from aviation authorities names explainability as a key ingredient of trustworthy AI, while leaving open how it should be demonstrated in practice.

Performance figures on a test set do not show why an algorithm reaches a decision, whether it relies on physically meaningful information, or how it behaves outside the data it was trained on. Explainable machine learning offers a wide range of methods to address this, from feature attribution and saliency methods, to example-based and concept-based explanations, but it is still an open question which of these can provide evidence that is strong enough to support qualification. This project therefore investigates how explainability methods can contribute to the qualification of machine learning algorithms for aerospace, starting from an use case, and provides a comparative assessment of several methods.

Assignment

The assignment will include the following tasks:

  • A literature study on the qualification of machine learning algorithms in safety-critical sectors and on explainability methods for machine learning (e.g., attribution and saliency methods, example-based and concept-based explanations, interpretable models, uncertainty quantification), including the ways in which explanations themselves are evaluated.

  • A use case provided by NLR, for instance automated defect detection, and identification of the substantiation needed to qualify the algorithm, translated into criteria that explanations should meet.

  • Implementing several explainability methods for the use case and analysing them against these criteria, for example their faithfulness to the model, their robustness and their usefulness to domain experts.

  • Assessing how the resulting explanations can serve as evidence in the qualification of the algorithm, and formulating recommendations for the use of explainability in qualification.

Results

The final outcomes of this assignment will be:

§ A structured assessment, as part of a literature study, of explainability methods for machine learning and their suitability for qualification in aerospace, together with a justified selection of the use case.

§ An implementation and comparative evaluation of several explainability methods on the selected use case, with recommendations on how explainability can support the qualification of the algorithm.

§ A technical report, either an MSc thesis following the guidelines of your faculty or an internship report, describing the approach, results, and conclusions of the work.

Duration

For an MSc thesis, the standard duration of a thesis at your faculty applies (typically 9 months). For an internship, the duration is 6 months.

Profile

  • You are an MSc student in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics or a similar master.

  • You have a strong background in machine learning, preferably deep learning. Knowledge of explainable AI is a plus.

  • You have experience with programming in Python and with machine learning libraries, for instance PyTorch or scikit-learn.

  • You have an affinity with aerospace, inspection or certification, and are motivated to bring machine learning closer to qualified use in practice.

What we offer

  • A challenging graduation project/internship in a high-tech result orientated work environment

  • Weekly supervision and availability of the technical staff for support

  • An internship allowance

  • Working in an actual R&D project as part of the team

  • Internship results to be used in the current and future projects

About NLR

Royal NLR has been the ambitious research organisation with the will to keep innovating for over 100 years. With that drive, we make the world of transportation safer, more sustainable, more efficient and more effective. We are on the threshold of breakthrough innovations. Plans and ideas start to move when these are fed with the right energy. Over 800 driven professionals work on research and innovation, from aircraft engineers to psychologists and from mathematicians to application experts. Our colleagues are happy to tell you what it's like to work at NLR. This assignment will be managed by the Avionics Systems and Maintenance Engineering (ASAM) department.

Interested?

Submit your application via the NLR portal, together with your (i) Motivation letter and (ii) CV and we will contact you as soon as possible. For more information about the assignment contact Alex Hurd (

title: IT Ops
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

As Dust's first full time IT Ops hire in Paris, you'll own the infrastructure that keeps a fast-growing team running: from devices and access management to the systems and security practices that scale with us. This is a foundational role at a company where AI is woven into every workflow, giving you a front-row seat to how the future of work is actually being built. You'll work directly with the team and have real impact from day one.

What you'll do

Own Device & Endpoint Management

  • Provision, configure, and manage all employee hardware (Mac and Linux) across the Paris team

  • Maintain MDM tooling and ensure all devices meet security and compliance standards

  • Build and document onboarding/offboarding hardware workflows

Manage Identity & Access

  • Own IAM across SSO, Google Workspace, and third-party SaaS tools

  • Ensure access controls are current, auditable, and correctly scoped

  • Partner with the team to implement least-privilege access policies

Keep the Office Running

  • Manage AV, networking, and physical infrastructure at the Paris office

  • Be the first point of contact for IT issues — resolving quickly and building self-serve resources to reduce recurring requests

  • Coordinate with vendors and manage hardware inventory

Drive Security & Compliance

  • Support internal security reviews, audits, and compliance initiatives

  • Identify risks proactively and propose practical mitigations

  • Maintain IT documentation that stays accurate and useful

Build IT Systems That Scale

  • Automate repetitive processes and reduce manual IT overhead

  • Evaluate and implement new tools as the team grows

  • Contribute to IT roadmap planning alongside the Ops and Engineering teams

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

Aptitude

  • Hands-on experience managing macOS and Linux endpoints in a SaaS or tech environment

  • Strong working knowledge of MDM solutions (Jamf, Kandji, or equivalent), SSO, and identity management platforms

  • Solid understanding of network fundamentals: routing, VPNs, DNS, and office connectivity

  • Comfortable working in security-conscious environments with an understanding of access control best practices

  • Able to document systems and processes clearly enough that others can operate them independently

Attitude

  • Shows up as a team multiplier — resolves issues without drama and leaves things better than they found them

  • Communicates proactively: flags problems early and follows through without needing to be chased

  • Takes user experience seriously — treats every colleague as a customer of IT

  • Gives and receives direct feedback without friction

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where the priorities can shift

Agency

  • Proactively identifies IT risks and improvements before they become problems

  • Owns issues end-to-end: from diagnosis through resolution, without dropping the thread

  • Builds processes and automation that reduce recurring manual work for the team

  • Makes reasonable calls under ambiguity rather than escalating everything upward

  • Continuously looks for ways to use AI tools to improve how IT operations run at Dust

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

Aufgaben

  • Als IT-Support Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) betreuen Sie Arbeitsplatzsysteme und Anwendersoftware und sorgen für eine zuverlässige IT-Unterstützung der internen Mitarbeiter

  • Sie überzeugen durch Verantwortungsbewusstsein, eine sorgfältige und eigenständige Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägte Kunden-, Service- und Teamorientierung

Benefits

  • Work-Life-Balance: Freuen Sie sich auf flexible Arbeitszeiten bei einer 38,5 h/Woche

title: IT Support Specialist L2 (f/m/x)
descriptionHtml:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy.

 

We are looking for a hands-on IT Support Specialist to join our IT team in Berlin.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, takes ownership of their work, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly.

You will be responsible for providing reliable IT support, managing incidents and service requests, supporting device lifecycle operations, and ensuring a smooth employee experience.

 

We are looking for someone who can work independently, communicate confidently with stakeholders, and balance urgent requests with structured service delivery.

 

What you'll do:

  • Own and resolve L1/L2 technical support requests end-to-end, ensuring timely resolution and adherence to SLAs.

  • Provide hands-on walk-in and remote IT support across multiple locations.

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, connectivity and application issues across Windows, MacOS, iOS and Android devices.

  • Manage, prioritize and document tickets in Jira Service Management or similar ITSM platforms.

  • Investigate recurring incidents, identify potential root causes and collaborate with relevant teams on resolution.

  • Escalate complex issues appropriately while maintaining ownership and tracking progress.

  • Manage competing priorities in a high-volume support environment while maintaining service quality.

  • Configure, deploy and maintain laptops, mobile devices and peripherals using Microsoft Intune and other endpoint management tools.

  • Maintain accurate IT asset records, including device assignments, returns, replacements and inventory.

  • Support hardware lifecycle activities, including provisioning, repairs and secure disposal, in line with IT security policies.

  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding, including device preparation, access provisioning, equipment handovers and returns.

  • Assist with large onboarding waves, ensuring timely preparation, tracking and delivery of devices.

  • Troubleshoot Microsoft Teams Rooms, conferencing equipment and related AV systems.

  • Provide technical support for Microsoft 365, Teams and other workplace collaboration tools.

  • Identify opportunities to improve support processes, reduce recurring issues and enhance the employee experience.

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides and knowledge base articles.

  • Collaborate with distributed IT teams to ensure consistent service delivery across locations.

  • Communicate proactively with employees and stakeholders, setting realistic expectations and providing timely updates.

  • Follow established IT processes, security standards and escalation procedures.

 

What you'll bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on IT support experience in a corporate or enterprise environment.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows and macOS environments.

  • Practical experience supporting Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and enterprise applications.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Intune or similar endpoint management tools.

  • Experience with ITSM platforms such as Jira Service Management.

  • Understanding of ITIL principles, incident management, request fulfilment and SLA-driven support.

  • Experience with hardware provisioning, device troubleshooting and IT asset management.

  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks and manage competing requests.

  • Strong communication and customer service skills, including handling challenging situations professionally.

  • A proactive, accountable and solution-oriented approach.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting large-scale onboarding and offboarding operations.

  • Familiarity with Snipe-IT or similar IT asset management systems.

  • Experience troubleshooting Microsoft Teams Rooms and audiovisual equipment.

  • Basic networking knowledge, including VPN, DNS, DHCP and connectivity troubleshooting.

  • Basic scripting knowledge using PowerShell or Bash.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Defender and endpoint security concepts.

  • Experience working with distributed or international IT teams.

  • Awareness of ISO 27001, GDPR and IT security best practices.

     

Are you interested even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential—regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️

 

What we offer:

  • Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.

  • The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.

  • The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? With Workflex, we offer you the opportunity to relocate abroad for up to 30 days a year, depending on your responsibilities.

  • Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee.

  • Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you.

  • Stay up to date & help shape the future - Transparent all-hands meetings, short decision-making processes, and an open feedback culture - without mistakes, there is no progress.

  • The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events.

  • Your extra boost - 29 vacation days + one additional day off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve, discounted membership at Wellhub, and corporate benefits. Everything you need to help you achieve a good work-life balance.

  • Investing in your future – We don’t just think sustainably when it comes to energy, but also when it comes to you. Take advantage of our company pension scheme to build a solid foundation for your future, step by step.

  • Make your home smart – Sustainability starts at your doorstep. As part of our team, you’ll benefit from a permanent 25% discount on the entire Bosch Smart Home product range – for an even more efficient and connected home.

     

At Enpal, we are proud of the diversity of our team. No decisions are made on the basis of skin colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age, either during recruitment or employment. Enpal stands for a safe workplace and takes action against discrimination and harassment of any kind.

title: IT-Systemadministrator (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Einleitung

Wir suchen neue Kolleg:innen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Weg zur Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht und einem starken Team aus über 60 Kolleg:innen begleiten wir tausende Mandant:innen erfolgreich auf dem Weg zum deutschen Pass. Alle unsere Stellen sind Festanstellungen bei uns vor Ort in Cottbus.

Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich selbst einen Eindruck auf unserer Karriereseite. Denn wir können hier schreiben, was wir wollen, am Ende bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung.

Wir bieten Dir

Keine starren Prozesse, kein Mikromanagement. Bei uns entscheidest du, wie du arbeitest, mit Tools, die du selbst mitgestalten darfst, und Kolleg:innen, die mitdenken. Wir entwickeln ständig neue Systeme, um unsere Arbeit zu optimieren, statt nur Tickets zu schließen. Und falls doch mal was brennt: Wir löschen gemeinsam.

  • Echte Eigenverantwortung und kurze Wege
    Du bist nicht eine:r von vielen in einer langen Zuständigkeitskette. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich in deinem Bereich, in einem überschaubaren Team, mit kurzem Draht zu allen Abteilungen und zur Geschäftsführung, ohne drei Hierarchieebenen dazwischen. Wenn du eine Idee hast, wie ein Prozess besser laufen oder ein Tool sinnvoller eingesetzt werden kann, wirst du gehört.
  • High-End-Hardware nach Wahl
    Egal ob MacBook oder Windows-Tower: Du bekommst die Maschine, auf der du am besten performst, dazu 4K-Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset und einen ergonomischen Arbeitsplatz mit höhenverstellbarem Tisch.
  • Musik bei der Arbeit
    Bei uns wird nicht mit der Stirn gerunzelt, wenn du dir Kopfhörer aufsetzt. Wenn es dir hilft (und niemanden stört), kannst du auch gern Heavy Metal über eine Soundanlage an deinem Schreibtisch pumpen.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf das Leben von Menschen. Du unterstützt sie dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Das ist keine trockene Büroarbeit, sondern Arbeit mit echter Bedeutung.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit und flexible Teilzeit
    Keine Kernzeiten, keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster. Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell: Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Nach deiner Einarbeitung ist gelegentliches Homeoffice aber kein Problem, auch spontan.
  • Spontan frei, wenn das Leben dazwischenkommt
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend, kurzfristiger Arzttermin oder einfach mal eine Auszeit: Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Modernes Altbau-Büro mit Fitnessraum
    Hohe Decken, viel Tageslicht, Pflanzen und ein Innenhof für die Pause zwischendurch, mitten im Herzen von Cottbus. Unser eigener Fitnessraum im Haus steht dir kostenlos und jederzeit zur Verfügung. Einen Einblick in unsere Räume bekommst du auf unserer Website.
  • Team-Events und Feel-Good-Angebote
    Sommerfest am See, Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner: Wir feiern gern. Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht, und früher gehen ist auch kein Problem. Zwischendurch sorgt unsere Feel-Good-Managerin für kleine Auszeiten, von Nacken- und Schultermassagen bis zu kurzen Entspannungs-Sessions.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Als IT-Systemadministrator (w/m/d) planst, betreust und entwickelst du Systeme, die unser Unternehmen voranbringen. Du kümmerst dich um Server, Netzwerke und Sicherheit und hast dabei alle Freiheiten, Prozesse smarter zu machen.

  • Server-Verwaltung & Pflege
    Du betreust unsere internen Server, kümmerst dich um Updates und stellst sicher, dass alle Systeme stabil laufen.
  • Netzwerkadministration
    Du überwachst und konfigurierst Router, Switches, Firewalls und VPNs.
  • Datensicherung & Wiederherstellung
    Du planst, überprüfst und testest Backups regelmäßig und stellst sicher, dass im Ernstfall keine Daten verloren gehen.
  • Systemmigrationen
    Du planst und begleitest den Umstieg auf neue Systeme, ob Update, neue Software oder neue Hardware.
  • Schnittstellen & Automatisierungen
    Du verbindest Systeme über APIs oder Tools wie n8n. So machst du Prozesse effizienter und reduzierst Klickarbeit und Fehler auf ein Minimum.
  • Domains & Bereitstellung interner Tools
    Du behältst den Überblick über unsere aktiven Domains und stellst interne Tools lokal oder online genau den richtigen Teams sicher und performant zur Verfügung.
  • Technischer Support im Alltag
    Du bist eine der ersten Anlaufstellen bei IT-Fragen und hilfst Kolleg:innen weiter, per Chat oder vor Ort.
  • Einrichtung neuer Arbeitsplätze
    Du richtest neue PCs, Notebooks und Monitore ein und kümmerst dich um Softwareinstallationen, Zugänge und Netzwerkeinstellungen.
  • Neue Technologien evaluieren
    Du testest neue Tools, prüfst ihre Praxistauglichkeit und empfiehlst, was uns wirklich weiterbringt.
  • Abstimmung mit Dienstleistern
    Du betreust externe Anbieter, Partner oder Remote-Entwickler:innen und stimmst deine Arbeit mit ihnen ab.

Dein Profil

Kein Zertifikat der Welt ersetzt echte Erfahrung in der Praxis. Genau die suchen wir. Egal ob du sie mit oder ohne Ausbildung gesammelt hast: Uns interessiert, was du wirklich kannst, welche Systeme du schon verantwortet hast und was du noch erreichen willst. Direkte Kommunikation, Neugier und Spaß an der Arbeit sind uns wichtiger als jeder Abschluss. Und wir suchen jemanden, der bereit ist, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der IT-Administration
    Du hast bereits IT-Systeme im laufenden Betrieb betreut, ob in einem Unternehmen oder für Kund:innen, und weißt, was es heißt, wenn morgens etwas nicht läuft und alle darauf warten.
  • Festanstellung vor Ort in Cottbus
    Du möchtest fest bei uns angestellt sein und im Team vor Ort in Cottbus arbeiten. Für Freelance-Aufträge oder reine Remote-Stellen sind wir leider nicht die richtige Adresse.
  • Netzwerke & Sicherheit
    Lokale Netzwerke, Router, Switches, Firewalls und VPNs: Du hast sie schon eingerichtet und betreut und weißt, wie man ein Firmennetzwerk sicher aufstellt.
  • Server, Cloud & Systemarchitektur
    Du verstehst, wie lokale Server, Cloud-Server und Serverlandschaften zusammenspielen, und hast Erfahrung mit Docker und Datenbanken (z. B. Supabase) oder vergleichbaren Plattformen.
  • Plattform-Know-how
    Google Workspace, Windows und macOS sind für dich Alltag, nicht Neuland.
  • Backups & Datenschutz
    Du hast einen Plan von Backup-Strategien und weißt, wie man mit personenbezogenen Daten umgeht, von der Speicherung über die Verarbeitung bis zur Löschung.
  • APIs & Automatisierung
    Du weißt, wie man einen authentifizierten API-Call macht, und hast Lust, Abläufe mit Tools wie n8n zu automatisieren.
  • Nachhaltige Lösungen
    Du findest lieber eine saubere Lösung als einen schnellen Workaround.
  • Offenheit für Neues
    Du hast Lust, regelmäßig Neues zu lernen, ob Tools, Trends oder Technologien.
  • Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe
    Eigentlich wollen wir hier nichts Generisches schreiben, aber dieser Punkt ist uns wichtig: Gute Zusammenarbeit zählt für uns genauso viel wie Erfahrung. Jemand, mit dem die Zusammenarbeit angenehm und reibungslos läuft, ist im Alltag oft wertvoller als jemand mit noch mehr Know-how, mit dem die Kommunikation aber schleppend ist.
  • Deutsch oder Englisch
    Du sprichst Deutsch oder Englisch, am besten beides (ca. B2-Niveau). Keine Sorge, einen Nachweis brauchen wir nicht.
  • Nice to have: CRM-Erfahrung
    Wenn du zusätzlich schon mit CRM-Systemen wie HubSpot gearbeitet hast, umso besser.
