title: Outcome Testing and Controls Assurance Officer
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

This role is responsible for delivering Outcomes Based Testing (OBT), providing independent, evidence-based assurance that Allica is consistently delivering good customer outcomes in line with the FCA's Consumer Duty. The role also undertakes Secondary Controls Testing in accordance with Allica's Risk Management Framework.

The successful candidate will plan and execute a portfolio of testing activities, communicate findings clearly to stakeholders, and agree, monitor, and support action plans through to resolution. They will work collaboratively with Risk Business Partners and the wider First Line of Defence (1LoD) Controls team.

Beyond completing testing against a defined framework, the role requires a proactive and analytical approach. The role holder will identify root causes, drive meaningful remediation, and provide constructive challenge to stakeholders, helping to improve customer outcomes and strengthen Allica's control environment.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Conduct outcome-based testing across Allica’s customer facing journeys to assess whether customer outcomes are consistent with Consumer Duty obligations. 

  • Review customer cases, communications and operational activity to identify potential customer harm, process weaknesses or customer experience issues, including the treatment of vulnerable customers. 

  • Assess both process execution and customer experience, ensuring documentation is complete, communications are clear and customers do not face unnecessary barriers or delays. 

  • Communicate Outcomes Based Testing results clearly to relevant stakeholders, ensuring findings are understood and owned. 

  • Agree appropriate action plans with stakeholders to remediate instances of poor outcomes and track these through to closure. 

  • Deliver Secondary Controls Testing, assessing the design and operating effectiveness to obtain an overall rating for each control, in line with Allica’s Control Testing Standards. 

  • Communicate control testing output to stakeholders and agree action plans where control weaknesses or failures are identified. 

  • Accurately update RiskSmart with control test results, ratings, findings and associated action plans. 

  • Maintain regular engagement with Risk Business Partners across the wider 1LoD Controls team on control testing outputs, sharing themes and supporting a consistent testing approach. 

  • Escalate significant issues, risks or thematic concerns in a timely manner. 

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Outcomes Based Testing and controls testing methodology, templates and reporting. 

  • Ensure all testing is conducted objectively and independently, in line with Allica's Risk Management Framework and relevant regulatory requirements, including the FCA Consumer Duty and Conduct Rules. 

  • Support reporting and insight through dashboards and analysis, contributing to root cause identification and continuous improvement initiatives.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Capable of working in a fast-paced environment, managing complex, competing and alternating priorities across control testing and outcomes based testing with a constant focus on delivery. 

  • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify root causes behind poor customer outcomes or control failures, not just symptoms. 

  • A confident, clear communicator, able to present findings and constructively challenge stakeholders at varying levels of seniority. 

  • Show curiosity and sound judgement when assessing customer journeys and identifying potential customer harm or process weaknesses. 

  • Demonstrate a proactive and solution-focused mindset, with a desire to improve processes and customer experience. 

  • Be able to work independently with minimal supervision, while remaining a collaborative and engaged member of the wider team. 

  • Have experience of controls testing, quality assurance, outcomes-based testing, or 1st/2nd line risk and assurance work, ideally within Financial Services. 

  • Have a working knowledge of the FCA Consumer Duty and Conduct Rules, and how these apply in practice to Allica’s products and supporting customer journeys. 

  • Be explicit in demonstrating where they've gone the extra mile, embraced new challenges, or stood out from their peers in a previous testing, assurance or risk role.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Partner Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

This Role

The Solution Partner Ecosystem is the second biggest growth lever at Dust, yet Europe's agency and consultant market is still almost entirely untapped.

As Partner Development Manager (EU) at Dust, you will build a volume engine to boost partner-led revenue. Your job is to find the right partners across Europe, recruit them, and get them to their first win fast, and then transform into a repeatable motion. Working directly with our global partnerships team, you'll own the outreach motion, the onboarding, and the early relationship with every new partner you bring in, primarily digital transformation agencies and AI consultants.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can build a relationship from a cold message, run a disciplined process, and never lose the human touch that makes partners want to show up. You will be part of a growing partnerships team of 6 people, with partner managers distributed by location and a global partner operations and a solutions engineer.

Key Responsibilities

Hunt and recruit partners across Europe

  • Map the agency and consultant landscape across key European markets and identify highest-leverage entry points

  • Build and run an outbound motion to engage high-potential agencies and AI consultants: cold outreach, events, referrals, and everything in between

  • Develop targeted messaging tailored to different partner profiles, geographies, and languages

  • Qualify and prioritise your pipeline based on partner fit, client base relevance, and activation potential

Qualify partners and shape their Dust proposition

  • Run discovery conversations with prospective partners to assess their client base, AI readiness, and commercial fit before investing further

  • Help partners articulate how Dust fits into their service offering, whether that's a new AI practice, an add-on to existing engagements, or a standalone product recommendation

  • Make the call on which partners are worth advancing and move quickly on the ones that aren't

Onboard and enable new partners to go to market

  • Run structured onboarding for every new partner: product training, sales methodology, and deployment fundamentals

  • Own product training sessions with new partners and make sure they can demo, pitch and deploy Dust independently before going live

  • Get partners to first deal fast and track time-to-activation as a core success metric

Manage your partner portfolio and drive performance

  • Own quarterly business reviews with active partners: pipeline, escalations, and partnership trajectory

  • Keep the account management layer efficient and systematic to handle a high volume of partners

Support partners through live deals

  • Coach partners through sales cycles where Dust expertise is needed on the call

  • Build shared accountability for revenue outcomes between Dust and the partner network

Requirements

  • 5+ years of partnership management or business development experience in B2B SaaS, with proven track record of driving revenue through partner channels

  • Outbound-first mindset with a proven ability to recruit cold partners into active pipeline contributors, without relying on warm intros or an established brand to open doors

  • Relationship building expertise with ability to establish trust and drive action with consulting firms and system integrators

  • Strong enablement instincts — you can translate a technically complex product into a partner-ready sales motion and get partners to first deal without hand-holding

  • Excellent communication skills in English and French, nice to have a third European language

  • Entrepreneurial background or mindset: you've built something from scratch before, whether a territory, a partner channel, or a program, and you can show the impact

  • Self-starter mentality comfortable with ambiguity and can easily iterate on a built playbook

  • Nice to have: Existing network of agencies or consultants across Europe is a strong plus; we're looking for someone who brings complementary reach, not just experience in the category

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Direct revenue impact: You'll be directly involved in signing partners, closing deals and driving measurable business results

  • AI-native partner operations: Build and shape the partner operations in a AI-native team

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with sales, partnerships, and product teams

  • High-growth environment: Join at a pivotal moment as we scale from €1M to €40+M ARR

  • Innovation opportunity: Help define how AI companies should approach partnership development

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

descriptionHtml:

Founded in October 2022 by Johanna von Geyr (build-up and led Financial Services Practice for a NASDAQ-listed strategy consultancy) and Harald Braunstein (serial entrepreneur with exits incl. IPO), we bring together deep functional domain expertise and networks in global Financial Services, with a proven track record in building, scaling, and investing in leading software product companies.  

Curious what ALAIKA is all about? Explore our website and introduction deck. 

Join the movement — apply now.

  • Lead. Run the Data & AI practice as a whole — strategy, structure, hiring, IP, and P&L. Build the leadership team and develop the next generation of partners. Set the bar for what Data & AI advisory looks like in Financial Services. 
  • Build. You are not joining a practice; you are building one. Shape what ALAIKA’s Data & AI franchise becomes — and co-build the firm around it. That is not a slogan — it is your Tuesday. 
  • Sell. Originate at the highest level. Personally close ALAIKA’s biggest Data & AI mandates. Set the sales strategy — the book you build is the book the practice grows on.

“Show me an athlete who did well academically. An athlete because they know what it takes to win and they have had to experience loss.” 

— Kenneth C. Griffin, Founder of Citadel 

You'll set the bar — and lead a team that meets it. Intrinsically driven people, who do "what it takes." Your job is to shape them, sharpen them, and prove that ALAIKA is where the best go next. 

  • Book-smart. Strong academic foundation. Think in structures, not gut feel. 
  • Street-smart. Read the room fast. Prioritise ruthlessly. Grasp commercial reality. 
  • People-smart. Communicate with precision — clear, direct, persuasive. Build trust across functions and seniority. 
  • Athlete performance mindset. High aspirations. Grit. Learn faster than the environment changes. 
  • Entrepreneurial guts. You have built something, owned something, or bet on yourself at some point — and it shows in how you operate. P&L is not an abstraction. Ambiguity is not a problem. You move. 

What you bring 

  • Track Record. A track record of building — a Data & AI practice, a Data & AI-native company, or a senior data and AI function at a majorstrategic consultancy or Financial Services firm.  
  • Senior Network. Established relationships across data, AI, and Financial Services — C-suite, technical leadership, regulators, and the broader ecosystem. Your network walks in with you. 
  • Sales Track Record. Proven ability to originate and close mandates at €3m+ scale. You have built a book before. 
  • Market Authority. Deep domain credibility — named deployments, published thinking, conference and keynote presence. The market should know who you are before we introduce you. 
  • People Leader. You have hired, developed, and graduated, as well as made the hard calls on people. You understand that it is your task to build the best sports team — not a family.  
  • Languages. Fluent in English and German. Additional languages are a plus. 

Why join ALAIKA 

  • Equity & ownership. A partner seat with meaningful equity. You own a piece of what you build — and you gain access to the full ALAIKA ecosystem: Advisory, Capital, Building, and the network behind it. Not just a seat at the table. A platform to build from.

— Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI  

  • Stellar Network. Shoulder-to-shoulder with financial services executives running today’s giants and the founders building tomorrow’s. 
  • Offices. Munich and Barcelona. More coming. 

Plus: the essentials done right — EGYM Wellpass, bike leasing, a kitchen stocked with healthy food and team events worth showing up for: Oktoberfest, team dinners, and more. 

Advise the leaders. Build what comes next.
Invest in the future of Financial Services. 

Apply with CV, transcripts, and references. Let’s see if you are the one.

ALAIKA is an equal-opportunity employer. We hire on merit and welcome applications from people of all genders, backgrounds, ages, and identities. Our team spirit celebrates diversity. We want you to be your true “you” and offer everyone an open culture and safe space

title: Partner Manager - Agency Partnerships
descriptionHtml:
Tracksuit exists to help marketers prove their brand building is working. We give teams the data they need to make smarter decisions, convince stakeholders, defend budgets, and track their progress. The brand tracking industry is dominated by 100-page reports, static data and big price-tags. We're doing things differently by being built for the modern marketer: always-on, accessible, and approachable.

We're now tracking more than 1,000 brands across 25 countries globally. With offices in Auckland, Sydney, London and New York City, we're scaling fast with a brilliant team of collaborative and ambitious humans. Our culture is defined by "high care, high performance". We strive to be the best and look after each other while we do it.

Agencies are how a lot of brands find Tracksuit. We're looking for someone to grow those partnerships across the UK.

As a Partner Manager, you'll own our agency partnerships in the UK, from finding and winning new agencies to onboarding them and growing them into partners who regularly bring Tracksuit to their clients. You'll represent Tracksuit to agencies, and bring what agencies need back into the business. As we grow in Europe, you'll pick up agency opportunities there too.

What you'll do

  • Find, qualify and win new agency partners, through outreach and inbound interest

  • Onboard and train agencies so they know how and when to bring Tracksuit to their clients

  • Build trusted, long-term relationships with a portfolio of agency partners

  • Drive referred pipeline and revenue, working with our Account Executives from first introduction to close

  • Give agencies real value, from brand insights and pitch support to co-marketing and events

  • Track how your partners are performing and change what you do based on the results

  • Share what agencies tell you with our Sales, Customer, Marketing and Product teams

What you'll bring

  • At least 2 years in partnerships, business development or a client-facing role, ideally in an agency or a SaaS

Start: 01.01.2027

title: Personal Assistant
descriptionHtml:
What we’re all about.

We find, when we come together in the pursuit of excellence, great things happen. And that’s how we do things at Quantexa – together. Our business is data, but our culture is collective. We’re about growth – but not just the bottom line. We create a culture where people feel empowered to do their best work. We might work across continents and time zones, but that doesn’t stop us from collaborating. We’re connected. We celebrate our successes together, and we unite to tackle the challenges.

At Q, we’re looking for people who share that vision. People like you.

The Opportunity

Our part-time Leadership Personal Assistant (PA) to our Executive Committee will be a central point in enabling our Senior Leaders to focus on creating the biggest impact for our clients, our colleagues and our business strategy. This is for a fixed period of 6 months, role, working Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, and you’ll be office based on all three days.

You’re a brilliant communicator, in writing and in person, with laser-focused attention to detail and a curious, intuitive, agile and practical approach to a busy, varied senior team. You’re a connector, seamlessly making things happen across Quantexa. What makes you Q will help you flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

Our 8 Senior Leaders head up our functions, and our CEO works with his own dedicated PA. You’ll start by supporting 4 of the Senior Leaders, working alongside our current PA. From January, you’ll provide maternity cover, looking after all 8 Senior Leaders until our PA returns from maternity leave in May. Support will be tailored to each leader, from regular day-to-day help to occasional, ad hoc requests.

Our Senior Leaders are used to being self-sufficient, so many of your duties will be cross-functional or project-focused. As you support them, we’ll support you. You’ll report to our Chief Operations Officer, who’ll help you juggle priorities and focus your time on the things that add the most value.

The Senior Leaders are appreciative, hardworking and will value the contribution you bring to making their lives easier. We’re growing fast, and you’ll be an integral part of our journey, with the chance to push the boundaries of what’s possible and make a difference to a lot of people.

What you’ll be doing

  • Acting as the point of contact between our Senior Leaders and internal/external clients, distributing correspondence in an efficient and mindful manner.

  • Creating, drafting and formatting communications for diverse audiences and formats, such as PowerPoint presentations and reports.

  • Planning and coordinating off-sites, meetings and small team events for Senior Leaders and their teams.

  • Planning, coordinating and running annual Board offsite meetings.

  • Attending meetings, taking minutes, delegating actions and managing progress.

  • Managing diaries, scheduling meetings and booking travel.

  • Handling the inevitable last-minute juggling that comes with supporting a team of busy, dedicated senior people.

Requirements

What you’ll bring.

  • Organized and proactive: you juggle multiple projects at once without dropping any balls, take responsibility and create opportunity.

  • Always one step ahead: you embrace change, instinctively know what needs to get done, then make it happen.

  • Excellent communication: you write and speak well for diverse audiences, and you’re creative and detail-focused in getting the message across.

  • Teamwork, one of our core values: you’re a people person who builds strong relationships with colleagues, investors, the board and clients.

  • Customer-focused: you thrive on delivering a great service and making life easier for those you support.

  • Resilient, tenacious and a pleasure to work with, making Q fun wherever you are.

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

title: Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

  • Taking ownership and driving impact 
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

Your Mission

At Catawiki, our Platform Horizontal has evolved from solely managing the cloud into a broad function supporting Reliability, Developer Experience, Security, and Quality. We take a holistic approach to creating systems and tools that help developers deliver applications seamlessly and reliably without getting bogged down in infrastructure complexity.
As a Platform Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of development, infrastructure, and operations. You’ll help shape and execute our long-term platform vision, empowering Catawiki teams to deliver value to customers with speed, reliability, and security.

What You'll Do

You’ll build and improve the platform capabilities that enable our engineering teams to develop, deploy, and operate applications effectively at scale.

  • Build a self-service developer platform with a particular emphasis on developer experience, designing and maintaining platforms that abstract complexity and give teams the tools to deploy, monitor, and optimise their applications.
  • Orchestrate cloud-native infrastructure, manage Kubernetes clusters and other cloud resources, focusing on performance, scalability, and cost efficiency through FinOps practices.
  • Boost developer productivity by building and enhancing CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, and reusable templates that accelerate development and deployment cycles.
  • Drive reliability and scalability through applying practices for fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and scaling so applications run smoothly under changing conditions.
  • Improve platform operations usage and enhance our observability stack to monitor platform health and resolve incidents proactively.
  • Collaborate and innovate by partnering with product teams to understand their needs, build simple and impactful solutions, and champion cloud-native best practices across Catawiki.

What You'll Bring

You measure what matters, introduce changes gradually, and treat failure as a normal part of learning. You use tooling and automation wherever possible to reduce toil, and enjoy sharing knowledge with others.

  • Cloud-native expertise: At least 5 years of production experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • Automation mindset: Experience automating workflows and CI/CD pipelines and working with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
  • Observability experience: Hands-on experience using and maintaining tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or OpenTelemetry to improve reliability and performance.
  • Strong ownership: You proactively address platform issues and work toward long-term scalability and resilience.
  • Collaborative approach: You work effectively with developers and cross-functional teams to align goals and deliver impactful yet simple solutions.
  • Continuous learning: You keep developing your knowledge of cloud-native tools, technologies, and practices in a fast-moving ecosystem.

How We Work

The Platform Horizontal supports engineering teams across Catawiki by reducing infrastructure complexity and providing reliable, secure, and scalable foundations.

  • We collaborate closely with product teams to understand their challenges and improve their development experience.
  • We favour self-service capabilities, reusable solutions, automation, and measurable, gradual improvements.
  • We share knowledge and treat reliability, security, quality, and developer experience as shared responsibilities.

Where You'll Be

This is a Hybrid role based in Amsterdam. You will work from our Amsterdam HQ a minimum of 2 days per week.
This role is open to candidates worldwide. For selected candidates, Catawiki can provide visa sponsorship and relocation support to the relevant location, subject to eligibility and applicable restrictions.

In Return

You’ll be part of an enthusiastic, highly motivated team of 800+ Catawikians.

  • A competitive Annual Gross Base Salary depending on your level, competencies, and overall experience.
  • A Work From Home Allowance to help with your monthly household bills.
  • Commuting between your home and our office is covered by Catawiki.
  • Amazing Office right in the centre of Amsterdam.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

  • Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
  • Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
  • A culture of connection defines us. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
  • Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion”. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Our Offices and Way of Working

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

Interested?

Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support the review of your application. AI may help us assess how your experience matches the requirements of the role, but hiring decisions are always made by our recruitment team

title: Portfolio Risk and Treasury Manager
descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent.

We're a 160+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites, with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far.

We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy.

The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards, came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100.

Learn more about us on our website.

🎙️ The Role

We're hiring a Portfolio Risk and Treasury Manager.

This role reports directly to the CFO and sits in our Finance team. You will be tem's first dedicated hire in risk oversight and treasury, independent of the teams whose positions and processes you oversee and challenge. It's a solo, individual-contributor role for now: no team to manage, but real ownership of a complex, cross-functional, load-bearing area that touches our pricing and trading engine, FP&A, cash management and our commercial and people teams, and that increasingly matters to how investors, the board and funding partners see tem's risk maturity.

tem doesn't yet have anyone who owns liquidity as a discipline, or a second line of defence on risk. Growth in our business is capital-intensive: every collateral demand, margin call, commission payment and new market adds to the cash we need to carry, and the cost of that cash is rarely visible in the decisions that create it. You will build that capability from scratch, bringing treasury and independent risk oversight together, so that tem's risk and liquidity management stands on its own rather than marking its own homework.

In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Stand up tem's second line risk function: independent oversight and challenge of our first line risk processes, with risk appetite and limits that are set, monitored and acted on.

  • Build the liquidity models tem runs on, short and long term: working capital, collateral, margin calls, cash runway, and the credit facilities and letters of credit behind them.

  • Put cost of capital into our commercial pricing decisions, so the liquidity a deal consumes is visible at the moment the deal is made.

  • Work with the CFO to secure liquidity provision that scales ahead of the business and new markets.

  • Replace manual portfolio reconciliation with automation, and build our operational risk framework from the ground up.

🚀 Responsibilities

  • Second line oversight: establish and run independent oversight and challenge of tem's first line risk processes across trading and portfolio activity, input into risk appetite and the setting of notional and VaR limits, and monitor ongoing adherence.

  • Liquidity modelling: build and maintain short-term (cash runway, margin call forecasting) and long-term (growth and new market funding) liquidity models, covering generator collateral, hedging counterparty collateral, variation margin, credit facilities and letters of credit.

  • Working capital: own working capital efficiency as a measured, targeted discipline rather than a byproduct of other teams' decisions, working closely with Finance's cash management team.

  • Cost of capital and pricing: develop tem's cost of capital framework, make it usable in pricing, give our pricing and commercial teams the cost of capital impact of their decisions, and challenge decisions that consume liquidity without adequate return.

  • Liquidity risk: model liquidity risk from volume and price variance on energy volumes, run stress scenarios and report liquidity headroom against them.

  • Liquidity supply and funding: work with the CFO to engage lenders, credit facility providers and collateral and letter of credit providers, keep liquidity provision ahead of the business with early visibility of when new capacity is needed, and prepare liquidity and risk materials for funding partners, investors and the board.

  • Operational risk: build tem's operational risk framework from the ground up, including incident reporting and management, and drive automation of portfolio data reconciliation, from hedge contracts and confirmations through to hedge settlement and cash reconciliation with Finance.

  • Reporting and stakeholders: build automated, async-first risk reporting (dashboards and written updates by default, a live sync only when something needs real-time discussion), represent tem with hedging and generator counterparties and funding partners, and communicate risk and liquidity positions clearly to leadership.

🎯 Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Risk management or treasury experience from a fintech, quant trading or other digital-native environment: modern, tech-first risk practices rather than legacy, spreadsheet-driven ones.

  • Knowledge of energy markets, energy trading or energy risk management and portfolio balancing.

  • Liquidity modelling experience: working capital, collateral and margin dynamics, and cash forecasting over short and long horizons.

  • Risk modelling experience, including VaR and stress testing, and an understanding of cost of capital and how to translate it into commercial decisions.

  • Data literate: comfortable working with and drawing conclusions from portfolio and risk data.

  • Genuinely curious and intellectually sharp (this is a thinking role, not a process-running one), and confident communicating with senior stakeholders, external counterparties and funding partners.

Desirable

  • Experience raising or managing credit facilities, letters of credit or other trade finance.

  • Experience of US electricity markets.

  • Operational risk experience, or familiarity with the Ofgem regulatory environment.

  • Comfortable using AI tools as part of day-to-day work. No coding or SQL required.

✨ Benefits & Perks

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,400 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to GBP150 or EUR170 per month for wellbeing.

🗣️ Interview Process

  • First call with our Talent Team.

  • Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager.

  • Technical Interview with the Team (90 mins). You'll meet with potential peers in this session and will discuss how you would model and stress tem's liquidity, where you would set and monitor risk limits, and how you would make cost of capital usable in pricing decisions, including a practical exercise.

  • Bar Raiser Interview with Stakeholders.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

Elle dispose de 3 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR) organisées autour de 9 laboratoires de recherche (UER) qui mènent une recherche appliquée en relation étroite avec l’industrie.

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID)). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.

Sujet : « Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable Renewable Energy Production and Storage in Subsurface Reservoirs”

Ce poste fait partie de la subvention « Leveraging AI for Sustainable Renewable Energy Production and Storage », financée par Hi ! Paris (https://www.hi-paris.fr/). La recherche sera menée à l'ENSTA, Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Le poste offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet de recherche stimulant et impactant. Les connaissances, l'innovation et les compétences développées dans le cadre de ce poste offriront d'excellentes perspectives d'évolution de carrière tant dans l'industrie que dans le monde universitaire.

Le changement climatique exige des stratégies innovantes pour exploiter les énergies renouvelables. Le sous-sol de la Terre offre un potentiel important grâce à des technologies telles que l'énergie géothermique profonde, le stockage souterrain de l'hydrogène et le captage, l'utilisation et le stockage du carbone (CCUS). Ces méthodes pourraient transformer le paysage énergétique de la France et de l'Europe, mais elles sont souvent entravées par la sismicité induite par l'injection de fluides dans la croûte terrestre.

Pour relever ce défi, il faut des solutions avancées. La théorie du contrôle mathématique, telle qu'explorée dans le projet INJECT du CER (https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101087771), offre des stratégies pour minimiser les risques sismiques tout en optimisant la production d'énergie. Par ailleurs, l'intelligence artificielle (IA), en particulier l'apprentissage par renforcement (AR), présente une approche transformatrice grâce à sa nature agnostique et orientée vers la performance. L'apprentissage par renforcement peut développer des politiques très efficaces pour la gestion des systèmes souterrains et sert de paradigme pour aborder des systèmes complexes avec des incertitudes et des contraintes similaires, débloquant ainsi des applications plus larges dans divers domaines. Pour plus d'informations, veuillez contacter : ----- class="Default" style="text-align:justify;">Missions / Activités principales :

En tant que post-doctorant, vous ferez progresser les méthodes d'intelligence artificielle pour relever les défis du monde réel en matière de contrôle des systèmes régis par des équations différentielles partielles (EDP) non linéaires et non lisses. Les objectifs clés comprennent le développement d'algorithmes RL robustes, stables et adaptables, qui peuvent améliorer les modèles prédictifs pour la sismicité induite, le contrôle et l'optimisation de la production.

Le poste met l'accent sur la recherche interdisciplinaire, en intégrant l'IA à la géomécanique et à la théorie du contrôle pour approfondir la compréhension scientifique de l'injection de fluides dans le sous-sol et de la mécanique des tremblements de terre. Les résultats contribueront à des avancées scientifiques de pointe ayant un impact sur les communautés universitaires et industrielles.

title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en fondements quantiques et méthodes algébriques - CDD de 18 mois
descriptionHtml:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en fondements quantiques et méthodes algébriques pour rejoindre le département INFRES à Télécom Paris.

Le poste est accueilli au sein de Quriosity, équipe commune à Inria et Télécom Paris, au laboratoire LTCI et au département Informatique et Réseaux (INFRES). Située à Palaiseau, sur le plateau de Saclay, l’équipe bénéficie d’un environnement actif en information quantique et en fondements de la théorie quantique.

Le recrutement relève du projet PIQ « Nouveaux outils algébriques pour les décompositions causales des processus quantiques », sous la responsabilité d’Augustin Vanrietvelde. Il porte sur la phase 1 du projet, pour une durée de 18 mois.

Le projet étudie la conjecture des décompositions causales : tout canal unitaire admettrait une décomposition dont les connexions reflètent fidèlement sa structure causale. L’objectif est de développer des outils algébriques et syntaxiques pour étudier des cas ouverts, construire des décompositions ou identifier des obstructions. La recherche est exploratoire ; les résultats partiels et les limites des méthodes seront documentés.

Vos principales missions seront de :

Mener des recherches sur les décompositions causales des processus quantiques dans le cadre de la phase 1 du projet PIQ.

Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat de projets étudiants et de stages.

Contribuer au rayonnement scientifique de Télécom Paris, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris.


Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en physique, mathématiques, informatique ou dans une discipline pertinente pour le projet, obtenu au plus tard à la prise de fonctions.

Vous devez posséder de solides connaissances en fondements quantiques, notamment en causalité quantique, ou en méthodes algébriques avancées, ainsi que de bonnes capacités de raisonnement mathématique, de démonstration et d’analyse critique. Vous devez être autonome dans la conduite de recherches théoriques, savoir rédiger des travaux scientifiques rigoureux et maîtriser l’anglais scientifique, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

Des connaissances en algèbres d’opérateurs, en information quantique et en formalismes diagrammatiques sont souhaitées. Une expérience en calcul symbolique ou numérique appliqué à des problèmes théoriques, ainsi qu’en encadrement d’étudiants, constitue un atout. Enfin, vous devez faire preuve d’un bon esprit d’équipe, de capacités de dialogue et de synthèse, ainsi que de solides qualités rédactionnelles et pédagogiques.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers).

Vous bénéficierez de :

  • flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service)

  • télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible

  • Remboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75%

  • Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne...

  • A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé

Informations diverses :

Type d'emploi : CDD de 18 mois

Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, d'identité de genre et d’orientation sexuel et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

title: Werkstudent:in / Praktikant:in Customer Success & Operations (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Über 5 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland sind pflegebedürftig, und jedes Jahr werden es mehr. Ihnen stehen Leistungen zu, die oft nie ankommen, weil Formulare, Zuständigkeiten und Behördensprache dazwischenstehen.

Jeden Fall einzeln zu prüfen und bis zur Entscheidung zu begleiten, war bisher zu aufwendig. Mit KI geht das zum ersten Mal für viele Familien gleichzeitig. Genau das macht Decari: Wir prüfen, welche Leistungen infrage kommen, etwa ein höherer Pflegegrad, Hilfe zur Pflege oder Eingliederungshilfe, und begleiten die Anträge bis zur Entscheidung. Pflegedienste in mehreren Bundesländern arbeiten bereits mit uns. Unser Ziel: Jede Familie in Deutschland bekommt die Pflegeleistungen, die ihr zusteht.

Wir sind ein kleines, AI-natives Team mit Erfahrung aus der Versicherungs- und Pflegebranche. Wir waren frühe Mitarbeiter in Startups, die von Sequoia, Accel, Index Ventures und Y Combinator finanziert wurden und zusammen über 100 Mio. Euro eingesammelt haben. Neue Ideen testen wir erst einfach und von Hand, was funktioniert, automatisieren wir, und unsere Abläufe ändern wir jede Woche, manchmal täglich. Wir übernehmen Ownership und haben wenig Ego.

Deine Rolle

In dieser Rolle baust du Decari mit uns auf. Du arbeitest direkt mit Julien (Operations) und den Gründern und bist operativ und taktisch mittendrin: Du sprichst jeden Tag mit Familien und Pflegediensten, siehst, wo es hakt, und gestaltest den Prozess aktiv mit. Das geht als Pflichtpraktikum oder als Werkstudent:in (bis 20 Stunden pro Woche, tagsüber). Du suchst ein anderes Modell? Sprich uns an.

Berlin, hybrid: im Praktikum mindestens 4 Tage pro Woche im Office, als Werkstudent:in mindestens 2. Start ab sofort, für mindestens 6 Monate, bezahlt, danach ist eine Festanstellung möglich.

Was du machst

  • Du bist der erste Kontakt der Familien zu Decari und verbringst den größten Teil deines Tages am Telefon. Im Gespräch findest du heraus, ob und wie wir helfen können.

  • Du bringst Fälle ins Ziel. Aus einem guten Gespräch machst du einen vollständigen Fall und bleibst dran, bis alles da ist, was wir für den Antrag brauchen.

  • Du betreust unsere Pflegedienste mit. Für sie bist du die erste Ansprechperson zu ihren Familien.

  • Du verbesserst den Funnel. Du kennst die Zahlen von der Anfrage bis zum Antrag, bringst Ideen ein und testest sie direkt.

  • Du baust mit uns Automatisierungen. Was wir oft genug von Hand gemacht haben, übernimmt danach die KI.

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn

  • Du gern telefonierst, auch 50 Mal am Tag, und dich eine Mailbox oder ein Nein nicht aus dem Takt bringt

  • Du gut zuhörst, empathisch bist und schnell und fehlerfrei schreibst

  • Du anpackst und dir für unglamouröse Arbeit nicht zu schade bist

  • Du Ownership übernimmst: Dinge jetzt erledigst, die einfachste Lösung suchst und selbst einen Weg findest, wenn du feststeckst

  • Du KI im Alltag nutzt und neue Tools schnell lernst

  • Du sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift besitzt (C1), weil du täglich mit Familien telefonierst und diese berätst. Eine weitere Sprache wie Polnisch, Türkisch, Russisch oder Arabisch ist ein Plus

  • Du studierst und suchst ein Pflichtpraktikum oder einen Werkstudentenjob, zum Beispiel in BWL, Gesundheitsmanagement, Sozialer Arbeit oder Jura.

  • Du schon Kundenkontakt hattest, etwa im Nebenjob, in einem Praktikum oder in einem eigenen Projekt

Eher nichts für dich, wenn

  • Du nicht gern telefonierst

  • Du noch nie mit KI- oder Automatisierungstools gearbeitet hast oder dir technisches Grundverständnis fehlt

  • Du nur „strategisch“ arbeiten willst

  • Du dich unwohl fühlst, wenn du mehrere Aufgaben gleichzeitig jonglierst

  • Du nicht gern direkt mit Kunden arbeitest oder ein dynamisches Umfeld nicht magst

  • Du nur einen klassischen 9-to-5-Job suchst

  2. Kurzes Telefonat (15 Minuten)

  3. Bezahlter Probetag in Berlin

title: Pre-Sales Engineer - Energy Retail
descriptionHtml:
Location: London or Bristol, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: Senior Engineer C3

Team: Growth

Salary: £60,000 - £75,000 + discretionary bonus

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Head of Sales Engineering

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you’ll do

As a Pre-Sales Engineer, you are a trusted technical contributor within our team, helping deliver impactful sales engagements through configuration and development in our demo environments. You’ll play a contributor role to larger deals, and often lead pre-sales activities for smaller or less complex opportunities. You are a key part of the commercial engine, helping us scale by ensuring our technical pre-sales efforts are thorough, accurate, and client-focused.

This role will report to the Head of Demo Engineering and you’ll be part of a team that works on sales to Kaluza’s largest clients globally. You will have broad expertise on Kaluza’s product suite and our value differentiators and will develop depth in particular areas of our products. You will have a good understanding of the challenges facing energy retailers from a client or user perspective and be able to show-case how our solutions solve them.. 

You will play a crucial role in building product demonstrations and collateral that evangelises the Kaluza platform.

  • Own and deliver demo activities for small to mid-size opportunities, especially during high team capacity periods. This includes configuring and delivering tailored product demonstrations and responding to client technical questions with clarity and confidence.

  • Support technical delivery on complex deals, working alongside senior team members to prepare solution configurations, contribute to discovery conversations, and ensure client requirements are well captured and translated.

  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to scope solutions, validate feasibility, and communicate trade-offs in a clear and client-friendly manner.

  • Lead or contribute to proof-of-concept (PoC) projects, ensuring they reflect client needs and demonstrate our platform’s ability to deliver measurable outcomes. Track PoC success criteria and highlight risks or gaps to the wider team.

  • Represent the Pre-Sales function in internal planning and alignment sessions, helping ensure technical accuracy, smooth handovers, and clear documentation for post-sale teams.

  • Document and share learnings from client engagements, including product feedback, recurring questions, and potential areas for improvement in our pre-sales approach or demo assets.


What you’ll bring 

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Software development experience in a regulated industry using TypeScript, with a track record of designing and building complex solutions to customer problems

  • Experience architecting solutions on AWS, knowing which technologies to use when and the trade-offs involved

  • Confidence working with and explaining event-driven architectures and asynchronous APIs

  • Experience in a commercial or client-facing technical role, ideally selling SaaS in a regulated industry, with examples of adapting a solution to meet a customer’s unique needs

  • The ability to distil complex concepts into clear, simple points, and to work through differing opinions with empathy

  • Comfort working autonomously across multiple opportunities, handling ambiguity and knowing which data to use to measure success

An interest in renewable energy and the challenges facing energy retailers will help you hit the ground running.

Tech stack: TypeScript, AWS, event-driven architectures, asynchronous APIs


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

descriptionHtml:

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Prescription Coordinator on a 12-month fixed-term cover contract, to join our Operations team at Kings Cross. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a busy environment, has a keen eye for detail and enjoys working collaboratively to make a real difference.

This is a full-time, fixed-term contract for 12 months, working 40 hours per week.

 

About the Role

What You Will Need

  • A patient-focused approach with empathy, patience and a genuine desire to help others.

What We Offer

About Montu

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPMs). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and delivering an exceptional standard of patient care.

As we continue to grow, we are focused on building talented, passionate teams who share our commitment to improving the patient experience and making medical cannabis more accessible across the UK.

Joining Montu means becoming part of an ambitious and evolving business where you will have the opportunity to develop your career, contribute your ideas and make a meaningful difference to the patients we support.

title: Principal Engineer (contract)
descriptionHtml:
Principal Engineer

About this role

The bar has moved. Five years ago a strong engineer was measured by what they could build and how well they could mentor others to build it. Today, with Claude Code and agents, we produce quality work at a speed that would have looked superhuman in 2022 (Podium, PayPoint, Zuto, RL, OAG Analyser and others).

What separates exceptional from good is no longer typing speed or local craftsmanship. It is the complete package: architecture, deep engineering foundations, communication, system thinking, and the judgement to direct both your own intelligence and AI toward outcomes that matter.

Exceptional people at this level are not the best implementer in the room; they are the person whose specifications, decisions, and review judgement compound into systems that work in production and that others (and agents) can build on. They are a force multiplier, they hold a room at the highest levels, and clients treat them as the SME by default.

Your mindset

The mindset is the engine, and it is almost impossible to teach retrospectively. You are outcome obsessed, not output obsessed and you care whether the problem was actually solved - you resist the ego instinct to admire a clever solution and ask whether it was needed at all.

You are intellectually honest about uncertainty, taking a trust-but-verify approach and assuming the surprising bug is the one that will burn. You are deeply pragmatic, which matters at CreateFuture where pace counts: you have outgrown the religious wars about platforms, languages and patterns, you hold opinions loosely, and you decide for the systems in front of you, not the ones you wish you had.

You have a bias toward delivery: the smallest thing that works, then iterate, treating documents and meetings as means to that end.

And you are relentlessly curious beyond any immediate need, wanting to know how the database actually stores things or why a Claude Opus inference call costs what it does, which keeps you several layers ahead while the rest of the team is still reading the API docs.

AI as the accelerant

For a Principal to be truly exceptional, this is now already a first-class competency in your arsenal, not a side skill. An engineer who is brilliant by last year's standards but not fluent with AI is not exceptional in 2026. In practice that means:

  • Setting AI up to succeed. You treat context engineering as a craft (the right files, specs, examples and constraints), and you architect systems with clean interfaces, good naming, machine-readable specs and knowledge bases so the codebase is a quality baseline AI can work on later. No separate ivory-tower architect required.
    Reviewing and choosing well. You read far more code than you write, and your value is in the quality of review: catching the silent assumption, the security flaw, the architectural drift, knowing where models fail and looking there first. You pick the right tool for the job (Claude Code for a deep refactor, an inline assistant when that is enough, a sub-agent for parallel work, the right model for analysis versus generation) and you know the constraints differ by client, an enterprise like PayPoint or Natwest versus a scale-up type business like Zuto or OAG.
    Working with non-determinism. You see where AI moves the bottleneck and help people left and right of you unblock the value stream. You build with AI components but know success is no longer a binary, reaching for evals, golden datasets, structured outputs and fallback paths as naturally as you reach for unit tests.

Technical breadth across the full stack

Exceptional means depth in at least one area but competence everywhere the system reaches.

  • Backend: an instinct for distributed systems (what fails, what is eventually consistent, where queues back up), APIs that age well, thoughtful data modelling, and an understanding that languages are mostly syntax differences you can close with AI.
    Cloud: cost-aware and security-aware by default, reaching for IaC, composing the primitives rather than stitching together managed services and hoping it works.
    Data: modern pipelines, governance and lineage, increasingly vector stores and embeddings, with data quality treated as seriously as production code because garbage in, garbage out is far worse once AI features depend on it.
    Web and mobile: past the framework arguments, with a clear view on what you would pick today, and able to build "good enough" front ends yourself with AI.

Full-stack here means seeing the platform as one system and knowing which levers matter most. It does not mean front-end work with a few Node.js servers.

System thinking, consulting and commercial judgement

At CreateFuture we work in a consultancy context, where many otherwise excellent IC engineers can struggle.

You know technology is roughly 30% of the picture; the rest is design, argument and reasoning, commercial and political acumen, and the clarity to frame outcomes for a COO, CTO, CIO or CEO in their own language.

You know when gold-plating is wasteful, you can name when a project's real problem is not technical and say so even when it is awkward, and you have a strong sense of what is durable versus what is fashion.

You are not the engineer who introduced the team to seven new technologies last year; you are the one who removed three and quietly made the remaining stack stronger.

Leadership mentality

Technical work is necessary but no longer sufficient. By default you raise the level of everyone around you, regardless of discipline.

  • Communicate clearly and frequently (documents, decisions, post-mortems, design notes); the written artefact is the machine-readable context we can feed to AI later.
  • Make decisions and own them. You don't escalate everything or hoard control, and you are willing to be the benevolent dictator when it is your turn.
  • Mentor in AI fluency, not just code: tooling, prompting and review discipline, so your team is twice as productive a year from now.
  • Need little line management. You communicate upwards, raise by exception, self-resolve, and can be trusted with financial controls.
  • Disagree well. You tell people they are wrong with evidence and no ego, and you change your own mind when you are shown to be wrong.

What we're not looking for

  • The gifted engineer who sits in a silo. This is a team game.
  • The one who is fluent with AI but ships without the guardrails and quality gates enterprise clients expect.
  • The one with strong technical opinions who cannot justify them commercially and gets defensive when challenged.
  • The pure manager who wants to orchestrate teams rather than get involved. This is about setting a new standard, not coordinating it.
  • The engineer who will not immerse in a client environment. This role will mean on-site work and trusted relationships built in person. We are not going back to working away from the client and being bypassed.

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

  • Call with our Talent Acquisition Team 
  • Role specific capability interview 

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

We look forward to your application!

title: Principal Engineer, Mobile Platform & Backend Systems
descriptionHtml:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Team

Our diverse Product & Engineering team values innovation, collaboration, and the continuous improvement of our platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where employees can grow and thrive while working on cutting-edge technology that shapes the future of AI and search.

At AlphaSense, we believe that diverse experiences and perspectives are critical to our success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves.

About the Role

AlphaSense is moving beyond search with SuperAnalyst: AI-powered workflows that monitor change, update outputs, and surface what matters as situations evolve. Mobile brings that intelligence into the moments when customers are away from their desks.

Delivering those experiences through native applications presents a distinctive engineering challenge: services evolve continuously while released apps remain in customers' hands. Designing for that reality creates an opportunity to shape how AlphaSense builds shared product capabilities, with benefits reaching well beyond iOS and Android.

Based in Mobile Engineering, you will use a close connection to customer and product needs to shape backend systems across engineering organizations. You will help decide which cross-team problems to tackle and where architectural investment will have the greatest impact, then work with the owning engineers to build and prove the solution in production.

What You'll Do

  • Shape the systems behind product experiences: Set technical direction for client-facing APIs and the backend architecture behind them. Work with service and platform owners to simplify how backend services connect and support product workflows across clients.
  • Lead across engineering organizations: Work across application, search and AI, and shared platform teams to shape technical priorities around customer and product needs. Represent Mobile with senior engineering leaders, Product, and customers, building agreement on the architecture and investment needed to deliver shared capabilities.
  • Turn architecture into production systems: Lead delivery of services and subsystems that span team boundaries, from choosing the technical approach to implementing the hardest parts and proving them in production. Design these systems for reuse beyond the initial use case.
  • Shape shared identity and access: Partner with User Management and platform teams to evolve how users authenticate, maintain sessions, and access product capabilities across Web and Mobile. Build native-client requirements into shared identity and configuration services.
  • Leave engineers and teams stronger: Help engineers deepen their technical judgment and build the expertise to own and evolve the systems you deliver together. Combine hands-on delivery with coaching and reusable patterns, whether embedding with an existing team or bringing engineers together around a focused mission with leadership support.

What We're Looking For

Your strongest experience should be in backend and platform engineering, with client needs informing your architectural decisions. Prior iOS or Android development experience is not required.

Required:

  • Deep production backend and distributed-systems expertise, including service boundaries, data ownership, consistency, failure recovery, and integration models. A track record of simplifying complex architectures with impact across teams or domains.
  • Strong hands-on engineering experience, with significant personal contributions to production code and system evolution. Ability to develop a deep understanding of unfamiliar codebases and turn investigation into sound engineering decisions.
  • Experience designing client-facing REST and GraphQL APIs, with sound judgment about business-logic placement, product states, and backward compatibility. Understanding of how mobile lifecycle and network constraints affect backend design.
  • Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, entitlements, and session management, including trust boundaries and the security implications of client-service interactions.
  • Experience improving customer-visible reliability and performance across client and backend systems, with practical expertise in observability and production validation.
  • A track record of leading consequential technical change across teams through influence rather than reporting authority.
  • Product and stakeholder leadership that connects technical decisions to customer value. Demonstrated success challenging assumptions and building alignment with senior leaders, balancing immediate customer and product needs with durable foundations other teams can build on.

Preferred:

  • Experience building production systems for AI-powered search, research, or analysis workflows.
  • Experience with enterprise identity and managed applications, such as Auth0, Microsoft identity, or MDM/MAM ecosystems.
  • Experience designing shared configuration or service discovery for multi-tenant platforms and dedicated customer environments.
  • Experience designing and building event-driven systems, including publish/subscribe or event-streaming architectures such as Kafka.
