title: Senior Data Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

Our data flows from our applications, product events and business systems, in a highly regulated healthcare context. This role exists to build the platform that makes sure that data arrives complete, on time and safe to use, so Product, leadership, RevOps and Finance work from the same numbers.

You will be the first data engineer in a new data team that sits in Product, works across the company and reports to the Head of Data. You will own the platform that moves our data into Snowflake and shape the architecture decisions around it: which tools we build on, how pipelines are orchestrated and monitored, and how data infrastructure is managed as code.

What to expect

This is what you can expect from us as a Senior Data Engineer:

  • Purposeful work – your work gives the teams serving hospitals and aftercare providers data they can trust.

  • Real ownership – as the first data engineer in a new team, you shape the data platform and its tooling.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

This is how you will make an impact as a Senior Data Engineer:

  • Data from our application databases, product events and SaaS tools needs to reach Snowflake reliably. You build and run that ingestion and decide where to buy a managed connector and where to build.

  • Our pipelines need clear dependencies, retries, alerting and SLAs. You set up orchestration so a failed or partial load stops downstream work instead of silently producing wrong numbers.

  • New products need event pipelines. You design them together with engineers, keeping patient data out of analytics events by design.

  • Product and Finance need to work from the same definitions. You maintain the dbt models that connect product usage with customer, billing and revenue data.

  • Our CRM (HubSpot) and our internal systems need to talk to each other. You build the data flows between them, including two-way synchronisation where it is needed.

  • Data quality problems need to be caught before a dashboard or a board report does. You establish validation, monitoring and alerting.

  • Our data needs strong privacy and access controls. You enforce role-based access and masking in Snowflake, pseudonymisation, and deletion that propagates across raw and modelled data.

  • Data code needs the same engineering standards as our product code. You bring code review, testing, documentation and CI/CD to it.

How we build

We run a modern cloud-native stack to move, model and protect data reliably in a regulated healthcare environment.

  • Cloud: AWS (The European Sovereign Cloud partition)

  • Runtime: Kubernetes (EKS) and Postgres (RDS)

  • Warehouse and modelling: Snowflake (EU), dbt

  • Orchestration: Airflow or Dagster (being introduced)

  • BI: Looker

  • Observability: Datadog

  • CI/CD: GitHub Enterprise Cloud with Actions

  • Infrastructure: CloudFormation

  • Business systems: HubSpot, Chargebee


  • Several years (typically 5 or more) building production data pipelines, as a data engineer or as a backend engineer on data-intensive systems.

  • Strong Python: you write tested, maintainable production code, not only scripts.

  • Advanced SQL, including window functions, CTEs and query optimisation.

  • Production experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud warehouse: compute sizing and cost control, role-based access, masking, and performance tuning.

  • Experience with dbt, or a similar tool for tested and documented transformations.

  • Solid ingestion fundamentals: initial versus incremental loads, change data capture from Postgres, idempotency, schema evolution, late and out-of-order data, and backfills.

  • Production experience with an orchestrator such as Airflow or Dagster.

  • Experience with AWS and with deploying your own work in containers.

  • A data quality mindset: you profile data, test assumptions and build checks.

  • Practical knowledge of GDPR: you can identify personal data and implement pseudonymisation, access control and deletion.

  • You use AI coding tools in your daily work and know where they help and where they need checking.

  • Ability to own decisions as the only data engineer and to explain technical trade-offs to non-engineers.

  • Preference for writing over talking, resulting in clear, concise, yet complete documentation and asynchronous communications.

  • Fluent English, written and spoken. Other languages are a plus.

Bonus points

  • Healthcare or regulated-domain experience (e.g. ISO 27001, C5).

  • Integrating CRM and SaaS systems such as HubSpot or Salesforce, including reverse ETL or two-way sync.

  • Designing product event tracking (e.g. Snowplow or Segment).

  • Kubernetes in production.

  • Reading and changing Go code.

  • Managing Snowflake as code.

  • German language skills.

Our values

This will help you decide if you want to join us – our values are:

  • Strong opinions, weakly held. We adapt, negotiate trade-offs, and reconsider decisions when necessary. We don't stick to one implementation – we re-evaluate and adjust as needed (including throwing away the old one).

  • Pragmatic choice of tools and avoidance of one-size-fits-all thinking.

  • Bringing professionalism and empathy to how you work with others.

  • Strong belief in solid technical fundamentals and preference for understanding and first principles over memorization.

You'll deliver results from new channel testing, app acquisition, subscriber growth, paid advertising, and creative testing. Responsibilities may also include owning a portfolio of existing channels (Google ads, paid social, app install campaigns) with the goal of efficiently scaling profitable advertising. About the Role:

Camunda Hub is where enterprises run Camunda at scale. From Hub they manage their clusters and tenants, decide who can do what, and roll changes out across the whole organization. We’re looking for a Senior Product Builder to own the backend and architecture that let Hub manage a whole fleet of clusters. Your first focus will be the mechanism that sends access, secret, tenant and licence changes out to every connected cluster and brings deployments, health and audit records back. From there, you’ll shape Hub’s foundations: its event model, the service boundaries and data model other teams build on, and how Hub behaves when things fail or get upgraded. The platform is your product. Your users are platform administrators, Centres of Excellence and the builders across Camunda who depend on what you create. You’ll join a new two-person pod in our remote-first team. You’ll have real ownership as the person who makes the call, and you’ll build AI-first, from written specs through to production. Our customers run mission-critical processes on Camunda, so your work will matter to them every day.

What You Will Do:

  • Take over Hub's fleet propagation mechanism from the team building its first version, and make it work for access, secrets, tenants, licences and custom roles

  • Write short design documents for foundational changes, get them reviewed by the teams that depend on them, and turn them into tested, shipped code

  • Design how Hub behaves when things go wrong: offline clusters, partial failures, Hub outages, and clusters being adopted or detached

  • Build the path from clusters back to Hub, starting with deployment inventory, health, audit records and licence status

  • Design Hub's first event and webhook mechanism, so admins and agents can react to changes instead of polling for them

Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world. We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all. But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles. The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

This is the role that owns the first impression. From the moment someone lands on our homepage to the point they hand over their payment details, you’ll shape every critical step. We’re redesigning how millions of pet lovers discover and join TrustedHousesitters - and this hire will lead that work. If you’ve spent your career moving conversion needles, experimenting relentlessly, and building beautiful product at speed, this is your next chapter.

The Role: Experimental, Visual, and Commercial

You’ll own the full acquisition and onboarding experience at TrustedHousesitters - web and mobile - sitting within the New Member Revenue squad. That means everything from the homepage and landing pages through to registration flows, onboarding nudges, and first payment. You’ll work directly with product, engineering, data, CRM, and our CRO Manager, and you’ll have real ownership of the experimentation roadmap for your area.

The challenge is genuinely interesting. Our product is loved - but our acquisition experience needs to match that. We’re running a push to make TrustedHousesitters feel as aspirational as Airbnb, peppering real trust signals and community moments into journeys that currently skew too utilitarian. You’ll need to balance a high visual bar with a rigorous test-and-learn mindset. Neither alone is enough.

About the role:

As a Backend Senior Software Engineer on the Data Layer team, you'll help build and evolve the storage and query layer that keeps Camunda 8's process data fast, accurate, and available at scale. As a Senior Software Engineer on Camunda's new Data Streaming team, you'll help build a foundational new piece of architecture that changes how customers and internal products access process data. Today, customers have no first-class way to stream their own process data out of Camunda, and Camunda's own analytics product is bottlenecked by querying the same storage the live engine depends on. You'll be part of a greenfield team rebuilding how process data is consumed and served at scale, built on top of a durable, continuously-written streaming layer that decouples data consumption from the live engine. You'll be part of a small team from day one, with real room to shape both the architecture and the team's scope as it matures.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, the Data Layer and Distributed Systems teams, QA, and support, and work closely with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence how our data streaming architecture evolves to meet our customers' needs.

What You Will Do:

  • Help rebuild how Camunda's analytics product consumes and serves process data at scale, moving it off the engine's critical path entirely.

  • Design and build the core streaming infrastructure that decouples process data access from the live execution engine, backed by durable, object storage.

  • Build customer-facing data streaming capabilities, including a supported way to integrate with systems like Kafka, so customers can reliably get their process data into their own tools.

  • Make foundational architecture decisions as part of a small, high-ownership team, including how the system guarantees consistency and durability across a distributed streaming pipeline.

  • Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, partnering with Support and SRE to investigate data layer production issues, and feeding what you learn back into the product.

What You Will Bring to the Role:

Must Haves:

  • 7+ years of experience as a backend engineer, in Java, with a strong focus on distributed or data-intensive systems.

  • Hands-on experience building or operating an analytical serving layer over a table format such as Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake - including experience with an embedded/lightweight query engine (e.g. DuckDB, or similar), or a stateful stream-processing framework (e.g. Flink, Kafka Streams).

  • A track record of working with object storage systems (S3/GCS/Azure or similar) and building reliable, idempotent upload/commit protocols against them.

  • Solid grounding in the reasoning behind correctness and consistency in data-intensive systems (e.g. concurrent writes, atomicity, idempotency).

  • A demonstrated track record of driving a technical initiative through genuine ambiguity in a still-being-designed system, not just extending an established one.

  • Proven experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end-to-end, from solution design, project planning, and coordinating across teams, right through to driving predictable delivery.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote-first environment: you translate requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and give and receive clear, direct feedback in code review.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with Kafka or a similar streaming/event-log system

  • Experience with embedded state stores (RocksDB or similar) for projection/checkpointing workloads.

  • Experience with stream processing frameworks (e.g. Apache Flink), particularly stateful processing with local state backends and checkpointing.

  • Familiarity with object-storage-native streaming architectures (e.g. systems like WarpStream) is a plus, even without direct hands-on experience.

descriptionHtml:
Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun.

Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle.   • Maîtrise du cycle de vente (A à Z) : tu pilotes l'intégralité du parcours d'acquisition de nouveaux clients pour Salonkee. Cela inclut la chasse initiale, la prise de rendez-vous qualifiés, la réalisation de démonstrations percutantes et le closing des contrats.

  • Expérience sales : pas besoin d'un CV parfait; ce qu'on cherche avant tout, c'est quelqu'un avec la fibre commerciale et le drive pour aller chercher le client.   • Autonomie & organisation : véritable self-starter, tu planifies tes journées de façon stratégique et trouves les meilleurs leviers pour établir Salonkee dans ton secteur

  • Excellent relationnel : tu sais instaurer une confiance immédiate et créer un lien fort avec des entrepreneurs indépendants

  • Digital native : tu es à l'aise avec les outils SaaS et les environnements tech: la maîtrise d'un CRM est un vrai plus.

  • Mobilité : le permis B est indispensable. Tu gères en totale autonomie la région d'Avignon

  • Langues : français natif. Un anglais professionnel est apprécié pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un salaire fixe entre 28.000 € et 34.000 € brut annuel + variable déplafonné (OTE cible : 39.000 € – 45.000 €). Ton succès, ton revenu

  • Véhicule de fonction + carte essence + badge télépéage

  • Organisation autonome. Tu gères ton agenda dans un cadre de confiance

  • 25 jours de congés + repos supplémentaire (sous conditions)

  • Mutuelle

  • Tickets-restaurant

  • Un parcours d'intégration structuré : formation produit, accompagnement terrain avec ton manager les premières semaines, et accès à l'expérience de nos équipes déjà en place dans 6 autres pays

  • Un accès direct au leadership et une vraie capacité d'influence sur la stratégie commerciale dès tes premiers mois

  • L'opportunité de participer à une success story et d'avoir un impact tangible sur l'avenir du secteur de la beauté et du bien-être

  • Des événements d'entreprise réguliers pour renforcer la cohésion d'équipe et créer des opportunités de networking et de collaboration

Chez Salonkee, nous sommes convaincus que l'innovation s'épanouit dans un environnement où chacun se sent inclus et valorisé. Nous bâtissons une équipe diversifiée à l'image de l'industrie que nous servons : créative, passionnée et riche de perspectives variées. Peu importe qui tu es ou d'où tu viens, tu trouveras ici ta place pour grandir, contribuer et être toi-même.

Salonkee promeut l'égalité des chances et la diversité. Nous accueillons toutes les candidatures, indépendamment du genre, de l'origine, de l'âge, du handicap ou de l'identité.

title: Research Engineer, Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As a Member of Technical Staff, Infrastructure in Harvey Research, you’ll build the systems that power how we adapt and improve leading open-weight models for legal work.

We recently post-trained our first model built for legal work, and we’re now building the team to scale up our post-training efforts. You’ll own the infrastructure behind that effort: distributed training, RL rollout systems, the environments where models learn to use tools and complete complex legal workflows, and the internal systems the team uses to manage data, run evals, and launch and track training jobs. You’ll help decide what we build, what we adopt, and how the pieces fit together. You’ll join a small, high-bar team of hands-on engineers and researchers, where each person owns a large part of the stack.

We’re looking for research engineers who have built demanding ML or distributed systems, can debug across the stack, and want to work closely with researchers to make training faster, more reliable, and easier to iterate on.

Learn more about our work at harvey.ai/research.

What You'll Do

  • Scale our post-training stack, supporting SFT and RL on leading open-weight models.

  • Build distributed rollout infrastructure that coordinates model inference, tool execution, and collection of training experience for long-horizon tasks.

  • Build the infrastructure for reproducible agent environments where models can interact with documents, tools, and external systems during training and evaluation.

  • Own the performance and reliability of training runs, including GPU utilization, checkpointing, failure recovery, and observability.

  • Identify and remove bottlenecks across training and inference to shorten the path from research idea to useful result.

  • Build the internal tools and services the team runs on: training data management and versioning, running evals and browsing results, and launching and tracking training jobs and experiments.

  • Integrate models into production, including serving, latency, cost, and online evaluation, so research reaches customers quickly and safely.

  • Partner closely with researchers to turn experimental workflows into dependable systems while keeping room for rapid experimentation.

What You Have

  • Experience building ML infrastructure, distributed systems, or research tooling, with ownership of performance, reliability, and operation.

  • Strong Python and generalist software engineering skills across backend services, data systems, and internal tools, with familiarity with PyTorch, JAX, or similar ML frameworks.

  • Experience with distributed training or inference, including diagnosing performance bottlenecks and failures across the stack.

  • Understanding of post-training workflows; experience with RL rollouts, agent environments, or sandboxed tool execution is a plus.

  • Practical judgment about what to build versus adopt, and the ability to partner with researchers and ship quickly as needs evolve.

We are hiring for this role across multiple levels.

title: Responsable de la Sécurité des Systèmes d’Information (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Description du poste

Le RSSI Groupe aura pour mission de définir, piloter et contrôler la stratégie de cybersécurité du Groupe, avec quatre objectifs principaux :

  1. Réduire l'exposition du Groupe aux risques cyber susceptibles d'affecter ses activités, ses données, ses clients ou son image.
  2. Travailler en collaboration avec la DSI, s’assurer que les bonnes pratiques au niveau du SI soient mises en place.
  3. Garantir notre capacité à répondre aux exigences réglementaires, contractuelles et clients en matière de sécurité.
  4. Structurer la préparation et le suivi des audits, en assurant la mise en œuvre et la clôture des plans d'actions associés.
  5. Donner à la Direction une vision consolidée du niveau de risque cyber, des priorités et des actions engagées.

Vos principales missions

Le RSSI Groupe aura notamment la responsabilité de :

    • Définir la stratégie et la feuille de route cybersécurité Groupe ;
    • Identifier et évaluer les principaux risques cyber auxquels le Groupe est exposé ;
    • Proposer à la Direction les priorités et investissements nécessaires à leur maîtrise ;
    • Définir les règles et politiques de sécurité applicables au Groupe ;
    • Coordonner les actions cybersécurité entre les différentes entités ;
    • Accompagner les filiales et les projets stratégiques sur les sujets de sécurité ;
    • Piloter la conformité aux différentes exigences applicables au Groupe ;
    • Préparer et coordonner les audits clients, réglementaires et internes ;
    • Piloter les plans de remédiation issus de ces audits ;
    • Structurer la gestion et l'escalade des incidents cyber ;
    • Développer la sensibilisation et la culture cybersécurité auprès des collaborateurs et du management ;
    • Évaluer les risques liés aux fournisseurs et partenaires critiques ;
    • Mettre en place des indicateurs permettant à la Direction de suivre régulièrement le niveau de risque et l'avancement de la feuille de route.

Requirements

Idéalement : 5 à 10 ans d'expérience en cybersécurité, dont une expérience en gouvernance ou management de la sécurité.

Une expérience dans un environnement :

  • Industriel ;
  • Aéronautique ;
  • Défense ;
  • International ;

Compétences

Le candidat devra maîtriser ou connaître :

  • Gouvernance cybersécurité ;
  • Analyse de risques ;
  • Gestion des audits ;
  • Gestion des incidents ;
  • Gestion des vulnérabilités ;
  • IAM ;
  • Sécurité Cloud ;
  • Sécurité des infrastructures ;

title: RF Test & Validation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As RF Test & Validation Engineer, you own the characterization and validation of Harmattan’s in-house radio, from boards to integrated systems. You take RF measurement work off the designers’ plate and turn it into a repeatable, automated discipline: setups, measurements, and clear results fed back to the design team. You also keep the RF lab in working order as test capacity grows. You work primarily within the Radio team, with occasional exposure to other RF-based teams.

Responsibilities

  • Run RF characterization and validation of radio boards and integrated radio systems.

  • Build and maintain automated RF test benches, including interconnects, harnesses, and fixtures.

  • Develop reusable Python suites for instrument control and data capture across standard RF measurements.

  • Perform pre-compliance and compliance-support measurements, including EMC and thermal testing.

  • Test antennas, both standalone and integrated on systems.

  • Support the integration of the radio on our systems.

  • Analyze results, flag anomalies, and deliver clear, structured reports to RF designers.

  • Own the RF lab: track calibration, manage fixtures and accessories, and identify equipment gaps.

  • Support team members who are less experienced in RF testing.

Candidate Requirements

  • Hands-on experience running RF characterization with VNA, spectrum analyzer, signal generator, power meter, AWG, and oscilloscope.

  • Solid grasp of standard measurements such as S-parameters, P1dB, IIP3, sensitivity, and spurious.

  • Experience building reusable test automation, Python preferred.

  • Skilled in fine-pitch SMD and coaxial-cable rework on RF boards.

  • Careful around input-power damage thresholds, protecting both instruments and devices under test.

  • Rigorous and perceptive: interprets results before reporting and spots anomalies early.

  • Writes clear, structured reports.

  • Keeps a shared lab tidy and works well alongside designers.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Sales Development Representative
descriptionHtml:
Thanks for stopping by and learning more about this role at Sitemate! ✨🏗️

We’d love to hear from you 👩‍💻👩🏽‍💻🧑🏿‍💻👨🏻‍💻

📝 Overview

The Sales Development Representative is responsible for qualifying and routing inbound leads across two channels: self-service and inside sales. This role involves frequent engagement with prospects through phone calls, emails, live chat, and internal tools such as Slack and Salesforce. This role runs inside that same AI-native approach we build for customers. Leads and account data flow into an AI-populated Salesforce, so reps start from a clean, enriched pipeline instead of manual entry. Every call is coached live by ClaudeMate, giving real-time feedback on framing, objection handling, and next steps as the conversation happens. Success in the role is measured by the number of product demonstrations booked and completed, with a strong track record of team performance consistently meeting or exceeding monthly targets.

 

Room to grow, fast-tracked

We hire SDRs expecting you to grow past the role. “Grow from Within" is one of our leadership operating principles - meaning proven performance gets noticed and backed fast, and that managers and leaders are encouraged to gravitate towards internal promotions vs. external hires

For SDRs, that typically means a path to Account Executive within 9 to 12 months, based on performance, not tenure. One of our SDRs moved into a leadership role running Sales Development for all of North America within 8 months. Others have made the jump from SDR to Enterprise AE and describe the same pattern from the other side: "Sitemate is process-driven (everything engineered), so if you can learn and grow from these processes and you’re open to honest, constructive feedback while giving your best every day, you'll level up quickly".

Read more stories like these on People of Sitemate.

Employment:

🔧 Day-to-Day

  • You will be qualifying and routing inbound leads through two channels; self service & inside sales

  • You’ll be spending most of your time with prospects across phone calls, emails and live chat on our website, as well as internal tools like slack and salesforce.

  • Your quota is measured by the number of demonstrations booked and completed at the subsequent stage of the process. Our current team in this role have achieved >=95% of their targets each month since starting

 

⚡ Challenges

  • Learning about the built world if you haven’t had any exposure to it - there are a lot of different types of companies and plenty of new terminologies to learn.

  • Up-skilling your call/phone and email skills - although we have plenty of examples for you to learn from during your onboarding.

  • Understanding SaaS financial acronyms and common terminology - if you have not worked in a SaaS company before, there is going to be a lot of metrics to learn. This cheat sheet is a good resource: The Ultimate SaaS Acronyms Cheat Sheet

  • We move very quickly, so you’ll need to be excited to come in and learn extremely fast.

 

✅ Who This Role is For

  • Ambitious individuals wanting to pursue a career in SaaS

  • People who thrive in a structured, high-agency, KPI-driven environment

  • Strong communicators who enjoy building relationships

  • Resilient individuals who can persevere and perform with high-volume tasks

 

🚫 Who This Role is Not For

  • Those unwilling to handle rejection frequently

  • People uncomfortable with people and conversations

 

🎯 Skills & Tools

Must Have:

  • Confident and clear communication skills, with excellent writing and presentation skills over email, phone, video conferencing and in-person.

  • Excellent task organization and prioritization skills, you’re able to multi-task efficiently.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with modern tooling - CRMs, Health Scoring, Live chat, Knowledge bases.

  • Experience conducting customer meetings digitally (e.g. Zoom/Teams) and/or physically (in person/face to face with customers).

  • Patience working in an industry where not all users are tech-savvy.

About Sitemate:

Sitemate builds best-in-class software and AI agents for the built world, helping construction, infrastructure and industrial companies work smarter and faster. Our mission is to multiply the engineering power of the built world.

Storm is the #1 data capture agent for the front line of the built world - converting audio, photos and videos into clean structured records.

With conversational support in-app and across SMS, Whatsapp and phone calls, Storm is shifting front line workers from paperwork and clunky digital forms, to natural language and multi-channel data capture.

Our core platforms are Dashpivot (safety, quality and field reporting), Gearbelt (fleet and asset management), Flowsite (no-code integrations), and the Sitemate mobile app for every worker on site.

We have strong product-market fit, generating thousands of new leads per month through word of mouth and organic channels. We are backed by Blackbird, with 200 people across 18+ countries and entities in Australia, the UK, the US and Canada.

 

Life at Sitemate

At Sitemate, you’ll join a team that values transparency, high velocity, hustle, diversity, and innovation - not as buzzwords, but as the principles we work by every day.

We move fast, communicate openly, and operate with trust and autonomy. You’ll have access to key company metrics, clear career development plans, and the opportunity to grow your career based on performance, not tenure.

We believe diverse teams build better products. Our team includes members from 18+ countries - 55% identify as coming from underrepresented ethnic backgrounds, 43% identify as female, and our team spans ages 22–51.

 

Our Core Values

Our core values dictate “how we work”. We believe that basic human values such as honesty, trust and integrity are required to simply ‘get in the door’. Our values are designed to help us determine if an already great person, will be a great fit at Sitemate.

  • Handle with Care: Handle with thought and care, decisions are considered and consciously delivered

  • Everything Engineered: Everything engineered, intentional, planned and systematic

  • Quality Certified: Do it well, with attention to detail and accuracy, or don’t do it at all

  • Fast Tracked: Fast, incremental, and constant delivery of change

  • High Vis: A high visibility, transparent and  open environment

  • Rain, Hail or Shine: Show up for your team, your customers and yourself

Learn more about our values:

  • Listen:

    • Unleashing your Zilla

    • On scaling Sitemate, diversity, and culture

 

What We Offer

  • Competitive, performance-based remuneration

  • Equity options - own a piece of what you’re helping to build

  • 25 days paid annual leave, plus sick, carer’s, and compassionate leave

  • Parental leave - 16 weeks for primary and 6 weeks for secondary carers (including adoption and stillbirth support)

  • Learning & Development - professional growth budget and transparent career plans

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - for confidential counseling, mental health support, and life resources

  • Laptop and home office setup budget

  • Flexible work - a hybrid rhythm, with 2 to 3 days in office, 2 WFH each week - with the flexibility to work from anywhere for several weeks a year

  • Community & Connection - weekly catered lunches, global offsites, and “Life Story” sessions

  • London office perks - large private outdoor terrace, on-site showers & bike storage, surrounded by cafés, galleries & vibrant nightlife in the heart of Shoreditch and a 5-minute walk to Old Street tube

 

Equal Opportunity

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Sitemate welcomes applicants of all genders, ethnicities, ages, sexualities, and abilities. Our team’s diversity is one of our greatest strengths, and we’re committed to ensuring an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Sales Director to lead the volume end of our Sales organization in EMEA. Tiers 2 and 3 make up the broad base of our client portfolio: a large number of banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms and advisors, with smaller account sizes than our Tier 1 and strategic clients. Retention, expansion and coverage at scale drive growth here.

You’ll lead a team of 6–8 Account Managers, each owning a book of Tier 2 and Tier 3 clients, and a small number of Account Executives winning new clients in the same tiers. You’ll own renewals and net retention for the segment, build a repeatable operating rhythm across a high volume of accounts, and grow a team within our newly tiered sales organization.

This is a hands-on leadership role reporting to the Head of Sales, EMEA & APAC. You’ll combine coaching with disciplined pipeline and forecast management, and you’ll be accountable for how your team performs against its number.

What you’ll work on

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

  • Lead the Tier 2 and Tier 3 EMEA team to consistent, forecastable delivery quarter over quarter.

  • Own segment net retention and expansion, and make sure every account has a renewal plan well ahead of its date.

  • Coach and manage a team of 6–8 Account Managers, and Account Executive, through weekly pipeline, renewal and forecast reviews.

  • Set coverage models and account prioritization so your team spends its time where the revenue and risk are.

  • Run a clear operating cadence across the segment, including book and territory planning, account plans and a shared methodology.

  • Recruit, onboard and develop the team, including training on demos, usage analysis and client reviews.

  • Manage performance through structured reviews, goal setting and development plans.

  • Partner with Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Enablement, Rev Ops, Marketing and Product to remove barriers to growth and bring client feedback into the roadmap.

  • Work with the Head of Sales, EMEA & APAC and the US team to keep handovers, tiering and territories consistent globally.

  • Keep accurate CRM records and forecasts, and use the data to coach and make decisions.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Have 5+ years of experience leading account management or commercial teams, ideally in capital markets, fintech or data and SaaS.

  • Have a track record of managing high-volume books and delivering retention and growth across them.

  • Are comfortable owning a team number and can show how you’ve consistently hit it.

  • Are a proactive coach, not a reactive manager. You share process, help your team plan ahead and don’t wait for forecasts to slip.

  • Have run a disciplined cadence of pipeline reviews, forecasting and account planning.

  • Have a good knowledge of financial markets and the ability to build relationships across the buy side, sell side and advisory community.

  • Are comfortable with CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) and use data to drive decisions.

  • Build trust across a matrixed commercial organization and partner effectively with Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Enablement, Rev Ops and Product.

  • Thrive in ambitious, fast-moving environments where expectations are high, opportunities are abundant, and no two days look the same.

    Our benefits

    We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

     

    Financial & Insurance

    • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

    • Equity options

    • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

    • Private Medical Insurance

    • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

    • Group Life Assurance

    • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

    Time off

    • 25 holiday days per year

    • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

    • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

    • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

    • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

    Growth & Culture

    • Professional learning and development budget

    • Bi-annual team socials

    • Summer and Winter company social events

     

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

title: Sales Enablement Lead
descriptionHtml:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, and deliver enablement programs that drive productivity across our fast-growing European sales and sales engineering teams, including supporting new hire onboarding cohorts as they ramp in seat, in region.

  • Use AI tools to create content faster, run AI-driven role-play and call coaching, and give sellers self-serve answers to their questions.

  • Own training on the tools EMEA sellers and SEs use daily for account research, call prep, call recaps, pipeline updates, and drafting outreach and proposals.

  • Teach sellers when to trust AI output, how to verify it, and how to handle customer data under EU privacy and regulatory requirements (GDPR, EU AI Act), so every seller can explain, demo, and stand behind how Sierra uses AI with customers.

  • Create playbooks and programs, track adoption and impact (tool usage, time saved, ramp speed, deal velocity), and report results to EMEA and global sales leadership. Turn the best field practices into shared prompts, playbooks, and workflows for the global enablement team.

  • Localize and launch global sales plays in EMEA (flagging any that don’t translate), collect field feedback for the global Programs Lead, and support regional launches with Sales Leadership and Marketing.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years in sales enablement at a B2B software company, with exposure to both onboarding and plays

  • Experience adapting centrally built programs for a regional audience

  • Evidence of leadership: prior people management, or leading projects and mentoring others, and a genuine interest in leading a team

  • Credibility with senior sales leaders and experienced sellers and SEs, and a strong facilitator

  • Hands-on, daily use of AI tools in your own work, and experience teaching others to adopt new tools and change how they work

  • Comfortable working independently with a team several hours behind you

Even better…

  • Experience in AI or enterprise software

  • Additional European languages

  • Experience as the first enablement hire in a region

  • Experience hiring or building a team

  • Experience running an AI fluency or AI tooling program for a sales team

  • Familiarity with the EU AI Act or GDPR as they apply to how sales teams use AI

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

Das SDR-Team ist entscheidend dafür, wie wir neue Kund:innen gewinnen.

Als erstes Glied in unserer Sales-Kette prüfen SDRs, welche Anfragen gut zu Pennylane passen, und machen daraus Gesprächstermine – und legen damit die Basis für den Erfolg des gesamten Teams.

Das deutsche SDR-Team besteht aktuell aus 2 Personen, und du gestaltest es mit, während es wächst. Du berichtest direkt an Jacob, unseren Global Head of Sales SME, und bringst deine Erfahrung aktiv in den Aufbau unseres deutschen SME-Vertriebs ein – mit Sales Academy, Buddy und Shadowing bringen wir dich schnell auf Pennylane-Niveau.

Wie trägst du zum Projekt bei?

Wir erhalten täglich viele Inbound-Anfragen von Unternehmen, die Pennylane kennenlernen möchten. Genau mit diesen arbeitest du – 100 % Inbound-Vertrieb, Kaltakquise (Outbound) gibt es in dieser Rolle nicht.

Die größte Herausforderung: Tempo, Volumen und Qualifizierungstiefe in Balance halten. Du reagierst schnell auf deutsche Interessent:innen und gehst gleichzeitig tief genug, um ihr Buchhaltungs-Setup, ihre geschäftlichen Herausforderungen und die Komplexität ihres Falls wirklich zu verstehen.

Konkret heißt das:

  • Du qualifizierst deutsche KMU-Leads: Unternehmensprofil, aktuelle Buchhaltungs- und Finanz-Tools, Pain Points, Bedarf und Kaufkontext

  • Du machst aus qualifizierten Leads hochwertige Termine mit dem passenden Account Executive – relevant, sauber terminiert und mit hoher Wahrscheinlichkeit, dass sie stattfinden

  • Du sorgst für eine saubere Übergabe und dokumentierst Qualifizierung, Use Cases, Stakeholder, Dringlichkeit, aktuelles Setup und nächste Schritte in Salesforce

  • Du fasst per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn nach und reaktivierst Leads, die abgetaucht sind oder einen Termin verpasst haben

  • Du entwickelst unseren deutschen SME-Vertrieb mit: Du teilst Marktfeedback, verbesserst unser Messaging und arbeitest eng mit AEs, Marketing und dem gesamten Sales-Team zusammen

  • Optional, je nach Erfahrung: Du verantwortest den kompletten Sales-Zyklus für Self-Sign-up-Abbrecher – du reaktivierst Interessent:innen, die ihre Registrierung nicht abgeschlossen haben, zeigst ihnen die passende Lösung und schließt die Opportunity selbst ab

Dein Erfolg misst sich vor allem an stattgefundenen qualifizierten Terminen, Show-Rate, Akzeptanz durch die AEs, der Conversion von Termin zu validierter Opportunity und der beeinflussten Pipeline. Die Ziele kalibrieren wir gemeinsam am Volumen und der Reife des deutschen Marktes.

Wie sehen deine Aufgaben im Alltag aus?

So sieht dein Einstieg bei uns aus:

Die ersten 30 Tage

  • Du lernst Pennylanes Produkt, unseren Ideal Customer, den deutschen Marktkontext, unsere Qualifizierungsmethodik, Salesforce und unsere internen Sales-Prozesse kennen und begleitest SDR- und AE-Calls (Shadowing)

Bis Tag 60

  • Du qualifizierst deutsche Leads eigenständig, erkennst ihre zentralen Pain Points und übergibst sie mit vollständigen, verwertbaren Notizen an den richtigen AE

Bis Tag 90

  • Du verantwortest den gesamten Qualifizierungsprozess für deutsche SME-Leads, erfüllst die vereinbarten Aktivitäts- und Qualitätsstandards, lieferst einen verlässlichen Fluss hochwertiger Termine und identifizierst erste Hebel für bessere Conversion und besseres Messaging

Nach 12 Monaten

  • Du bist ein verlässlicher, autonomer SDR für den deutschen SME-Markt, erreichst oder übertriffst deine KPIs, kennst deutsche Kundenprofile, Buchhaltungs-Workflows und typische Einwände aus dem Effeff und wirst von den AEs als Quelle hochwertiger Opportunities geschätzt

  • Du prägst unser deutsches Sales-Playbook mit und beschleunigst den Aufbau unseres SME-Go-to-Market in Deutschland

  • Abhängig von deiner Leistung und offenen Positionen kannst du dich perspektivisch in Richtung Account Executive entwickeln

Wen wir suchen

  • Du bringst mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit – als SDR/BDR, im Inside Sales oder in einer vergleichbaren kundenorientierten Rolle, idealerweise in SaaS, Fintech, Buchhaltungssoftware oder einem anderen beratungsintensiven Vertriebsumfeld

  • Du führst starke Discovery- und Qualifizierungsgespräche: Du verstehst das Buchhaltungs- und Finanz-Setup eines Unternehmens, erkennst Pain Points, Dringlichkeit und Entscheider:innen und beurteilst, ob eine Anfrage zu Pennylane passt

  • Du arbeitest mit hoher Eigenverantwortung, Follow-up-Disziplin und CRM-Sorgfalt: hohes Lead-Volumen, saubere Salesforce-Daten, hochwertige Übergaben an die AEs

  • Du bist neugierig, kundenorientiert und ein:e starke:r aktive:r Zuhörer:in – du stellst die richtigen Fragen und gibst dich nicht mit Oberflächenantworten zufrieden

  • Du bist resilient, diszipliniert und proaktiv: Du gehst souverän mit Absagen um, bleibst beim Nachfassen dran und hältst in einem schnellen Sales-Umfeld ein hohes Tempo

  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau und verhandlungssicheres Englisch (unsere Unternehmenssprache)

  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Inbound-Qualifizierung und Salesforce, Verständnis für Buchhaltungs-, Finanz- oder ERP-Prozesse, Erfahrung im Verkauf an Steuerberater:innen, Finanzteams oder Geschäftsinhaber:innen – und Französischkenntnisse

Was wir bieten

  • 📄 Unbefristeter Vollzeitvertrag, Start zum 1. Januar 2027 oder früher

  • 🏢 Hybrides Arbeiten: 2 Tage pro Woche (Montag und Donnerstag) in unserem Berliner Office, die übrigen Tage flexibel; gelegentliche Reisen

  • 🎓 Strukturiertes Onboarding: Sales Academy, Buddy-Programm und Shadowing

  • 🚀 Entwicklungsperspektive in Richtung Account Executive – abhängig von Leistung und offenen Positionen

  • 🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage.

  • 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

  • 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

  • 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

  • 🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

  • 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

  • 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

  • 🌍 Ein internationales Team mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten und ein starkes, gut finanziertes Mutterunternehmen in Frankreich

🤝 Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Kennenlerngespräch mit Mirko, Recruiter (30 Min.)

  2. Zweites Gespräch mit Jacob, Global Head of Sales SME (30 Min.)

  3. Praktische Case Study und Debrief mit Jacob, Global Head of Sales SME, und einem Mitglied des Sales-SME-Teams (45 Min.) – wir schauen auf Discovery-Qualität, Gesprächsführung und Struktur

title: Secretaris Adviesraad | Publieke Sector
descriptionHtml:
Omschrijving

Wij zijn voor een onafhankelijke organisatie in het publieke domein op zoek naar een Secretaris van de Adviesraad.
De organisatie fungeert als onafhankelijk adviesplatform en kennismotor voor cultuurbeleid binnen een grote gemeente. De secretaris vervult een centrale rol in de ondersteuning van de adviesraad en opereert op het snijvlak van strategie, bestuur en beleid.
In deze opdracht ben je verantwoordelijk voor de inhoudelijke en procesmatige regie van adviestrajecten. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van adviezen, ondersteunt de bestuurlijke besluitvorming en geeft operationeel leiding aan een compact bureau. Daarnaast fungeer je als strategische sparringpartner van de voorzitter en draag je bij aan de positionering en impact van de adviesraad binnen het publieke domein.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Regisseren, ontwerpen, plannen en bewaken van adviestrajecten.

  • Coördineren van zowel gevraagde als ongevraagde adviezen.

  • Monitoren van politieke en maatschappelijke ontwikkelingen en vertalen naar strategische advieskansen.

  • Zorgen voor kwalitatief hoogwaardige, bestuurlijk bruikbare adviesnota’s.

  • Analyseren en samenbrengen van input van verschillende stakeholders, onderzoeken en beleidsinformatie.

  • Operationeel aansturen van een compact team van beleidsmedewerkers, onderzoekers en ondersteunende medewerkers.

  • Voorbereiden van bestuurlijke besluitvorming, begrotingen en contracten.

  • Fungeren als strategische rechterhand van de voorzitter.


Wat vragen wij?

Eisen:

  • Academisch werk- en denkniveau.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring in een strategische, adviserende of vergelijkbare functie binnen een politiek-bestuurlijke omgeving.

  • Grondige kennis van gemeentelijke beleids- en begrotingscycli.

  • Ervaring met bestuurlijke advisering en complexe besluitvormingsprocessen.

  • Uitstekende schriftelijke vaardigheden en ervaring met het opstellen van beleids- en adviesdocumenten.

  • Sterk analytisch vermogen en het vermogen om complexe vraagstukken te vertalen naar heldere beleidsconclusies.

Aanvullende wensen:

  • Kennis van en affiniteit met het culturele domein.

  • Ervaring met het verbinden van uiteenlopende stakeholders en belangen.

  • Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van strategische adviezen in een maatschappelijke context.

  • Inzicht in de dynamiek tussen formele organisaties en informele netwerken.

Competenties

  • Politiek-bestuurlijke sensitiviteit.

  • Analytisch en synthetiserend vermogen.

  • Sterke schriftelijke en communicatieve vaardigheden.

  • Verbindend en inclusief leiderschap.

  • Organisatiesensitiviteit.

  • Proactieve en strategische instelling.

Informatie

Start: zo snel mogelijk.

Aantal uur: 32 - 36 uur per week.

Locatie: Rotterdam

Vorm: detachering, met zicht op een vaste functie.

Graag ontvangen wij jouw CV voor vrijdag 30 oktober 17:00 met contactgegevens en de beschikbaarheid. Wij geven je op korte termijn een inhoudelijke reactie op jouw interesse in de interim opdracht.

title: Security engineer, application security (UK)
descriptionHtml:
🚀 About WRITER

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance.

Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com.

📐 About the role

This is where security meets innovation at enterprise scale. As a security engineer, applications at WRITER, you'll be building the security foundations that protect the AI systems powering some of the world's most recognizable brands. You'll work at the intersection of application security, AI infrastructure, and developer enablement—partnering with engineering teams to embed security into every line of code while ensuring our platform remains both powerful and trustworthy.

The opportunity is massive: you'll help define how enterprise AI applications are secured, from threat modeling our LLM architectures to building automated security controls that scale across our growing platform. This isn't about saying "no"—it's about finding creative ways to say "yes, and here's how we do it securely." You'll tackle challenges that most security engineers never encounter: securing AI agents, protecting training data pipelines, and designing controls for systems that didn't exist a few years ago.

This role is hybrid from our London office, reporting to the head of security engineering.

🦸🏻‍♀️ What you'll do

  • Build security into the DNA of our AI platform by conducting threat modeling sessions with product teams, designing secure architectures for new features, and ensuring security considerations shape product decisions from day one—not after the fact

  • Own and evolve our application security program including establish and maintain SAST/DAST scanning in CI/CD pipelines, conducting security code reviews for critical changes, and building automation that catches vulnerabilities before they reach production

  • Partner with engineering teams to establish and champion secure coding standards, creating reusable security patterns and libraries that make it easier for developers to build securely by default

  • Design and recommend security features and products that help secure customer environments. You are the advocate and the vision for how we protect and secure customers..

  • Integrate and leverage AI agents to help increase velocity for the security team and the overarching engineering org to ensure that we are proactive in minimizing risk while we build products

  • Lead security assessments and penetration testing of WRITER's applications, AI services, and APIs, identifying vulnerabilities across our tech stack and working collaboratively with teams to remediate issues at scale

  • Design and implement security controls for protecting data pipelines, model training environments, and customer-facing AI agents

  • Stay ahead of emerging threats in the AI/ML security landscape, researching attack vectors specific to LLMs and generative AI, and proactively building defenses against novel risks

⭐️ What you need

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in application security engineering, with a proven track record of securing large-scale production systems—bonus points if you've worked in fast-growing startups or high-growth environments

  • Understanding of developer experience and developer workflows for shipping features and products. You care deeply about reducing risk while considering velocity of engineers.

  • Technical expertise in at least two programming languages (Python, Java, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript) and the ability to read and review code across multiple languages, understanding both business logic and security implications

  • Knowledge of security tools and methodologies including SAST/DAST solutions, vulnerability management platforms, security testing frameworks, and DevSecOps practices—you know which tools to use and when automation beats manual review

  • Excellent communication skills that allow you to translate complex security concepts into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences—you can explain why something matters and motivate teams to action

  • A builder's mindset that looks for opportunities to automate, scale, and empower rather than create bottlenecks—you understand that security enables the business, not blocks it

  • Alignment with WRITER's values of Connect (building strong relationships across teams), Challenge (pushing the boundaries of what's possible in AI security), and Own (taking end-to-end responsibility for the security of our platform)

    🍩 Benefits & perks (UK full-time employees):

    • Generous PTO, plus company holidays

    • Comprehensive medical and dental insurance

    • Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks)

    • Fertility and family planning support

    • Competitive pension scheme and company contribution

    • Annual work-life stipends for:

      • Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc.

      • Learning and development stipend

    • Company-wide off-sites and team off-sites

    • Competitive compensation and company stock options

title: Security GRC Lead TL1
descriptionHtml:
Job title: Security GRC Lead

Location: London or Bristol 

Level: TL1

Team: Security 

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Head of Information Security 

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

Where in the world of Kaluza will I be working? 

You'll be joining the Information & Cyber Security team, a core part of our Platform & Security Engineering organisation. Security at Kaluza isn't a silo — you'll work closely with colleagues across security engineering, identity and access management, platform engineering and enterprise technical services.

As the Security GRC Lead, you will serve as the accountable operational owner for Kaluza’s Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance capability. You will establish and maintain a unified Common Control Framework, lead regulatory and framework readiness (including SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, and ISO 22301), and work with engineering teams to demonstrate effective implementation of controls.

A core focus of this role is acting as the primary information security bridge to Kaluza’s central Risk & Compliance team. You will closely collaborate with them to assess the impact of evolving security and privacy regulations, ensuring regulatory risks are clearly quantified, actionable, and seamlessly integrated into the wider enterprise risk framework.

What you will be doing

  • Regulatory Impact & Horizon Scanning: Collaborate closely with the Risk & Compliance team to monitor, evaluate, and interpret emerging regulatory changes in the information security, privacy, and critical infrastructure domains.

  • Security Impact Assessments: Translate complex regulatory developments into actionable security control requirements and risk assessments for Kaluza, specifically covering:

    • Sector & Critical Infrastructure Regulations: NIS2, AESCSF, NCSC Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF), and the UK Cyber Security and Resilience Bill.

    • Emerging Tech & Governance Standards: AI management and governance expectations (ISO 42001).

  • Enterprise Risk Integration: Partner with Risk & Compliance to ensure security and resilience risks, control gaps, and regulatory exposures seamlessly flow into and align with the enterprise risk management (ERM) framework. Maintain high data accuracy across the security risk register to support board-level visibility.

  • Common Control Framework: Design, build, and maintain a single Common Control Framework (anchored initially on ISO 27001 Annex A) mapped across all regulatory, framework, and client contractual requirements.

  • Standards & Policy Suite: Help continuously improve Kaluza's security policy and standards library.

  • Continuous Control Monitoring: Shift Kaluza from point-in-time evidence gathering to automated control monitoring using commercial GRC platforms (e.g., Vanta), making audit readiness a natural byproduct of daily operations.

  • SOC 2 Type 2 Programme: Lead the gap assessment, control build-out, and sustained observation period required for Kaluza’s SOC 2 Type 2 commitment.

  • Standards Maintenance: Oversee continuous alignment with ISO 27001 and ISO 22301 to prevent posture drift between annual audit cycles.

  • Governance Reporting: Draft security reporting for internal leadership committees and forums, ensuring alignment with enterprise-wide reporting standards set by Risk & Compliance.

  • Client Security Assurance: Own client security reporting commitments and streamline response workflows for client questionnaires and external audits.

  • External Partner Coordination: Direct and manage external GRC consultants (e.g., Cydea) to execute audit operations and supplier assessments efficiently.

What you will have

  • Core Framework Expertise: Hands-on experience implementing and managing ISO 27001, ISO 22301, and SOC 2 Type 2 frameworks.

  • Regulatory Horizon Scanning: Sound understanding of UK/EU cybersecurity laws, critical infrastructure mandates (e.g., NIS2, CSRB, CAF), and emerging tech governance.

  • Tooling & Risk Management: Experience working with automated GRC platforms (e.g., Vanta, Drata) and managing risk registers aligned with enterprise risk taxonomies.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated experience partnering with enterprise Risk, Legal, or Compliance teams to analyze and operationalize complex regulatory requirements.

We would still encourage you to apply even if you don’t have experience of all of the above - we look for potential as much as skills fit.

Leadership & communication

You’ll be…

  • Strongly aligned with the principle of "business value over compliance-for-its-own-sake", focusing on practical, lean governance rather than administrative overhead.

  • Able to build strong bridges across central Risk & Compliance, technical engineering teams, senior leadership, and enterprise clients.

  • A proactive leader comfortable establishing an integrated GRC capability from design through to execution.

  • A pragmatic decision-maker who takes into account the short & long-term commercial, people & process costs and consequences of those decisions

  • Accomplished at influencing (within teams, as well as upwards and outwards), using a mixture of communications skills

  • Skilled in bringing alignment, clarity of thought and direction to information security, compliance and engineering challenges

Why Join Kaluza in This Role?

Strategic Enterprise Impact: You will shape how security governance interfaces with central Risk & Compliance, directly influencing Kaluza's posture across international energy markets.

Unlocking Technical Innovation: Your work takes compliance administration away from senior engineers, enabling them to focus on core platform innovation like AI security architecture and multi-tenant scaling. You’ll leverage AI-assisted tooling to synthesize and reconcile control evidence from multiple operational systems with human oversight, helping us accelerate & innovate within the compliance domain.

Growth Capability: As the accountable owner of GRC, you will establish the foundation and build the business case for expanding the security GRC team as Kaluza scales.

 

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: Senior Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Location

London (UK)

Working Pattern

This is a hybrid role. Candidates should expect to spend 3 days per week in the London office.

Role Overview

You will own a portfolio of smaller and mid-sized financial services clients and be accountable for retention, expansion and advocacy. You will report to the Head of Sales.

Many of these accounts started with a narrow scope. Your job is to grow them into broader, multi-module relationships by deepening adoption, landing new use cases and modules, and turning satisfied clients into references.

Your primary measure is net revenue retention (NRR): gross retention plus expansion annual recurring revenue (ARR).

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio and Renewals

Own a named portfolio of financial services clients: renewals, expansion and commercial relationships end to end.

Run structured renewal processes early, protecting gross retention and removing surprises.

Keep forecast and customer relationship management (CRM) data in HubSpot accurate. We run on data, not optimism.

Account Planning and Expansion

Build account plans that map each client's regulatory agenda, such as the Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA), Consumer Duty, the Senior Managers and Certification Regime (SM&CR) and operational resilience, to where Decision Focus can add value next.

Identify, qualify and close expansion opportunities: new modules, entities, business units and geographies.

Client Relationships

Build multi-threaded relationships from practitioner to executive sponsor, and lead quarterly or annual business reviews.

Work with risk, compliance and operational resilience leaders and, as accounts grow, at Chief Risk Officer (CRO) and Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) level.

Advocacy and Client Insight

Work closely with Pre-sales, Customer Success, Product and Partnerships.

Feed structured client insight back to Product and Marketing so that what clients ask for shapes a more repeatable proposition.

Develop references, case studies and advocates that help the new business team win.

Candidate Profile

Experience

Proven experience in an account management or business-to-business (B2B) software sales role, with at least five years selling into financial services (banks, insurers, asset managers or pension providers).

Experience working in a scaling organisation, ideally within a technology, software as a service (SaaS) or high-growth environment.

A track record of hitting retention and expansion targets, with numbers you can talk through.

Enough working knowledge of the regulation your clients face to hold a credible conversation with a Head of Compliance or a CRO.

Experience selling governance, risk and compliance (GRC), regulatory technology (RegTech) or risk software would help but is not essential, and neither is experience of long, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles.

Experience in the Nordic, DACH (Germany, Austria and Switzerland) or French markets, a Nordic language, German or French, or exposure to a structured sales methodology such as MEDDICC would also help.

Capabilities and Approach

Intelligent and curious: you want to understand the client's business, not just the renewal date.

Commercially sharp: you protect value and know when to walk away from a bad deal.

Credible with senior people, and pleasant to work with internally.

Comfortable operating with autonomy in a scale-up: you build the process where none exists yet.

Clear, concise written and spoken English: you can write a board-ready business case.

High standards and ownership: you finish what you start.

Background

Likely currently working in account management, selling software into financial services.

Looking for ownership of client relationships from day one, and a clear path to larger, strategic accounts, with a short line to the leadership team.

Compensation and Benefits

Competitive market salary.

30 days of annual leave.

8% employer pension contribution.

Additional Information

Decision Focus is a European-owned GRC SaaS company serving regulated financial services firms across the UK, the Nordics and the US. We are profitable and commercially disciplined.

We are a lean team. That means real independence, direct access to senior leadership and clients, and a high bar for everyone. We are moving from complex, bespoke sales cycles towards growth that is more repeatable and product-led, and we want people who will help shape that shift.

This position offers high visibility, autonomy, and the chance to shape how account management works as we scale.
