title: Senior adviseur geotechniek
descriptionHtml:
Jouw impact bij Movares

Jij zorgt met jouw geotechnisch advies dat civiele projecten veilig, uitvoerbaar en toekomstbestendig gerealiseerd kunnen worden.

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

  • Je werkt aan geotechnische analyses, adviezen en ontwerpen voor civiele en infrastructurele projecten.

  • Je pakt, afhankelijk van je ervaring, projecten zelfstandig op, van vraagstelling tot advies en ontwerp.

  • Je bent sparringpartner voor collega’s en opdrachtgevers bij complexe geotechnische vraagstukken.

Als senior adviseur geotechniek werk je aan uiteenlopende civiele en infrastructurele projecten, van spoor- en railinfrastructuur tot civiele constructies en waterbouwkundige werken. Je combineert technische analyses met advies en vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar veilige, uitvoerbare en duurzame oplossingen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met opdrachtgevers en collega's. Binnen het team deel je jouw expertise en begeleid je, afhankelijk van je ervaring, ook junior adviseurs inhoudelijk.

Dit ben jij bij Movares

Je bent een ervaren geotechnisch adviseur die verder kijkt dan zijn eigen berekening. Je overziet het geheel, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en weet collega’s daarin mee te nemen. Je vindt het leuk om kennis te delen en bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van collega’s en het team.

Werk je nu bij een gespecialiseerd bureau en mis je de breedte van projecten, de invloed op inhoudelijke keuzes of de ruimte om collega’s te begeleiden? Of wil je jouw geotechnische expertise inzetten in projecten met grote maatschappelijke impact? Dan past deze rol goed bij jou.

Dit breng je ook mee:

  • meerdere jaren ervaring binnen de geotechniek, passend bij een medior- of seniorrol;

  • ervaring met Deltares-software (D-serie); ervaring met Plaxis is een pre, net zoals affiniteit met lijninfrastructuur;

  • sterke schriftelijke en mondelinge vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als Engels.

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je aan opgaven die Nederland verder helpen. Tegelijk krijg je de ruimte om je werk en loopbaan in te richten op een manier die bij jou past. Met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, veel flexibiliteit en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen.

Een sterk fundament

Een goede basis begint bij voorwaarden waarop je kunt rekenen:

  • een salaris tussen € 4.650 en € 7.580 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

  • een flexibele pot van minimaal 15% van je jaarsalaris, inclusief vakantiegeld;

  • een goede pensioenregeling bij Zwitserleven, waarbij Movares twee derde van de pensioenpremie betaalt;

  • een NS Business Card voor woon-werkverkeer en zakelijke reizen. Privé profiteer je met de kaart van de dalurenkorting.

Maximaal flexibel

Vorm een manier van werken die aansluit bij jouw leven én jouw ambities. Maak keuzes die bij jou passen:

  • flexibel werken volgens ons Any Time Any Place-principe, passend bij je team, klanten en projecten;

  • De mogelijkheid om twee weken per jaar te werken vanaf je vakantieadres binnen de EU;

  • 20 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen vanuit je flexibele pot;

  • met je flexibele pot kies je wat voor jou belangrijk is, bijvoorbeeld voor extra inkomen, pensioen, een fiets, bedrijfsfitness, verduurzaming van je woning of het aflossen van je studieschuld;

  • € 750 budget per vijf jaar om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten;

  • € 2,45 netto thuiswerkvergoeding per thuiswerkdag.

Veel ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • Ontwikkel een loopbaan die past bij jouw talenten en ambities. Kies jouw eigen pad:

  • ruimte om je expertise, ambitie en loopbaan verder te ontwikkelen;

  • leren door te doen, samen met ervaren collega's en met gebruik van een breed aanbod aan ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • de kans om actief kennis te delen en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van ons vakgebied.

Samen groeien

Deel mee in de waarde die we samen creëren en de groei van onze organisatie. Samen voor succes:

  • je flexibele pot groeit mee met de resultaten van Movares;

  • een winstdeling met een doelbedrag van 5% van je brutojaarsalaris, afhankelijk van de resultaten;

  • en de mogelijkheid tot participeren in de waardeontwikkeling van Movares door middel van aankoop van phantom-aandelen.

Jouw team bij Movares

Je werkt samen met een hechte groep geotechnische adviseurs die elkaar makkelijk weten te vinden. Eén dag per week – op woensdag – werken jullie sowieso samen op kantoor in Utrecht. Daarnaast is twee dagen per week op kantoor gangbaar, maar stemmen we locatie en werktijden flexibel af. Er is altijd iemand aanwezig en de lijnen zijn kort.

De sfeer in het team is open en gelijkwaardig. Er is weinig hiërarchie: senioriteit gaat hier niet over ‘boven iemand staan’, maar over kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Collega’s kunnen goed met elkaar opschieten, schakelen snel en staan voor elkaar klaar. Samenwerken doen we bewust, omdat we geloven dat je daar betere oplossingen van maakt.

title: Senior AI Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
About GeneralMind

GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics.

Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments.

We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer who treats LLMs as production software, not as magic. Someone who can own the agent layer of our platform end to end - from prompt and context design, through tool use and orchestration, to evals, reliability, and continuous improvement in live customer environments.

This role sits at the intersection of two things that are rarely mastered together: shipping LLM-powered systems that actually work in messy enterprise reality, and the discipline of a real engineer - evals, observability, cost, latency, failure modes. Models get smarter every month. What stays scarce is the engineering judgment to make them reliably useful on top of SAP, Oracle, and the mess of real operational data.

You will be a senior individual contributor working directly with the founders. The person in this role won’t be handed a roadmap - they’ll help define it, and build the AI practice around it.

What you will do

AI Ownership

  • Own the agent layer end-to-end: prompt and context design, tool use, orchestration, evals, and long-term technical direction.

  • Be the person who understands why an agent made the decision it made - and who other engineers come to when a model behaves in ways they can’t explain.

  • Set the bar on how we build with LLMs: eval-driven development, context engineering, structured outputs, cost and latency discipline.

  • Make foundational decisions with conviction - which model, which pattern, which guardrail - document the reasoning, and evolve them as the system grows.

LLM Systems in Production

  • Design agents that survive real enterprise environments: ambiguous inputs, flaky upstream systems, exception cases that weren’t in anyone’s spec.

  • Build the eval harness that lets us ship confidently: offline evals, online evals, regression suites, human-in-the-loop review.

  • Think in failure modes: hallucinations, silent drift, prompt injection, tool misuse. Build the detection before you need it.

  • Own cost and latency as first-class product requirements, not afterthoughts.

Agent & Context Engineering

  • Design agent architectures that compose cleanly: tool selection, state, memory, planning, escalation.

  • Build the context layer that makes agents actually useful on top of SAP and Oracle data - retrieval, grounding, schema awareness, auditability.

  • Evolve agents without breaking live customer deployments; manage prompt and model versioning with intention.

  • Know when the right answer is a bigger model, a better prompt, a fine-tune, a tool, or just classical code.

Reliability & Systems Thinking

  • Detect regressions in agent behavior before a customer does; build the evals and observability to catch them early.

  • Own the operational posture of the AI systems you ship: alerting, runbooks, replay, on-call readiness.

  • Identify structural debt in prompts, pipelines, and context before it compounds; refactor with thought.

What we are looking for

  • Experience: 6+ years building production software, with clear ownership of LLM-powered systems in real customer environments - not demos, not notebooks.

  • LLM depth: Non-negotiable. You’ve shipped agents or LLM features that run on live traffic. You have strong opinions about prompting, context, tool use, structured outputs, and what breaks in production.

  • Evals as a first instinct: You don’t ship LLM code without a way to measure it. You’ve built eval pipelines that actually catch regressions, not just vibes.

  • Python depth: You’re fluent in Python and comfortable in production service codebases. You make deliberate calls about async, framework choice, and performance.

  • Reliability instinct: Hallucination containment, idempotency on tool calls, graceful degradation when a model is wrong - part of how you design, not patched in later.

  • End-to-end ownership: You’re comfortable being the person who holds the full agent picture - from prompt to production incident. You identify what’s broken or missing before you’re asked.

  • A real spike: We’re a strong team with broad coverage. What we’re hiring for is someone who brings a 10x improvement in an area we’re currently underinvested in. That might be agent evaluation, context engineering on enterprise data, agentic reliability, deep NLP/LLM internals, or domain-specific grounding. We don’t know exactly what shape it takes - but you should know what yours is, and be able to articulate why it matters.

title: Senior AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity.

Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance.

We were founded by former operators and builders with deep experience in banking, payments, and lending. Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, and OakNorth.

Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures.

 

Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our team. You will own the systems that connect our models to our product: the data pipelines that feed them, the context they work with, the multi-agent systems they run in, and the metrics that tell us whether they work. You'll set the standards and patterns our team builds on and work closely with our ML and backend engineers to take AI functionality from prototype to reliable, production-grade systems.

As an early-stage startup, we pride ourselves on our ability to roll up our sleeves and build from scratch. You’ll ship code frequently, iterate quickly based on feedback, and still meet the stringent security, performance, and uptime requirements our clients expect.

We all love to build, scale, and grow: our leadership team has a strong track record of building products, scaling teams, and driving growth, and our ambitious engineers join us from leading tech companies and unicorns.

If you’re passionate about building the foundations that make AI products reliable, measurable, and fast to iterate on, this role is for you. You’ll have a meaningful opportunity to shape our engineering culture from the ground up.

What you'll do

  • Own the data pipelines behind our AI platform end to end, turning register data and web content into parsed, structured data with a full audit trail and strong data-quality checks

  • Build the context management layer that decides what our agents and LLMs see, balancing relevance, token budgets, memory, and cost

  • Build the harnesses our agents run in: the agent loop, tool calling, context assembly, guardrails and tracing

  • Design and build multi-agent and autonomous agent systems, including the agent-to-agent interfaces that let our agents hand work to each other reliably

  • Develop evaluation pipelines and production metrics for LLM and data quality, so every change to a model, prompt, or pipeline can be measured before and after it ships

  • Run and harden our LLM integrations in production, with robust fallbacks, rate limiting, caching, cost tracking, and observability

  • Set up MLOps practices such as CI/CD for ML components, versioning of prompts, models, and datasets, and safe rollouts

  • Work closely with ML and backend engineers to turn prototypes into reliable production services with clean interfaces

Composed of nine nationalities and operating from hubs in France, North America, and Israel, we believe in great science and fast achievements. Our work is guided by these core principles:

  2. High velocity: speed matters. We move quickly, one step at a time.

What you’ll do

Design high-performance analog and mixed-signal ICs optimized for precision, power, and area, driving Arago’s prototype and product iterations from architecture to silicon validation.

Responsibilities

  • Design and simulate analog and RF integrated circuits, including critical blocks such as amplifiers, mixers, PLLs, ADCs, DACs, and bias/reference circuits, with a focus on signal integrity, linearity, and precision.

  • Optimize circuits for power, area, and performance trade-offs, ensuring designs meet system-level requirements across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) variations.

  • Collaborate closely with optics, simulation and PCB teams to define architecture and block-level specifications for Arago’s successive prototypes and product iterations, ensuring tight alignment with overall performance and integration goals.

Required Skills and Experience

  • A sound mathematical understanding and deep physical intuition of analog electronics, as well as analog voltage-to-current and current-to-voltage conversion at low and high frequencies.

  • Extensive experience in IC design and post-layout design methodology using standard industry tools like Cadence Virtuoso.

  • Proficiency in designing and optimizing mixed-signal circuits, including DACs and ADCs at low (kHz-MHz) and high (>GHz) frequencies, and signal conditioning circuits, ensuring flawless integration between analog RF components and digital processors.

  • Strong understanding of signal integrity, crosstalk, and noise reduction techniques in mixed-signal environments, particularly in high-frequency RF systems interfacing with digital processors.

  • Advanced node experience required (<28nm).

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Introducer Tech builds the systems that partners in Germany use to refer businesses to iwoca. The aim is to get new partners integrated quickly and to make applying simple for their customers. The team also looks after how partners earn commission.

Its work covers three main areas:

  • The Lending API. Developing the versioned API and the webhooks that keep partners up to date on their customers.

  • The Introducer Portal. Building the web app that German brokers log in to, to submit applications and upload documents.

  • The sign-up journey. Improving how businesses apply and how well they convert, after a partner referral.

The team is growing to have two product managers, who each focus on either the broker or the partner flow, and three engineers across the backend and frontend, including this hire.

The team currently works in sprints, with three stand-ups a week and planning every two weeks. However, there is room to adapt how it works as it grows.

The role

You'll be the senior engineer behind iwoca's broker and partner channels in Germany, from the tools partners integrate with to the internal systems that broker account managers use.

Ownership and autonomy

  • Own the Lending API in Germany end to end, deciding what to build, when to release a new version, when to retire an old one, and what iwoca can promise partners.

  • Own the developer portal and every tool partners use to integrate, from documentation that their developers and coding agents can build from to self-serve testing that needs no help from iwoca.

Impact

  • Ship the features that make partners choose iwoca, starting with pre-qualification, which shows a customer what they could borrow before they apply.

  • Automate parts of the broker funnel and the internal CRM that broker account managers use, cutting friction and the lag between a decision and the action that follows, and building agents wherever they help.

Growth trajectory

You'll work with the commercial colleagues who bring in new partners, and join the team's weekly support rotation.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Backend engineering. You've designed and built production backend systems in Python – ideally with Django, though FastAPI or Flask count too. You've used PostgreSQL or another relational database in production, and kept it fast and maintainable.

  • API design. You've built and evolved APIs that other teams or companies depend on, and made the decisions on structure, versioning, and change.

  • Ownership. You've taken work from a commercial problem through to production – scoping the solution, making the trade-offs, and iterating based on how people use it.

  • Mentoring. You've helped other engineers grow through code reviews and design sessions.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

The salary

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

title: Senior Bilanzbuchhalter*in (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Werde Teil unseres Teams

Apaleo ist die offene Hospitality-Plattform, die Hotels die Freiheit gibt, ihre Technologie so zusammenzustellen, wie sie sie wirklich brauchen. Wir waren von Anfang an API-first, und jetzt denken wir unsere Plattform AI-first weiter: Mit Agent Hub, dem ersten KI-Agenten-Marktplatz der Hotellerie, geben wir Hotels die Freiheit, autonome Agenten für ihr Business einzusetzen. Denselben Anspruch haben wir an unser eigenes Finance: Wir bauen es konsequent AI-native auf.

Dafür suchen wir eine*n Senior Bilanzbuchhalter*in, die oder der fundiertes Buchhaltungs-Know-how mit echter Begeisterung für agentische Workflows verbindet und mit uns Strukturen, Prozesse und Kontrollen für ein skalierbares Finance aufbaut. Du übernimmst zunächst eigenverantwortlich das operative Tagesgeschäft in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem dreiköpfigen Finance-Team. Mittelfristig verschiebt sich dein Fokus vom Buchen zum Orchestrieren: KI-Agenten übernehmen Belegverarbeitung, Kontierung und Abstimmungen, du definierst die Regeln, überwachst die Ergebnisse und verantwortest Qualität und Compliance als Human in the Loop. Mittelfristig gestaltest du mit uns den Weg zu einem AI-native Accounting- und ERP-Setup und wirst zur zentralen Ansprechperson für alle buchhalterischen Fragen bei Apaleo.

So bringst du dich ein:

  • Du bearbeitest eigenverantwortlich sämtliche in der Finanzbuchhaltung anfallenden Geschäftsvorfälle (Rechnungskontrolle, Debitoren-, Kreditoren-, Anlagen-, Sachkonten- und Bankbuchhaltung) und stellst eine jederzeit prüfungssichere, GoBD-konforme Datenbasis für Reporting und Steuerung sicher.

  • Du konzipierst und implementierst agentische Workflows für wiederkehrende Prozesse wie Belegerfassung, Kontierung, Bankabstimmung, Rückstellungen und Intercompany und gestaltest damit, wie sich deine eigene Rolle über die Zeit entwickelt: weg vom manuellen Buchen, hin zum Orchestrieren, Überwachen und Freigeben der Arbeit von KI-Agenten.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit externen Steuerberater*innen und Wirtschaftsprüfer*innen zusammen.
  • Du gestaltest mit, wie sich unser Finance-Tech-Stack mittelfristig zu einem AI-native Accounting- und ERP-Setup entwickelt: von Tool-Auswahl und Datenmodell über saubere Stammdaten und Schnittstellen bis zu skalierbaren End-to-End-Prozessen, die mit uns mitwachsen.
  • Du wirst über Zeit zur zentralen Ansprechperson für alle buchhalterischen Fragen bei Apaleo und bringst die Erfahrung und Übersicht mit, um Themen auch über dein eigenes Gebiet hinaus einzuordnen.

Das bringst du mit:

Must-haves

  • Abgeschlossene Aus-/Weiterbildung zum/zur Bilanzbuchhalter*in (IHK) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, mit mehrjähriger praktischer Erfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung.
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse im deutschen Handelsrecht (HGB); IFRS-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
  • Sehr gute DATEV- und Excel-Kenntnisse sowie ein ausgeprägtes Prozess- und Systemverständnis: Du denkst in Datenflüssen, nicht in Einzelbuchungen.
  • Erfahrung mit Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen unter echtem Zeit- und Deadlinedruck im Unternehmen.
  • Nahezu muttersprachliches Deutsch (für die Kommunikation mit Steuerberater*innen, Wirtschaftsprüfer*innen und Behörden sowie für statutarische Meldungen) und gutes Arbeitsenglisch (für die Zusammenarbeit mit Legal und weiteren internationalen Stakeholdern).
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige und proaktive Arbeitsweise, du sprichst Unklarheiten direkt an, statt sie auflaufen zu lassen.
  • Du bist mindestens zweimal pro Woche in unserem Büro in München, idealerweise wohnst du bereits in München oder im Umkreis.
  • Du bist komfortabel mit Prozessambiguität und schnellem Wandel, triffst pragmatische 80/20-Entscheidungen und lieferst gleichzeitig hohe Qualität, wo es darauf ankommt.
  • Echte Neugier auf KI: Du nutzt Tools wie ChatGPT oder Claude bereits im Arbeitsalltag, prüfst ihre Ergebnisse kritisch und willst Prozesse grundlegend neu denken, statt sie nur zu digitalisieren.

Nice-to-haves

Das kannst du von uns erwarten:

  • Ein vielfältiges und internationales Team – Arbeite mit engagierten Experten aus verschiedenen Fachbereichen und mit unterschiedlichem Hintergrund zusammen und entwickele eine wirklich globale Lösung.

Bereit, mit uns durchzustarten?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Du kannst Dich direkt über unsere Karriereseite mit Deinem Lebenslauf bewerben.

Warum Apaleo?

Bei Apaleo zu arbeiten bedeutet mehr als nur eine Stelle anzutreten: Es geht darum, echte Veränderungen in der Hotellerie voranzutreiben. Deine Beiträge gestalten unsere innovative, API-first und zunehmend AI-first Plattform direkt mit, beeinflussen unternehmensweite Entscheidungen und helfen, die Zukunft der Hospitality-Technologie neu zu definieren. Bei Apaleo zählt deine Meinung, deine Ideen werden geschätzt, und dein Einfluss ist spürbar. Werde Teil eines Teams, in dem deine Arbeit den Fortschritt vorantreibt, Zusammenarbeit Innovationen hervorbringt und Wachstum ein gemeinsames Ziel ist.

Wir sind stolz darauf, ein Arbeitgeber zu sein, der Chancengleichheit und Gleichstellung fördert und sich für einen vielfältigen, integrativen und einladenden Arbeitsplatz einsetzt. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Herkunft, unabhängig von Rasse, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlechtsidentität oder -ausdruck, Geschlecht, nationaler Herkunft, Alter, Familienstand, Behinderung oder anderen Merkmalen, die durch geltendes Recht geschützt sind. Deine personenbezogenen Daten werden mit größter Sorgfalt und in Übereinstimmung mit der DSGVO und den einschlägigen Datenschutzbestimmungen behandelt. Wir begrüßen Unterschiede und glauben, dass Vielfalt unser Team bereichert und Innovationen vorantreibt.

title: Senior BMS Software Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

In this BMS Software Engineer role, you will join the VÆRIDION Airborne Software team within the Technology division. You will be responsible to lead the design of software required for our propulsion battery management and power distribution for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft. Your contributions will be instrumental in ensuring the safety, reliability, and performance of the High Voltage Propulsion Battery System at the core of VÆRIDION’s novel propulsion system.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the design, development, and implementation of embedded software for propulsion battery and power distribution from prototypes to future airworthy systems.

  • Implement software development processes and toolchains in compliance with aviation standards and regulations.

  • Define and document software requirements, specifications, and interfaces for the high voltage electrical power system.

  • Collaborate closely with cell, electrical, and thermal engineers to integrate algorithms for battery state estimation, cell balancing, fault detection, power control, and thermal management.

  • Conduct thorough testing and validation of the software, including integration testing with other aircraft systems.

  • Support system integration, iron bird/field testing, and certification efforts, providing expertise on software functionality and performance.

  • Stay current with advancements in battery technology, software development methodologies, and aviation regulations.

 

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field. A Master's degree is preferred.

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in software development, with a focus on embedded systems and real-time applications.

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in software design, with a focus on embedded systems and real-time applications.

  • Proven track record of designing and implementing software for safety-critical systems, preferably in the aerospace or comparable safety-critical industries.

  • Strong proficiency in C/C++ programming languages and experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS).

  • Experience with battery management systems, electric propulsion, power electronics, or related fields is highly desirable.

  • Familiarity with aviation standards such as RTCA DO-178C and DO-254 is a plus.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to convey complex technical concepts to cross-functional teams.

  • Fluent English language skills are essential, fluent German or other language would be beneficial.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Senior Business Development Representative
descriptionHtml:
About Taktile

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator.

About the Role

As a Senior Business Development Representative at Taktile, you'll drive AI adoption in Financial Services by engaging future customers in their very first interactions with us and identifying new market opportunities. It’s a pivotal role that enables our sales team to focus on high-value, revenue-generating activities and is powered by leveraging your creativity, charm, grit, and strategic thinking.

You will:

  • Own pipeline-generating activities in your territory and outreach to strategic prospects to generate high-intent opportunities with Mid-Market and Enterprise companies

  • Support the development and execution of strategic outbound initiatives

  • Lead our attendance at major conferences and host dinners to meet industry leaders across the world

  • Collaborate with the marketing, growth, and sales teams, and bring in leads applying qualification frameworks such as PACTT.

  • Be supported by an ever-developing AI toolstack to automate the busywork and focus on using your brain

  • Conduct initial qualifications for high-potential leads

Joining us will be a great decision if you:

  • You are creative and proactive, always looking for ways to stand out with prospects and to improve the way we do things

  • You are customer-focused and convincing in live conversations (phone, video, face-to-face)

  • You are a problem solver and find joy in handling complexity

  • You are resilient. It can be a tough role, with lots of rejection, but the wins make it worth it!

You will make our decision easy if you have:

  • 2-3+ years of experience in a fast-growing startup, preferably in lead management and project management roles or 2-3+ years of experience in a field like finance & investment banking, consulting or software engineering

  • Proven ability to meet or exceed activity and pipeline targets.

  • Familiarity with outbound tools such as HubSpot, Aircall, lemlist or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

  • Strong communication, organization, and time management skills.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

  • A growth mindset, genuine curiosity about AI and financial services, as well as a willingness to learn.

Our Offer

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package

  • Get access to a self-development budget that you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes

  • Join us onsite in our inspiring office spaces in Berlin, NY, or London and travel to quarterly team meetings around the world

  • Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early-stage company by creating new opportunities

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy. Interact with and learn directly from founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo

  • Get to know and learn from experienced mentors such as the founders of Looker, GitHub, Mulesoft, Datadog, and UiPath

  • Use the equipment of your choice including meaningful home office set-up.

  • Benefit from an onboarding and training path supported by best-in-class coaches to become a true expert in your field

Our Stance

  • Work with colleagues who lift you, challenge you, celebrate you, and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism, and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify, or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

About us

Taktile is building the world's leading software platform for running critical and highly-automated decisions. Our customers use our product to catch fraudsters, prevent money laundering, and expand access to credit for small businesses, among many other use cases. Taktile is already making millions of such decisions across the globe every day.

Taktile is based in Berlin, London, and New York City. It was founded by machine learning and data science veterans with extensive experience building and running production ML in financial services. Our team consists of engineers, entrepreneurs, and researchers with a diverse set of backgrounds. Some of us attended top universities such as Harvard, Oxford, and Stanford and some of us have no degree at all. We have accumulated extensive work experience at leading tech companies, startups, and the enterprise software sphere.

Our backers include Y Combinator, Index Ventures, and stellar angels such as the founders of Looker, GitHub, Mulesoft, Datadog, and UiPath.

The applicable entity will be confirmed during the offer process.

We collect and process your name, contact details, resume/CV, work history, education, and any other information you submit or that we obtain from publicly available sources or references.

title: Senior Commercial Manager
descriptionHtml:
ÜBER UNSERE COMPANY

freiheit.com wurde 1999 in Hamburg gegründet und entwickelt seitdem custom large-scale Softwareprodukte. Unsere Mission ist: “Ship great software”.

In mehr als zwei Jahrzehnten haben wir immer das ausgeliefert, was wir versprochen haben – “always on time, on budget, on target and on quality”.

85% unserer Members sind Software Engineers mit Abschlüssen in Informatik, Physik oder Mathematik, viele auch mit fundierten Kenntnissen in Maschinellem Lernen und Künstlicher Intelligenz.

Seit über einem Vierteljahrhundert arbeiten wir für das „Who’s Who“ der deutschen und europäischen Industrie- und Handelsunternehmen.
Retail, Automotive, E-Commerce, Healthcare und mehr.

Unsere large-scale Softwareprodukte werden täglich von Millionen von Benutzern verwendet und sind entscheidend für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg unserer Kunden. Jedes Produkt ist somit geschäftskritisch und ist von strategischer Relevanz.

Gemeinsam machen wir “mission impossible possible”.

Unser Team besteht aus 300+ Members aus der ganzen Welt. In unseren Büros in Hamburg und Lissabon bauen wir gemeinsam Produkte, die noch nie jemand zuvor entwickelt hat.

Unsere Teams arbeiten datengetrieben, um ihre eigene Produktivität ständig zu optimieren. Jedes Teammitglied übernimmt die “end-to-end” Verantwortung für seine Arbeit. Um erfolgreich zu sein, muss man produktiv sein. Um produktiv zu sein, muss man effizient und effektiv sein.

Technology never rests. Neither do we.



ÜBER DEINEN JOB

  • Zusammen mit unserem CEO übernimmst du Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Geschäftsentwicklung bei freiheit.com
  • Dafür hast du immer ein klares Ziel im Blick: Den Erfolg Deiner Kunden.
  • Enge Kundenbeziehungen sind für uns selbstverständlich, als verlässlicher Partner bist du öfters beim Kunden vor Ort und identifizierst mit ihm zusammen seine wichtigen strategischen Ziele.
  • Du bist strategischer Berater der Geschäftsführung und pflegst interne und externe Beziehungen.
    • Client Success
  • Deine Verantwortung ist die kaufmännische Projektsteuerung und die erfolgreiche Projektumsetzung, immer zusammen mit unseren Engineering Teams.
  • Mit Start und Ausbau eines Projektes stellst Du gemeinsam mit den Engineering Directors das für das Projekt optimale Engineering Team auf.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Engineering Teams zusammen und identifizierst evtl. Frictions in dem jeweiligen Projekt. Deine Verantwortung ist es, diese zu beseitigen und damit sicherzustellen, dass das Engineering Team effektiv und effizient arbeiten kann und unsere “Optimal Work Environment” sichergestellt ist.
  • Du bist der Projektmanager und initiierst und moderierst regelmäßige Meetings, Review Sessions, Steering Committees.
    • Client Development
  • Zusätzlich entwickelst du Business und konvertierst unsere Leads zu Bestandskunden.
  • Du pflegst und erweiterst kontinuierlich Dein Netzwerk, verstehst die Potenziale bei unseren Kunden und fokussierst Dich zusammen mit dem Engineering aktiv auf den Kundenausbau.


    • ÜBER DICH

  • Du hast 5-6 Jahre Arbeitserfahrung in einem anspruchsvollen Umfeld (Konzern, Top-Tier Beratung oder Ähnliches).
  • Du hast einen erstklassigen Hochschulabschluss im Bereich der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Ähnlichem.
  • Du bist im Herzen Unternehmer und hast ein ausgeprägtes “Customer-First Mindset” und ein erstklassiges Gespür im Umgang mit Kunden.
  • Idealerweise hast Du Erfahrung bei der kommerziellen Planung und Auslieferung von komplexen large-scale Software-Projekten.
  • Du bist begeistert von Technologie und erstklassigem Software Engineering.
  • Du arbeitest sehr präzise und bist sicher im Umgang mit Zahlen.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (mind. C1) und verhandlungssicheres Englisch.
  • Du fühlst Dich wohl im Umgang mit Engineers & Non-Engineers, bist offen und ehrlich und arbeitest gern im Team.
  • Du hast Durchhaltevermögen und “Situational Awareness” mit absolutem Willen zum Erfolg.
  • Du hast Spaß daran, selbständig zu arbeiten, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und an neuen Herausforderungen zu wachsen.
  • Du möchtest Dich kontinuierlich in allen kaufmännischen Themen weiterentwickeln, insbesondere das Thema Leadership interessiert Dich, um aufgrund unserer ambitionierten Wachstumspläne zukünftig Teamverantwortung zu übernehmen.

    • ÜBER UNSERE COMMUNITY

    Auf die Frage, warum jemand hier arbeitet, lautet die Antwort oft: „wegen der Menschen“ und „weil ich in meinem Leben noch nie so viel gelernt habe“.

    Wir glauben, dass produktive Menschen glückliche Menschen sind.

    In unseren Engineering Hubs in Hamburg und Lissabon triffst du auf Menschen aus der ganzen Welt.

    Hier hast du die Möglichkeit, mit intelligenten Menschen an spannenden Aufgaben zu arbeiten und Projekte von der Idee bis zur Auslieferung umzusetzen – end-to-end.

    Ein wahrer Experte in seinem Fachgebiet wird man nicht über Nacht – dazu braucht es Jahre harter Arbeit und kontinuierliches Lernen. Als ein Member unserer Community wird viel von dir verlangt, und niemand kann die Arbeit für dich übernehmen.

    Unser Unternehmen ist ein Ort, an dem du die beste Version deiner selbst werden kannst.

title: Senior Compliance Director – UK
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

BJAK is Southeast Asia’s largest digital insurance platform, expanding financial access through automation, data, and digital scale. As we grow across markets, we are committed to building a platform that is safe, compliant, and trusted.

We are hiring a Senior Compliance Director – UK to lead regulatory strategy, risk governance, and compliance operations for our UK market entry and expansion alongside the CEO. This role is expected to hold the SMF16 (Compliance Oversight) Senior Management Function once approved, and will act as our primary point of contact with the FCA.

This is a build role: you'll be creating frameworks, policies, and controls from scratch rather than inheriting an existing function.

 

Why This Role Matters

The Senior Compliance Director – UK will:

  • Design and enforce compliance frameworks that enable safe scaling of digital financial services.

  • Ensure BJAK operates in accordance with UK regulatory standards, especially FCA requirements.

  • Protect consumers through transparent, fair, and ethical practices.

  • Establish BJAK as a trusted partner with regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.

  • Build compliance capability and culture across the company.

 

What You Will Do

Regulatory Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements.

  • Lead regulatory readiness for market entry, licensing, and ongoing supervision.

  • Serve as the primary contact with the FCA and relevant UK bodies.

  • Interpret regulatory changes and guide business strategy accordingly.

 

Risk Governance & Compliance Operations

  • Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance.

  • Conduct risk assessments and implement remediation plans for identified gaps.

  • Establish monitoring, testing, and reporting processes for ongoing compliance.

  • Ensure internal audits, compliance reviews, and control testing are operationalised.

 

Consumer Protection & Business Integrity

  • Embed fairness, transparency, and responsible selling throughout the organisation.

  • Oversee product compliance, marketing reviews, pricing governance, and distribution oversight.

  • Implement complaint handling frameworks aligned with regulatory standards.

 

Cross-Functional Support & Training

  • Partner with product, operations, legal, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure compliant execution.

  • Provide guidance on regulatory implications of new products, partnerships, or distribution models.

  • Deliver training to ensure teams understand and execute compliance responsibilities.

 

You Will Thrive in This Role If You

  • See compliance as a strategic enabler, not a blocker.

  • Operate with high integrity, sound judgment, and strong attention to detail.

  • Communicate clearly and influence leaders using data and logic.

  • Enjoy building frameworks and scaling systems from early-stage to mature environments.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, evolving settings where regulation meets innovation.

 

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of compliance, risk, or regulatory experience within financial services, insurance, insurtech, or fintech.

  • Deep understanding of UK regulatory frameworks, including FCA rules and consumer duty requirements.

  • Experience in compliance for digital platforms, distribution, or insurance products (preferred).

  • Proven ability to design policies, conduct risk assessments, and manage complex compliance programs.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including dealing with regulators.

 

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in start-up or high-growth environments.

  • Previous SMF experience.

  • Background in insurtech, digital distribution, or online marketplaces.

  • Knowledge of GDPR, AML, sanctions, or cross-border compliance.

 

Location Requirement

  • This role is based in the UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week.

 

Why Join Us

  • Shape compliance for a fast-growing international fintech-insurtech platform.

  • Build frameworks that enable safe, inclusive financial access at scale.

  • Work closely with leadership and regulators to drive responsible innovation.

  • Competitive compensation with long-term growth and international career opportunities.


Compensations Range

  • We offer a highly competitive package, ranging from £100,000 to £150,000, reflecting both experience and suitability for this pivotal role.

title: Senior Copywriter
descriptionHtml:
Hi, we’re Phiture — the mobile growth consultancy working with the teams behind leading apps like Adobe, Headspace, and LEGO® 👋. We’re setting the standard for growth in the brave new digital world, and we need great people to join our global team!

WHAT TO EXPECT:

We're looking for a sharp, versatile Senior Copywriter to own copy across some of Phiture's biggest accounts, including one of Europe’s biggest mobile gaming companies, the USA’s largest retailer, a fintech that keeps families connected across borders, and a fast-growing productivity app.

You'll join a close-knit creative pod, working side by side with our Creative Lead, designers and Growth Consultants. Together, you'll turn briefs, audience insights and testing hypotheses into conversion-focused copy that reaches millions of users in app stores around the world.

This isn't copywriting in a vacuum. You'll see how your messaging performs, learn from every test and use those insights to make the next round sharper. You'll switch between very different brands, tones and formats, often within tight character limits and on deadlines tied to larger experiments. It's a role for a writer who cares as much about why copy works as how it sounds, and who wants to grow into ASO, experimentation and creative strategy.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Own copy delivery across your assigned accounts, from brief interpretation through to final QA on production and market localisation
  • Translate creative briefs, audience insights and testing hypotheses into clear, conversion-focused copy, and ask the right questions when context or objectives are missing
  • Write across a range of formats, including:
    • App store metadata, screenshot captions and in-app events
    • Promotional content, storyboards and CRM campaigns
  • Build deep knowledge of each client's brand, products, features and audiences, understanding not just what we're promoting, but why
  • Switch confidently between distinct brand voices, formats and markets, keeping each brand's identity intact while leaving room for creative testing
  • Partner closely with designers so that copy and visuals work towards the same objective
  • Write English source copy that translates well, and adapt messaging for different English-speaking markets
  • Use creative testing and performance results to shape your recommendations and bring new ideas to the table
  • Present and explain your creative rationale in meetings, alongside the Creative Lead
  • Brief, guide and review freelance copywriters when the workload calls for it
  • Carry client feedback, brand preferences and past learnings into every new piece of work
  • Run copy QA and proofreading, including checking final designs for accuracy, localisation and consistency
  • Plan your own workload and capacity, flagging risks early so copy never holds up design, testing or launches
  • Use AI tools thoughtfully to work smarter, with the judgement to critically edit what they produce

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Native-level English copywriting ability, with excellent grammar, editorial skills and exceptional attention to detail
  • Proven experience in a senior copywriting role, writing compelling digital copy across different formats and brands
  • Strategic and commercial thinking: you can find the real user benefit in a brief and explain why your copy will work, not just why it sounds good
  • A strong portfolio that shows range across brand voices and clear, benefit-led messaging
  • Experience managing multiple projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, with full ownership of quality, priorities and delivery
  • A collaborative mindset: you enjoy working closely with designers and strategists, and respond constructively to feedback
  • Confident communication with clients and internal stakeholders at all levels
  • Experience in a creative or digital agency, ideally in mobile, performance or growth marketing
  • Experience with ASO, SEO, UX or performance copywriting is a plus, but not essential, we'll teach you the ASO side. What matters most is strong craft, curiosity and a real interest in how ASO works beyond the copy itself
  • Curiosity about products, audiences and the data behind them

We encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of their age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. We celebrate diversity and are excited about building teams that represent a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

title: Senior Corporate FP&A Specialist
descriptionHtml:
The Senior Corporate FP&A Specialist focuses on supporting all Distalmotion entities on driving strategic management decisions through financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting. The role works closely with FP&A Leadership and is cross-functional with the teams’ stakeholders to track performance, analyze variances, develop financial outlooks, and support key business initiatives.

The Senior Corporate FP&A Specialist has the capacity to operate autonomously and maintain a high standard of accuracy and consistency in financial outputs and supports ongoing improvements to FP&A processes and reporting.

TASKS:

Financial Planning:

• Support the development of Distalmotion’s short-, medium-, and long-term financial plans by preparing analyses, models, and inputs that align with corporate objectives

• Assist in the annual budgeting, rolling forecast, and long-range planning processes by collecting inputs from departments, validating assumptions, and ensuring data accuracy and consistency

• Build, maintain, and update financial and forecasting models under guidance from FP&A Leadership, including scenario and sensitivity analyses to support planning and decision-making

• Support the preparation and financial evaluation of business cases for new investments and strategic initiatives, including analysis of costs, benefits, and key risks

• Prepare financial analyses and summaries that provide management with forward-looking insights on performance, profitability, and resource allocation

Financial Analysis & Performance Management:

• Support month and quarterly performance reviews by preparing standard reports, ad hoc analyses, and management presentations ensuring accuracy within communicated timelines

• Support FP&A Leadership in the preparation of budgets and forecasts by completing analysis that is presented accurately and timely

• Develop ad hoc analysis to support strategic and operational decision making

• Perform financial and operational performance analysis across functions, programs, and projects, supporting management’s understanding of business results

• Prepare and maintain KPI reports, dashboards, and performance tracking tools to provide clear visibility into actuals versus budget and forecast

• Analyze variances and key performance drivers, clearly explaining results, risks, and opportunities

• Present findings and recommendations clearly to both finance and non-finance stakeholders

• Review historical budgets, expenditures, and forecasts to identify trends and opportunities to improve planning and forecasting accuracy

• Provide meaningful insights by challenging business assumptions and educating business partners on financial issues and concepts

• Contribute to competitor, market, and industry analyses by gathering data and assessing financial implications to support strategic planning

Requirements

Qualifications :

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance or Accounting, Master’s degree preferred

• Minimum of 7 years of progressive FP&A experience, in a medical device company

• Knowledge of US GAAP financial reporting requirements

• Proven expertise in financial modelling, accounting, forecasting, and variance analysis skills

• Experience working in multinational organization and collaborating with global finance teams

Skills & Competencies :

• Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities with strong attention to detail and accuracy

• Strong business acumen and understanding of P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow dynamics

• Experience with cross functional business partnering in a medical device company

• Good interpersonal skills and proven track record of working independently and adapting quickly in a dynamic, evolving environment

• Established proficiency with inventory management and margin improvement initiatives

• Result & performance driven: assumes full ownership and accountability for delivering accurate and timely results while seeking guidance only when needed

• Able to translate FP&A Leadership instructions and requests into meaningful output within required timelines

• Demonstrated ability to work multiple projects and priorities simultaneously under time pressure while keeping high level of quality and accuracy

• Sense of urgency: ability to identify, prioritize, and execute work/project plans

• High level of integrity, professionalism, and sound judgment when handling confidential information

• Proven track record of developing and maintaining cash forecasting models to support cash flow scenario analysis within a complex accounting structure in a global organization

• Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage effectively across cultures and organizational levels, and to build trusted, culturally sensitive partnerships in a global environment

• Willingness to adjust work schedule to ensure time sensitive deliverable commitments are achieved

• Fluent in English

Benefits

title: Senior Counsel, Privacy & AI Compliance (EU)
descriptionHtml:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.   We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

What You’ll Do:

The Legal and Government Affairs team at CoreWeave is highly collaborative and partners closely with teams across the company to navigate complex legal landscapes while enabling innovation and growth. The team is pragmatic, solutions-oriented, and deeply engaged in strategic decision-making, with a strong emphasis on building trusted relationships across the organization.

As Senior Counsel, Privacy & AI Compliance (EU), you will serve as a key legal advisor on European privacy, data protection, and artificial intelligence requirements. If you thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex problems, and are eager to make a significant impact, CoreWeave is the place for you.

About the role:

Reporting to the Senior Director & Lead Managing Counsel, Privacy, Regulatory & Compliance, you will independently advise on complex regional matters, help operationalize evolving legal requirements, and partner closely with Privacy, Product, Engineering, Security, Commercial Legal, Government Affairs, and business teams across Europe. You will play a central role in scaling practical, risk-based privacy and AI compliance frameworks for CoreWeave’s cloud infrastructure, products, and European operations.

In this Role You Will:

  • Advise on EU and UK privacy, data protection, and AI laws and regulatory developments, including the GDPR, UK GDPR, ePrivacy requirements, the EU AI Act, the EU Data Act, and related national implementing laws and guidance.
  • Translate complex legal requirements into clear, practical, and scalable guidance for Product, Engineering, Security, Commercial, Marketing, HR, Procurement, and operational teams across Europe.
  • Lead or support privacy and AI assessments for new and evolving products, features, data uses, vendors, and business initiatives, including DPIAs, legitimate-interest assessments, transfer impact assessments, AI risk and classification analyses, and documented compliance decisions.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to embed privacy by design and default, responsible AI, data minimization, transparency, security, retention, and governance requirements into product architecture and development processes.
  • •  Advise on international data transfers, data localization and residency requirements, cross-border access, and related contractual and operational mechanisms, including EU Standard Contractual Clauses and the UK International Data Transfer Addendum or Agreement.
  • Support implementation of CoreWeave’s AI compliance framework in Europe, including role and use-case classification, risk management, transparency, recordkeeping, human oversight, technical documentation, contractual allocation of responsibilities, and governance for internal and customer-facing AI uses.
  • Provide regional guidance on data subject rights, records of processing, privacy notices, consent and cookies, retention and deletion, data sharing, direct marketing, and other core privacy program requirements.
  • Advise on European product launches, market entry, strategic partnerships, customer and vendor arrangements, and commercial terms involving privacy, data use, AI, and regulatory responsibility.
  • Support cybersecurity and privacy incident response in Europe, including assessment of regulator and data subject notification obligations, engagement with relevant stakeholders, and documentation of defensible legal decisions.
  • Lead or support responses to inquiries, audits, consultations, and investigations involving European data protection authorities, AI regulators, and other governmental bodies; coordinate with local counsel and drive follow-up and remediation.
  • Develop and maintain regional policies, procedures, playbooks, training, control mappings, and evidence of compliance, and monitor emerging legal and enforcement trends to inform business strategy and program priorities.

Who You Are:

  • 4+ years of relevant legal experience, including substantial experience advising on European privacy and data protection matters; a mix of law firm, regulatory, and in-house experience is preferred.
  • Qualified to practice law in an EU member state or the United Kingdom and in good standing with the applicable professional body.
  • Strong working knowledge of the GDPR and UK GDPR, including controller and processor obligations, privacy-by-design requirements, data subject rights, international transfers, DPIAs, security and breach notification, and regulator engagement.
  • Meaningful experience with AI governance or emerging AI regulation, including the ability to interpret and operationalize the EU AI Act for technology, cloud, infrastructure, or enterprise use cases.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex regional matters, identify material risk, present practical options, and make clear, defensible recommendations in ambiguous situations.
  • Experience building or operationalizing privacy and AI compliance programs through policies, assessments, controls, training, governance processes, monitoring, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Technical fluency and the ability to understand data flows, cloud architecture, product functionality, AI systems, and security practices and translate them into actionable legal guidance.
  • Excellent drafting and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex legal requirements clearly and influence technical, commercial, and business stakeholders across jurisdictions.
  • Proven ability to build trusted cross-functional relationships, manage multiple priorities, and work effectively in a fast-paced, rapidly scaling global environment.

Preferred: 

  • Experience advising a high-growth cloud, AI, SaaS, data center, infrastructure, or other technology company.
  • Experience engaging with European data protection authorities, AI regulators, standards bodies, industry groups, or external counsel on novel technology issues.
  • Experience advising on cross-border data transfers, cloud service provider obligations, enterprise AI governance, and the allocation of regulatory responsibilities between providers and customers.
  • Familiarity with recognized privacy, security, and AI governance frameworks or standards, such as ISO/IEC 27701, ISO/IEC 42001.

title: Senior CRM Manager
descriptionHtml:
Join our expanding Product Growth team! We’re actively recruiting a Senior CRM Manager as we continue to scale at M-KOPA. Most senior growth hires get one channel and one pod for years. This role is built differently: you’ll own two of our core growth pods in your first year, then land where you’ve had the most impact. It’s a fast track to pod leadership, not a support seat.

The Impact 💚

You’ll drive the conversion growth that turns customers into long-term, high-value ones, creating financial inclusion for Africa’s traditionally excluded. We’ve already helped over 10 million customers access over $2 billion in credit 🌍

The Opportunity

🏗️ Real ownership from day one. You'll be the one accountable for delivery in Repeat Phones, not shadowing or supporting someone else's plan.

🎒 Two growth motions, one year. You'll take on Digital Lending mid-way through, working directly with one of our strongest performers to understand cash loans end to end, then carry that pod solo for a defined stretch. Few people get this breadth this early.

🧭 A defined path, not indefinite floating. You'll build real expertise in our two conversion pods first, then move into Lifecycle in the second half of next year, reporting to the Lifecycle CRM Lead once you're there. The destination is set. What you bring to it is up to you. 🌍 Work inside a proven CLV engine. M-KOPA has helped more than 10 million customers access over $2 billion in credit. You'll be executing inside systems that already work, not guessing at what might.

What You'll Do

Phase 1: Repeat Phones. Take ownership of reactivation and upgrade campaigns in CleverTap, working closely with the Growth Lead there to understand what's driving the pod's numbers and where the next opportunity is. You'll be trusted to make real calls here, not just execute a checklist.

Phase 2: Cross into Digital Lending. Work directly with the Digital Lending lead, one of our top performers, to understand cash loan growth end to end before taking it on yourself.

Phase 3: Own Digital Lending. Carry primary responsibility for Digital Lending for a defined period, with the Repeat Phones lead available if you need a second opinion.

Phase 4: Move into Lifecycle. In the second half of next year, join the Lifecycle pod full-time, reporting to the Lifecycle CRM Lead. You'll bring a year of hands-on conversion experience into a pod that's still being built, real currency for shaping what Lifecycle does next. Throughout all phases, you will:

  • Build and run multi-channel campaigns (SMS, WhatsApp, push, in-app) in CleverTap against pod goals

  • Track funnel performance and flag drop-off points to the pod lead you're supporting

  • Run structured experiments (creative, audience, incentive, or timing) with clear hypotheses

  • Turn what works into documented playbooks the next person can pick up

  • Keep data quality and campaign tracking clean enough that leadership can trust the numbers

Key Metrics You'll Influence

Repeat Phones: Reactivation rate, upgrade conversion %, unit economics per sale

Digital Lending: Approval → disbursement rate, digital loan volume, approval quality

Campaign ROI and payback period across both

Your Environment

💼 Tech Stack: CleverTap (primary), Looker Channels: WhatsApp, SMS, push, in-app messaging

Markets: Kenya, Nigeria, Uganda, Ghana

What You Need

  • 5+ years in growth, performance, or lifecycle marketing, ideally in fintech, telco, or e-commerce, with real ownership over what a campaign or a pod achieved, not just involvement in it.

  • Judgment as much as skill. You can walk into a pod, understand what's working and why, and make calls on where to push, not just follow a brief.

  • Genuine appetite for pod leadership. This is a deliberate path toward owning a pod outright, and the breadth here is designed to get you there faster than a single-channel role would.

  • Hands-on fluency in CRM platforms like CleverTap, Braze, or similar, and comfortable reading a funnel or cohort without translation.

  • Energized, not unsettled, by ambiguity. You'll work across two pods and land in a third decision point by mid-year. If that sounds like an opportunity rather than a risk, you'll thrive here.

  • Strong enough presence to build trust quickly with senior leads across two different pods.

Location & Benefits

  • 🌍 Fully remote role within UTC -1 to UTC +3 time zones

  • 🤝 Work with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa

  • 📚 Professional development programmes and coaching partnerships

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • 💚 Well-being support and career growth opportunities

 

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

 

Our Impact 💚

Our technology has created measurable change:

  • Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected

  • Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use M-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000+ livelihoods created for agents

  • Green 🌱: 2.1 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided through clean energy products, with over 127,700 circular economy products provided

 

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships. 

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

title: (Senior) Customer Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Empower every employee.

AI has changed how office workers get things done. For the 80% of the global workforce that doesn't sit at a desk, it has barely arrived. Flip AI is changing that.

Flip AI is the #1 Frontline Agentic Operating System (OS) to build, automate and orchestrate any frontline use case on a foundation of secure identity and comms with strong UX. In practice, that means one app where frontline workers in retail, manufacturing and logistics access their systems, run their processes, and use AI.

More than 1,000 brands trust Flip AI, and over two million people use it worldwide, at companies like Bosch, REWE, FORVIA HELLA and Greif. In August 2026, Notion Capital and HV Capital doubled down with a new $25M round, bringing our total funding to more than $85M.

Our mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch.

Job Description

As a Customer Engineer you sit on the edge of the product, inside the customer's environment: their identity stack, their HR systems, their security review, their AI roadmap. You take a tenant from nothing to hundreds of thousands of live users and you decide how the technical side gets solved, sometimes by designing the integration and enabling the customer's IT to build it, sometimes by building the first version yourself and handing it over. That includes where our AI goes live: agents in the frontline app, tool access over MCP, and the authentication questions underneath them that nobody has solved yet.

What you can expect

  • Technical ownership end to end: You own the technical side of enterprise onboardings, from the first architecture conversation to a stable live rollout at scale.

  • Integrations that make Flip AI load-bearing: You design and land identity and authentication (OIDC, Entra ID, Frontline Identity), user provisioning (SCIM), REST APIs and connections into HR and ops systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG.

  • Advise and enable instead of absorb: You bring the customer's IT, their partners and our external development partners to a solution you would sign off on, and you make sure they can run it without you.

  • Build where building unblocks: Where building is the fastest way to prove an approach or to unblock a rollout, you build the first version and then hand it over cleanly, with the documentation and the handover conversation that make it stick.

  • AI where it meets the customer: You lead how agents, MCP-based tool access and agent-to-agent scenarios land at enterprise customers, including the auth and data boundaries that have to hold around them.

  • Technical authority in the account: You work with customer project management, IT, security, functional departments and works councils, you decide the technical questions, and you feed the gaps you see back into our product and engineering teams. Expect regular travel to customer sites, roughly 10 to 30 percent of your time.

What you bring to the table

Must-haves

  • Around 3 to 5 (or more) years in IT or tech consulting, customer engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering or SaaS implementation, with real enterprise exposure.

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise integration and identity: SSO and authentication (OIDC, OAuth, Entra ID or comparable), REST APIs and API-based integrations delivered inside real enterprise IT environments.

  • Customer-facing technical responsibility in enterprise projects, where you made the technical calls together with IT, security and functional departments rather than only coordinating them.

  • Genuine technical depth without being a full-time production developer: you read code, review a design, debug an integration and build a working prototype.

  • German at C1 level or above and fluent English.

Nice-to-haves

  • Provisioning experience (SCIM) and integrations into HR or workforce systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG.

  • An informed, current view on where agentic AI is heading: MCP, A2A, EMA and the authentication questions underneath them. We are looking for someone who follows the field closely and has an opinion, not for years of experience that cannot exist yet.

  • Prior work as a Customer Engineer or Forward Deployed Engineer at a product company, rather than in classic consulting only.

  • Workflow automation tooling (n8n or similar), comfort with logs, metrics and dashboards, or experience with German co-determination and enterprise data protection.

What we offer you

  • Work mode: We’re remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value the power of in-person collaboration. Depending on the role, you’ll join occasional team events, workshops, or meetings in our Berlin or Stuttgart offices - always with plenty of notice. The exact balance will be discussed during your interview.

  • Work-Life-Balance: We don't want you to grow roots to your desk chair. That's why we cover the costs of your E-Gym-Wellpass membership and offer job bike leasing.

  • Celebrating success: Expect highly motivated and committed people in a relaxed working atmosphere.

  • Be part of something bigger: You actively shape Flip AI in your role. Along the way, you are an enabler of the rapid growth process of a young tech company and grow towards your goals, fun is guaranteed.

  • Happy to be a Flipster: Stay tuned for regular team events and culture days that bring us together as Flipsters.

  • Working abroad: At Flip AI you can also work abroad in the European Union. Let's talk about remote work in the interview.

At Flip AI, everyone is welcome - no matter what gender you identify as or how old you are. Sexual identity, origin, religion, world view and disabilities do not influence your potential job at Flip AI. The most important thing is that YOU fit in!
