title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Introduction

We’re expanding and have a fantastic opportunity for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our mechanical and biomedical engineering department. We want to deepen and broaden the skills we already have in the group, and to add to its great culture. This role would suit someone in the early stages of their career, looking for a new challenge within an innovative company.

This team works predominantly across healthcare projects, and you will use your engineering skills at all stages of the development life-cycle, taking responsibility for design challenges and technical problems.

There is no deadline for this role, as we recruit on a rolling basis. Once the position is filled, we will close the advert. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What you’ll be doing

The majority of your time will be spent delivering exceptional mechanical engineering for our multi-national medical technology clients, understanding their requirements and communicating clearly and effectively. You will be hands-on in solving complex mechanical challenges, often alongside other disciplines, within supportive project teams.

You will work on projects across a range of healthcare sectors, including medical devices, drug delivery, surgical systems and diagnostics instruments. The technical challenges we tackle are ground-breaking, innovative and make a real difference to the landscape of medical technology.

You will guide aspects of the mechanical development and define technical solutions, using your experience to design systems and parts for manufacture by applying real-world knowledge. Your work is likely to include:

  • First-principles engineering analysis
  • Concept generation and the development of engineering designs
  • Rapid prototyping
  • Hands-on testing and experimentation, including the design and execution of test programmes
  • Detailed design for manufacture and assembly, and liaising with suppliers
  • Presenting results, both internally and to clients
  • Preparing technical reports and producing high-quality documentation

Our culture encourages team members to take on the level of responsibility that suits them. You will have the opportunity to significantly develop your skills and career, learn from others and make a substantial impact on our projects.

We are keen to support the development of our employees, and as such offer an extensive in-house training program. As you advance within the organisation there will be plenty of opportunities for you to develop your technical skills and specialism, take on more leadership responsibilities and/or focus more on supporting the development of sales opportunities.

What you can bring

You’ll bring strong mechanical engineering ability and enthusiasm to the role. You will deliver high-quality work on client projects, to specification and to timelines. You will be responsible for delivering the tasks you’re assigned, and for defining tasks for yourself and often for others.

We’re looking for applicants who can demonstrate:

  • An excellent undergraduate degree in Mechanical Engineering (or a related subject such as Biomedical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or Mechatronics) or equivalent experience
  • Design engineering industry experience, for example (but not limited to) high proficiency in CAD (e.g. SolidWorks), design analysis, structural analysis, rapid prototyping, technical drawings, design for manufacture and design for assembly
  • A proven track record of working in a diverse team and of successful delivery
  • A creative and analytical approach to problem-solving and concept generation
  • Strong written and verbal communication

In addition, experience in any of the following would be advantageous (but is not essential):

  • Experience in a consulting environment
  • Experience in medical device development, or other regulated product development
  • Familiarity with analysis tools such as Python/MATLAB, CFD and FEA
  • An interest in applying engineering to the biomedical field

What we do

Cambridge Consultants is one of the world’s leading product development and technology consultancies, with a reputation for cutting-edge design, development and value creation for a global client base. We develop breakthrough technology for some of the most exciting companies on the planet. Our people, facilities and work make us unique. Our medical technology division develops some of the most novel products, with tangible and often life-changing benefits for users and patients.

What we offer

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays (with the option to buy 10 more a year)
  • Company bonus (profit share)
  • Flexible working patterns and hybrid working
  • Medical insurance and group income protection
  • Employee assistance programme and mental health support group
  • Enhanced maternity/paternity leave
  • Sabbatical leave
  • Travel insurance (business and leisure)
  • Generous company pension plan
  • Personalised career development and training plans
  • Free breakfast and two-course lunch in the office every day
  • Free onsite parking and we are close to public transport links
  • A variety of events organised by our social committee, ranging from summer and Christmas parties to board game nights and socials at our own rooftop bar!

Why Cambridge Consultants?

At Cambridge Consultants, you'll contribute to radical, new-to-the-world innovation that transforms business, society and the planet. Joining our multidisciplinary teams means helping to turn bold ideas into reality, harnessing the power of deep tech to create products, services and experiences that have never existed before. title: Senior ML Engineer
descriptionHtml:
For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands.

About SkinVision

Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped over 3 million people worldwide. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin cancer images and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. Where needed, cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need.

Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SkinVision

We're on the lookout for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer based in our Amsterdam office with the right skills and experience to ensure the Machine Learning team releases models with exceptional performance making use of state-of-the-art techniques. Not only are ML models vital to our product and hence for our end users, e.g., enabling early detection of skin cancer, they also enable our internal team to perform optimally. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in training new and optimizing existing Machine Learning and computer vision models (Python), has hands-on experience in MLOps and deploying models to production (preferably in AWS) and is able to gather requirements and communicate results to the stakeholders directly involved in the model development and deployment. Moreover, in this senior role, it is vital that you can mentor other team members, own the technical processes and actively contribute to the ML roadmap. Knowledge of data orchestration tools (Apache Airflow), data modeling (dbt) and working in a regulated and/or medical environment are a plus!

What you will do

  • Drive the full ML model development lifecycle: from understanding and co-defining the problem to providing inputs on data collection, assessing the quality of data, model training, validation, deployment and monitoring.

  • Create requirements for data collection for both new and existing models. This includes data for model training and testing.

  • Develop and improve efficient ML training pipelines in the cloud (AWS or similar).

  • Involve stakeholders appropriately during the entire development, deployment and monitoring lifecycle.

  • Scale the ML environment and processes to multiple models being developed and deployed simultaneously.

  • Ensure ML development aligns with medical device standards if applicable, including ML best practices, experiment tracking, traceability, data lineage and documentation.

  • Support and mentor team members.

  • Showcase ML models and capabilities both internally and externally, by giving presentations, workshops, training, etc.

  • Stay abreast of the latest industry standards, best practices and emerging trends in Machine Learning and AI and share insights with the broader team.


Your profile

  • 8-10 years of proven professional experience as a Machine Learning Engineer or similar role, showcasing exceptional proficiency in model training, deployment within a consumer product, data analysis, stakeholder management and teamwork/mentoring.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Econometrics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related field.

Skills

  • Ability to translate user needs and requirements into technical requirements and a development plan.

  • Hands-on expertise with modern deep learning architectures and other ML architectures, ideally but not restricted to image data.

  • Hands-on experience with MLOps practices for scalable training, deployment and monitoring.

  • Experience in developing and deploying ML models for a consumer product (mature development processes), ideally in the healthcare space or a regulated environment.

  • Ability to iterate quickly from ideas to experiments, learning from results and making data-driven decisions.

  • Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving skills and the ability to extract actionable insights from intricate datasets.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the capacity to effectively convey technical concepts to diverse audiences.

  • Proven ability to thrive in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment, managing multiple priorities and deadlines.

  • Experience with mentoring and leading team members.

What we offer you

  • A vibrant, dynamic, and rapidly growing scale-up in Amsterdam

  • An enthusiastic, professional, and international team

  • Regular team events, including off-sites and fun activities

title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager – Performance Marketing, MMM & AI (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du hast den kompletten Performance-Marketing-Mix fest im Griff und nutzt KI im Kampagnenmanagement nicht als Hype, sondern als tägliches Werkzeug? Du möchtest datengetriebene Entscheidungen zur Budgetallokation treffen und aktiv mitgestalten, wie modernste AI-Tools die Steuerung im E-Commerce revolutionieren? Dann wartet in unserem Team in Berlin deine nächste große Challenge auf dich: Bei benuta übernimmst du echte Ownership über unsere Kanäle hinweg und treibst ein echtes Greenfield-Thema voran – die Skalierung KI-gestützter Analysen und Strategien für den europäischen Marktführer im Home-&-Living-Bereich!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Strategische Kanal- & Budgetsteuerung: Du entwickelst und verantwortest die kanalübergreifende Performance-Marketing-Strategie via MMM zur Erreichung unserer Unternehmensziele (Umsatz, Effizienz, Lead-Gen, Brand Awareness). Du steuerst und optimierst Kampagnen über Google Ads, Bing Ads, Meta, Pinterest, Reddit Ads sowie Affiliate-Partnerschaften mit einer konsistenten Budget- und Ziellogik.

  • AI-Integration & Workflow-Innovation: Du treibst den Einsatz von LLMs (z. B. Claude, Gemini) für die automatisierte, kanalübergreifende Analyse unserer Kampagnendaten aktiv voran. Du entwickelst Prompts und Workflows für beschleunigtes Reporting, Anomalie-Erkennung sowie Budget-Optimierungen und agierst als interner Expert für KI-gestützte Marketing-Tools.

  • Analyse & Bidding-Evaluierung: Du überwachst und analysierst alle relevanten KPIs (CPO, ROAS, CAC, Conversion Rate) auf Basis von GA4 und unserem serverseitigen Tracking-Setup (server-side GTM). Zudem bewertest du KI-gestützte Bidding- und Automatisierungsfunktionen der Werbeplattformen auf ihren Mehrwert.

  • Tracking-Setup & Datensicherheit: Du implementierst und verwaltest Tracking-Setups (z. B. Conversion-APIs, UTM-Konventionen) und stellst eine saubere, datenschutzkonforme Datengrundlage sicher.

  • Testing: Du verantwortest fortlaufende A/B-Tests und Budget-Experimente zur kontinuierlichen Performance-Steigerung aller Kanäle.

  • Partner-Management & Kollaboration: Du verhandelst und entwickelst Vendor- und Partnerverträge (z. B. im Affiliate-Bereich) weiter. Bei der Kampagnenabstimmung arbeitest du eng mit den Teams aus Design, Content und IT zusammen.

  • Mentoring: Du unterstützt bei der fachlichen Anleitung sowie dem Onboarding von Junior-Kolleg*innen im Team und teilst dein KI-Wissen.


Dein Profil

  • Ausbildung: Du hast dein Studium (BWL, Marketing, Medien, Kommunikationswissenschaften o. Ä.) erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit.

  • Relevante Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing mit – idealerweise kanalübergreifend (SEA, Paid Social, Affiliate) und mit nachweisbarer Budget- oder Teilprojektverantwortung. Erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung ist von Vorteil.

  • AI-Expertise (Must-have): Du besitzt praxiserprobte Erfahrung im Einsatz von KI-Tools und LLMs im Marketing-Kontext (z. B. Prompting für Reporting, Analysen, Forecasting). Du verfolgst aktuelle AI-Trends aktiv und brennst darauf, diese bei benuta einzubringen.

  • Hard Skills: Du zeichnest dich durch ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten aus, nutzt GA4 sowie gängige Attributions-/Reporting-Tools souverän und hast tiefe Kenntnisse in mindestens einem Zentralkanal (Google Ads, Meta). Erfahrung mit Bing, Pinterest, Reddit, Affiliate und serverseitigem Tracking runden dein Profil ab.

  • Soft Skills: Du arbeitest datengetrieben, denkst lösungsorientiert und begeisterst dich für E-Commerce sowie die Themen Home & Living.

  • Sprachkompetenz: Deine Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind sehr gut (weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus).

Deine Benefits

  • Impact & Gestaltungsspielraum: Bei uns kannst du aktiv mitgestalten, die Marke benuta weiterentwickeln und spannende KI-Projekte umsetzen – wie etwa den Aufbau KI-gestützter Analyse-Workflows für unsere Kampagnendaten. Deine Ideen werden gehört und du bekommst Freiraum für die Umsetzung eigener Ansätze.

  • Präsenz & Flexibilität: Der Schwerpunkt unserer Arbeit liegt auf dem persönlichen Austausch und der gemeinsamen Zusammenarbeit vor Ort an unserem Standort in Berlin. Für die nötige Flexibilität in deiner Alltagsplanung - sei es für private Termine oder ungestörtes Arbeiten - bieten wir dir ein jährliches Kontingent von 26 Home-Office-Tagen.

  • Deine Mobilität: Egal wie du zu uns kommst, wir unterstützen dich. Du hast die Wahl zwischen einem vergünstigten Jobticket oder einer Tankkarte. Zudem bieten wir dir ein Firmenrad-Leasing (JobRad) und eine gute ÖPNV-Anbindung.

  • Zeit für Erholung: Du erhältst 28 Tage Urlaub und profitierst von unserem flexiblen Gleitzeitmodell. Weihnachten und Silvester sind bei uns grundsätzlich arbeitsfreie Tage, die nicht von deinem Urlaubskonto abgehen.

  • Deine Entwicklung: Unsere unterschiedlichen Abteilungen mit internationalen Teams arbeiten an vielfältigen Projekten zusammen. Dadurch lernst Du permanent neue Sichtweisen, Tools und Prozesse kennen – inklusive aktuellster KI-Anwendungen im Performance Marketing.

  • Kultur & Mitarbeitervorteile: Ein strukturiertes Onboarding, flache Hierarchien und attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte warten auf dich. Bei uns gilt: Come as you are – fühl dich wohl und sei einfach du selbst!

Klingt nach deinem nächsten Match? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Lade einfach deinen Lebenslauf und deine relevanten Zeugnisse über unser Online-Portal hoch.

Dein Ansprechpartner ist Michael Stanke (Head of Online Marketing).

*Bei uns zählt der Mensch und seine Motivation - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion oder sexueller Orientierung. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit einer Schwerbehinderung oder ihnen Gleichgestellten werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

Über benuta

Seit 2008 revolutionieren wir von Bonn aus den europäischen Teppich- und Home-&-Living-E-Commerce. Mit über 100 Millionen Euro Umsatz, modernster AI-gestützter Produktinszenierung und Kunden in 17 Ländern verbinden wir die Sicherheit eines etablierten Marktführers mit dem Drive und den flachen Hierarchien eines Digital-Pioneers. Unser Ziel ist einfach: Jedes Zuhause noch schöner zu machen. Werde Teil unseres Teams und hilf uns dabei, noch mehr Menschen für unsere Produkte zu begeistern.

About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around 4 days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a Senior Post Producer do at WPP Production?

You’ll play a central role in delivering high-quality post-production projects across edit, grade, VFX, motion, and sound. As a Senior Post Producer you will bridge hands-on production and leadership, managing key projects, supporting producers, and maintaining strong relationships with clients, agencies, and creative partners. You’ll ensure projects run smoothly, budgets are met, and the creative standard remains high across everything that leaves the studio. You’ll be someone who thrives on collaboration, solves problems calmly under pressure, and takes pride in delivering work that looks, sounds, and feels exceptional. The ideal candidate will have experience working with a global technology brand or demonstrate a strong drive and ambition to contribute to a high-calibre account.

Production

  • Lead multiple post-production projects from brief to final delivery, managing timelines, budgets and workflows.
  • Oversee offline, online, grade, VFX, motion graphics and audio, ensuring projects are delivered on time and to a high standard.
  • Own production workflows, tracking progress, risks and budgets and keeping the Executive Producer informed.
  • Proactively identify and resolve challenges, balancing creative, technical and commercial priorities.
  • Manage global workflows across a centralised production hub and continuously improve ways of working.
  • Explore and implement AI and emerging technologies to improve efficiency, quality and output.

Clients & Collaboration

  • Act as a senior point of contact for clients and agency partners throughout production.
  • Lead client calls, reviews and presentations, building trusted relationships and managing expectations.
  • Collaborate closely with creatives, artists, technical teams and senior production leads to deliver high-quality work.
  • Support and mentor junior and mid-level producers, sharing best practice and fostering a collaborative team environment.

Quality & Commercial

  • Own the studio QC process, ensuring work meets brand, technical and delivery standards.
  • Develop and implement robust QC workflows and best practices.
  • Prepare budgets and estimates, maintaining accurate financial tracking and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency.
  • Contribute to rate cards, templates and processes that strengthen production and commercialperformance.

Requirements

  • Strong post-production experience across broadcast, digital and social.
  • Senior-level experience managing complex, high-end campaigns from brief to delivery.
  • Strong understanding of the full post-production pipeline, including edit, colour, online, VFX and audio.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects, priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communicator, confident working with clients, agency partners and internal teams.
  • Experience managing international clients and senior stakeholders across multiple markets.
  • Calm, organised and solutions-focused, with the ability to stay composed under pressure.
  • Collaborative team player who leads by example and supports the development of others.
  • Passionate about craft, creativity, technology and innovation, with a strong eye for detail and efficiency.
  • Genuine interest in technology brands and the wider tech landscape.
  • Flexible and adaptable when project deadlines require occasional evening or weekend support. We value work-life balance and these instances are infrequent, with time off in lieu provided where appropriate.

At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. title: Senior Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:

We're turning the function that has always said 'no' into infrastructure that says 'yes, and here's how'.

This is a fundamental shift in how regulated industries and compliance teams operate, and we're only at the beginning. The product you'll design is what people actually touch when they experience that shift.

  • A Chrome extension that runs compliance checks inline in Google Docs, where marketers actually write copy. Built with Monzo as the design partner. Public on the Chrome Web Store.

What you'll do

Nice to have

descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

Changing your car should feel like one seamless journey, not a series of disconnected tasks. Right now it's the opposite: people value their car in one place, search for the next one in another, and manage the handover somewhere else, much of it on the web and most of it forgotten between car changes. The Carwow app is our most direct relationship with those customers, and today it is nowhere near what it could be.

We are reimagining it. If we can give people a reason to open Carwow between car changes, understand what they drive and what they want next, and make the moment of changing effortless, the app becomes the place UK drivers start. This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with design and engineering to build it.

This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. The best consumer apps of the next few years won't be lists with filters; they will understand you and act on your behalf. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, the fluency to prototype it quickly with the latest tools, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise.

If you want to shape a new consumer product from the ground up, work at the cutting edge of applied AI, and build things that millions of UK drivers could use, this is it.

  • Cross-functional Leadership:

Your initial focus will be on building an exposure screening product for insured fleets, enabling customers to load their insured fleet, attach policy values, and continuously monitor exposure and accumulation against the live global fleet picture.

This is a high-impact opportunity to build a new product category from the ground up. You will work directly with underwriters, brokers, P&I clubs, claims and exposure-management teams, as well as Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing, to ensure the product solves real customer problems and establishes Kpler as a trusted source of marine insurance intelligence.

The role is ideal for an experienced product leader who is comfortable operating in an ambiguous, early-stage environment and has a track record of taking B2B data, analytics, or SaaS products from concept through to customer adoption.


Key Responsibilities
  • Own the Marine Insurance product strategy, vision, and roadmap, defining what gets built and in what order while balancing customer value, commercial opportunity, technical feasibility, and time to market.
  • Lead the development and delivery of the first Marine Insurance product release, focused on exposure screening across the live global fleet and enabling customers to monitor exposure and accumulation continuously.
  • Lead market and customer discovery with hull and cargo underwriters, war-risk underwriters, P&I clubs, brokers, claims, and exposure-management teams to understand customer needs and translate insights into product direction.
  • Define and refine the product proposition and customer experience, ensuring Kpler's data and intelligence are translated into clear, actionable outcomes for insurance professionals.
  • Establish the exposure and accumulation methodology underpinning the product, working with data and domain experts to ensure the methodology is credible, transparent, and trusted by underwriters and brokers.
  • Own positioning and competitive strategy, monitoring the marine insurance analytics landscape and clearly defining Kpler's differentiation and value proposition.
  • Lead the go-to-market strategy for the product, working with Sales and Marketing on positioning, packaging, pricing input, launch planning, and early customer adoption.
  • Identify and develop strategic partnerships across the insurance ecosystem that can accelerate adoption or strengthen the underlying data proposition.
  • Act as the key link between Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing, creating alignment around product strategy, priorities, launch plans, and customer outcomes.
  • Track product performance, customer feedback, delivery progress, and key risks, using evidence and market insight to continuously refine the roadmap and maximise product impact.

    • Skills and Experience
  • 5–7 years of Product Management or senior commercial experience, ideally within maritime data, shipping intelligence, marine insurance, or a closely related B2B data/SaaS environment.
  • Proven track record of owning products end-to-end, from strategy and customer discovery through to delivery, launch, and customer adoption.
  • Strong track record of translating complex customer needs into clear product strategy, roadmap priorities, and product requirements, working closely with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Strong understanding of the marine insurance data landscape, including exposure, accumulation, sanctions, and war-risk screening, as well as the wider competitive environment.
  • Experience operating in ambiguous, early-stage environments, with a pragmatic and iterative approach to building, launching, learning, and improving products.
  • Strong commercial and go-to-market experience, including product positioning, packaging, pricing input, launch planning, and working closely with Sales and Marketing.
  • Strong data and analytical literacy, with the ability to work effectively with data and engineering teams and understand maritime and trade data concepts such as AIS, ownership, and trade flows.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across technical, commercial, and senior external audiences.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly and influence stakeholders across different levels and functions.
  • Strong ownership mindset and a bias to action, with the confidence to make decisions, navigate uncertainty, and focus on delivering outcomes rather than perfection.

title: Senior Product Manager, Software
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own how our device software behaves. You'll take the product vision and turn it into features our software team can build with confidence.

This is product work at the level of detail. You'll think through how features should behave in every situation, including the edge cases, and give the team clear answers. You'll also make sure that work gets delivered. That means keeping the backlog in shape, setting priorities and following features through to release. You'll start on future releases of CoMind One, our first product, and help shape CoVision as it moves towards delivery. As the team and product line grow, so does the role.

At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day.

Responsibilities:

  • Define how features work, step by step, including the edge cases and failure modes that matter in a clinical setting.

  • Package features for build: what it does, why it matters, what it looks like, and the decision logic behind it.

  • Prototype flows and interactions using AI tools, so the team sees the idea before they build it.

  • Sit with the software team and make the call when a feature question comes up.

  • Act as the link between our commercial team and the software team, turning customer and market needs into clear requirements. Use quick prototypes to test those needs with customers and the commercial team before they reach the backlog.

  • Shape the product roadmap with the Product Lead.

  • Own the software backlog in Jira: intake, triage and grooming, so it reflects real priority.

  • Write acceptance criteria and check that what ships matches what was intended.

  • Partner with the Project Manager, who runs sprints, so sequencing and timing reflect real priority rather than convenience.

  • Keep decisions and documentation in Confluence, not lost in Slack.

  • AI is fundamental to our culture — it's not just a tool, but a core part of how we work, collaborate, and innovate. We expect all team members to embrace AI in their daily work and continuously find new ways to use it effectively.

Skills & Experience:

  • Demonstrable product management experience on software that runs on physical hardware.

  • You understand the pace of regulated hardware: long development cycles and infrequent releases.

  • Evidence of making product decisions from logic and a deep understanding of users.

  • Writing requirements precise enough for engineers to build without repeated back-and-forth.

  • You're comfortable debating a feature with engineers and explaining why it matters for the product.

  • A natural translator: equally comfortable in a conversation with a non-technical stakeholder describing a problem and in a ticket-grooming session with engineers debating implementation trade-offs.

  • You use AI tools heavily in your day-to-day work.

  • Hands-on experience building interactive prototypes, using AI tools to turn an idea into something clickable that users and engineers can react to.

Nice to have:

  • Medical device experience, or exposure to ISO 13485 or IEC 62304.

  • Software engineering or technical background.

  • Experience with embedded or real-time software.

Benefits:

  • Company equity plan so all employees share in the success of the company

  • Salary-sacrifice pension scheme

  • Private medical, dental and vision insurance (medical history disregarded)

  • Group life insurance at 4x annual income

  • Comprehensive mental health support, including unlimited access to 1:1 sessions with trained professionals

  • Unlimited holiday allowance (+ bank holidays) and one week of remote working per quarter

  • Lunch voucher (£10) every day for JustEat and free dinner on those days where you need to work later

  • Twice weekly deliveries of fresh fruit and an extensive selection of snacks and drinks

  • YuLife subscription, allowing you to turn your daily steps and meditation into discounts at a range of stores

Disclaimer - We use Granola, an AI notetaker, throughout our interview process to help capture notes. It's used only for note-taking during the conversation. Transcripts aren't saved to shared drives or stored externally. Let us know if you'd prefer we don't.

Compensation: £80K – £110K • Offers Equity

title: Senior Product Manager, Technical (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the Company

Affinidi is a technology company dedicated to changing data ownership for good. We empower businesses and individuals with control and ownership of their data, with a comprehensive approach to managing their holistic identity – accounting for all aspects of their digital footprint while ensuring privacy and security.

Affinidi’s technology enables users to benefit from decentralised digital identity solutions. We believe that everyone has the right to own and control their data, and we are committed to creating a trusted digital credentials ecosystem that empowers businesses and individuals to securely exchange data and services across borders and industries.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager (Technical) who wants to help define how trust is built into the next generation of AI systems. At Affinidi, we’re building the Trust Fabric product suite to give AI agents verifiable identity, policy guardrails, and real-time observability, so organisations can move from promising proofs of concept to secure, governed production deployments with confidence. 

This is a role for builders. You’ll work side by side with engineering to turn ambitious ideas into real, high-impact products, fast, iteratively, and with strong product judgment. You’ll take on complex, ambiguous challenges that don’t come with a playbook, bring structure to what matters, and help the team move with clarity, speed, and conviction. You’ll also collaborate with deeply engaged teams and senior leaders in an environment that expects high standards, values ownership, and gives you the chance to shape meaningful products from the ground up. 

If you like combining technical depth, product thinking, and execution, you’ll fit right in. 

What you’ll be doing 

  • Shape and deliver solutions: Partner closely with engineers to define and refine solutions early, helping move ideas from concept to production in practical, incremental steps while staying close enough to implementation to understand trade-offs and guide decisions. 
  • Drive focused, outcome-oriented delivery:Balance user needs, market context, and execution speed while focusing on getting working solutions into users’ hands for validation, then iterate based on feedback and measurable outcomes. 
  • Work through ambiguity: Take ownership of areas where requirements are not fully defined, structure problems into clear, actionable paths forward, and maintain momentum even as direction continues to evolve. 
  • Own product direction:Contribute to product strategy and roadmap definition, align short-term priorities with longer-term platform thinking, and make thoughtful trade-offs that support both delivery and scalability. 
  • Collaborate across stakeholders: Work across engineering, design, and go-to-market teams, engage effectively with senior and executive stakeholders, and bring alignment and clarity in environments with diverse perspectives. 
  • Be developer-obsessed: Understand developer workflows and key pain points, and help improve integration, usability, and the overall product experience. 

 What we’re looking for 

  • Core experience: You bring 5+ years of experience in Technical Product Management, a strong technical background that lets you engage deeply with engineering topics, hands-on experience working with APIs, systems, and integrations, and a proven track record of delivering products in close collaboration with engineering teams. 
  • Technical depth: You are comfortable understanding how systems are designed and operate in practice, able to engage in technical discussions, challenge assumptions, and evaluate trade-offs, and willing to go into detail when needed by reviewing flows, investigating issues, or clarifying implementation approaches. 
  • Mindset: You take ownership from problem to outcome, are comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving priorities, combine structured thinking with a bias toward action, and can move between big-picture strategy and practical execution. 
  • Collaboration & communication: You communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, are comfortable working with experienced, highly engaged stakeholders, and know how to build alignment and drive decisions forward. 
  • Nice to have: It’s a plus if you have had exposure to identity, distributed systems, or similar domains, and experience in fast-paced, product-led environments. 

What you’ll get 

  • A team that values ownership, quality, and speed 
  • Close collaboration between product and engineering 
  • Hybrid working model in Berlin + flexible hours 
  • Unlimited vacation 
  • Competitive compensation 
  • A strong environment to learn, build, and have impact 

Equal Opportunity 

We believe in hiring different and diverse talent and providing a safe space where everyone can share their views without fear, where differences are celebrated, and where no one is left out. Inclusive cultures are the foundation for collaboration and innovation within our team. 

Privacy Notice

By applying for this position, you confirm that you have read and understood Affinidi’s Candidate Privacy Policy, and consent to the collection, use, and disclosure of your personal data for recruitment purposes, as described in the policy.

title: Senior Product Manager - Trading
descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

The Role:

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager, Rosso.

This is the second product manager on Rosso, reporting into the Rosso Product Lead. Rosso is deeply technical, built on ML-led models and complex engineering covering forecasting, pricing optimisation and portfolio balancing, so this is a role for a technically-minded PM who's happiest closest to the hardest problems. You'll work on complex, important problems as they arise across the Rosso product surface, alongside the other PM on the team, rather than owning one fixed patch. In the near term that means the portfolio area: fulfilling and balancing a growing two-sided portfolio, managing imbalance, and finding the revenue and margin in every position we hold. It's still forming, it carries live financial risk, and it needs someone who wants to win in it.

You will:

  • Take business and customer needs and turn them into feasible, shipped product, working closely enough to the ML and forecasting work to make good calls on it.

  • Own the technical-product detail, setting clear success criteria for how well a model or forecast needs to perform, and designing for the edge cases and operational reality of a system carrying live financial risk.

  • Drive open product decisions to a close - yours and the team's - so delivery keeps moving at pace, with a clear Now, Next and Future for the initiatives you own.

🚀 Responsibilities:

Turn needs into shipped product

  • Take business and customer needs and turn them into feasible product execution, balancing them against nascent ML and forecasting innovations that push the frontier of what's possible.

  • Take initiatives from discovery through to regularly released product, with a clear Now, Next and Future for a given area.

  • Drive open product decisions to a close, so work keeps moving.

  • Decide what to formalise, what stays a prototype and what to drop - be the editor and builder, not just the instigator.

Own the technical-product detail

  • Work embedded in full-stack teams that include ML/data science and software engineers, close enough to the models to make good calls.

  • Set clear success criteria for how well a model or forecast needs to perform for the product to work, and design for the edge cases and operational reality of a system that carries live financial risk.

  • Pull and interrogate your own and others' data to influence and inform decisions, and reason about model performance and error as business indicators.

  • Get close to the people who use what you build, from internal commercial teams to generators and businesses externally.

Win in the portfolio

  • Concentrate, in the near term, on the portfolio area while it's still forming, without that becoming a permanent boundary on where you work.

  • Treat hedging, imbalance and trading decisions as product decisions: when to hold a position, when to trade it out, when to reprice to close a gap in the portfolio.

  • Find the tangible and most pressing problems worth solving - such as whether to buy or build a new forecasting capability, or how to ensure Rosso reacts at scale to any event in the system.

  • Chase the commercial outcome, not just the shipped feature - the measure of this role is margin found and risk managed, at pace.

🎯 Requirements:

Must haves

  • A product manager with real product execution behind them: owned at least one complex product area end to end, with a track record of moving real business outcomes, not just shipping features.

  • Commercial drive. You set the pace for yourself and the people around you, push decisions to a close, and go after revenue and margin. You want to win, and it shows in how you work.

  • Experience in or around trading. Energy trading is the ideal, but financial trading, fintech, battery or EV trading all count - you understand positions, hedging and what it means for a system to carry live financial risk.

  • Uses data analysis throughout the product process, to validate ideas, progress work, and measure success.

  • ML-literate: has worked closely enough with ML and data science to make good calls on model-led products, and can reason about model performance and error as business indicators.

  • Built product in a startup, scaleup or other high-growth environment, with high personal ownership of an area.

  • A strong instinct for failure points, edge cases and the operational reality of a live system.

  • AI-native, AI-literate and AI-critical - you know where it helps and where it hurts.

  • A clear, structured communicator, especially in writing.

Bonus points

  • Hands-on energy trading experience - intraday, day-ahead, imbalance or battery optimisation.

  • Experience where forecasting or fulfilling a two-sided marketplace is central to the product.

  • Experience going through a third-party-access and/or international-expansion transition.

  • Experience with regulated industries and data-heavy products.

✨ Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive salary - our current band for this role is £85,000-£93,000 or equivalent in local currency.

  • Stock Options - everyone on the team has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday + public holidays - Swap public holidays for ones that matter most to you. Plus, get an extra day off for your birthday 🎉.

  • Remote & flexible working - We're fully remote with clear core hours, and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Home working & wellbeing budgets:

    • Up to £1,200 / €1,200 annually to upgrade your remote setup (co-working passes, equipment, etc.).

    • Up to £150 / €150 monthly on anything that supports your wellbeing - from therapy to gym memberships to meditation apps.

 

🗣️ Interview Process:

Our processes normally take around 2-3 weeks from first call to offer - please let us know about any adjustments to timelines that may be required.

  1. First call with our Talent Team (30 Mins). This is to understand your experience, motivations, and discuss the role in more detail.

  2. Behaviour Interview with our Product Lead (45 Mins). This is your chance to really understand the role, the expectations, and ensure alignment on ways of working.

  3. Technical Interview with the Team (75 Mins). You’ll meet with potential peers to discuss how you drive product execution, work closely with ML and engineering teams, and think through real product scenarios - built around a real product decision shaped by a model or forecast, so we're testing on proof, not assertion.

  4. Bar Raiser Interview with Stakeholders (45 Mins). The final session will be with two cross-functional stakeholders, and will explore how your values align with ours, and is designed to be a genuine two-way conversation, your chance to understand what it’s really like to work at tem.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

Compensation: £85K – £93K • Offers Equity

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

The Opportunity

Billions have gone into enterprise AI. Most of it isn't working — organisations still can't turn model capability into measurable business impact. That's not a training problem or a slide-deck problem. It's a hard, unsolved technical challenge: building the systems that translate what AI can do into how work actually gets done inside real organisations, at scale, with proof it's working. That's the problem Multiverse exists to solve, and it's the one this role exists to sell.

Multiverse is seeking an exceptional Senior Product Marketing Manager to drive growth across both sides of our marketplace: attracting industry-leading enterprise partners and shaping a best-in-class platform experience for our learners.

  • Establish success metrics and analyse product performance, reporting to key stakeholders and using data to refine messaging and GTM strategies.

  • Own competitive landscape analysis, becoming an expert on market trends to help shape the product roadmap.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to align teams, deliver effective launches, and maintain trust with high-expectation stakeholders.

  • Champion the voice of the customer in product and commercial decisions via research, feedback, and market analysis, collaborating with external research partners when useful.

About you:

  • 5+ years of relevant product marketing experience, including close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Marketing stakeholders.

  • Track record of impact and excellence leading product marketing or strategy initiatives at hyper-growth companies.

  • Proactive, effective communicator who adapts easily to changing priorities within a diverse, distributed team.

  • Positive-sum mentality, balancing high-level strategic reflection with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and execute.

  • Motivated by high-expectation stakeholders, with a proven ability to earn and retain trust through challenges.

  • High internal expectations for what is possible, coupled with the ability to bring others along on that journey.

  • Confident user of AI to improve the speed and quality of your work, raising the bar for what is possible within the team.

title: Senior Prototype Machinist
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

[Deutsche Version weiter unten]

Your Mission

At The Exploration Company, we develop, manufacture, and operate Nyx — a modular, reusable orbital spacecraft designed to be refuelled in orbit and transport cargo, with crewed missions potentially planned for the longer term.

We’re looking for a hands-on, technically mature professional with an engineering degree or extensive CNC experience to take full ownership of the machining process for space-grade components. You’ll be responsible for CAM programming, machine setup and optimisation, and continuous improvement. You’ll also contribute directly to future investments in machining equipment and tooling.

You’ll work on a variety of high-precision parts, including rocket engine components, post-processed metal 3D-printed parts, and critical propulsion subcomponents. You’ll work across a fleet of modern, multi-brand, 5-axis machining centres and CNC lathes.

This role offers a high-impact technical position, with opportunities for career growth and increased responsibility.

Fluency in English is expected, as our work environment is international.

Your Responsibilities

  • Define and optimise machining strategies, including sequencing, tooling, fixtures, and in-process controls.

  • Program complex components in HyperMill or equivalent CAM software for 5-axis milling and CNC turning.

  • Validate parts using multi-brand CNC equipment, ensuring that they meet tolerance and surface-finish requirements.

  • Manufacture rocket engine components, precision assemblies, propulsion subcomponents, and Inconel structures, including setting workpiece origins and preparing cutting tools.

  • Perform first-line maintenance to keep machines in good working order.

  • Analyse and improve toolpaths, reduce cycle times, and stabilise machining quality.

  • Work with design, quality, and production teams to provide feedback, propose design improvements, and troubleshoot issues.

  • Lead equipment investment efforts, including specification development, supplier coordination, and commissioning.

Profile

  • An engineering degree or 5+ years of experience as a highly skilled technician in CNC/CAM machining of complex parts.

  • Expertise in HyperMill or equivalent CAM software and tight-tolerance machining.

  • Solid knowledge of 5-axis milling and/or precision turning.

  • Experience working with space or aerospace materials, such as Inconel, titanium, and other high-performance alloys.

  • An autonomous, hands-on approach, with the ability to structure and lead technical topics.

  • An interest in developing machining capabilities through process and equipment leadership.

Deutsche Version

Deine Mission

Bei The Exploration Company entwickeln, fertigen und betreiben wir Nyx – ein modulares, wiederverwendbares Orbitalfahrzeug, das im All betankt werden und Fracht transportieren kann. Langfristig sind auch bemannte Missionen vorgesehen.

Wir suchen eine praxisorientierte, technisch versierte Persönlichkeit mit einem Ingenieurabschluss oder umfangreicher CNC-Erfahrung, die den gesamten Bearbeitungsprozess für weltraumtaugliche Komponenten eigenverantwortlich übernimmt. Du bist für die CAM-Programmierung, das Einrichten und Optimieren der Maschinen sowie die kontinuierliche Prozessverbesserung verantwortlich. Darüber hinaus wirkst du direkt an zukünftigen Investitionen in Bearbeitungstechnik und Werkzeuge mit.

Du arbeitest an unterschiedlichsten hochpräzisen Bauteilen – darunter Komponenten für Raketentriebwerke, nachbearbeitete Metall-3D-Druckteile und kritische Subkomponenten von Antriebssystemen. Dabei nutzt du einen modernen Maschinenpark mit 5-Achs-Bearbeitungszentren und CNC-Drehmaschinen verschiedener Hersteller.

Diese Position bietet dir eine technisch anspruchsvolle Aufgabe mit hoher Wirkung sowie die Möglichkeit, künftig zusätzliche Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt, da unser Arbeitsumfeld international geprägt ist.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Bearbeitungsstrategien definieren und optimieren, einschließlich Bearbeitungsreihenfolge, Werkzeugauswahl, Vorrichtungen und prozessbegleitender Qualitätskontrolle

  • Komplexe Bauteile in HyperMill (oder ähnlicher Software) programmieren, einschließlich 5-Achs-Fräsen und CNC-Drehen

  • Bauteile auf CNC-Maschinen verschiedener Hersteller validieren und dabei Maßhaltigkeit sowie Oberflächenqualität sicherstellen

  • Raketentriebwerkskomponenten, präzise Subkomponenten von Antriebssystemen und Inconel-Strukturen fertigen, einschließlich der Einrichtung von Werkstücknullpunkten und der Vorbereitung der Schneidwerkzeuge

  • Erstwartungs- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten durchführen, um die Maschinen in einwandfreiem Zustand zu halten

  • Werkzeugwege analysieren und verbessern, Bearbeitungszeiten reduzieren und eine stabile Bearbeitungsqualität sicherstellen

  • Mit den Teams aus Konstruktion, Qualitätssicherung und Produktion zusammenarbeiten, um Feedback zu geben, Konstruktionsvorschläge einzubringen und technische Probleme zu lösen

  • Investitionsprojekte für Maschinen und Anlagen vorantreiben – von der Spezifikation über die Koordination mit Lieferanten bis hin zur Inbetriebnahme

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Ingenieurstudium oder mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung als hochqualifizierterTechniker im Bereich CNC/CAM für komplexe Bauteile

  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit HyperMill oder vergleichbaren CAM-Systemen sowie in der Bearbeitung mit engen Toleranzen

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse im 5-Achs-Fräsen und/oder Präzisionsdrehen

  • Erfahrung mit Werkstoffen aus der Raumfahrt- bzw. Luft- und Raumfahrtindustrie, insbesondere Inconel, Titan und Hochleistungslegierungen

  • Selbstständige und praxisorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Themen zu strukturieren und voranzutreiben

  • Interesse daran, den Ausbau unserer Fertigungskompetenzen durch die Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Anlagen aktiv mitzugestalten

Warum The Exploration Company?

  • Eine ganzheitliche Aufgabe – von der Vorbereitung bis zur Auslieferung – mit hoher Eigenverantwortung

  • Direkte Mitwirkung an der Fertigung von Raumfahrtkomponenten der nächsten Generation

  • Die Möglichkeit, eine moderne Fertigungswerkstatt mit aufzubauen und zukünftige Industrieinvestitionen zu verantworten

  • Klare Entwicklungsperspektiven in Richtung technische Leitung oder Management innerhalb eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens

  • Ein multikulturelles, internationales Team, das sich leidenschaftlich für die Erforschung des Weltraums begeistert

The Exploration Company ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert und sich der Vielfalt verpflichtet.

  • Unterstützung beim Umzug, einschließlich Visa-Unterstützung bei Bedarf, ist verfügbar.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

  • Experience developing and executing reliability or qualification plans

  • A strong understanding of reliability testing, life testing and product qualification principles

  • The ability to analyse complex datasets and turn them into practical engineering conclusions

title: Senior Sales Support Technician
descriptionHtml:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are looking to add a Senior Sales Support Technician to our team. In this position, you will support the preparation, setup, and execution of aerospace communications demonstrations, field tests, and customer engagement activities. Working closely with the Sales Consultant and engineering teams, this role assists in deploying and operating satellite communication systems, RF hardware, ground station equipment, and related technologies used to demonstrate product capabilities to prospective customers and partners.

This position plays an important role in supporting technical demonstrations, validating system performance in real-world environments, and ensuring equipment and systems are properly configured for successful customer engagements. The Communications Technician will also support equipment maintenance, test preparation, and troubleshooting activities while helping translate technical system capabilities into successful customer demonstration experiences.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Support the preparation, setup, and operation of aerospace communication systems used in customer demonstrations and technical presentations.
  • Assist with deployment and configuration of ground station equipment, antennas, RF systems, satellite communication terminals, and related hardware.
  • Participate in field demonstrations, trade shows, and customer engagement events to help showcase system capabilities.
  • Work closely with Sales Consultants and technical teams to ensure demonstrations accurately represent system performance and capabilities.
  • Prepare and configure communications equipment, hardware, and software prior to customer demonstrations or test activities.
  • Assist in validating system performance and verifying that equipment is operating correctly prior to demonstrations.
  • Support integration and connectivity between ground systems, communication payloads, software tools, and network infrastructure.
  • Maintain demonstration equipment, test hardware, and supporting tools to ensure readiness for field use.
  • Assist with diagnosing and resolving technical issues during demonstration activities or system testing.
  • Provide hands-on support for RF systems, communication equipment, network connectivity, and hardware integration.
  • Coordinate with engineering teams to address system issues or performance anomalies discovered during demonstrations or testing.
  • Manage inventory, transport, and preparation of demonstration equipment used for customer engagements.
  • Ensure proper handling, packaging, and transport of sensitive technical equipment.
  • Support logistics planning for field deployments, including shipping, equipment preparation, and setup coordination.
  • Support Sales Consultants during technical discussions with customers by assisting with equipment setup and system operation.
  • Help demonstrate system functionality and capabilities during live customer demonstrations.
  • Assist in documenting demonstration results and gathering feedback to support future product improvements.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, and business development teams to ensure demonstration environments accurately reflect product capabilities.
  • Provide feedback to engineering teams regarding demonstration performance, usability, and potential improvements.
  • Support internal testing and validation activities when demonstrations require integration with engineering prototypes or development systems.

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • Associate degree or technical certification in Electronics, Communications Technology, Telecommunications, or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years of industry experience in engineering, systems development, or program/project management roles within aerospace, space, or defense industries.
  • Experience managing cross-functional engineering and operations teams in complex technical programs.
  • Basic understanding of RF communications, satellite communications, or wireless communication systems.
  • Ability to set up and operate technical equipment used in communications demonstrations or testing environments.
  • Familiarity with antennas, ground station equipment, or network connectivity systems preferred.
  • Strong troubleshooting and hands-on technical problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with both technical teams and customer-facing personnel.

    • PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
  • Proficiency in German and English (both written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.
  • Knowledge of market analytics and technology planning and commercialization.
  • Experience with the aerospace telecommunications industry.
  • Experience with startups.
    • CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills.

title: Senior Security Architect
descriptionHtml:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

What you'll be doing
This role does the hands-on architecture work. You design the secure patterns engineering builds against, review hard problems in depth, and help make secure-by-design real across the Hyperblock and Polaris platform and the AI product surface. You work closely with the Principal Security Architect, who sets the technical bar. You own significant areas of that work and deliver them end to end. Engineers adopt good architecture because it is the better path. You will build that kind of architecture, working on problems that carry real risk.

Anaplan is not a simple SaaS application. The platform performs highly dimensional, enterprise-scale modelling with responsive recalculation and strong correctness expectations. The technical surface includes the legacy Hyperblock engine, the newer Polaris engine, and a growing set of AI products. These include CoModeler for AI-assisted model building and CoPlanner for conversational planning support.

Enterprise customers in regulated industries increasingly ask a hard question: if Anaplan is breached, can Anaplan staff or an attacker read their data? Answering it takes rigorous architecture work. We are commissioning an independent Trail of Bits assessment of exactly this. It covers end-to-end tenant isolation, the proposed BYOK design, and internal infrastructure boundaries. You will help turn findings like these into concrete design changes. That includes moving key management from legacy HSM-based designs to Vault, and extending encryption coverage to storage and data paths that lack an agreed architecture today.

What you'll do
• Produce reference architectures: design and maintain security patterns for platform and AI components, working to the standards set by the Principal.
• Contribute to identity and authorisation design: including tenant isolation, service-to-service trust, and authorisation for AI agents and analyst-style workflows.
• Apply cryptography and key management: work on encryption, BYOK and key custody. Be clear about where data is plaintext, who can use keys, and what each control protects against.
• Design AI guardrails: input and output controls, tool and authorisation boundaries, and prompt-injection and abuse defences. Draw on MITRE ATLAS and the OWASP LLM Top 10.
• Run threat models: lead them on high-risk systems, working with engineers to trace trust boundaries and compromise paths. Turn the findings into prioritised, actionable design changes.
• Support external assessments: prepare architecture evidence, join discovery sessions with engineering, and check that what is built matches what is documented.
• Improve the supply chain and attack surface: build integrity and provenance, hardened images, and less exposed surface.
• Stay hands-on: write and review designs and prototypes, and test your own work.
• Grow the practice: mentor engineers, contribute to standards, and help turn design decisions into enforceable guidance.

What we're looking for
• Solid experience in secure software architecture, with depth in at least two of: cryptography and key management, identity and authorisation, tenant isolation, and threat modelling.
• A working understanding of AI and ML security, and of how LLM-driven features change identity, authorisation, supply chain, and verification.
• The ability to design and review real systems, and to defend your decisions to strong engineers.
• A record of influencing engineers without formal authority, including when risk and delivery pressure conflict.
• Experience with enterprise-scale SaaS or cloud-first systems, ideally multi-tenant.
• Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain architecture honestly to engineers, leadership, and customers.

Nice to have
• Experience with Vault, KMS/HSM, or BYOK/HYOK designs.
• Experience designing for regulated environments, such as FedRAMP.
• Contributions to NIST, ISO, or OWASP, or talks and published research.
• An offensive grounding that you use to pressure-test designs.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to ----- before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer — Token Factory (Inference Platform)
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Token Factory is a part of  Nebius Cloud, one of the world’s largest GPU clouds, running tens of thousands of GPUs. We are building an inference platform that makes every kind of foundation model — text, vision, audio, and emerging multimodal architectures — fast, reliable, and effortless to deploy at massive scale. To deliver on that promise, we need an engineer who can make the platform behave flawlessly under extreme load and recover gracefully when the unexpected happens.

In this role you will own the reliability, performance, and observability of the entire inference stack. Your day starts with designing and refining telemetry pipelines — metrics, logs, and traces that turn hundreds of terabytes of signal into clear, actionable insight. From there you might tune Kubernetes autoscalers to squeeze more efficiency out of GPUs, craft Terraform modules that bake resilience into every new cluster, or harden our request-routing and retry logic so even transient failures go unnoticed by users. When incidents do arise, you’ll rely on the automation and runbooks you helped create to detect, isolate, and remediate problems in minutes, then drive the post-mortem culture that prevents recurrence. All of this effort points toward a single goal: scaling the platform smoothly while hitting aggressive cost and reliability targets.

Success in the role calls for deep fluency with Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, Terraform, and the craft of infrastructure-as-code. You script comfortably in Python or Bash, understand the nuances of alert design and SLOs for high-throughput APIs, and have spent enough time in production to know how distributed back-ends fail in the real world. Experience shepherding GPU-heavy workloads — whether with vLLM, Triton, Ray, or another accelerator stack — will serve you well, as will a background in MLOps or model-hosting platforms. Above all, you care about building self-healing systems, thrive on debugging performance from kernel to application layer, and enjoy collaborating with software engineers to turn reliability into a feature users never have to think about.

If the idea of safeguarding the infrastructure that powers tomorrow’s multimodal AI energizes you, we’d love to hear your story.

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI
